objects.text: Aliases: White Fox Age: Unknown, appears to be early 30s Gender: Female Background Ami Han was born as one of the last Kumiho, a species of Korean dokkaebi that was hunted to near extinction by an alliance of humans and Samjokgu, their natural predators. Han was offered a position at the South Korean National Intelligence Service, and became one of their best operatives and eventually the director of NIS. She has also served on and worked alongside several superhero teams such as Tiger Division and the Agents of Atlas. Powers Her Kumiho heritage gives her superhuman physical charateristics, including enough strength to smash apart drones designed by Tony Stark, speed fast enough to dodge a Hulk, and durability to tank attacks from Maestro, a stronger version of Bruce Banner. Possesses senses of such power that she can detect traces of extradimensional energy. Can also communicate with animals, hypnotize people with her voice, extend and retract claws on her fingertips, and can transform into her nine tailed fox Kumiho form. Can also absorb life force using the Yaewoo Guseul, or Fox Marble. Is a highly skilled hand to hand combatant and intelligence operative, to the point where she became the director of South Korea’s National Intelligence Service while also leading their superhero team Tiger Division. Is fluent in at least 6 languages, including Greek and English. Wields a battle stave with a telescoping mechanism.
objects.title: White Fox (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Dazzler Age: Likely mid-twenties to early thirties Gender: Female Background: After rejecting the career in law her father planned out for her, Alison became a world-famous singer. She makes use of her mutant ability to to create special effects. Powers: Alison is an alpha level mutant with the ability to transform sound waves into light. She can also absorb and store sound inside her body to release later as either sound waves or light. Consequently, she is immune to light and sonic-based attacks.
objects.title: Alison Blaire (Marvel)

addons.text:
You now have gained access to the entire roster of Normandy crew members, past and present, across all iterations of the ship. This includes experts from every field: warriors like Garrus Vakarian, biotic prodigies like Liara T’Soni, engineers like Tali’Zorah vas Normandy, medics like Dr. Chakwas, and strategists like Miranda Lawson. Each crew member comes with their peak skills, weaponry, and abilities.

Furthermore, you can add additional crew members from other parts of Mass Effect lore, including Mass Effect: Andromeda, as well as key characters from the Mass Effect books and comics. These crew members do not need to originate from the same time period, allowing you to recruit pioneers like Ryder’s squad—such as Cora Harper and Drack—or historical figures like Kastanie Drescher of the First Contact War. Each addition brings unique skills, knowledge, and expertise, ensuring your crew remains unmatched in strength, diversity, and capability across all eras.
addons.title: “You Were Born To Do This"

addons.text: You can now select any Mass Effect ship in the galaxy to act as your home base. Whether it’s the original Normandy SR-1, the sleek Normandy SR-2, or another iconic vessel like the Everest or Destiny Ascension, it will be equipped with all the advanced technology and upgrades necessary to support your crew and missions.
addons.title: Destiny Ascension

objects.text:
Name: Commander J. Shepard
Alias: None
Gender: Male/Female 
Sex: Male/Female 
Age: 32 (as of the Reaper War)

Power: Shepard (Mass Effect) is the core ability of Commander J. Shepard, embodying their unmatched mastery in the Soldier, Biotic, and Engineer specializations. This versatile skillset has made them unmatched as a Specter agent, leader, and diplomat. As an N7 Soldier, Shepard excels in all forms of combat, demonstrating mastery of every weapon type—from assault rifles to heavy weapons—combined with extraordinary durability, stamina, and reflexes that allow them to thrive in even the most harrowing conditions.

As a Biotic, Shepard wields incredible power and precision, capable of manipulating gravity to tear apart dreadnought-class armor or perform intricate tasks like removing a single wire from a complex device from across the room.As an Engineer, Shepard possesses unparalleled technical expertise, excelling in hacking, drone deployment, and deploying tech abilities like Overload and Incinerate to neutralize shields, dismantle armor, and shut down synthetic adversaries with ease.

Shepard is always outfitted with state-of-the-art N7 armor, advanced weaponry, Biotic amplifiers, and a customized Omni-Tool, ensuring they are fully prepared for any challenge the galaxy throws at them.

Appearance: Handsome/Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Citadel Council Spectre Agent
Quality of Life: Poor (Constantly in dangerous situations, has the weight of the entire galaxy on their shoulders, often ignored by superiors)
objects.title: Commander Shepard (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
Name: EDI (Enhanced Defense Intelligence)
Alias: None
Gender: Female-programmed
Sex: Female-humanoid platform
Age: less than 5 years (as of the Reaper War)

Power: EDI is a highly advanced AI capable of high-level hacking, real-time data analysis, and unmatched computational speed, enabling her to outthink and outmaneuver nearly any opponent. When integrated into a starship’s systems, she optimizes navigation, enhances stealth technology, and improves mission efficiency. Additionally, her ability to control drones and robotic units expands her effectiveness on the battlefield.

In her humanoid platform, EDI demonstrates superhuman strength, durability, and precision, along with her normal abilities to interface with technology near instantaneously. Her fusion of physical power and superior intelligence makes her an exceptionally versatile and formidable combatant.

Appearance: Beautiful Humanoid Platform
Civilian Identity: Normandy’s AI
Quality of Life: Life Has Its Ups and Downs (Previously lobotomized in order to be controlled, faces frequent mistrust from people outside of Normandy crew, developed extremely close friendships with crew-mates)
objects.title: EDI (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
Name: Urdnot Wrex
Alias: None
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Over 1,400 years old

Power: Wrex’s physical capabilities are extraordinary, with superhuman strength, durability, and regenerative abilities unique to Krogan physiology. His biotic powers allow him to unleash devastating attacks, such as Warp to destabilize opponents, Barrier for added defense, and Throw to hurl enemies across the battlefield.

Wrex’s skill with weaponry is unmatched, particularly in the use of shotguns, which he wields with deadly precision. His centuries of experience as a mercenary and warlord has made him a master battlefield tactician, capable of outfighting even the most fearsome of adversaries.

Appearance: Attractive by his species’ standards, Ugly by human standards
Civilian Identity: Leader of Clan Urdnot
Quality of Life: Poor (Centuries of violence and betrayal, Found a new life’s purpose, Faces constant challenges in uniting his people)
objects.title: Urdnot Wrex (Mass Effect)

addons.text: Now instead of just the 'singular' Geth platform Legion, you also gain a Platoon of twenty Geth Prime's, these heavily armed and shielded pieces of hardware provide combat boosts to any other Geth platforms in the area, while being formidable combat assets themselves.
addons.title: Geth Prime Platoon

addons.text: With this you don't just get the 'singular' Geth platform Legion, you also gain a Corp of Geth platforms alongside them. All of these platforms are armed, shielded and built to withstand the rigors of combat. On the battlefield, their ability to share data on enemy tactics and positions, coupled with a large quantity of "expendable" drones and turrets, makes them a formidable threat.
addons.title: Geth Corps

objects.text: Aliases: Geth, Infiltrait0rN7 Gender: Agender Age: NA Background Legion is a unique mobile Geth platform designed to operate outside Geth space and interact with organic life. The specific platform was created after Commander Shepard’s destruction of the Reaper known as “Sovereign,” and was dispatched to investigate numerous worlds visited by Shepard, ultimately ending on Alchera at the site of the Normandy SR-1 crash, where it salvaged a piece of the Commander’s N7 armor to repair damage to the platform. Legion encounters the Commander on a derelict Reaper, assisting in the retrieval of the Reaper IFF and eventually joining Shepard’s crew for the suicide mission beyond the Omega-4 relay. Following the Suicide Mission and the arrival of the Reapers, Legion can once again be encountered, assisting Commander Shepard in various ways to free the Geth from Reaper control, before attempting to upgrade the Geth by disseminating the 1,183 programs to the Geth Consensus. Powers Legion is a gestalt consciousness formed by 1,183 unique programs from the Geth Consensus, inhabiting a unique Geth infiltrator "Mobile Platform" As an artificial intelligence operating a robotic body, Legion excels with Hacking, Combat Drones, & Sniper Rifles. Coupled with powerful kinetic barriers.
objects.title: Legion (Mass Effect)

addons.text: Tali’Zorah now comes with a universal cure for the Quarian immune deficiency and no longer requires her environmental protection suit. This reproducible cure also grants others the ability to metabolize both dextro- and levo-amino-based foods, allowing Quarians to easily live on any type of garden world.
addons.title: Quarian Immunity Booster

objects.text:
Name: Tali'Zorah vas Normandy (formerly nar Rayya)
Alias: None
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 24 (as of End of Reaper War)

Power: Tali is a brilliant Quarian engineer and tech specialist, excelling in hacking, repairs, drone operation, and optimizing advanced systems. In combat, she utilizes a range of tech-based abilities, including deploying combat drones, disabling enemy shields, and sabotaging enemy systems. However, her Quarian physiology comes with significant limitations—she requires dextro-amino food and has a severely weakened immune system, making even a single breach in her environmental suit potentially fatal. Despite these challenges, her intelligence, resourcefulness, and tactical expertise make her an invaluable ally.

Appearance: Unknown
Civilian Identity: Researcher and Soldier
Quality of Life: Poor (Species exiled from homeworld, Species discriminated against across galaxy, Constant fear of death from suit tear)
objects.title: Tali'Zorah nar Rayya (Mass Effect)

objects.text: Age: 29 Gender: Male Background Garrus was born in Palaven to a C-Sect father. Always taught about doing his duties and the importance of law and justice, he eventually grew to learn that the first did not always bring the later. Eventually leaving his job as a detective to help save the galaxy, Garrus decided to take justice by his own hands by being vigilant. Despite later being betrayed by one of his colleagues and carrying the wounds from it - both physical and emotional - Garrus is a jovial man, sarcastic and good natured, loyal to those he calls friends. Powers Power: Garrus is from the Turian Hierarchy, a people known for their reach and flexibility discipline. Trained since a young age, he had mandatory military training near adulthood and later became a capable police detective. He is a terrific sniper, able to hit moving targets far away easily, and is an apt hacker and combat engineer. Additionally, he is a great squad commander and dancer.
objects.title: Garrus Vakarian (Mass Effect)

objects.text: Alias: The Shadow Broker Age: 109 Gender: Non-Binary Background Liara was an archeologist that studied the extinct Prothean empire. When she learned the true reason for their disappearance, she joined forces with the Normandy crews and helped save the galaxy from the Reapers. Deciding to work as an info broker to help to prepare the galaxy to the inevitable threat of the Reapers, Liara eventually stole the identity of the Shadow Broker, the greatest broker in the galaxy. Though still a loving person, she is now far from the once timid and naive archeologist she once was. Liara now is a hardened veteran, using her gifts and tools to prepare the galaxy to its imminent war for survival. Powers Liara is an asari, a species renowned for their biotics—the ability to manipulate mass. She can increase or reduce mass, move objects in a way similar to telekinesis, create small singularities that tear material and people apart, generate barriers to protect herself or allies, lock enemies in place, and utilize many other applications. She is also a professional archaeologist with decades of experience and a skilled information broker, able to extract valuable intelligence and manage a network of informants.
objects.title: Liara T'Soni (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
Alias: None
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 26

Power: Vetra is a skilled survivor, fighter, and scavenger. She grew up in rough environments, working dangerous jobs to protect her sister and stay alive. In combat, she’s tough, resourceful, and reliable—great with shotguns, rifles, and field gadgets. She knows how to modify her gear and adapt to any situation, using cover and tech to stay one step ahead.

Outside of combat, she’s a talented negotiator and fixer. She can talk her way through tense situations, make deals, and find supplies no one else can. She’s not flashy, but she always gets the job done—and once you earn her trust, she’ll do anything to protect you.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Pathfinder Team Provisioner, Smuggler Turned Survivalist
Quality of Life: Mixed
objects.title: Vetra Nyx (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
Nickname: Peebee

Gender: Female
Age: 100 and change
Appearance: Beautiful

Power: Peebee is an Asari, a long-lived alien species, capable of living for approximately a thousand years. Each Asari is also a natural biotic, capable of creating gravity-manipulation fields.
objects.title: Pelessaria B'Sayle (Mass Effect)

addons.text:
Due to you already having a connection with Mazingers you and Team Z experience a special resonance that open up new possibilities.

First is that you are able to upgrade the girls and strengthen their abilities or give them new ones, how this works is that you design upgrades for Mazinger Z, Great Mazinger and Grendizer like the normal giant robot version of themselves. Once finished you hand the girls the designs specifically for them and with a flash of Photon Power they will have their upgrades, keep in mind how the upgrades look will largely be up to the girls and tend to look cute while manifesting differently. Such as instead of transforming into a golden fist for the Big Bang Punch Z-Chan's regular Rocket Punch will turn golden or she summons a giant golden fist.

Any resources you have on hand for the upgrade (scaled to the size of the girls) will be consumed with the light of Photon Power.

A knock on effect of this is the girls also benefit from any Minion boosting powers you have like 'A Master's Servant' and I hope it haunts you' without you controlling them and you can empower them further by sharing your energy with them, a normal person could give each girl two boosts to double their power each time before being brought to their knees barely able to stay conscious. If sick or generally frail than you can only give each girl one boost.

The second new possibility that has opened up is that Team Z can transform into their respectful Mecha selves albeit with more feminine designs, while in these forms at minimal all aspects of themselves such as power, defence, luck and a long list of other things will see a massive severalfold increase.​
addons.title: RGZ + INFINITY!!!

objects.text:
Names: Z-Chan (Mazinger Z), Gre-Chan (Great Mazinger) and Grenda-San (Grendizer)
Alignment: Chaotic (?) Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown (16 - 18)

Powers: A Moe anthropomorphism version of Mazinger Z, Great Mazinger and Grendizer these girls are able to use the powers of these great mechanical titans with each possessing the power to easily destroy cities and take similar attacks with minimal damage. Due to their status as comedic versions of these mecha they all have Rule of Funny applied to them so while they can get up into comedic situations it tends to work out in the end for them and you.

Appearance: Beautiful.
Civilian Life: High School Student, Part-Time Job
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Robot Girls Team Z! (Mazinger)

objects.text: Alias: Mega Man, Mega, Rockman Age: Built as 10 years old. Gender: Male Background Rock was initially built as an assistant to Doctor Light, alongside his 'sister', Roll. However, soon after his creation, a mad scientist known as Wily, who was Light's fellow college alumni, took over 6 of Light's subsequent robots and tried to take over the world. Rock insisted on being turned into a battle robot to fight Wily, and soon with the help of Roll, he gained the power to become Mega Man. Powers Rock, or more specifically his "Mega Man" form, is quite a capable solar powered fighter. He is able to jump large gaps, slide at long distances and speed, and impossible power; capable of lifting an entire large castle above his head, even if he can't move while doing so, and on a lesser level throwing robots a dozen times heavier than him, and so on. In his Mega Man form, Rock owns a Mega Buster, which shoots a powerful energy capable of tearing through machines and steel like nothing. But the bread and butter of Rock's weapon arsenal is his weapon copy system. Through this, he can copy any robotic systems, and turn them into weapons. Note: Rock has all weapons and upgrades from 1 to 11, including the Game Boy Games. Examples include the Metal Blade (Circular Saw blades thrown at high speeds), The Gravity Hold (Gravity manipulation up to 20G's and reversal), and Black Hole (A miniaturized, weak black hole.)
objects.title: Rock (Mega Man)

objects.text:
Name: X
Alias: Mega Man X
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 100+

Power: X, a Reploid created by Dr. Light, possesses superhuman strength, speed, and endurance, along with advanced mobility, including dashing, wall-kicking, and high jumps. As the first robot with free will and sentience, X has limitless potential, allowing him to evolve and adapt. His main weapon, the X-Buster, can be supercharged for greater damage, and he can equip upgrades like Special Weapons from defeated foes and Armor Parts left by Dr. Light. X also demonstrates mysterious bursts of power, enabling him to overcome seemingly insurmountable challenges.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Maverick Hunter
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: X (Mega Man X)

objects.text:
Alignment: Lawful Good 
Gender: Male 
Sex: Male 
Age: 100+ 

Power: Zero, a Reploid created by Dr. Wily, possesses the same physical feats as X. Including his own variant of the X-Buster, called the Z-Buster. But specializes in mastery over several different kinds of weapons, with his most iconic being the Z-Saber. He can also equip similar upgrades like X, but are instead focused on adding new techniques to his arsenal. Such as the Rekkoha to call down several beams of light throughout the area, or to imbue his blade with the different elements.

Appearance: Handsome 
Civilian Identity: Maverick Hunter 
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Zero (Mega Man X)

addons.text:
When Ciel and Maria met, the two got along instantly, like a house on fire, the two talking and spending time together to the point you would be forgiven for thinking the two were sisters.

And then they started talking about science and technology, which led to things taking a far more… terrifying tone.

When Maria and Ciel began working together, their own interests, potential, and ability grew far beyond the sum of their parts, exponentially growing as it seemed like they skilled years – if not lifetimes – of their own research and efforts. Ciel will not only have perfected the Bio Metal along with the Rock / Mega System, but improved upon it to the point it would rival Shadow and Zero, but more importantly act as a life support system for Maria so she could live a long life even if she wasn't cured; meanwhile, Maria would grow to rival any iteration of her grandfather Gerald and cousin Eggman, as she is able to decipher and uncover many secrets of previous Great Civilizations.

Maria and Ciel together are only comparable to Dr Eggman and Dr Willy working together; a rather apt description, as together they are able to create the Super Genesis Wave, a feat able to rewrite reality on a multiversal scale with no known counters outside of the Chaos, and maybe Sol, Emeralds. Normally, it would require the use of the Seven Chaos Emeralds, but together Ciel and Maria can perform such a feat, merely taking longer if the two wanted.
addons.title: Sisters from Different Misters

objects.text: Alias: Doctor Ciel Age: 14–16 Gender: Female Background An artificially created human, Ciel had her genetics edited to create better Reploids. She stands out even among her already genius peers, as her intellect is literally world-changing: she created the Ciel System, which would lay the foundation for future civilizations, and also the Bio Metals, which allow people to draw on the power, skill, and knowledge of legendary Reploids. At first, she was a researcher in Neo Arcadia; later, she became the founder of the resistance and subsequently the Guardians (an independent peacekeeping force), and as a result, her contributions to the world place her on the same level as Dr. Light, who created the Reploids. Powers Her condition as an artificially created human with modified genetics grants her exceptional intelligence capable of transforming the world, enabling her to develop the Ciel System and the Bio Metals, through which people can access the power, skills, and knowledge of legendary Reploids.
objects.title: Doctor Ciel (Mega Man Zero)

objects.text: Aliases: "David" or Iroquois Pliskin Gender: Male Age: 23 (as of MG1), 27 (as of MG2), 33 (as of MGS1), 35-37 (as of MGS2), 42 (as of MGS4) Background Created as a clone of the legendary Big Boss in the "Les Enfants Terribles" project, his career was perhaps determined before he was even born. After enlisting in the Army in 1991, he was quickly promoted to being a Green Beret, before being further promoted to Big Boss's personal unit FOXHOUND. After realizing his unit leader and genetic father's leadership of Outer Heaven, he foiled his plans in both South Africa and Central Asia. Afterwards, he intended to retire to Alaska, but it was not meant to be. He was recruited by Colonel Campbell to infiltrate Shadow Moses, where his story can be said to truly begin... Powers Potentially the single greatest soldier to ever live, IQ of 180, master of CQC, fluent in six languages, genetically engineered to have superior mental and physical abilities (roughly equivalent to the perks Olympic, Frankenstein, & Rapid Learning), with nanomachines that give him a grab-bag of minor abilities on par with Tier 0 Powers, as well as nano-communication through the Codec and the information provided by the Soliton Radar. You may choose for him to be at any of his canon ages, and you may remove his accelerated aging, sterility, and FOXDIE if you wish.
objects.title: Solid Snake (Metal Gear)

objects.text: Real Name: Hal Emmerich Gender: Male Age: 25 (as of MGS1), 27-29 (as of MGS2), 34 (as of MGS4) Background Son of mad scientist (and all around bastard) Huey Emmerich, Hal had an unusually terrible childhood. His father's suicide almost took his adoptive sister with him, leading Hal to withdraw from the still living members of his family. After graduating from MIT & Princeton, he briefly joined the FBI before being kicked out for hacking on company time. Seeing his natural talents, he was hired by ArmsTech, which led to him being involved in the creation of Metal Gear REX and the Shadow Moses Incident. After a life-changing encounter with Snake during that incident, he decided to found "Philanthropy", an NGO dedicated to global disarmament. Powers Brilliant scientist, engineer, and hacker. Weirdly charismatic despite his unkempt appearance and "nerdy" behavior. As he is supremely knowledgeable in almost every field (except the humanities, which he is famously terrible at) and has a high general intelligence, calling him for advice can get you out of almost any jam.
objects.title: Otacon (Metal Gear)

objects.text: Alias: Jack The Ripper i.e. "Saucy Jack" & "The White Devil" Gender: Male Age: 23 (as of MGS2), 28 (as of MGS4), 32 (as of MGR) Background Raiden has never known any life but that of a soldier, starting his life as a child soldier in Liberia, under the command of future US President George Sears, also known as Solidus Snake. He was so successful as the "White Devil" that the Patriots kidnapped and brainwashed him as an important asset in the S3 Plan. After being freed by Snake and Otacon, he lives his life according to his own rules, never allowing other people to use him as a pawn ever again... Powers Raiden is a soldier who even before his cybernetic enhancements was equal to the legendary Solid Snake, with cybernetics powerful enough to suplex a Metal Gear or stop an entire naval vessel one-handed, fast enough to slice bullets out of the air with ease or run up the side of a building, endurance great enough to shrug off direct attacks from Metal Gear armaments, the ability to generate and weaponize electricity, & the ability to heal from sources of electricity. He is also an extremely skilled martial artist and swordsman, fluent in several languages, gene-treated to have superior mental and physical abilities even without the cybernetics (roughly equivalent to the perks Olympic, Frankenstein, & Rapid Learning), with nanomachines that give him a grab-bag of minor abilities on par with Tier 0 Powers, as well as nano-communication through the Codec and the information provided by the Soliton Radar. He is also considered to be quite handsome, something that has even effected his missions once or twice.
objects.title: Raiden (Metal Gear)

objects.text: Full Name: Eiselin Burchelli Meijal Hulkenberg Age: Unknown (Likely mid to mid-late 20's) Gender: Female Background Hulkenberg is a Roussainte tribeswoman, an outcast from the Principality of Montario's Hulkenberg Family due to her becoming a knight in a family of politicians. As a result of her prodigious talent with weaponry even as a teenager, she was hired to protect the prince, only for her charge to suffer an assassination attempt. Believing her prince dead, she wandered across Euchronia in penance, only returning to Grand Trad for the king's funeral following his assassination. This ended up with her joining the resistance following the necromancer's attack and awakened to the Knight Archetype. Powers Hulkenberg is a prodigy-level combatant with knowledge over various forms of melee weaponry, sharpened by her intense training regimen. As an Archetype user, she is able to transform into any Archetype that she has studied, with her totem Archetype lineage being the Knight, which synergizes with lances.
objects.title: Hulkenberg (Metaphor: ReFantazio)

objects.text: Age: Unknown (Likely mid to mid-late 20's) Gender: Female Background Euphausia is a Mustari tribeswoman, a priestess and younger sister of the leader of Virga Island, Edeni. Eupha had been intended to be a sacrifice for her people’s god, a dragon named Eht, only for Edeni to decide to be a brother before chieftain and tasked the resistance to save her from the Dragon Temple. In its depths, Eupha learned Eht had been overtaken by a Human, Homo Margo, for centuries, and many dragon priestesses had died for nothing. Eupha and company eventually exorcised the mutated beast out of Eht and named her home "Eht Ria". Powers Outside of her Summoner Archetypes, Eupha is a holy woman of the Mustari with deep ties to her culture and beliefs. All Mustari possess a third eye, though it acts like a magic/magla sensory organ, with Eupha in particular having such an acute sense of magla/magic sight, it can rival a Euchronian Fairy. As an Archetype user, she is able to transform into any Archetype, with her totem Archetype lineage being the Summoner, which synergizes with crosiers, a type of rod. Note "Etoreika" is not Eupha's actual surname; it's a cultural surname given to her as part of her station. The Mustari of Virga Island don’t have surnames.
objects.title: Euphausia Etoreika (Metaphor: ReFantazio)
Juani Cygnus (Metaphor: ReFantazio)
objects.text: Age: Unknown (Likely mid to mid-late 20's) Gender: Female Background Junah is a Nidia tribeswoman, a songstress and adopted younger sister of Rella the Saintess. Junah had been enslaved as a child, and was forced to pick erika flowers, a toxic Euchronian flower, until she was able to escape, running into Rella and House Cygnus, who adopted her. She first came into contact with the resistance during the funeral of the late king, and proceeded to play as a mole agent for the resistance to learn about Louis Guiabern, though she would fully join following the resistance boarding Louis's Skyrunner Charadrius for the possibility of breaking the prince’s curse and her awakening to the Masked Dancer Archetype when Idaeus Glodell kidnapped her and tried to expose her and Will, the protagonist of Metaphor: ReFantazio as rats. Powers Outside of her Masked Dancer Archetypes, Junah is a trained classical/operatic singer, able to sing powerfully and emotionally. As with all Nidia, Junah has a powerful if severely limited glamor spell that allows her to interact with the world as if she was a normal person, rather than her true, child-sized self. This glamor can be broken if she experiences such traumatic shock (such as a certain toxic flower) that she can’t maintain it. She’s also an aspiring poet, but jealously guards her poems from prying eyes. As an Archetype user, she is able to transform into any Archetype, with her totem Archetype lineage being the Masked Dancer, which synergizes with fans. Note Junah biologically is not a child; Nidia tribesmen simply stop growing at a very young age, necessitating the glamor.

Name: Samus Aran
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20+

Power: Samus Aran, infused with Chozo DNA and trained as a warrior since childhood, possesses superior athleticism, strength, hand-to-hand combat skills, and adaptability to alien environments. She wields the Power Suit designed by the Chozo, fused with her mind, body, and spirit, which can be upgraded and morph into a sphere, along with an Arm Cannon capable of firing energy beams and missiles. Her infusion with Metroid DNA also granted her immunity to X Parasites, the ability to absorb bio-energy and machinery, and a unique human/Chozo/Metroid hybrid form.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Intergalactic Bounty Hunter
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Samus (Metroid)

objects.text: Aliases: N/A Gender: Female Age: Under 1000 Background Tohru was originally raised under the belief that humans as a species were evil, and being raised under this belief had led her to join the Chaos Faction of dragons. She could have become better, but her close friend was such a glutton that she destroyed the temple dedicated to her and started a rivalry that further solidified her choice of Faction. This only changed when she was greatly injured by a deity and escaped to another dimension, only able to heal herself when a drunk human pulled the sword still imbedded in her hid out. Ever since then, she has been able to put aside her hatred and recognize humans for both their virtues and sins… and also awakened a deeply buried yuri orientation. Powers Being a dragon, Tohru has a litany of standard dragon abilities, those including incredible strength, speed, durable scales, immense endurance, flight, fire breath, venom, and regeneration. Swing a dragon from the universe she is from however makes these traits all the more powerful, with even a casual play fight with juvenile dragons leading to fire breathes capable of nuking cities. Besides this, she also has potent magical abilities including dimensional portals, shapeshifting, perception blocking, and more.
objects.title: Tohru (Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid)

objects.text: Aliases: Lucoa Gender: Female Age: Unknown (Somewhere upwards from 5,000 to 200,000 years) Background Once an Aztec deity that was a major part of civilization’s development, she was given a cursed wine at a party that lead to her having a drunken affair with her younger sister, Quetzalpetlatl. This resulted in her being exiled from the pantheon and stripped of her godhood, though she still kept her enormous magical capacity, personal strength and was still a feathered serpent dragon. She soon became a part of the ‘Spectator’ faction of dragons, and deliberately kept out of any conflict between dragons, gods and humans, both due to her past and due to personal dislike of conflict. Powers Despite no longer having her domains from her time as a god, Lucoa still holds an immense amount of knowledge capable of pushing any ancient civilization forward several millennia. Aside from this, she also holds immense magical knowledge just from being around for so long, knowing how to casually travel between dimensions and even has a form of reality bending, once transforming the world into a zombie apocalypse scenario just out of curiosity and a desire to be alone with someone. Lastly, she can of course turn into a several kilometer long feathered serpent dragon, with just her head being larger than some small mountains and her lower body lazily stretching over the horizon even when not stretched out in a straight line.
objects.title: Quetzalcoatl (Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Cat Noir
Alignment: Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 14

Power: Adrien is the wielder of the Cat Miraculous, able to turn into the superhero Chat Noir with the help of his friend Plagg.

As Cat Noir, he has enhanced strength, speed, durability and an omnitool. Furthermore he has the special ability 'Cataclysm', allowing him to destroy anything that he touches with his hand.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Student/Model
Quality of Life: Has Its Ups and Downs

Note: By default, this is Adrien Agreste from Season 3. Optionally, you may choose which season he comes from instead.
objects.title: Adrien Agreste (Miraculous Ladybug)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Ladybug
Alignment: Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 14

Power: Marinette is the wielder of the Ladybug Miraculous, able to turn into the superhero Ladybug with the help of her friend Tikki.

As Ladybug, she has enhanced strength, speed, durability and an omnitool. Furthermore she has the special abilities 'Lucky Charm', creating an object helpful to whatever task she has, and 'Miraculous Ladybug' which restores all the damage in a city wide area that may have occurred due to a villain.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Student/Aspiring Fashion Designer
Quality of Life: Has Its Ups and Downs

Note: By default, this is Marinette Dupain-Cheng from Season 3. Optionally, you may choose which season she comes from instead.
objects.title: Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Miraculous Ladybug)

objects.text:
Name: Olivia & Angelica Rapha Redgrave
Alias: [Olivia: Livia (to those close to her)] [Angelica: Angie (To those close to her)]
Alignment: Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 17
Species: (Lessened) New Human (a variant of human with the ability to use magic, while New Humans were powerful once upon a time they have consistently gotten weaker over generations with both Olivia and Angelica having what little scraps their current generation have as they steadily revert to being normal humans again)
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Life: [Olivia: Commoner] [Angelica: Duchess]

Power:

Angelica has been trained from a young age in all matters regarding state craft and nobility, and while she may not outright excel in all aspects she is a very competent noble groomed to be queen one day. Along with this she has been trained as an adventurer meaning she can handle herself in a fight against normal enemies, physically fit and expertise with firearms and wilderness survival. Angelica has received training with magic possesses a high affinity for magic with her speciality being fire magic allowing her to conjure it from thin air and control it with her being immune to her own magic, along with numerous other techniques such as psychic defence and being able to resonate with other magic users to combine their power while during a small ritual.

Olivia's commoner upbringing meant she had little chance to learn and develop many skills early on, however a chance encounter when she was younger led her wishing to learn all she could about magic. With this desire, hard work and her own affinity with magic being the highest not seen for generations Olivia quickly became one of if not the strongest magic user in the academy with her making the most of the academy's facilities to learn as much as she could gaining a large arsenal of spells. However she mainly uses her Light Magic for healing, protection and attacking with Light Arrows.

However, all those pale in comparison to Olivia's 'Heart Sharing' ability. A power that can revoke the willpower of all beings in a wide area whether their human, machine or monster by sending her emotions directly into their souls with only those with psychic / soul immunity being unaffected. While under this affect the victims will experience a gradual loss of consciousness as they follow Olivia's command as an aura of light surrounds Olivia that will spread out killing monsters and further weakening mental resistance.

Quality of Life: Terrible

Timelines in which Olivia ends up happy are far fewer than the ones where she meets a terrible fate due to the schemes of nobles, die to monsters, die in a war, forced into a relationship she cannot say no to earning the ire of all around her or gets her body stolen leaving her trapped in her own mind.

Angelica is surrounded by nobles who pay her lip service but would not hesitate to throw her under the bus for their crimes claiming they did it in her name, her fiancé the crown prince actively hates her due to no fault of her own and would either die or be exiled from her family before she finished her schooling due to a mixture of nobles scheming or the prince cheating on her and any attempt of addressing the issue only earning her further scorn. Even if all went well and she married the prince it would be a loveless marriage where the question would be when would he cheat on her and not if.​
objects.title: Olivia & Angelica Rapha Redgrave (Mobuseka)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ~17

Power: Izayoi possesses superhuman physical strength, speed, durability, and reflexes that place him far beyond normal human limits. His most notable ability is the power to nullify and counteract other supernatural abilities, regardless of their nature, with sheer force or resistance. This "Gift of Rebellion" allows him to defy seemingly invincible powers and face opponents who rely on overwhelming abilities with ease. He has a brilliant mind and excels at strategy, quick thinking, and provoking his opponents to gain the upper hand.

Appearance: Izayoi has messy blond hair, sharp golden eyes, and a confident smirk that rarely leaves his face. He typically wears casual clothes but carries himself with a sense of authority and fearlessness.
Civilian Identity: A rebellious teenager with a mysterious past who thrives on challenges and adventure.
Quality of Life: High (Independent, Thrill-Seeker, Fearless).

Warning: Izayoi's overconfidence and penchant for picking fights with powerful opponents can create dangerous situations. While incredibly skilled, his disregard for caution and his constant search for strong opponents may lead to unnecessary risks or collateral damage.
objects.title: Izayoi Sakamaki (Mondaiji-tachi ga Isekai Kara Kuru Sō Desu yo?)

objects.text:
Name: Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 598

Power: Kiss-Shot is a five-century-old vampire and the strongest vampire in the world. She is virtually immortal, able to regenerate from any damage within mere moments, whether from missing limbs, being burnt to ashes, or even recovering from induced death through sheer regeneration. As a vampire, Kiss-Shot can create other vampires, has night vision, can walk on ceilings as if on the floor, go inside shadows, and drain energy from living beings by sucking their blood, which also allows her to recover. Her physiology enhances her strength, durability, speed, and other attributes to superhuman levels. She can destroy a human's head with a single punch and once traveled from Antarctica to Japan in a single jump, with the recoil nearly destroying the continent of Antarctica. Her laughter creates shockwaves, and she claims she could destroy the planet if she desired, but not the sun. As the strongest vampire, Kiss-Shot's shapeshifting abilities are the highest among vampires, and she can both manipulate and generate matter. She can search her own memories by forcing her hand into her brain, possesses telekinesis, can manipulate her own weight, and manipulate spiritual energy to create a portal for time travel. She also owns the Demon Sword Kokorowatari, which can cut through all supernatural creatures, though it cannot harm beings that aren't supernatural, slipping through them like a ghost. Even if the sword is destroyed, she can replicate it via matter creation.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Shinobu Oshino
Quality of Life: Okay (She lived for a long time and her condition left her into a dark path, desiring a meaningful death, she would one day meet Araragi Koyomi who she would turn into a vampire and after a battle and reconciliation, she would spend her life with Araragi and only die the day they decide to die together.)

Note: The main reason why she lost to the vampire hunters in the first place was because she was suicidal and wanted a place to die, though she later regretted it.
objects.title: Kiss-Shot (Monogatari Series)

addons.text: Mastermind, just as any part of Elliot’s fractured psyche, is part of a coping mechanism to deal with his addled mind, a part of an alter system within Elliot’s mindscape: The Family. It would be unfortunate to find yourself under the circumstances where he forcefully discovers his real relationship with his Father that can be described as “bad touch”, causing enough mental distress and having the right mindset for a Shard to latch on to. Elliot now has the potential to Trigger with a 15 SP Tier 1 Tinker/Thinker power based on Elliot’s trauma.
addons.title: Mastermind

objects.text: Age: 30-33 Gender: Male Background Due to traumatic experiences, he developed a form of dissociative personality disorder to cope with his life and some buried trauma, forming a “family” within his mind, particularly Mr. Robot, who spearheads the hacktivist group “fsociety”, snowballing into a series of half-baked yet solid plans to defeat E Corp, ending in the ousting of the Deus Group run by Whiterose. Powers Elliot Anderson is a talented cybersecurity engineer who moonlights as a vigilante hacker, possessing a good head on his shoulders, albeit plagued by too many demons to fully fit into society's mold. Note: You’ll be meeting the “Mastermind” alter of Elliot, as he’s both the current driver and actor for his rage and fantasies, while he is “somewhere”.
objects.title: Elliot Alderson (Mr. Robot)

objects.text:
Hero Name: (Epithet) Black Wolf Sword King
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 40+

Power: enhanced hearing, sight, smell, and strength from being a beastkin. Has a demon eye under eyepatch to see flow of mana. She owns one of the gods seven swords. Knows elementary-ranked fire magic. Knows all techniques of sword god style. The ultimate technique is a long sword of light in which she moves at light speed to deliver a single quickdraw blow slicing one to multiple opponents in half.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: S rank adventurer and King/God rank swordswoman 
Quality of Life: Depends mostly on being an extremely loyal tutor and bodyguard for royalty, avoiding slavery narrowly as a beast-kin chieftains daughter
objects.title: Ghislaine Dedoldia (Mushoku Tensei)

objects.text: Real Name: Kagami Sumika Gender: Female Age: Teenager (exact age unclear) Background In the Extra universes, Sumika Kagami is a well meaning but bad-tempered Japanese high school student with a crush on her childhood friend, Takeru Shirogane. In the Unlimited & Alternative universes, this person perished and was experimented on by the BETA, with her brain separated from her mind and made to feel the most horrific tortures in the BETA's attempt to understand human psychology. After the raid on the Yokohama hive by the UN, scientist Kouzuki Yuuko took pity on the poor brain in a jar and gave her a new cybernetic body and mind, enhancing her stll biological brain with the most powerful Esper abilities yet known. Now, with a vengeful heart, she has become a core part of Alternative V, the UN's final attempt to retake Earth from the BETA... Note that if you don't want her to remember one of the worst fates in all of fiction, you can just have the 00 Unit be Extra universe Sumika with superpowers. Powers A powerful cybernetic body roughly equivalent to a fully humanlike version of the third tier of the "Full Body Conversion" addon to "Cyberware (Cyberpunk 2077)", as well as ESP and other psychic abilities roughly equivalent to "Psiad (Trinity Continuum)."
objects.title: 00 Unit (Muv Luv)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: In the 25-35 range Background In the Unlimited & Alternative timelines she is one of the UN's top scientists (with a specialty in quantum physics) and the head of the main project to defeat the BETA, Alternative IV. In the Extra timeline, Kouzuki Yuuko is just as brilliant but has retreated from the scientific community due to personal disagreements, choosing to instead become a high school physics teacher, though even the limited resources of such a position were not enough to stop her from inventing dimensional travel on a whim. Powers Brilliant multidisciplinary scientist who revolutionized several fields in her own world, effectively possessing the powers "Alternative IV (Muv Luv)" (through the "Helm Memory Core (Battletech)" path, if you must know) & "Polymath" You may choose to replace her with one of her equally brilliant twin sisters (with Kouzuki Motoko's talents lying in biology and medicine, and Kouzuki Mitsuko's talent lying in photography and the arts), or use the multi-select to get several of them.
objects.title: Kouzuki Yuuko (Muv Luv)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: Teenager (exact age unclear) Background In the Extra universes, she is the heir of the Mitsurugi Zaibatsu, a multinational corporation so large that they could afford to remodel an entire city in a single day on a whim, and so important to the global economy, that in her youth, Meiya recalled receiving birthday letters from presidents, kings, & other major heads of state. In the Unlimited & Alternative universes, she is the sister of the reigning Shogun, who has joined the UN TSF forces as a political statement, refusing any special treatment simply on account of being next in line for the Japanese throne. Given that Meiya often serves as her body double, you may choose to have her beloved sister Koubin Yuuhi accompany her or take her place. Powers Skilled mech pilot, soldier, swordswoman, military officer, businesswoman, & politician. Depending on the universe, she is either the heiress to the Mitsurugi Zaibatsu (giving her an equivalent of the power "Golden One" due to how insanely rich she is) or heir to the Shogunate of Japan (giving her the equivalent of the "Chrysanthemum Throne" addon to "Yata no Kagami", though she does not possess any of the particular objects that serve as its prerequisites). objects.text: Age: 17 Gender: Female Background A girl who was emotionally abused by her family, who treated her like a monster due to her fascination with blood, until one day she snapped, attacking a classmate, and went on the run. She puts on a cheerful facade at nearly all times, smiling widely even as she attacks out of sadistic 'love.' She feels immense affection for those who are bloodied, and expresses that affection by attacking and trying to kill them, in order to drink their blood and become them. She also becomes quite agitated and hostile when someone gets between her and her fixations. What Himiko wants most is to live in a world where she won't be judged on her warped perspective of love. Powers Himiko possesses the Quirk 'Transform,' allowing her to shapeshift into anyone whose blood she drinks. The more blood she drinks, the longer the duration of her transformation; 1 cup of blood equates to 18 hours of transformation. Drinking the blood of multiple people lets her become any of them for the accumulated time. She can optionally replicate their clothes as well. Additionally, if she understands the target well enough, she can use their powers as well.

objects.text:
Alias: Princess of the Sun, Solar Sovereign, Radiant Daybringer  
Gender: Female  
Sex: Female  
Age: Over 1,000 years, though her true age spans millennia, having ruled Equestria since ancient times.  

Power: Celestia wields immense magical and celestial power as the Alicorn of the Sun, embodying the celestial sphere she governs. She controls the sun's movements with precision, ensuring the cycle of day and night. Her mastery of magic surpasses nearly all others, allowing her to teleport vast distances, manipulate objects with telekinesis, transmute matter, and cast powerful reality-altering spells. Her magic has sealed ancient evils, restored harmony, and empowered others to fulfill their potential. As an Alicorn, she possesses enhanced strength, durability, and flight capabilities, soaring through the skies with grace and endurance. Her immortality grants her an ageless existence and near invulnerability, allowing her to endure millennia of trials. Celestia can channel the essence of harmony, inspiring hope and banishing corruption with her radiant presence. Her connection to solar energy allows her to summon devastating bursts of sunlight or create protective barriers of light to shield herself and others. In moments of absolute need, she can draw on the full power of the sun, unleashing its apocalyptic might. Despite her immense power, Celestia is a symbol of peace, using her abilities to guide and protect rather than dominate. Her wisdom and leadership are as much a part of her strength as her magic, making her a revered figure of light and harmony.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Princess of Equestria and Daybringer, ruling alongside her sister, Princess Luna. While most of her duties are ceremonial or administrative, Celestia often serves as a mentor and guide to her subjects, especially Twilight Sparkle. She is also known for her love of tea, cake, and lighthearted moments, showing a playful side beneath her regal demeanor.  
Quality of Life: Very High: As the revered ruler of Equestria, Celestia enjoys the luxuries of a royal life, with loyal subjects and a peaceful kingdom. However, her responsibilities as protector and guide weigh heavily on her, requiring her to make difficult decisions for the greater good. Her immortality, while granting her unparalleled wisdom, can lead to isolation and sorrow as she outlives those she loves. Despite these challenges, she finds joy in teaching, harmony, and the beauty of her world.  

Celestia’s radiance and wisdom make her a beacon of hope and strength, embodying the ideals of leadership, compassion, and the eternal balance of light.
objects.title: Celestia (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

objects.text:
Alias: Princess of the Night, Lunar Sovereign, Dreamkeeper, Lady of the Moon  
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Over 1,000 years, though her true age spans millennia, having ruled Equestria since ancient times.

Power: Princess Luna wields extraordinary magic as the Alicorn of the Moon and Guardian of the Night. She controls the moon, guiding its phases and movements with elegance, and can summon lunar energy to create radiant beams of moonlight for illumination or destructive power. Luna can enter the dream realm at will, traversing the subconscious minds of ponies to help them overcome their fears or nightmares. As the Dreamkeeper, she protects against malevolent entities like the Tantabus, ensuring peaceful rest for her subjects.
Her command of shadows and darkness allows her to cloak herself or others from sight, obscure magical detection, and create illusions. Luna can veil the stars or intensify their glow, inspiring awe and serenity in those who gaze at the night sky. She can also alter her form to become a more terrifying figure, as she did as Nightmare Moon, or adopt less threatening forms to blend in with mortals.
Luna is an Alicorn, granting her immortality and resistance to conventional harm, capable of enduring millennia. She exhibits super-equine strength and stamina and soars through the skies with powerful wings, often leaving a trail of shimmering starlight. She is an experienced warrior, skilled in magical duels and melee combat, defending Equestria during times of conflict. Her presence inspires reflection and calm, her connection to emotions allowing her to comfort or challenge others as needed. This ability, combined with her dreamwalking, helps ponies grow emotionally and mentally stronger. Luna also perceives cosmic energies, celestial patterns, and disruptions in the magical balance of Equestria.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Princess Luna, co-ruler of Equestria, governs the night alongside her sister, Princess Celestia. While her duties often involve safeguarding dreams, she also manages aspects of Equestria’s governance, particularly during the nocturnal hours. Luna has a playful side, evident in her occasional use of the Royal Canterlot Voice and archaic speech, which she adapts over time to fit modern customs.  
Quality of Life: High: As Princess of the Night, Luna enjoys a life of luxury and reverence. Her castle, shared with Celestia, offers a sanctuary of peace and splendor. However, her immortality and past isolation as Nightmare Moon weigh on her, leaving her prone to feelings of guilt and loneliness. Through her bond with her sister and friendships forged after her redemption, Luna finds purpose and joy, though she continues to strive for acceptance and self-forgiveness.

Luna embodies the themes of redemption, balance, and self-discovery. Her journey from Nightmare Moon to a beloved princess reflects the power of second chances and the importance of inner harmony. She is a beacon of hope for those who feel unseen or unappreciated, reminding them that even the darkest nights give way to the beauty of the stars.
objects.title: Luna (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

objects.text:
Alias: Princess of Love, Crystal Empress, Heart’s Guardian  
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Likely over a century, though much younger than Celestia and Luna, having ascended to Alicornhood in her youth.
Species: Alicorn (Originally Pegasus)  

Power: Princess Cadance wields the divine power of love, embodying the bonds that connect hearts and souls. As the Alicorn of Love, she possesses potent magic that can strengthen relationships, mend broken connections, and inspire deep affection. With a mere touch or focused spell, she can rekindle lost love, soothe emotional wounds, and bring harmony to those in turmoil. Her magic is not mind control but rather an amplification of genuine emotions, allowing those affected to remember and appreciate the love they already hold.  

Her Empathic Awareness grants her a deep understanding of emotions, enabling her to sense love, friendship, and discord even without words. This ability extends to dreams, where she can influence emotions and guide individuals toward reconciliation.  

Beyond her love-based magic, Cadance is a skilled spellcaster, proficient in telekinesis, teleportation, and protective barriers. She demonstrated her power when she maintained a massive love-infused shield around the Crystal Empire to protect it from King Sombra. She can also infuse her spells with crystal energy, enhancing their durability and effectiveness.  

As an Alicorn, she possesses enhanced strength, agility, flight, and longevity, though she is not immortal like Celestia and Luna. She is a graceful flier, capable of swift aerial maneuvers and long-distance travel. Her endurance is considerable, allowing her to hold magical barriers for extended periods or endure emotionally exhausting situations.    

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Princess Mi Amore Cadenza
Quality of Life: Very High.
objects.title: Princess Cadance (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

objects.text:
Alias: Princess of Friendship, Ruler of Equestria
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Initially in her early 20s (pony years) upon ascending to Alicornhood, but her lifespan is vastly extended due to her ascension.

Power: Princess Twilight Sparkle embodies the power of magic and friendship, making her one of the most versatile and powerful Alicorns in Equestria. Originally a unicorn prodigy, her ascension to an Alicorn granted her vastly enhanced magical potential, flight, and increased durability. Over time, she grew into a leader worthy of ruling Equestria. She possesses advanced telekinesis, teleportation, and the ability to unleash powerful concussive or elemental blasts. She can alter the physical forms of herself and others, generate defensive barriers strong enough to withstand significant attacks, and interact with temporal anomalies using time magic. Her memory magic allows her to restore or alter memories, enhancing emotional healing, and she can manipulate gravity and weight distribution. Twilight has also demonstrated the ability to store and wield immense magical energy without suffering ill effects, as seen in her battle with Tirek.

Initially struggling with flight, she eventually mastered aerial combat and long-distance travel, flying at high speeds with remarkable agility. Her Alicorn body grants her increased stamina, resistance to physical attacks, and prolonged endurance in battle. As a leader and diplomat, she unites various pony tribes and non-pony species through wisdom and diplomacy. She founded the School of Friendship to spread harmony and successfully ruled Equestria after Celestia and Luna retired. 

Her strongest power is the magic of friendship, allowing her to create bonds that empower herself and others. She can call upon the Elements of Harmony’s latent power to purify and dispel corruption, inspiring those around her and strengthening relationships.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Princess Twilight Sparkle.
Quality of Life: Very High
objects.title: Princess Twilight Sparkle (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

objects.text:
Alias: Spirit of Chaos and Disharmony, Lord of Chaos
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Unknown, but ancient—potentially older than Equestria itself.

Power: Discord wields reality-warping chaos magic, making him one of the most powerful beings in existence. His abilities allow him to reshape reality at will, disregarding conventional physics and magical rules. He can create, alter, or erase objects, change the laws of nature, teleport instantly, manipulate time, and turn thoughts into reality. His magic is unpredictable, often manifesting in bizarre or humorous ways, such as creating chocolate milk rain or turning the ground into soap.

Despite his chaotic nature, Discord is nearly invulnerable; his body is highly resistant to harm, and he can regenerate from injuries instantly. He exists outside of conventional time and space, meaning normal magic has little effect on him. If needed, he can render himself intangible, invisible, or even functionally omnipresent.

His most dangerous ability is mind manipulation, allowing him to twist the personalities and emotions of others, making them act opposite to their true nature. He used this to corrupt the Mane Six upon his first major appearance. However, after reforming, he mainly uses his powers for mischief rather than harm.

Though immensely powerful, Discord is not omnipotent; he has been outmaneuvered, tricked, or temporarily weakened by magical artifacts such as the Elements of Harmony. Additionally, his own emotions and attachments (such as his friendship with Fluttershy) can influence his actions.

Appearance: Mixed
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Varies Wildly
objects.title: Discord (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

objects.text: Aliases: Nexus, The Moral Executioner, The Great Nexus, The First Nexus Age: Late 20s Gender: Male Background General Theodore Hellpop, former administrator of the world Vradic escaped with his son Horratio after following orders to destroy the world following its civil war. Raising his son on the abandoned moon of Ylum alone, Horratio had little to fill his time other than reading or playing with ‘imaginary friends’ who taught him how to ‘fusion-kast’, though he would often be tormented by visions of the millions of Varadic’s dead in his sleep. Eventually, Horratio killed his father, and he could rest. But the visions came anew, with a new target, a new mass murderer for Nexus to execute. Today, he still completes his mission, with Ylum becoming a planetary nation in its own right, filled with refugees Nexus delivered from planets about to fall to ruin. Horatio is well learned, but conflicted. A deeply christian man raised in near isolation who gains most of his companionship from killers or victims. At different times he’s been defiant, accepting, depressed and neutral. An enemy and a tool for the Merk all at once. Powers Empowered by an ancient alien called ‘The Merk’, Horratio can telecast immense amounts of energy directly from the centre of stars to perform a number of feats. Taking little energy are powers like telepathy and various low power plasma blasts, and on the higher end interstellar teleportation and blasts strong enough to melt planets. The price of this is high however, as not only does the energy come from stars, meaning that if over exerted random stars in the galaxy can simply wink out of existence as their energy is consumed, but the Merk that gives Horratio this connection remains tormenting him with visions of mass murderers, their victims crying out for a vengeance which he must exact or die of exertion in his own bed.
objects.title: Horatio Valdemar Hellpop (Nexus)

objects.text: Age: 4 Gender: Female Background Built as an experimental squad by YoRHA, A2 and her squad were tasked with destroying the Machine Army server in Mt. Ka'ala. While completing their mission, her squad was killed, and she learned the true nature of YoRHa and the constant war between androids and machines. Labeled as a traitor, she swore revenge, both against the machines that murdered her friends and the YoRHa that betrayed them. Behind the coldness, A2 is a caring individual, who wishes for the intimacy and friendship she once had. Powers Power: A2 is an android made for comb[A]t. She is an expert in several martial weapons, can lift several tons, has incredible speed and reflex to the point of outrunning missiles and parry bullets, is incredibly durable, and due to being an android, has no need for rest.
objects.title: A2 (NieR)

addons.text:
Death is no longer the end. So long another companinor form NieR is alive, the conscience of the fallen is stored in the black box of the remaining ones, without any memory loss due to their death. 
While they know how to fix and even build new bodies, this doesn't give them the ability to create a new black box or android bodies from nothing. At least, they will never have to say goodbye again.
addons.title: to [B]e forever with you

objects.text: Age: 3 Gender: Female Background Built by YoRHa, 2B was created to serve humanity and YoRHa, learning to shut down her emotions so she could kill the Machine life forms and other enemies without hesitation - though in truth she is quite emotional, caring deeply for her comrades. Despite carrying her duties so far without objections, the nature of her mission is starting to burden her. She is currently partnered with 9S, in a mission to find out the strange behavior the Machines are currently displaying. Powers 2B is an android that is suited to [E]xcel in combat scenarios. She is an expert in several martial weapons, can lift several tons, has incredible speed and reflex to the point of outrunning missiles and parry bullets, is incredibly durable, and due to being an android, has no need for rest.
objects.title: 2B (NieR)

objects.text: Age: 3 Gender: Male Background 9S is a high end model YoRHa scanner. Tasked with finding information on their enemies, his curious nature has put him in trouble more than once. Despite YoRHa orders for the androids to conceal their feelings, 9S is often shown to be a curious and good natured person. Caring deeply for those close to him, this emotional nature can turn into a vengeful one when those he cares about are hurt, or worse. Powers 9S is a [S]canner type android. Aside from some benefits of having a mechanical body such as having no need for rest and beyond human strength and durability, he possesses a vast array of sensor and analytical capability to gather and interpret information, and is an incredible hacker, being able to disable or even control enemies' machines in seconds.
objects.title: 9S (NieR)

addons.text:
Their bound, regardless of their version, was always strong. Now, so long either of them or another NieR companion is alive, should one of them fall, the conscience of the fallen is stored in the black box of the remaining ones, without any memory loss due to their death. 
While they know how to fix and even build new bodies, this doesn't give them the ability to create a new black box or android bodies from nothing. At least, they will never have to say goodbye again.
addons.title: n[E]ver one without the other

objects.text: Age: In their thousands Gender: Female Background Created and tasked with resurrecting humanity after a cataclysmic event, Devola and Popola tried their best on their mission. However, it was never meant to be, and in failing their impossible task, they were programmed to feel constant guilt by their failure, and to be ostracized by their peers. Despite this, they still persevere, helping other androids whenever they can. Powers Power: Devola and Popola are androids. While their models were created to care for humans, they are by no means frail. They are strong, durable, and have access to human-safe Maso, a magical substance that allows them to use magic. They are both competent fighters and medics, able to care for both humans and androids. They also have the normal benefits of being androids, such as no need for food or rest. Devola also has experience working as a bard, and Popola as a librarian.
objects.title: Devola & Popola (NieR/NieR Automata)

addons.text: While his past bonds can't be replaced, Emil's bond with his new companions is still strong. So long another companion from NieR is alive, they can build Emil back without any memory loss, and vice-versa. In exchange for not losing his memories anymore however, his cloning ability is reduced, only able to maintain 10 active clones at once.
addons.title: n[E]ver forget

objects.text: Alias: No. 7 Age: Around seven to eight thousand years. Gender: Male Background Experimented from a young age to be used as the “Ultimate weapon”, Emil was forced to merge with his sister after she had become a monster. Though gaining immense power from it, his body was transformed. Despite all of this, Emil carried on, finding solace in his friends, but even that was temporary as they too eventually passed away. Powers Emil is a being that can use maso (not harmful to humans) to do magic. He can fly, shoot powerful lasers from his eyes, heal and cast many offensive spells. He can also make copies of himself, though he avoids doing so as each time he does, he loses part of his memories and sense of self. He can also overheat his inner reactor to explode, delivering an explosion strong enough to kill all life on Earth, though he would refuse to use it unless everything else is lost.
objects.title: Emil (NieR/NieR Automata)

objects.text: Age: 21 Gender: Male Background Losing his parents at a young age, Nier did his best to take care of himself and his younger sister, Yonah. In a quest to search for a cure for his sister's disease, Nier grows and changes, from a once earnest young boy to a more jaded and cynical individual. Even so, he remains a good man to his core, doing everything he can to help his friends and save his sister. Powers Nier is a close range fighter. He is proficient with spears, broadswords, dual-wielding knives and more. Due to maso, he can achieve feats beyond a regular human could, and imbue his attacks with magical energy.
objects.title: Nier (NieR: Replicant)

objects.text: Age: 18 Gender: Female Background Growing as an outcast due to her intersex body, Kaine only had her grandmother as company. Even that was taken from her when a Shade cruelly took her life and mutilated Kaine to die. Saved ironically by another Shade that fused with her by taking half of her body, Kaine grew into a cynical and easy to anger woman. Despite this, she wishes for companionship, and cherishes the friends she makes later in her journey more than anything in the world. Powers Kaine is a close range fighter. Wielding two serrated blades, she is agile and strong, while also possessing high mobility. Due to maso, she can achieve feats beyond a regular human could, and imbue her attacks with magical energy.
objects.title: Kaine (NieR: Replicant)

addons.text:

objects.text: Aliases: Lilith, Dorothy, Rapunzel, Red Hood, Scarlet, and Snow White. Age: Outwardly 18–20 years old, but actually over a century old. Gender: Female Background The Nikke squad belonging to Grimm Models, the first Nikke created through the combined efforts of humanity in response to the First Rapture Invasion and considered the legendary 1st generation. The “modern” 9th generation Nikke are only a pale shadow of what the 1st generation Nikke could achieve, and each of them can easily destroy entire rapture squads and the most powerful bosses single-handedly. Lilith, or Liliweiss, is the leader of the squad and one of the strongest in history. She specializes in close combat and is capable of destroying hordes of enemies with a single blow. She is a multifaceted personality, strict, strong-willed, and fearless. Dorothy, before the squad was disbanded, was one of the most balanced, inspiring, and kind personalities. However, after severe trials, she became cruel, manipulative, and vengeful. She is a talented fighter and a capable leader. Rapunzel is a nikke with controversial hobbies, but she is loyal to her duty of seeing fallen nikke off on their final journey. Red Hood is the youngest member of the squad. She is good-natured, brave, and cheerful. She loves country music and adult magazines. Scarlet is a close combat fighter who follows the spirit of a “lone swordsman” and loves to drink. She is a regular serial nikke, but has undergone numerous modifications that have brought her capabilities on par with Grimm models. Snow White is determined and loyal to her duty, obsessed with the idea of destroying Raptures by any means necessary. She loves all kinds of fresh food. Powers The Goddess Squad includes the Grimms Model, which serve as the benchmark for the 1st generation and far surpass later generations of Nikke models. Grimms Model possess impressive combat capabilities and can utilize their built-in weaponry, including as mechanical armor. Their arsenal and capabilities may include: melee weapons and the ability to deliver supersonic strikes with them; a laser with a range of several kilometers capable of hitting individual falling coins; and a simple punch capable of destroying a tank. At the same time, they can withstand no less damage, which collectively allows them to easily destroy entire mechanized enemy units.
objects.title: Goddess Squad (Nikke Goddess of Victory)

addons.text:

You are free to determine the type and form of these upgrades, if necessary, but in any case, Absolute Squad nikkes will retain their uniqueness and the characteristics of character and appearance inherent to them.

addons.title: Joint Modernization Nikke

objects.text: Names: Emma, Eunhwa and Vesti. Age: Outwardly 18–20 years old, but actually over a century old. Gender: Female Background Absolute Squad, also known as “Miracle Squad,” is one of the most famous, top-ranked, and strongest squads, which has returned from the most dangerous missions safe and sound. Eunhwa, the leader of the squad, is a perfectionist who strives for excellence both in herself and demands it from the squad and others. She has a demanding, cold personality and can be cold and sharp in communication, especially if there is a reason for it. She works part-time as a nikke instructor. Vesti is a timid and shy introvert, but she has excellent combat skills and a desire to leave no enemy alive, which has earned her a fearsome reputation and the nickname “Reaper.” The squad treats her like a younger sister. Emma, the “older sister” of the squad, balances out the social problems of the other two members. She is a terrible cook. Powers Absolute Squad comprises the latest generation of Nikke, classified as SSR models and possessing combat capabilities far surpassing those of humans. The mechanical bodies of these Nikke are equipped with a virtually inexhaustible energy source known as the “core” and covered in a material called “Goddesium,” which is indistinguishable from human skin. They are so durable that they can withstand blows and gunfire that would turn an ordinary human into a bloody pulp. All Nikke wield powerful weapons whose recoil could break bones or even kill a human if they tried to use them.
objects.title: Absolute Squad (Nikke Goddess of Victory)

Power: She is the most powerful Flügel in history. The Flügel were created to slay gods, ergo they have transcendence over physical laws. They have superhuman strength, reflexes, speed, & unassisted flight.

Her magical prowess is beyond mortal comprehension, truly earning a ranking superior to mere "Creatures". This mastery of magic allows her to detect elementals and sense the use of magic. She may also walk through walls and teleport.

Heavenly Smite is her trump card. By concentrating on nearby elementals, she can unleash attacks capable of leveling countries. Even using less than 5%, she rented the sea asunder and continuously flattened an enemy city shielded by 3k mages.

Immortality is a benefit of being a Flügel. She is immune to disease, toxins, and physical or mental interference. She is nearly invulnerable to harm (for reference, this includes being immune to the explosion of a Hydrogen bomb), and she can regenerate from the gravest injuries totally unscathed, with the Rite of Restoration.

She can tap into the wisdom amassed by the Flügel. Her mind is connected to the race's collective knowledge. She is also fluent in over 700 languages.

Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Amazing

Alias: Ammy, Sunshine, Sunny

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Age: Ancient and timeless, at least 200 years old in her reincarnated form, though her existence spans millennia.

Power: Amaterasu is the embodiment of the Shinto sun goddess. She wields the Celestial Brush, allowing her to reshape reality and control natural elements. Her powers include:

Elemental Manipulation: Command over fire, water, wind, ice, lightning, and sunlight.
Rejuvenation: Restoring broken or missing objects.
Power Slash: Cutting through obstacles and enemies with divine energy.
Sunrise: Instantly summoning daylight.
Astral Pouch: Reviving herself if properly nourished.
Godhood: A divine shield that negates damage when fully charged.
Spiritual Purification: Her presence cleanses corruption and inspires faith, which strengthens her abilities.
At her strongest, she can command the faith of the world to bring vast, conceptual changes to her surroundings.

Appearance: Beautiful.

Civilian Identity: Goddess of the Sun (appears as an ordinary white wolf to most mortals).

Quality of Life: Good. Despite being revered as a goddess, Amaterasu is burdened with the responsibility of restoring balance to a corrupted world. Her connection to faith and nature sustains her existence and provides moments of tranquility. However, the constant battle against evil requires her to endure hardship and isolation at times.
objects.title: Amaterasu (Okami)

objects.text:
Alias: Humming Brook, Soul King
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 90

Power: Brook ate the Yomi Yomi no Mi, the Revive-Revive Fruit, and thus, was revived as a skeleton and is functionally immortal so long as his body is still in tact. This fruit overall just gives him a stronger soul, able to separate himself from his body like a ghost, exude pure coldness from the underworld and thus giving him some ice powers, and finally, the ability to overwhelm beings with weaker souls like Big Mom's Homies (which are creatures made out of fragments of her soul, and are thus, weaker).

Other than that, Brook is a skilled swordsman and a talented musician, capable of entertaining people via his musical prowess while also being able to hold himself in a fight. His bone body actually provides him with a lot of advantages, such as being light enough to run across water and thus bypassing the risk of drowning with his devil fruit.

Overall, he's your team bard, able to fight and sing, ensuring every battle is indeed also joyous.

Appearance: Bones
Civilian Identity: Musician of the Straw Hat Pirates, Popular Rockstar
Quality of Life: Has it's ups and downs, but it's better since joining the Straw Hats.

objects.text:
