Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 46

Power: Jinbei is a Fishman, who are a species that were estimated to be 10x stronger than an average Human, not only that, he is a master of Fishman Karate, which is a martial arts built around manipulating the water across your surroundings as well as within your opponents. This is great as so long as there's water in his enemies, he can essentially bypass a lot of opponents' defenses. This technique also doubles as a Water bending esque ability, able to manipulate liquids skillfully to attack from a further distance.

He also has the ability to speak with Marine life, an ability normally reserved to Merfolk which makes him exceptional. The biggest feat we've seen of him using this is him developing a network of Whale Sharks that help him traverse the insane seas of the One Piece world, which is filled with monstrosities that can just devour ships.

Finally, he is a Helmsman, able to understand the intricacies of the sea, making him amazing at traversing waters. It is said that with an equally capable navigator, a ship driven by Jinbei would never sink.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Helmsman of the Straw Hat Pirates
Quality of Life: Has it's ups and downs, but it's better since joining the Straw Hats.

addons.text:
The strongest trio of the Straw Hat Pirates—Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji—now stand at your side. Together, they form an unstoppable force, capable of defeating even the most insurmountable foes.

Each member of the Monster Trio now wields their peak powers and beyond. Luffy can utilize Gear 5 almost constantly, unleashing the full might of his awakened abilities with unmatched creativity and resilience. Zoro has perfected his Ashura mode, pushing his swordsmanship and Haki mastery to unparalleled levels. Sanji's Germa-enhanced genes have evolved far beyond anything Judge could have ever dreamed of achieving in his lifetime. Additionally, Sanji has awakened his Haōshoku Haki, further solidifying his place among the mightiest combatants.

Their recovery abilities have also reached extraordinary heights. Even after complete exhaustion or near-fatal injuries, they can fully recover to peak condition with just a few days of rest and proper nutrition. Their resilience ensures they are always ready for the next challenge.

Grateful for the new adventures awaiting them by your side, Luffy wholeheartedly invites you to join his crew, offering you a place in their legendary journey to the top. With the Monster Trio as your allies, no ocean is too vast, and no enemy too great.
addons.title: The Monster Trio

addons.text:
You have assembled the Straw Hat Pirates, and thus, have the super crew ready to conquer the vast and deadly seas of your world. They are a tight knit crew willing to go against the entire world to protect one another. And now, not only are you one of them, but you're also deemed their Vice Captain.

You are thus their closest leader next to Luffy, with Luffy himself respecting your suggestions and opinions. Heck, maybe with your skills, you can even lead them to their dreams even quicker? You do have their immense specialties at your disposal.

Yo ho ho ho! Set sail with your new friends, and push onwards!
addons.title: The Pirate King's Nakama

As a cyborg, he is powered by Cola, with other drinks seemingly having an effect on his personality. With Cola as fuel, he can do many things such as using the carbon to release a strong surge of air to send him or others flying, to even letting him use flamethrowers in his body. His metal skin also adds to his durability and strength. And finally, he's since upgraded himself to be able to use lasers, a technology made based on the Pika Pika No Mi (Light Light Fruit).

Otherwise, Franky is one of the best shipwrights there is in his setting. If you ever need a strong ship or a cool building, Franky is your man!

Appearance: Handsome

Power: The Shapeshifting doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates. He's not only a great doctor, but his experimentation with his own Devil Fruit, the Hito Hito No Mi (Human Human Fruit), he has achieved more forms than an average Zoan Type Devil Fruit User.

Normally, he's able to use these forms:

1. Animal Form, Hybrid Form, and "Human" form, which most Zoan Devil Fruits can achieve.

2. Guard Point, where he fluffs up his fur so much that it can protect him from most attacks.

3. Jumping Point, which makes his legs longer and let's him jump higher.

4. Arm Point, which makes his arms bulkier for hoof attacks.

5. Horn Point, which makes his horns large and can be used to dig and is great for underground combat.

7. Kung-Fu Point, which is an all-rounder form that is suited to martial arts.

Using his Rumble Balls, a drug used to strengthen his fruit, he can achieve Monster Point, a humongous kaiju esque form that was once dangerous due to it going berserk, but since training Chopper can now use it to deal with much larger opponents. This form only lasts for 30 Minutes, afterwards he is transformed into an infant like state that speaks like an old man, at least temporarily.

Otherwise, he's an amazing doctor who dreams to become a cure all to diseases. He'd be an asset in any team!

addons.title: Kuja
addons.text: Despite her cold facade, as both an Empress and a Captain, Hancock does understand that there are situations where having help, or just someone to do menial tasks for you, can be useful. As such, she will gain her own support depending on the scale of your organization to supplement your forces. A Small Organization: The other two members of the Gorgon Sisters, Boa Marigold and Boa Sandersonia, as well as their animal companions, a large hawk as well as Bacura, a panther the size of an elephant that has served as the Kuja Tribe's executioner for generations. A Large Organization: The entire crew of the Kuja Pirates including their ship the Perfume Yuda and the pair of Yuda snakes that allow it to maneuver without relying on the wind or currents. Yuda are giant sea-snakes with venom so potent that nothing living in the oceans would dare attack one. Your Private Island gains a small single-pier harbor specifically designed for the Perfume Yuda. The You Foundation: The entire island of Amazon Lily with its population ready to serve their Empress, and by extension you. This includes the symbiotic reptiles known as Snake Weapons, as well as all previous Empresses of Amazon Lily, restored to their prime. The island itself can be attached to your Private Island as an extension of its landmass or exist as a separate island under your control. Amazon Lily counts as a Property OoP.

objects.text: Alias: Snake Princess, Pirate Empress, World's Most Beautiful Woman Age: 31 Gender: Female Background Kidnapped as a child together with her younger sisters Sandersonia and Marigold and enslaved by the World Nobles before escaping when Fisher Tiger rampaged across the Holy Land of Mary Geoise. Deeply traumatized by their experiences, the three Gorgon Sisters concealed the truth of what happened to them as they grew stronger, with Hancock at age 18 taking on the mantle of both ruler of Amazon Lily as well as Captain of the Kuja Pirates as the strongest woman on the island, presenting a front of cold arrogance and disdain to all but her sisters. Hancock would go on to join the Seven Warlords of the Sea in order to protect her home, agreeing to at least on paper work for the same World Government that she loathed and despised with every fiber of her being. Powers Hancock is an extremely powerful and skilled combatant, easily able to shatter stone with a single kick. Her combat-skills are complimented by her mastery of all three types of Haki as well as her Devil Fruit, the Mero Mero no Mi or Love Love Fruit. This Devil Fruit synergies with Hancock's own incredible beauty, allowing her to turn anyone who feels attraction towards her to stone. This petrifying effect can also be released on direct contact or in a storm of energy-arrows and even affect things not susceptible to lust such as robots or even cannonballs, as well as forgo the petrifying effect entirely to fire a heart-shaped projectile with a speed and effect comparable to a rifle-bullet. Beyond pure combat ability Hancock also possesses great charisma and is skilled in subterfuge and deceit, being able to leverage her beauty to charm almost anyone regardless of gender. Finally, Hancock has an animal companion in the form of Salome, an extremely large snake belonging to a species of serpent that live in symbiosis with the Amazons, typically by shaping their bodies into bows for them to use, though Salome is large enough that she most commonly serves as as a throne for Hancock, as her bow-shape has dimensions more in line with those of a ballista.
objects.title: Boa Hancock (One Piece)

objects.text: Aliases: The World's Greatest Diva Age: 21 Gender: Female Background She is the adopted daughter of the Emperor Red-Haired Shanks, and she was also the musician of his crew. While visiting Elegia, known as the "Island of Music", she accidently released the demonic entity Tot Musica, slaughtering the entire island except for its king and the Red-Haired crew. In the end, she was left on the ruined island with the surviving King, Gordon, taking care of her. By accident, she found a special broadcasting device which allowed her to stream worldwide and became a famous Diva beloved all over the world. Powers She is quite weak physically by her world’s standards, but has a powerful devil fruit called the Uta Uta no Mi, which grants her the ability to pull the consciousness of the people who listen to her music into a dream world, no matter the distance where she is near-omnipotent. While under the effect of her power, she can also puppet the bodies of her targets, albeit quite clumsily, almost like controlling mindless zombies. Her weakness, besides the generic devil fruit drawbacks, is that her power heavily drains her stamina and can only be maintained while she is conscious.
objects.title: Uta (One Piece)

objects.text: Aliases: Queen of the Pleasure District Age: 36 Gender: Female Background Stussy is the MADS' research institute’s first-ever successful clone, having been modeled after Miss Buckingham Stussy. She was an agent of the CP0 serving the World Government but at the same time, she was also a spy employed by one of her creators called Dr. Vegapunk. As an agent, she spent years undercover, becoming one of the emperors of the Underworld under the epithet "Queen of the Pleasure District". She seems to be sadistic and cold-blooded at first glance but has a softer side and incredible loyalty towards people she cares about. Powers She is quite strong physically and skilled in the superhuman martial arts techniques of the World Government called Rokushiki being especially good at using Shigan, also known as Finger Pistol and Kami-e used for high-speed dodging. She is also an adept user of both Kenbunshoku Haki which allows individuals to sense the presence of others, and Busōshoku Haki which allows individuals to create an invisible armor around them. Finally, she is also a Devil Fruit user of the Batto Batto no Mi, Model: Vampire. Granting her the ability to transform into a Bat or Bat Hybrid form with the additional abilities to use thermal vision to monitor the heat generated internally by blood sources and to put people to sleep by drinking their blood. Albeit, this also makes her susceptible to the Devil Fruit drawbacks.
objects.title: Stussy (One Piece)

addons.text:
Ai Hoshino was simple a normal girl who wished to understand what love was and would find a strong true familial love during her time as an idol. But when she saw you, it was love at first sight. Something so overwhelming and so sudden it caused a subtle shift in her as Ai has become obsessed with you.

Wanting you to be in her life and only having eyes for her, there will be little she wouldn't do to make that happen. Subtle things here and there, she won't hurt those close to her or you because despite everything Ai just wants to be loved and does know how to get reactions out of people and manipulate them. After all, Ai knows how to put on a show.

If Aqua and Ruby are with her they will be wildcards in all of this, and it's an almost certainty Ai will want you to help raise them as their new step parent.​
addons.title: Drowning in Love

objects.text: Alias: First Witch of Kennet Age: 17 Gender: Female Background: Part of the Kennet Trio, she's an accomplished Practitioner interested in Law and ready to fight for what is right and just. For that reason she's going to college to study law. Lucy rarely shows fear or weakness, likes horror movies and misses no longer being capable of being sarcastic due to becoming a Practitioner. Lucy feels a strong sense of responsibility and protectiveness and is determined to make people face their dues where possible. She is often concerned for the safety of her friends, and has appointed herself as their de facto guardian. Powers: The Practice (Otherverse), Trifold Duelist, Law Magus, Familiar She's already gotten her Implement, an earring which gives her superhearing, and Familiar, a Dog of War named Grandfather who tends to accompany her in the form of a dog but can transform into a soldier equipped with a gun who has a lot of durability. As a Trifold Duelist she’s capable of using Fae, Goblin and War magic through various means to defeat her foes and relies on utilizing Law Magic to rule-lawyer her opponents into submission or to support and augment her arguments.

objects.text: Alias: Second Witch of Kennet Age: 17 Gender: Female Background: Part of the Kennet Trio, Avery is arguably the most moral of the trio and is usually the first one to leap to someone's defense, she's into girls and eager for friendship and love. She's a vegetarian and likes hockey. She usually flanks for the trio, and is the one that keeps up with their connections. Powers: The Practice (Otherverse), Pathfinding, Familiar She's an accomplished Pathfinder, wandering through countless Paths which grant her rewards and Boons upon completion as well as allowing her to quickly move from place to place through them. She comes with her opossum Familiar Snowdrop, a Boon Companion with whom she’s incredibly in tune with, but who is only capable of speaking by lying and who can turn into a human girl.

objects.text: Alias: Third Witch of Kennet, Sorceress, Master of Shadow, Half-light, and Shape, Peddler of Unwritten Texts, Hatcher of the Moon, Crucible breaker, Speaker for the Voiceless, and many others... Age: 17 Gender: Female Background: Part of the Kennet Trio, she’s both more skeptical and more imaginative than her two friends and pretty artistically creative. She’s aromantic. Powers: The Practice (Otherverse), Sorceress, Demesne She's a Sorceress, which is a Practitioner who's accomplished enough in many fields, enough that even much older Practitioners hold her in high esteem, and also Dabbles in all kinds of Practices that catch her fancy. Beyond giving her incredible versatility in what Practices she can do, she’s also got enough know-how and skill to improvise on the go. She has a Demesne which she uses as a wandering bookshop and which she can teleport from city to city with some preparation, and keeps helping people who are searching for books she can provide, be those Innocents, Practitioners or Others.
objects.title: Verona Hayward (Otherverse)

objects.text: Age: 45 Gender:Male Background: Alexander was awakened early and raised by a household of Augurs, taking easily to the art of Seeing. He traveled the world for four years to study various approaches to Augury before his return to Canada for a two year stint as assistant to the Lord of Halifax. He returned to Ontario to care for family and to work as a problem solver and investigator for the practitioner community. His work cooperating and connecting with fellow practitioners would later inspire the Blue Heron Institute. He raised the idea with peers and then later helped found and fund the BHI, where he was and is the sole teacher who has taught full- time every single semester. Alexander's dedication to the school is such that he set his Demesne here, in his office. In his breaks from work and teaching, he will occupy himself with trips to the city to take in shows and cinema, to fill up on civilization, or to nature, to get further from it, as his mood suits. In shorter breaks he remains on campus, using the workshops to pursue hobbies with enchantment, woodworking, and bronzeworking, even hand-making his Implement, Lux Obscura, a bronze-inlaid wand using wood given to him by a Dryad from her own Woodes (sic). Alexander is unmarried but describes himself as far from lonely. He maintains strong relationships with extended family, and enjoys evening discussions with groups of senior students in his study. He enjoys cooperating with other and this has resulted in him being quite crucial to some high level stuff like killing the Blue Heron which the BHI gets its namesake from. He has the willingness to blackmail people and Forswear them which he has reaped great Karma and strengthened Practice from, he also counts as peer some quite extraordinary figures who have international renown. Powers: The Practice (Otherverse), Augury, Demesne, Implement As a Practitioner coming from a Practitioner Family who’s also managed to live to 45 Alexander is a very well established Practitioner, this gives his Practice much greater power, especially as he’s already got his Implement and Demesne, as an Augur he’s capable of divining a great many things, but most capably the future and he’s quite adept at gathering allies around himself. He’s created the Belanger Circle for this purpose which consists of apprentices he’s taken who he makes sure stay loyal to him.
objects.title: Alexander Belanger (Otherverse)

objects.text: Aliases: Suzuki Satoru, Momon, Ainz Ooal Gown Age: Early 30s Gender: Male Background Born on a dystopian earth, Suzuki Satoru was a salaryman who lived alone and dedicated nearly all his personal time to playing Yggdrasil as Momonga. He later created a guild named Ainz Ooal Gown and it became one of the strongest guilds in Yggdrasil. Eventually as time passed and guildmates left the game, he kept playing to upkeep the guild base and preserve the memories of his friends. When he stayed online when Yggdrasil shut down his mind was transfered into Momonga and he was sent to a new world. Powers Momonga is level 100 undead player with a build focused on instant death and necromancy. He has over 700 spells ranging from Tier 1 to Super Tier spells as well as a massive amount of items in his inventory. Momonga has a Skill called The Goal Of All Life Is Death which makes his instant death spell able to kill everything they target, even things that are not considered alive. He is also a very skilled combatant, a genius tacticion and has a lot of detailed knowledge about Yggdrasil.

objects.text: Real Name: Hana Song Gender: Female Age: 21 Background After a long and storied career in the e-sports scene, she was recruited by MEKA ("Mobile Exoforce of the Korean Army"), an armored unit in the Korean military that used mecha to fight the Omnic threat. She was granted "Tokki", her personal mech, and allowed to customize it to her taste. After barely beating back several major attacks on Busan, MEKA allowed her to transfer to the newly reformed Overwatch (at her request) to take the fight to the Omnics directly. Powers Professional gamer, entertaining streamer & actor, military trained, skilled mech pilot, & possesses technical skills enough to maintain, operate, & recreate her MEKA from scratch.
objects.title: D.Va (Overwatch)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: 31 biologically, 40 chronologically Background Mei was initially employed by Overwatch in a scientific capacity at their ecological research station in Antarctica. After a freak storm cut it off from the outside world, they decided to cryogenically freeze themselves and wait for rescue rather than allow themselves to slowly starve to death. Nine years later, Mei would awaken to discover that no rescue arrived, and that she was the sole survivor of the cryopods. Distraught, she used the information from the comms systems to determine that Overwatch had long since disbanded and that she was on her own. Now she returns to a world in crisis not having forgotten the idealism of a bygone age... Powers Skilled scientist and engineer, specializing in thermal technology, environmental sciences, & meteorology. Has basic combat training as part of Overwatch. She is also a skilled ice skater and survivalist.

Her suit grants her exceptional mobility, including the ability to fly through the air and reach allies in need with remarkable speed. objects.text:
Name: Lena Oxton
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: chronologically 26, but biologically 24

Power: Out of sync with space-time, with her cybernetics allowing her to control this to teleport & perform minor time travel, general high speed & agility, skilled air force test pilot à la Chuck Yeager, special forces infantry training, & the ability to maintain and reproduce her advanced field equipment

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Superhero/Vigilante
Quality of Life: Excellent (naturally upbeat, good home life with supportive girlfriend, loves her job)
objects.title: Tracer (Overwatch)

objects.text: Real Name: Amélie LaCroix Gender: Female Age: 35 Background Born Amélie Guillard to a family descended from the former nobility, she was only connected to the world of heroes and villains through her husband Gerard LaCroix, and his work with Overwatch. One day, that work would put him at odds with Talon, who would kidnap his wife and brainwash her into a sleeper agent; he would not survive the month. With her mind being so thoroughly turned inside out by the brainwashing, she had actually enjoyed the murder, like an addictive drug. From then on she joined Talon willingly, seeking the thrill of the hunt. Powers Extremely skilled marksman & assassin, possesses biological modifications (like a slowed heartrate for increased accuracy & a lower metabolism), & has the ability to maintain & reproduce her advanced field equipment.
objects.title: Widowmaker (Overwatch)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 18
Power: She is the demigod daughter of Athena, the Greek Goddess of Wisdom and War As such, she is a superhuman genius, tactician, and combatant. She is an experienced fighter and has been fighting monsters since the age of 6. She is extremely clever and crafty, able to out talk or outthink her enemies almost always and can come up with plans on the fly due to her being able to keep a cool head during battles. She also has the rest of the normal demigod's classic powers, superhuman strength, speed, agility, durability, Endurance, willpower and the ability to manipulate the mist.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Student
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Annabeth Chase (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Name: Mrs. O'Leary
Alias: None
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown

Power: Mrs. O'Leary is a massive hellhound with a range of supernatural abilities. As a hellhound, she possesses superhuman strength, speed, senses (including the ability to smell supernatural beings), durability, and the ability to Shadow Travel to almost any location, though this can be tiring for her. Additionally, if she is ever killed, she will eventually reform over time.

Due to the Mist, Mrs. O’Leary appears in two different forms: she may look like a large but ordinary dog, but her true form is that of a gigantic hellhound that is about as tall and large as a garbage truck. Additionally to complement this Mrs. O’Leary can use the Mist to adjust her size but she can not go smaller than a big mastiff or bigger than her true form.

Appearance: Cute, Menacing (in her real form)
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Good

Note: While she is a hellhound and a monster, Mrs. O'Leary is sweet, energetic, and playful. She adores her owners, including you, and can sense people who call or think of her name strongly enough, allowing her to Shadow Travel to their location. However, this ability may not always work if she is too far away or occupied. Lastly, because she was purchased as a companion, Mrs. O’Leary does not reform in Tartarus when killed, but instead naturally reforms in the mortal world.
objects.title: Mrs. O'Leary (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Ghost King
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 15
Power: Nico is a demigod, a child of Hades from the Greek Pantheon. That gives him powers related to many of his fathers domains, the strongest being his connection to the dead. He can sense the moment someone dies, summon and command spirits, and exert control over the reanimated dead. Like other children of the Underworld, he can traverse great distances through Shadow Travel, vanishing into darkness and emerging elsewhere. Nico can also radiates an unsettling aura of fear and dread, causing enemies to falter in his presence.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Camper
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Nico di Angelo (Percy Jackson)

objects.text: Age: 18 Gender: Male Background Born from Poseidon and Sally Jackson, a mortal human, Percy faced tribulations from a young age. Becoming aware of his nature as a demigod when he was twelve, he faced monsters and gods, and saved the world on more than one occasion. A good natured and bold young man, Percy is now focused on getting his degree at New Rome University and trying to leave the hero's life on the back seat. Though as a demigod, that's rather easier said than done. Powers Percy is a demigod, a child of Poseidon from the Greek Pantheon. That gives him powers related to many of his fathers domains, the strongest being his connection to water. He possesses hydrokinesis in macro scale, limited control over the weather, immunity to damage from water, greater strength and healing while inside a natural water body, and he only gets wet if he wishes. He can also communicate with any equine or sea creature, and has an overhauled enhanced body due to his godly heritage. Asides from it, he is an expert swordsman, and a competent leader.
objects.title: Percy Jackson (Percy Jackson)

objects.text: Aliases: Son of Jupiter Age: 16 Gender: Male Background Named after the legendary hero to appease Juno and avert her ire, Jason was left at age two in the care of Lupa, the wolf goddess, and her pack. He trained there until ready for Camp Jupiter, where he later battled the Titan Krios and rose to Praetor. Powers Jason is a demigod, a child of Jupiter from the Roman Pantheon. That gives him powers related to many of his father's domains, the strongest being his connection to air. He can summon winds to aid himself in combat or travelling, his control is great enough to be able to fly. He has also inherited his father's powers over thunder and lightning able to summon bolts of lightning over his enemies while he himself is immune to any form of electrical injury. He is skilled in fighting with both swords and spears and an excellent leader.
objects.title: Jason Grace (Percy Jackson)

objects.text: Designation: Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapon Model 7 Age by Manufacture Date: 10 (P3) Gender: Female Background Aigis is a robot embedded with a shard of Nyx known as a Papillon Heart, granting her the potential of true sapience and human emotion, although much of her initial struggle and success was wiped out of her memory banks when her First Mission in Yakushima was stricken from official records in 1999. She was reactivated ten years later just in time to run into S.E.E.S. during their summer vacation in Yakushima, joining on as Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi's bodyguard and a fellow student. She represents the Chariot Arcana in S.E.E.S., though she serves as the holder of Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi's Aeon Social Link. Powers Aigis uses special firearm weapon attaches as her signature weapons, usually through her hands, as well as her Persona, Palladion, who uses Slash and Strike-affinity Physical Skills to supplement her Pierce-affinity normal attacks but in trade off she is weak to Electric SMT skills. While Palladion can evolve into Pallas Athena with the right circumstances, Aigis has no canon third tier Persona. Aigis's default Theurgy is Orgia Mode, a "stance change" crowd hitting Pierce Skill that allows her to cast skills without cost afterwards at the drawback of being too wild to command followed by her overheating afterward. Her second, which she can obtain after obtaining Pallas Athena, is Maximum Firepower, a single targeting Pierce Skill that ignores any Pierce resistances. Outside of her Persona, Aigis is capable of translating the speech of dogs (which she inherited from an unnamed fifth gen AS2W unit) as well as the knowledge of how to lock pick.
objects.title: Aigis (Persona 3)

objects.text: Age: 17/18 (P3) Gender: Female Background Mitsuru is the heiress apparent to the Kirijo Group, a multifaceted company that split from its parent company Nanjo Konzern. She is childhood friends with Akihiko Sanada and Shinjiro Araki, with the trio being the first iteration of S.E.E.S., but couldn't conquer Tartarus. These days, Mitsuru leads the Kirijo Group and the Shadow Workers to quell Shadow nests, to make up for the sins made by the Kirijo Group and the Kirijo family. She represents the Empress Arcana, serving as the holder of Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi's Empress Social Link. Incidentally, Mitsuru had met Aigis way back during the latter's First Mission, though as a 7-year-old child. Powers Mitsuru uses rapiers as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Penthesilea, who primarily uses Ice SMT Skills and a secondary in Mental Ailment SMT Skills (infamously Marin Karin), but in trade off she is weak to Fire SMT skills. While Penthesilea can evolve into Artemisia with the right circumstances, Artemisia has no canon evolution. Mitsuru's default Theurgy is Blizzard Edge, a single targeting Ice Skill that ignores any Ice resistances. Her second, which she can obtain after obtaining Artemisia, is Blade of Execution, an Almighty Skill that deals massive damage and lowers an opponent's capabilities across the board if they live it. Outside of that, Mitsuru has experience with leadership, as well as rapier swordsmanship. Note Alternatively, you can get her as her 20-year-old incarnation from the Arena games, retaining access to both of her Theurgies.
objects.title: Mitsuru Kirijo (Persona 3)

objects.text: Age: 16/17 (P3) Gender: Female Background Yukari grew up a fairly normal childhood right up until her father Eiichiro, a Kirijo Group head scientist, was murdered by the mad Kouetsu Kirijo, Mitsuru's grandfather, for protesting in calling forth The Fall. Since his death, Yukari and her mother's relationship never recovered. The backlash of her father's death and her mother's shutdown and men chasing caused her to be introverted and guarded, eventually rebuking her mother. She represents the Lovers Arcana, serving as the holder of Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi's Lovers Social Link. Powers Yukari uses bows as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Io, who primarily uses Wind SMT Skills and Healing SMT Skills, but in trade off she is weak to Electricity SMT skills. While Io can evolve into Isis with the right circumstances, Isis has no canon evolution. Yukari's default Theurgy is Cyclone Arrow, a single targeting Wind Skill that ignores any Wind resistances. Her second, which she can obtain after obtaining Isis, is Tranquility, a Support Skill that grants a huge bonus to the party's next magic attack, herself included. Outside of that, Yukari has lived pretty independently of her mother, giving her knowledge of many domestic skills. Note Alternatively, you can get her in her "Pink Argus" incarnation from the Arena games, retaining access to both of her Theurgies.
objects.title: Yukari Takeba (Persona 3)

objects.text: Age: 16/17 (P3) Gender: Female Background Fuuka is descended from a long line of doctors that was broken with her parents. As a result of breaking tradition, they gained an inferiority complex, which in turn gave Fuuka her own inferiority complex. As a result of her shyness and kindness, she gets bullies on her case. The fateful case of bullying was when she was imprisoned in Gekkoukan Gym, resulting in her being transported in the Dark Hour during the Third Full Moon Operation, awakening to her Persona as a result. She represents the Priestess Arcana, serving as the holder of Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi's High Priestess Social Link. Powers Amongst S.E.E.S., her Persona Lucia is the only one that is not a fighter, though if somehow forced into one, Lucia can serve as a incredibly durable meat shield. She instead specializes in providing various supporting skills on and off the battlefield, like providing various buffs, debuffs, and heals, as well as helping with navigating the randomly generated floors of Tartarus. While Lucia can evolve into Juno with the right circumstances, Juno has no canon evolution. Fuuka also possesses a high spiritual endurance, allowing her to withstand the Dark Hour up to 10 hours by the time many S.E.E.S. members could withstand one.
objects.title: Fuuka Yamagishi (Persona 3)

objects.text: Age: Hours old Gender: Female Background Metis was born from the Sea of Souls as Aigis's Shadow Self, splintering from Aigis's existence due to her "sister"'s desiring to return to an emotionless state from her struggling to come to terms with Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi's death and awakening her Wild Card potential. Metis would then assist S.E.E.S. with their trials in the Abyss of Time, ultimately helping everyone with accepting the Redeemer of Man’s fate and moving on. With Aigis accepting her grief and emotions, Metis returned to Aigis's Sea of Souls. She represents the Hierophant Arcana in S.E.E.S. following the death of Shinjiro Aragaki. As Metis came into existence after the death of Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi and due to her own short presence, she doesn’t possess a canon Social Link. Powers Metis wields scepters as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Psyche, a mixed attacker that uses Slash and Strike-affinity Physical Skills as well as Ice and Wind SMT Skills. Unlike many Persona users, Psyche possesses a neutral affinity chart, granting her zero weaknesses or resistances. Due to Metis's short appearance, Psyche has no canon evolutions. Unlike many characters, Metis has two Theurgies starting out: her first, and one she inherited from Aigis, is Orgia Mode, a "stance change" Strike Physical attack that allows her to cast skills without cost afterwards at the drawback of being too wild to command followed by her overheating afterward, and Charging Blitz, a single targeting Strike attack that ignores resistances. Outside of her Persona, Metis is capable of translating the speech of dogs (which she inherited from Aigis).
objects.title: Metis (Persona 3 FES: The Answer)

objects.text: Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Kotone was orphaned after her parents were killed by Arcana Death during its battle with Aigis on the Moonlight Bridge in 1999 sometime after Aigis's First Mission. Unable to kill it, Aigis was forced to seal Death into Kotone. Unknown to anyone, this sealing would later influence Kotone into coming to Gekkoukan High, to allow the sealed Death to eventually reassemble itself into Nyx after each Arcana Shadow's defeat. As the Wild Card, she naturally represents the Fool Arcana in S.E.E.S., and arguably Death as well. Powers Kotone wields naginatas as her signature weapons, which deals Slash damage. As a Wild Card, Kotone is able to wield multiple Personas that she gains from Shuffle Time pulls or visits to the Velvet Room. Unlike many characters, Kotone can have more than two Theurgies due to her being a Wild Card, being able to unlock up to 18 Theurgies by registering 26 specific Personas in her Compendium. Below are P3 Fusion Spells that haven't yet been adapted into canon Theurgies in P3R or P5X. Frolic: (Narcissus + Pixie) Heavy Almighty crowd hitter with a high Charm rate. Summer Dream: (Titania + Oberon) Random Support Skill that combines Dekunda and either an all party version of Heat Riser, Rebellion, or Mediarahan. Thunder Call: (Thor + Take-Mikazuchi) Severe Piercing Elec crowd hitter with a high Shock rate. Valhalla: (Valkyrie + Odin) Severe Pierce to one target with a medium chance of insta-killing them. Raktapaksha: (Garuda + Gururu) Heavy Wind Piercing crowd hitter that removes all enemy buffs and has a medium chance to inflict Down. Infinity: (Vishnu + Ananta) Massive Almighty attack on a single target that applies a shield over teammates that negates the next enemy attack. Last Judge (Metatron + Mithra) Severe Light Piercing crowd hitting attack. Outside of her Persona, Kotone is able to cook and bake and is fairly independent due to her parents' deaths. Note Kotone is the easiest/only known canon way Shinjiro Aragaki will survive October 10th, as he holds Kotone's Moon Social Link.
objects.title: Kotone Shiomi (Persona 3 Portable)

objects.text: Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Naoto was adopted by her grandfather after she was orphaned by a car crash, allowing her to be fully invested into the Shirogane family tradition of being detectives. As a result of her unusual upbringing and more staunch minded coworkers, she faced many labels and stereotypes that forced her to repress her femininity right up until she was thrown headfirst into the TV World, awakening her Persona within the Secret Laboratory. She represents the Wheel of Fortune Arcana, serving as the holder of Yu Narukami's Fortune Social Link. Powers Naoto's Persona Sukuna-Hikona is unique amongst her fellow Investigation teammates in the fact she does not have a weakness, just a resistance to Light & Dark SMT Skills. In combat, she uses Almighty SMT Skills & the Hama & Mudo Insta Kill Skills as her main elements with a secondary in various support skills, as well as Agi/Bufu/Garu/Ziodyne. Sukuna-Hikona can evolve into Yamato Takeru and Yamato Sumeragi depending on the right circumstances. Outside of her Persona, Naoto is a trained detective and police officer.
objects.title: Naoto Shirogane (Persona 4)

objects.text: Alias: None Age: 18 Gender: Female Background Chie was an ordinary second year high schooler until Saki Konishi's murder in the TV World and Yukiko being the next would-be victim. She then joined the would-be Investigation Team and stormed Yukiko's Castle with them, leading to her awakening to her Persona halfway into it when she and the gang ran into Shadow Chie. She represents the Chariot Arcana, serving as the holder of Yu Narukami's Chariot Social Link. Powers Chie uses special shoes as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Tomoe, who primarily uses Physical Skills with her Ice SMT Skills as a distant secondary due to possessing an infamously poor Magic stat, but in trade off she is weak to Fire SMT skills. Tomoe can evolve into Suzuka Gongen and Haraedo-no-Okami with the right circumstances. Outside of her Persona, she possesses a rough kick-based fighting style made from her watching her beloved Kung fu movies one too many times, with her strongest attack being the Galactic Punt, which was an insta-kill for any unfortunate TV World Shadow that didn’t possess a defensive edge against Physical.
objects.title: Chie Satonaka (Persona 4)

objects.text: Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Naoto was adopted by her grandfather after she was orphaned by a car crash, allowing her to be fully invested into the Shirogane family tradition of being detectives. As a result of her unusual upbringing and more staunch minded coworkers, she faced many labels and stereotypes that forced her to repress her femininity right up until she was thrown headfirst into the TV World, awakening her Persona within the Secret Laboratory. She represents the Wheel of Fortune Arcana, serving as the holder of Yu Narukami's Fortune Social Link. Powers Naoto's Persona Sukuna-Hikona is unique amongst her fellow Investigation teammates in the fact she does not have a weakness, just a resistance to Light & Dark SMT Skills. In combat, she uses Almighty SMT Skills & the Hama & Mudo Insta Kill Skills as her main elements with a secondary in various support skills, as well as Agi/Bufu/Garu/Ziodyne. Sukuna-Hikona can evolve into Yamato Takeru and Yamato Sumeragi depending on the right circumstances. Outside of her Persona, Naoto is a trained detective and police officer.
objects.title: Yukiko Amagi (Persona 4)

objects.text: Idol Alias: Risette (EN) / Risechi (JP) Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Rise was an ex-idol who got burned out of the idol life, and went to live with her grandmother in Yasoinaba, only to run head first into the Midnight Channel Incident, and was rescued from the Marukyu Striptease by the Investigation Team and Teddie. She represents the Lovers Arcana, serving as the holder of Yu Narukami's Lovers Social Link. Powers Of the Inaba Investigation Team, her Persona Himiko is the only one that is not innately a fighter, though if pressed, she is able to modify Himiko into an offensive Persona, capable of using Almighty affinity damage. She normally specializes in providing various supporting skills on and off the battlefield, like providing various buffs, debuffs, and heals. Himiko can evolve into Kanzeon and Kouzeon with the right circumstances. While using her Persona in an offensive manner, she takes to using a wireless mic holstered in a stand as her weapon. Outside of her Persona, Rise is a trained idol, meaning she can sing and dance with the best of them.
objects.title: Rise Kujikawa (Persona 4)

objects.text: Designations: Unit #031 / Fifth Generation Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapon Labrys Age by Manufacture Date: 13 (P4A) Gender: Female Background Labrys is an Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapon unit with an innate Kansai-ben twang created by the Kirijo Group under Mitsuru’s grandfather. Due to her possessing a larger Plume of Dusk, she developed her personality quicker than others. For combat data and “optimizing data”, she had to fight and destroy her sister AS2W units in “sanctioned matches” until she was deactivated when she escaped after overhearing her “sentimental memories” would be deleted. By 2012, Mitsuru would find Labrys's deactivated body, but her plane was hijacked by Hi-no-Kagutsuchi and Labrys taken and thrown into the TV World, eventually awakening to her Persona. She represents the Fortune Arcana. As Labrys met Yu Narukami long after he made his Fortune S.Link with Naoto Shirogane, she doesn’t possess a canon Social Link. Powers Labrys wields an enormous great axe as her signature weapon that gets stronger the more she lands attacks, as well as her Persona, Ariadne, a Physical attacker. Due to being from a fighting game, Ariadne has no canon resistance chart outside of P5(R) DLC. Due to Labrys’s limited appearances, neither Ariadne or Asterius have canon evolutions. In no small part thanks to the Malevolent Entity’s machinations as well as her larger than normal Papillon Heart, Labrys has a Jekyll & Hyde relationship with herself and her Shadow Self. Unlike her regular self, Shadow Labrys has a different Persona: Asterius, a hulking mixed attacker Fire Persona that’s so huge, it’s partially submerged into the ground to fit into normal spaces. Whereas Labrys can largely fight by herself without needing Ariadne, Shabrys uses Asterius liberally.
objects.title: Labrys (Persona 4 Arena)

objects.text: Real name: Kusumi no Okami Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Initially a sulky and tsundere-like amnesiac unused to daily life humans take for granted with ties to the Velvet Room, she later learned who and what she was: an aspect of the cognitive goddess Izanami-no-Okami who exists to perpetuate the fog cycle of Inaba, causing her to become suicidal and despondent until the Investigation Team rescued her from the Hollow Forest and herself. She represents the Aeon Arcana, serving as the holder of Yu Narukami's Aeon Social Link. Powers Marie as Kusumi no Okami was able to use various SMT elemental attacks, her favorite being the ironically named Hot Lightning, which is Almighty, not Electric. Even after being defeated in the Hollow Forest by the Investigation Team, Marie still retains much of her power of Kusumi no Okami, as seen with her becoming essentially Inaba's kami, influencing its weather patterns, as well as her using Kusumi no Okami for her Arena Ultimax Instant Kill attack. Other than that, Marie is an budding poet who later becomes a weatherwoman, and ran a service that duplicated Skill Cards Yu Narukami had found in his adventures.
objects.title: Marie (Persona 4 Golden)

objects.text: Alias: Panther Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Ann is an aspiring fashion model and one of the four founding members of the Phantom Thieves of Hearts. She became a Phantom Thief after she joined the others going into Kamoshida's Palace after her friend Shiho Suzui was raped by the Palace owner and attempted to kill herself. She represents the Lovers Arcana, serving as Joker's Lovers Confidant. Powers Ann's powers are entirely reliant on her being in an alternate world; without that, she's a regular girl. She uses a whip and SMGs as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Carmen, who primarily uses Fire SMT Skills, as well as single target heals and sleep/Charm ailment skills, but is also weak to Ice SMT skills. Carmen can evolve into Hecate and Célestine with the right circumstances.
objects.title: Ann Takamaki (Persona 5)

objects.text: Alias: Queen Age: 19 Gender: Female Background Makoto is an aspiring college student studying law as so she can become a police chief, to honor the late Papa Niijima. She became a Phantom Thief after she joined the others going into Kaneshiro's Palace after she was pressured by Principal Kobayakawa to find both Kaneshiro and the Phantom Thieves. She represents the High Priestess Arcana, serving as Joker's Priestess Confidant. Powers Makoto's powers are entirely reliant on her being in an alternate world; without that, she's a regular girl, though one with training in aikido. She uses knuckledusters and revolvers as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Johanna, who primarily uses Nuclear SMT Skills, as well as various heals and various buffing skills, but is also weak to Psychokinetic SMT skills. Johanna can evolve into Anat and Agnes with the right circumstances.
objects.title: Makoto Niijima (Persona 5)

objects.text: Alias: Oracle (EN) / Navi (JPN) Age: 16 Gender: Female Background She is a hacker par excellence, having inherited all of her mother Wakaba's brains. She is also a recovering agoraphobic, mostly caused by her shitty family blaming her for Wakaba Isshiki's mental shutdown and death (though being born out of wedlock probably meant she was not gonna be accepted anyways), with her uncle Youji neglecting her to the point Sojiro Sakura fought for custody rights and won. Her mental only started improved after she asked the Phantom Thieves to steal her heart, resulting in her awakening her Persona inside own Palace. She represents the Hermit Arcana, serving as Joker's Hermit Confidant. Powers Futaba's powers are entirely reliant on her being in an alternate world; without that, she's a regular girl, if, again, a really smart hacker/programmer. Of the Phantom Thieves, her Persona Necronomicon is the only one that is not a fighter. She instead specializes in providing various supporting skills on and off the battlefield, like providing various buffs, debuffs, and heals, as well as helping with navigating the randomly generated floors of Mementos. Necronomicon can evolve into Prometheus and Al Azif with the right circumstances.
objects.title: Futaba Sakura (Persona 5)

objects.text: Alias: Noir Age: 18 Gender: Female Background Haru is an aspiring college student in business and heir apparent to Okumura Foods after her father Kunikazu Okumura died from a mental shutdown at the hands of Gorou Akechi as Shido's hitman to frame the Phantom Thieves. She became a Phantom Thief after she found Morgana during his tantrum phase inside Kunikazu's Palace, partially awakening her Persona. She wouldn’t wake it fully until days later, after she met her father's Shadow. She represents the Empress Arcana, serving as Joker's Empress Confidant. Powers Haru's powers are entirely reliant on her being in an alternate world; without that, she's a regular girl. She uses an axe and a grenade launcher as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Milady, who primarily uses Psychokinetic SMT Skills, with her Persona skill set allowing her to fit into a few niches, but in trade off she is weak to Nuclear SMT skills. Milady can evolve into Astarte and Lucy with the right circumstances.
objects.title: Haru Okumura (Persona 5)

objects.text: Alias: Sophie (Yes, that's her actual Phantom Thief alias) Age: Unknown (Anywhere from months to a year+ old) Gender: Female Background Sophia is an AI developed by Kuon Ichinose, a computer software programmer beyond even Futaba's level of expertise. She was made to study the human heart out of Ichinose's misbelief that she herself didn't understand emotions (really she was just super depressed and never realized it), but had her memories wiped when she unwittingly triggered Ichinose, and was abandoned in favor of an inferior AI, EMMA. Sophia was later discovered by Joker, Skull, and Mona in the trash underneath the Shibuya Jail's Birdcage, and became a vital member of the Phantom Thieves for the rest of Summer 2017, especially after awakening to Pandora in the Jail of the Abyss. Powers As a AI, Sophia normally has no corporeal form outside of areas like the Metaverse, and as a result usually resides in a cellphone like she did with Joker's. She uses a pair of yo-yos and a laser pistol with huge, slow shots as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Pandora, who primarily uses Light SMT Skills, with her Persona skill set making her a powerful "Red Mage", but in trade off she is weak to Dark SMT skills. Pandora has no canonical evolutions.
objects.title: Sophia (Persona 5 Strikers)

objects.text: Alias: Violet Age: 15 Gender: Female Background Sumire is an aspiring gymnist, who gained an inferiority complex over her twin Kasumi. One day, this complex reaches a boiling point and ran away in frustration, only for Kasumi to sacrifice herself to prevent Sumire from getting hit by a truck. Her mental worsened until Maruki intervened, making Sumire believed she was Kasumi until the Third Semester Arc, where Sumire accepted her true self and moved on from Kasumi's death. She represents the Faith Arcana, serving as Joker's Faith Confidant. Powers Sumire's powers are entirely reliant on her being in an alternate world; without that, she's a regular girl. She uses a rapier and a lever-action shotgun as her signature weapons, as well as her Persona, Cendrillon, who primarily uses Physical and Light SMT Skills, but in trade off she is weak to Dark SMT skills. Cendrillon can evolve into Vanadis and Ella with the right circumstances.
objects.title: Sumire Yoshizawa (Persona 5 Royal)
Erina (Persona 5 Tactica)
objects.text: Age: Unknown (Resembling late teens) Gender: Female Background Erina was born a rebellious Cognition of Japanese National Diet politician Toshiro Kasukabe's memories of his equally rebellious high school friend Eri Natsuhara, and was the leader of the Rebel Corp that shook its sabers at the tyrant rulers of the three Kingdoms created by Salmael in an attempt to destroy Toshiro after subtle subterfuge to break his rebellious will failed. During their operations in the Nakabachi Kingdom, Erina evolved beyond what a Cognition was capable of, and gained the ability to transform into Ernesto, Toshiro's Persona. Powers As a combatant, Erina prefers using a spear with the Rebel Corps banner adorning it, with semi-automatic pistols as her gun choice. For her main attacking skills, Erina uses a line of Physical Skills unique to her named Partisan that had a high Forget/Mute/Silence proc rate. Due to the nature of Tactica mechanics, Erina has no traditional learnset. When Toshiro calls on the power of Ernesto while Erina is nearby, she is immune to any environmental hazards she may have unleashed through Toshiro's decisions with wielding Ernesto. Other than that, Erina has amateurish field dressing skills, which she learned from her time as a solo rebel fighting Cognitive Marie. Note You can alternatively have it so that Erina summons Ernesto like a traditional Persona instead of becoming Ernesto.

Name: Jack Sparrow Title: Pirate Lord of the Caribbean Sea Alignment: Chaotic Neutral Gender: Male Sex: Male Age: 40+ Power: He is a skilled sailor, marksman, and swordsman familiar with the four corners of the world. Power: Chell is a remarkably resilient and determined individual, possessing an unbreakable willpower that allows her to endure extreme mental and physical stress. She is a skilled problem solver, able to think quickly and utilize her surroundings to escape even the most dangerous situations.

Her most notable ability comes from her proficiency with the Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device (Portal Gun), which allows her to create two linked portals on any suitable surface. She can use these portals to traverse great distances, bypass obstacles, or build momentum for high-speed movement.

She also wears Long Fall Boots, which completely negate fall damage, allowing her to drop from any height without injury. Chell’s endurance is nearly superhuman, surviving countless deadly testing chambers, electrocution, turret fire, crushing hazards, and even direct confrontations with GLaDOS and Wheatley.

objects.text: Alias: “Caroline”, Genetic Lifeform and Disk Operating System Alignment: Lawful Evil Age: Unknown (Likely somewhere between 40-70 years old, if you are to include Caroline’s lifetime) Gender: Female Sex: Female Power: GLaDOS is among Aperture Science’s greatest works, being an Artificial Intelligence that was designed to act as the overseer, central computer, and highest authority in the Aperture Science Enrichment Center. Within the Enrichment Center, she is effectively omniscient, and able to control everything inside of it with ease. She harbors genius-level intelligence, deep scientific knowledge, and a talent in psychological warfare and manipulation. She was so smart, in fact, that after her first activation went very wrong, the scientists who developed her created various ‘personality cores’ to restrict her further in order to prevent her from attacking the staff again, one was even developed with the sole purpose of making her dumber. Appearance: Beautiful, but Married… to Science. Civilian Identity: N/A Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs (Was a human woman named Caroline, was hired as the assistant to Aperture Science’s CEO, witnessed the downfall of Aperture Science and the last years of said CEO’s life, had her brain scanned and downloaded into an AI, who (due to how it was designed) became malevolent and addicted to testing, to the point of essentially killing others for the sake of Science.) (After dying, being turned back on, and being dethroned from her position by a moron for a time, GLaDOS has become slightly better personality-wise and is still testing. She is currently raising baby birds as her personal ‘killing machines’.)

Well now, due to possessing both the original Chemical X and the knowledge on how it works, you have been able to give Powerpuff Girls Z the powers and abilities of their alternate counterparts. objects.text: Aliases: Momoko Akatsutsumi (Hyper Blossom), Miyako Gotokuji (Rolling Bubbles), Kaoru Matsubara (Powered Buttercup) Gender: Female Age: 13 Background Originally three normal middle school students; this version of the Powerpuff Girls would receive powers when an event in that world’s Professor Utonium (Utonium Kitazawa) lab would cause a modified version of Chemical X, called Chemical Z, that can travel as energy or Z Rays, that would launch out, empowering the three unrelated girls and empowering their future enemies as well. Balancing their normal civilian lives and heroics like stereotypical Magical Girls. Powers The girls share the same set of general powers, such as enhanced physical ability, enhanced senses, flight, and energy manipulation, along with a powerful resistance to corruption and probability manipulation. Each of the girls also has access to their Ninja transformation and the Dynamo Z, a transforming mecha with its three forms based on the girls, that the girls can summon on command in peak condition. However, they each have something they specialize in: Hyper Blossom with her yo-yos, Rolling Bubbles with her use of bubbles, and Powered Buttercup with her hammer.
objects.title: The Powerpuff Girls Z (Powerpuff Girls Z)

addons.text:
Something happened to Tommy's Master Morpher, whether due to a resonance with your own Morpher, crossed wires or the Will of the Grid itself, it has led to all of Tommy's Ranger forms and their connections to the Morphin Grid to merge together until Tommy wore the armour of his anomalous Evil Counterpart, Lord Drakkon.

However; unlike Lord Drakkon Tommy is better able to control this power and remain sane as well due in large part of him being in a better headspace and none of the Ranger Powers were forcefully stolen. Even unmorphed Tommy's base abilities rival those of a Power Ranger with a Battleizer (upgraded armour mode) along with low level reality warping abilities he mostly uses to summon Ranger Sentinels to help around or act as rank and file soldiers.

When in his Ranger form Tommy's already enhanced powers rise further as do his Sentinels to the power a war of Multiversal Conquest is something they can easily take part in, either as the Defenders or the Conquerors themselves.

Along with this surge of Morphin Grid Energy the secrets of the Grid have revealed themselves to you, giving you the knowledge to create any piece of Power Ranger equipment seen, hinted at or implied from the series along with the rest of Saban's Entertainment catalogue.​
addons.title: Recreation of an Anomaly

Abilities:
Kyoko wields a long red spear that can shift shape and extend at will. She uses it with exceptional proficiency in both close and mid-range combat. Her weapon can split into multiple segments connected by chains, allowing her to entangle enemies or strike from unexpected angles. Kyoko can also summon copies of her spear and throw them as projectiles. Like all magical girls, she has enhanced strength, speed, agility, and healing. Kyoko is also capable of creating illusions to distract her enemies, a skill she rarely uses.

Personality:
Kyoko is fiercely independent and initially appears selfish, focusing on her own survival. This stems from the trauma of her wish backfiring and resulting in her family's deaths. She believes magical girls should fight for their own gain, not for idealistic reasons. Despite this harsh worldview, she deeply values those who remind her of her younger self, especially Sayaka Miki, with whom she shares a complicated bond. Beneath her tough exterior is a girl who has suffered deeply and still seeks connection, even if she rarely admits it.

Abilities: Mami's main weapon as a magical girl are her ribbons. These ribbons can be summoned on command from nowhere or from Mami's clothing when she is transformed. These ribbons can be utilised in a multitude of different. Mami can use the durability of her ribbons to cut through enemies, she can also use her ribbons to bind enemies and hold them in place, Mami can also use her ribbons to create various different kinds of constructs, she can create structures as platforms for movement, she can create shields and barriers to block attacks, she can also form a duplicate of herself using her ribbons, and she can also construct old fashioned muskets and ammunition from her ribbons.

Personality: Mami has a strong sense of personal justice, and so helps innocents while disregarding the lack of rewards for her efforts. This leads to Mami killing familiars before they can develop into witches. As other magical girls would rather wait until a familiar has developed into a witch to harvest their grief seeds, Mami has trouble working with other magical girls. This, compounded with Mami being orphaned early in her life, turns Mami into a very isolated person, seeking friendship and companionship.

Appearance: Beautiful

Abilities: 
Mahou Shoujo (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)
Her main weapon as a magical girl is a handheld mirror. Her unique magic that she acquired as a result of her wish is suggestion, it allows her to hypnotise others, including witches, familiars, and even herself, to follow her orders. Mikoto Sena can use this magic to change her own identity in the perspective of other people.

Background: When Mikoto was little, her parents took her to the summer festival for the first time. Her father didn't seem very interested at all in the festival, but he had told Mikoto that today was special, and that she could get anything she wanted. She had wanted one of the prizes of a lottery, and so her father went and started pulling tickets. He pulled one ticket after another, but no matter how much he tried, he always got pity prizes. With a reminder from her mother that they wouldn't have enough money for the rest of the festival, her father gave up, and apologises to Mikoto, handing her a one of the small prizes instead, a handheld mirror. Mikoto remembered that her father had a sad look on his face that day.

In the current day, she lives in a household troubled due to her father's reckless and inconsiderate spending, causing her parents to constantly fight, sometimes even resulting in physical abuse. At school, she can't participate in any events that costs money. She pretends that everything is okay, but her lies make her feel isolated from her friends.

Mikoto makes a contract with Kyubey, wishing her father left, hoping that with her father gone, her mother wouldn't constantly be abused and they would have more money. It works, it turns out her father was cheating with another woman and now he's leaving them for her, initially, Mikoto was really happy, however, despite the financial and verbal abuse of her father, her mother still loved him, resulting in her mother turning to the same bad habits as her dad, and she's hardly ever home anymore. Now they're even poorer, and Mikoto still had to pretend that everything was fine.

Quality of Life: Bad (Her mother had a toxic relationship with her father, eventually resulting in her feeling isolated and alone)
objects.title: Mikoto Sena (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text:
Allignment: Chaotic Evil

Appearance: Terrifying

Background:
The Witch of Mirrors, or the Mirror Witch is a witch birthed from the soul gem of Mikoto Sena. 

Her familiars aren’t for fighting, but for playing house. Much like how she used her magic to create a false family in her life, her Witch copies the people that enter its labyrinth to make a false family as well.

Abilities:
The mirror witch's familiars replicate not only the physical appearance of a Magical Girl, but their abilities and memories as well, so well that some familiars are duplicated so faithfully that even the familiars themselves are not always aware that they are not the original. 

The mirror labyrinth has the ability to entrance people who have entered its labyrinth, instilling within them a desire to continue venturing deeper into its endless expanse at the expense of their own safety. Such victims will act and speak strangely, this enchantment will not disappear even when outside of the labyrinth. 

The Mirror Witch is capable of connecting its labyrinth with the labyrinths of its familiars that have matured into Witches (effectively, a matured Familiar's barrier becomes an extension of a massive shared barrier spanning many different locations at the same time, and there can be multiple instances of the Mirror Witch within that barrier at once). 

This includes barriers of other Mirror Witches from other universes. The Witch's labyrinth is also capable of connecting to the past and future of the timeline it resides in, and other timelines and/or universes entirely, and so time paradoxes may also occur via its labyrinth, for which the Mirror Witch acts as a corrective function to resolve: if a paradox were to occur as a result of its connection throughout time, and if a portal that would allow for the timeline to be corrected were to be removed or destroyed, the product of the paradox would be instantly destroyed; for example, an object from the past that is brought to a future, that is then unable to return to the past when the portal is was brought through is destroyed, would be instantly destroyed.
