objects.text: Alias: Mental Out Age: 14 Gender: Female Background Misaki is a student at Tokiwadai Middle School and is one of the seven Level 5 espers. Due to her powers, she has been a part of several Academy City experiments, including Project Exterior and the Clone Dolly experiment—a precursor to the Level 6 Shift project. Powers Misaki's power, Mental Out, allows her to control various fluids on a microscopic scale to manipulate a target's mind. The control is incredibly precise, allowing her to view and edit memories, manipulate senses, rewrite the personality of a target, implant commands, or even remotely pilot them like a puppet. She can exercise precise control on up to fourteen individuals or control hundreds of people with simple commands. Due to the high degree of freedom her power offers, Misaki usually makes use of remotes to mentally restrict various applications of power to different remotes and buttons. Her power can also be exerted on fluids outside of a living being, allowing her to flash-freeze objects or even create complex coatings that nullify friction. She can also access residual memories of inanimate objects, giving her a limited form of psychometry.
objects.title: Misaki Shokuhou (Raildex)

objects.text: Age: Teenager Gender: Male Background Gunha is a student in one of Academy City's high schools. He is currently the strongest Gemstone esper and the only Gemstone Level 5. However, while being among the strongest Level 5s, his power is not currently understood, leading to him being the last in the rankings. Powers His power is not properly understood. But so far he has demonstrated the ability to regenerate grievous and mortal wounds in mere moments, increased durability enough to catch a railgun projectile with his teeth, moving at twice the speed of sound, creating inexplicable explosions and defensive barriers, and much more.
objects.title: Gunha Sogita (Raildex)

objects.text: Alias: Meltdowner Age: Teenager Gender: Female Background Shizuri was born to one of the five wealthiest families in the world and since childhood was immersed in the family's criminal dealings. Some time after she enrolled in Academy City, she became a Level 5 esper and a leader of her own Dark Side group — Item. Powers Her power, Meltdowner, allows her to control electrons in a state when they are neither particles nor waves. In practice, this allows her to create electron beams that can burn through steel, electron shields that disintigrate matter on contact, use electron bursts for propulsion, etc. Being an electric-type esper also grants her a heightened resistance to electricity, but not a complete immunity.
objects.title: Shizuri Mugino (Raildex)

objects.text:
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 15

Power: Being a clone of Academy City's first ranked Level 5 esper, Accelerator, Yuriko possesses the same ability as him. It creates a thin AIM field around her that allows her to alter vector values of anything that comes into contact with the field. This field also automatically redirects any harmful vectors that come into contact with it. While powerful, overreliance on her ability left her extremely physically weak.

Appearance: Beautiful

Quality of Life: Bad (She is a clone in a city that half the time does not treat regular humans as people).
objects.title: Yuriko Suzushina (Raildex)

objects.text:
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Early teens

Power: Frenda is a Level 0 esper and thus doesn't have any supernatural powers. Nonetheless, she is very proficient with various weapons, especially explosives, some of which she creates herself due to her extensive knowledge of chemistry.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: student at one of the Academy City's high schools

Quality of Life: Varies (Member of a Dark Side group, rich, underling to a mentally unstable Level 5).
objects.title: Frenda Seivelun (Raildex)

objects.text: Names: Itsuki Yakumaru / Naruha Sakuragi / Rita Iizumi (Leader) / Taroumaru Seike Gender: Female / Female / Female / Male Sex: Female / Female / Female / Male Age: Teenagers Powers: Rita has a level 3 esper ability Predator that allows her to locate a target without regard for distance. When activated, she will see numerous eye shapes in the sky that will then start converging towards the target. Taroumaru possesses an ability called Stick Slip that allows him to control frictional coefficients within a meter of himself, to a point that maximising air friction will cause bullets to melt, and even giant 120-ton mechas cannot move through it. Itsuki has an ability Mix Master that allows her to separate liquids by manipulating their specific gravity. Mixing separated liquids in the right ratios lets her create chemicals with various properties. For example, coolant that reaches -269 degrees Celsius for flash-freezing enemies, chemical that produces liquid thermite reaction, containment foam, painkillers, and so on. Naruha’s ability, Paper Perfect, allows her to freely manipulate paper into various forms and shapes. The properties of the paper she uses also change to have the flexibility of cloth and the strength of hardened alloy. She can create furniture, clothes, armor, weapons, and even imitate complex machinery, although it requires a lot of focus to maintain it. Appearance: Attractive Civilian identity: Dark side mercenary-type group. Quality of life: Mostly good, unless they bump into level 5 esper during a job.
objects.title: Scavenger (Raildex)

objects.text: Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: 14 Power: Kaibi possesses an esper ability called Measure Heart that allows her to set herself at a certain "distance in the heart" from a target, thus, adjusting the feelings the target has towards her. If she sets herself at the same distance as the target's loved one, for example, then the target would feel the same affection for her, and will be no more able to attack her than they would be able to attack their loved one, even objectively knowing that they are not the same person. Appearance: Beautiful Civilian Identity: Operative of dark side organisation SCHOOL Quality of life: Mostly good
objects.title: Kaibi Gokusai (Raildex)

objects.text:
Epithet: The One who Purifies God and Slays Demons

Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 15

Power: In his right arm, Touma wields a power called Imagine Breaker that allows him to dispel various supernatural phenomena. But that is only the tip of the iceberg, as Imagine Breaker itself serves as a seal to much more mysterious and terrifying powers, the origins of which are not yet truly understood.

Appearance: Average

Civilian Identity: student at a Certain High School

Quality of Life: Bad (Constantly forced to deal with dangerous enemies due to the City he is living in being designed to pit him against adversaries to develop his powers).
objects.title: Touma Kamijou (Raildex)

objects.text: Magic Name: Regnum771 Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: 12 Power: Leivinia is a very knowledgeable and powerful magician with a genius-level intellect. She uses Golden-style Magic, a system primarily based on Hermeticism and Kabbalah. Appearance: Beautiful Civilian Identity: leader of the Dawn-colored Sunlight, the largest magical cabal in London Quality of Life: Good (Rich, leader of powerful magical cabal).
objects.title: Leivinia Birdway (Raildex)

addons.text:
The lonely Goddess has finally found something she has been unknowingly longing for for ages.

With your unique nature, your powers, the situation you found yourself in, or anything else piquing her interest and facilitating an initial connection, you both will over a short period of time learn to understand each other better than anyone or anything else, developing a mutual unbreakable bond, although the exact nature of your relationship will be left for you to determine.

With Othinus no longer suffering from crippling loneliness, she will no longer wish to destroy and remake the world as she was going to do before, content with simply staying by your side till the end of time. On the other hand, as this bond is deeper than any simple friendship, infatuation, or love, if either of you loses another, the consequences will be dire and unpredictable, with the one left alive quite possibly becoming a far worse monster than any of you could be before.
addons.title: Understander

objects.text: Epithet: Odin Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: Countless years old Power: Othinus is a Magic God of Norse mythology; as such, she has mastery over all spells that are related to or attributed to the chief god, Odin, as well as a multitude of extremely powerful spiritual items, such as Bone-Boat, which is used to transport the user to any point in the world by rotating the planet itself underneath the user, or Gungnier, the mythical lance of Odin that can destroy the universe once thrown. As a Magic God, Othinus possesses an almost unmatched ability to manipulate reality however she wishes through the use of phase manipulation. She can cause galaxies to collide, destroy anything by breaking the bonds between particles, create billions of phases instantly, each of which can be a universe in and of itself, complete with their own internal logic and laws, and much more. Appearance: Beautiful Quality of Life: Bad (After changing reality countless times she forgot how to restore her original one, as such she yearns to restore the world to the way it was before her tampering, or, alternatively, at least have somebody in this new world that she can have a genuine connection and understanding with).
objects.title: Othinus (Raildex)

addons.text:
Through some miracle, you had been able to rewrite the contract that bound Qliphah to her creator, the great demon Coronzon, making her your loyal familiar.

This allows you to telepathically communicate with Qliphah regardless of distance, even if she is incorporeal, peer through her senses, instantly summon her to your side, or empower her by channelling various energies you have access to.

You can also allow her to enter your body, gaining temporary access to all of her abilities, which are strengthened exponentially due to her becoming more stable in a proper physical body. Or you can temporarily surrender control to her, partially or fully, to allow her to wield your powers instead.

Lastly, the contract of familiar allows Qliphah to restore herself even after complete annihilation so long as you are still alive.
addons.title: The Stepping Stone of Wickedness That Supports Good Deeds

objects.text:
Numerological Value: 11

Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown

Power: Qliphah specialises in control and possession. While she lacks direct offensive capabilities, she is able to exert influence on the minds of others. Someone who is not experienced enough in dealing with Qliphoth has no way of defending himself; even a brief glance at her is enough to shock, confuse, and damage the mind. She can possess other people, remotely influence their minds, or assume direct control of their bodies through countless poisonous threads.

Among other things, she is not bound by gravity, able to effortlessly fly or hover in the air, as well as able to exist in an incorporeal state, creating a physical body when she needs one. When she materialises her physical form, she is similar in structure to an antropomorphized tree of Qliphoth. Someone must be able to destroy all 10 spheres and 22 paths to kill her; otherwise, she will be able to completely regenerate in time.

Lastly, her true nature is that of the guide. While the path to the Abyss in both Sephiroth and Qliphoth is controlled by Coronzon, if she can get access to a new cosmic hierarchy, she can assume the role of the guide, able to ascend individuals to a higher state of existence.

Appearance: Beautiful
objects.title: Qliphah Puzzle 545 (Raildex)

objects.text:
Epithet: Silver Star, The Greatest Magician in History, The Greatest Eccentric of the 20th Century
Magic Name: Beast666

Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: More than a hundred years old.

Power: Aleister is an incredibly knowledgeable and powerful magician. He is considered to be one of, if not the strongest magician in the world, and certainly the most influential, with his theories and practices defining the standard for all modern magic.

He mastered both magic and science to the point where he can contend with True Magic Gods while remaining human, create an entire new system of supernatural abilities, separating the world between science and magic sides, and much more.

Appearance: Androgynous

Civilian Identity: Board Chairman of Academy City
Quality of life: Bad (Depressed after the loss of his first daughter, hates the world that caused this, cursed to continuously fail in all his endeavours).

Note: If you so desire, Aleister can join you in his alternate body that he moved his consciousness into after releasing his various possibilities, Aleis-tan.
objects.title: Aleister Crowley (Raildex)

objects.text: Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: Approximately 30 Powers: Anna is an expert among experts, and has honed numerous types of magic, mostly fundamental magics, common spells, and basic ceremonies, past the limit to the extreme, such that they can be considered special and unique skills. This includes anti-recognition spells, people-clearing fields, and even basic refinement of magic power. Anna can conceal herself and other individuals from humans and mechanical cameras and sensors, and even possesses a temporal and spatial 'separation', that can isolate herself and a target from the rest of the world. She can also use simple, standard symbols in magic circles, such as a line, circle or triangle to terrifying effect; for example, she once used her foot to draw a line, which then sliced through several hundred tons of conjured sand, returning it to nothingness. She is also capable of using the magic circles prepared by others, while only using a simple pose, like a raised palm. Anna can emit magic power outside of her body, which can deflect some projectiles, and she could also use this to manifest 'non-existent things'. She is skilled in Rosicrucian and Kabbalah magic, and is an expert in Sephiroth, Qliphoth and Astrology. Appearance: Beautiful Civilian Identity: A member of the Theosophical Society and Leader of her own cabal, teacher of Mathers and Westcott. Quality of Life: Unknown Note: You may choose the version of Anna Kingsford back when she was still alive, or you can choose the version that was reanimated using technology after her death.
objects.title: Anna Kingsford (Raildex)

objects.text: Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: ~1000 years old. Power: Ladylee is an immortal girl, having eaten Ambrosia, a fruit that bestows immortality upon whoever consumes it, and is unable to die, age, rot, immune to all illnesses, diseases, disorders, entirely self-sustained, and will regenerate from any and all injuries no matter how destructive, even if some may incapacitate her for a while. Due to changes in her life force, she cannot use magic directly but nevertheless gathered an incredible amount of magical knowledge, as well as proficiency in creating magic tools. Appearance: Beautiful Civilian Identity: CEO of Orbit Portal Company Quality of life: Horrible (At this point she had already spent hundreds of years trying to kill herself in various ways without success, after growing weary with her long life)
objects.title: Ladylee Tangleroad (Raildex)

objects.text:
Epithet: Dweller in the Abyss
Numerological Value: 333

Age: ???

Personality: Coronzon sees humans as beings lower than itself, like ants, primarily stemming from her belief that humanity is bad as humans are a threat to the natural order of the world. 

Coronzon is sadistic, manipulative and self-serving. It grants wishes to humans out of amusement, and also delights itself through crafting tragedies. 

Powers: Coronzon is a demon that dwells behind the Sephiroth in the same Abyss as Da'at, well versed in Enochian magic and Thelema. It can possess sentient beings and inanimate objects as hosts, and can draw on magical energy from another dimension to empower the abilities of it's host. Coronzon is also capable of creating artificial demons like Qliphah Puzzle 545.

Appearance: ???

Civilian Identity: Dweller of the Abyss

Quality of Life: ???

Note: You can choose whether Coronzon appears in their true form, or as their primary host, Laura Stuart
objects.title: Coronzon (Raildex)

addons.title: The Key to the Imaginary Number District
addons.text:
Due to the prodigious amounts of AIM Diffusion fields you are able to produce, Kazakiri Hyouka is able to hold her form within your vicinity continuously, regenerating even if her body is destroyed without needing to return to the Imaginary Number District.

This will allow her to follow you and maintain herself even in worlds that possess metaphysics that would impede her appearance.

You will be able to communicate with her via telepathy through your AIM Diffusion field even when she isn't materialized.

What's more is that, through this connection, she is able to easily access her FUZE=Kazakiri mode by borrowing your processing power, with her strength growing dramatically in proportion to your esper abilities and processing power.

She won't be vulnerable to being controlled against her will by external threats that could tamper with AIM fields as she is linked to yours. With your permission, you may allow her to use your Esper abilities through the bond you share.

objects.text: Alias: FUZE=Kazakiri Gender: Female Age: Mid-teens physically Background Hyouka is the conscious form of the aggregation of the AIM Diffusion Fields of all espers in Academy City, the Imaginary Number District, who gained sentience the moment Touma entered the city, as Imagine Breaker led to her obtaining a fear of death. As an artificial angel, an angel created by science instead of religion, she normally resides in the Imaginary Number District, separated from humanity, though she can enter the physical world for short periods to visit her friends. Powers As an amalgamation of the AIM fields with a consciousness, she is indestructible, allowing her to recreate any damage done to her body. Even with the complete destruction of her AIM Core, it would only momentarily hinder her. Her strength allows her to lift objects several times her own weight and punch through walls with ease. She is capable of turning into FUZE=Kazakiri if she is in an area emitting high concentrations of AIM Diffusion fields and if enough processing power is available to her. While in this form, she can fire a beam-like attack that can reach up to several tens of kilometers and put up a force field around people to protect them from all harm. She can fly at hypersonic speeds and summon a sword made of pure energy at will. Lastly, she may exude more pressure on reality via AIM fields to nullify magic, inducing severe backlash in the perpetrator, possibly even killing them, depending on the scale of the action. However, in worlds outside of Raildex, her artifical angel mode is unlikely to be available.
objects.title: Kazakiri Hyouka (Raildex)

addons.title: The Camps
addons.text:
You gain all of the camps that Natsuki Subaru has managed to secure the loyalty and devotion of, as well as all Camps for the throne of Lagunica. This includes every person affiliated with those camps, as well as their armies, leaders, knights, and other explicitly established members.

You may decide whether their loyalty and devotion remain directed toward Subaru. By default, however, their loyalty and devotion are directed toward you.

The camps you gain include Felt’s, Crusch’s, Emilia’s, Priscilla’s, and Anastasia’s, along with their respective knights, armies, and all other people explicitly belonging to those camps. This includes individuals such as Felix, Ricardo, Petra, Julius, and many others. as well as the Army he raised, the Pleiades Battalion, and those he gained the loyalty of in Vollachia, and much more.

objects.text: Name: Natsuki Subaru Sex: Male Age: 17 Background Subaru was a fairly ordinary teenage boy—albeit a shut-in—until he mysteriously found himself in Od Laguna. Despite everything that’s happened, he deeply misses his parents. Powers He possesses several Authorities of Sin. Among them is Return by Death, which allows him to rewind time to a somewhat unpredictable point, functioning much like checkpoints in a video game. He also wields Invisible Providence, enabling him to manifest an unseen hand powerful enough to shatter a tree trunk, and to phase it through matter at will. In addition, he has Cor Leonis, which lets him take on the burdens of others and, with their consent, distribute his own burdens among his allies. He has an above-average affinity for Yin magic, though his Gate is broken, limiting his ability to use it. However, he compensates for this with an exceptionally high affinity for spirits. Note: Return by Death currently functions as it did during the “ten-second hell loop", due to his lack of connection to Satella. However, you may choose to bear the strain on his mind and magic to allow it to operate as it did throughout the rest of his journey. you may choose if his Gate is fixed/healed. This also means he lacks The Taboo.
objects.title: Natsuki Subaru (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
Alternate Names: None
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Genders:Female
Sex:Female
Age:17/18/late 20s
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Maids
Quality of Life: Okay/Bad/Horrible/Dead

Power: Both are Onis, which, when entering their Oni forms, gain physical capabilities far beyond those of humans. They are capable of completely obliterating someone's head with a punch or effortlessly jumping dozens of feet into the air, as well as leaping off and surviving falls from cliffs. Rem is above average in water magic, which allows her to perform modest spot healing and create shards of ice that, with enough charge time, can grow larger than herself.

Ram, having lost her horn, cannot sustain her Oni form for more than a few seconds without suffering immense damage. Despite this limitation, she is highly skilled in wind magic and potentially other types of magic. She possesses a form of clairvoyance, enabling her to use the senses of "lower lifeforms" and anyone close to her. Both share an ability to communicate their feelings and emotions with each other. She may eventually learn how to use this ability to "borrow" Rem's horn.

Note:Their general age, quality of life and personality depends on both when and what version you choose. Ram regardless of which version you choose suffers from chronic headaches and exhaustion and requires regular mana infusions to survive.
objects.title: Rem & Ram (Re:Zero)

addons.text: Your supernatural charisma has boosted Satella's obsession so high that it has slightly looped back around to being a positive. You can now (barely) convince her not to go on a life-wiping rampage and even potentially stop her from killing every single person who comes nearby, to an extent. This won't completely stop everything, but it will mitigate the worst-case scenario of the world ending.
addons.title: I can fix her

addons.text:
Satella is your Divine Patron. You can optionally choose not to have her manifested in the world, which could be considered a good thing. However, if you break a taboo, she can still forcefully summon herself into the world. Your religion is The Witch Cult, and your goal is to gather more cultists to worship Satella. To Satella, she doesn’t really care; anyone worshipping her besides you is merely a means to an end for powering you up. Don’t expect her to care about the lives of any of her followers other than you.

The more worshippers she gains, the more powerful her Authority becomes, even to the point of beginning to gain the other Authorities of Sin and their expressions. She can then gift these to her worshippers, making them Sin Archbishops. Let's be honest, it will probably only go to you unless you can somehow convince her that powering up the others would help you. She can still grant blessings as usual.
addons.title: What is wrong with you!?

objects.text:
Alias: Witch of Envy
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral/Chaotic Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 400+
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Bad (Is completely insane because of Witch Factor and even in bouts of lucidity is still kind of insane. It was the sane half of her that tried to destroy the world.)

Powers: An extreme master of Yin Magic, she can create a cloak of shadows that obliterates anyone who touches it and spread this shade across the ground in an ever-expanding tide, which could eventually cover the planet if given enough time. She can also form tendrils or hands out of her shadows, capable of phasing through both organic and inorganic matter. She has a miasma which will drive most people nearby insane besides you.

She can freeze and rewind time for herself and others by sharing her Witch Factor with them. This ability allows her to undo a death by reversing time after the person has died, placing them back in the past to find a way to survive. Finally, she possesses seemingly flawless immortality. While she can be injured and defeated, her body cannot be destroyed by any external force.


Note: If you choose her she will be obsessed with you just as much as she was with Subaru. This will stop her from just killing you immediately in her insanity while also giving you access to the Witch Factor of Envy and Return by Death. But it will also mean she will punish you if you try to tell anyone about this power by freezing time and squeezing your heart. She will never outright kill you.

Note 2: Don't choose her unless you're either a masochist or have some way to deal with her. As she will almost certainly try to swallow the whole world in shadows and keep you in her Shadow Garden for all eternity.
objects.title: Satella (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
Alternate Name: Witch of Greed
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appearance wise 19, chronologically 400+ years old
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: Good

Power: One of the greatest magicians to have ever existed. Capable of using all six elements to a masterful level, she later created her own spells. One such ability allows her to bring down the stars onto her opponent. She is also highly skilled in inventing and creating magical objects, even cloning people or making artificial spirits that rival Great Spirits in power. Her Authority is unknown, but it grants her a Book of Wisdom that allows her to draw knowledge from the world's memory to the point that it borders on omniscience. And on top of all that, she is a genius of the highest order—many people, including royalty, sought her advice and knowledge.

Note: Even though she has many great feats, she is very black-hearted and has been mentioned to not understand the feelings of others to the point of being a sociopath. She does not take into account people's feelings or what would happen to them mentally when she "helps" them. She is also known to conduct potentially cruel experiments, such as trapping her "daughter" in an intentionally false contract for centuries just to see if she would break it. Even saying this, she does not act maliciously but rather because she truly does not understand others and because her greed for knowledge drives her to act in such ways.
objects.title: Echidna (Re:Zero)

addons.text: Capella Once lived for the NEED to make every single person in the world love her. But now, she NEEDS the love of only one person, yourself. Every ounce of her warped conception of love is directed at you and you alone, and you're expected to return said love to her or be forcibly transformed into a legless, armless nugget as punishment. Which only she can spare you from out of guilt or until she believes you love her again.
addons.title: An Archbishop's Obsession

objects.text:
Alternate Names: Sin Archbishop of Lust, Mother
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female (Can change this)
Age: Unknown, at least 50 years old.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: One of the Leaders of the Witch Cult, Leader of a Organization of Assassins.
Quality of Life: Good

Power: Through the Witch Factor of Lust, she can transform both herself and others into various beings—such as changing into another person, a dragon, growing wings and tails, or turning anyone she’s annoyed with into giant flies or even lumps of meat with no senses. She can also use this ability to heal herself by replacing injured or missing parts of her body with uninjured ones. She can even transform into people she’s never met by simply reading someone’s body to find out who they love, down to their voice. She is also capable of magic and possesses a future-seeing book called a Gospel.

Note: Capella is a very unstable and jealous woman, known to brutally torture and kill others if she thinks they are loved more than she is by someone else. She believes all love should belong solely to her and has a sadistic side, taking enjoyment in torturing those she dislikes. She also views everyone besides herself as mere bags of meat. Dealing with her is very difficult, as even people she "likes" are liable to be transformed into piles of meat or insects if she feels that you love someone else more than her or if you fail her in some way.
objects.title: Capella Emerada Lugunica (Re:Zero)

addons.text: Instead of becoming a Great Spirit, you can choose to give it to Beatrice. Doing so will fix her problems of gathering mana and even make her more efficient at using it. While you could buy an additional element and still be a Great Spirit of that element, you can further give that Great Spiritness of that element to Beatrice instead. Doing this, the Yin Element would drive her abilities into overdrive to the point that she could stalemate Satella as long as she had the mana.
addons.title: Super Betty, I Suppose

objects.text:
Alternate Names: Great Spirit of the Forbidden Library, Beako, Betty
Alignment: Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Looks around 11-12 years old, Actually 400+ years old
Appearance: Adorable
Civilian Identity: Hikikomori
Quality of Life: Bad

Power: An artificial spirit made by Echidna, she is a very powerful and knowledgeable user in Yin Magic with some passing skill in water and wind magic. She is limited, though, by the fact that she cannot naturally absorb mana from the atmosphere like a true spirit and must take it from living beings. It is possible for you to form a contract with her and gain access to spirit arts through her. She is liable, though, to make you swear to never form a contract with any other spirit.
objects.title: Beatrice (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
Alternate Names: Sword Saint, Monster
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 19 - 20 years old
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Royal Knight
Quality of Life: Bad (You may end up being her first and only ever true friend)

Power: One of, if not the strongest person in the world. Through the use of the unique situation of her gate, she can absorb massive amounts of mana to enhance herself to great levels, allowing her to dodge lightning, survive being thrown at the moon, and jump back to Earth as a falling fireball. She can also wish for Divine Protections—unique blessings from Od Laguna—giving her abilities like projectiles always missing, getting stronger during specific kinds of days, or telling salt from sugar. Has the Dragon Sword Reid, as expected of the Sword Saint; it usually cannot be drawn in nearly all situations, but if it does, she is unlikely to ever lose the battle she is in.

Note: Because of her gate, she cannot use magic, she cannot give you Divine Protections, nor can she just wish for any Divine Protection that she wants. She's really more of a really impressive brick or bodyguard.
objects.title: Adelheid Van Astrea (Re:Zero)

objects.text: Aliases: Emilia-Tan, Lia, Witch of Frost, Half-Devil, and Emily Age: 114 Gender: Female Background Emilia grew up in Elior Forest with her dolls and Fortuna as her closest companions. Restricted to her “princess room,” she eventually began sneaking out, during which she met Geuse, who gradually became a father figure to her. In time, Regulus Corneas and the Pandora discovered them. This encounter led to Geuse taking in the incompatible Authority of Sloth and later being tricked into killing Fortuna. The trauma caused Emilia to release all of her mana, freezing herself and the entirety of Elior Forest. A hundred years later, she awoke to the care of Puck, later met Roswaal L. Mathers, and eventually came to live in his mansion—where she would finally meet Natsuki Subaru. Powers Emilia uses her fire affinity to manifest a wide range of ice magic, both fundamental and uniquely her own. She can call down massive glaciers from the sky, unleash devastating ice storms, forge weapons of frozen mana, immobilize opponents in solid ice, or shape ice into writhing vines and thorned tendrils to bind her enemies. She also possesses the largest known mana reserves among humanoid magic-users, allowing her to cast powerful spells repeatedly with almost no visible strain. In addition to offensive magic, Emilia is capable of using healing magic, and she naturally holds an exceptionally high affinity for spirits. Emilia is currently contracted with several lesser spirits and was once bound to Puck, the Great Spirit Of Fire. Moving forward, she brings her lesser spirits with her.
objects.title: Emilia (Re:Zero)

objects.text: Aliases: Princess Sex: Female Age: 19 Background She is an exiled Imperial Princess of the Vollachia Empire, the matriarch of House Bariell, and a leading contender to become the 42nd ruler of Lugunica. She possesses an extraordinary level of arrogance, likely fueled by her remarkable luck and natural talent for ruling. Despite her arrogance, she holds great love and care for all under her. Powers Priscilla has great intuition and is very intelligent and clever. She has an affinity for Yang of unknown strength, as well as the Divine Protection of the Sun, which enhances every part of her body under sunlight. She possesses great combat skills, comparable to those of Crusch Karsten, and has access to the Yang Sword Vollachia, which is capable of incinerating almost anyone near-instantly and extinguishing flames that would normally be impossible to put out. She also possesses the Soul Marriage technique, which allows her to grant others a portion of her Od, provided that she loves them in some manner and they love her in some manner. This enhances their healing abilities, heightens their pain tolerance, and provides other unknown benefits.
objects.title: Priscilla Barielle (Re:Zero)

objects.text: Alias: Witch of Vainglory Sex: Female Age: Unknown, at least 400 Background A mysterious Witch regarded as taboo by both the world and the very Witch Cult she is said to preside over. Though her appearances have been scarce, she has quietly orchestrated several pivotal events throughout history, including the Permafrost of Elior Forest and the death of the previous Sword Saint during the Great Conquest. Powers She is the Witch of Vainglory, wielding the Authority of “Phenomenon Manipulation,” which allows her to alter reality itself. Through this power, she can rewrite her own death or that of others, erase a person’s presence in an area by making it as though they were “never there,” and manipulate memories—such as when she implanted false memories in Emilia’s mind during her attack on Elior Forest.
objects.title: Pandora (Re:Zero)

objects.text: Name: Shaula Sex: Female Age: 400+ Background Shaula is the apprentice of the Sage, Flugel, and throughout history has often been mistaken for her master across the world. For over 400 years, she was tasked by Flugel with guarding the Pleiades Watchtower, attacking anyone who approached it—including Subaru and his companions. However, she later obeyed Subaru’s commands after coming to believe he was her master, becoming an ally to his group during their time within the tower. She also appears to have been taught various bits of Earth slang and terminology. Powers As a witchbeast, Shaula possesses physical strength far exceeding that of an ordinary person. She has demonstrated the ability to effortlessly lift both an earth dragon and a dragon carriage, carrying them and moving them between levels of the Pleiades Watchtower. She is also capable of using “Hell’s Snipe,” a technique that manifests as a massively powerful, glowing white, homing needle. In addition, she can create magic circles to unleash rapid volleys of these attacks in succession. At will, Shaula can transform into and out of her true mabeast form—a gigantic red scorpion. In this state, her Hell’s Snipe is greatly enhanced in every aspect. She also gains regenerative abilities, the capacity to make parts of her body explosively volatile, an extremely durable carapace and pincers, and a significant amplification of her already formidable physical abilities. Note: if you have either the power Return By Death (Re:Zero) or the Companion Satella (Re:Zero) you may choose for her to forever see you as her master.
objects.title: Shaula (Re:Zero)

objects.text: Name: Patrasche Sex: Female Age: Unknown Background She is an Earth Dragon, said to descend from the Divine Dragon Volcanica. Though this claim is only partly true, it fills her with immense pride—at least until she meets Natsuki Subaru. From the moment they meet, she forms an immediate bond with him. Her attachment surpasses that of a typical companion, evolving into a deep, almost romantic devotion marked by fierce protectiveness and jealousy. Through her journeys at his side, her world gradually expands, and she comes to care deeply not only for Subaru, but for all the members of the Emilia Camp as well. Powers As an earth dragon, Patrasche possesses the Divine Protection of Wind Evasion, allowing her to move without being affected by wind or experiencing any air resistance while running. This ability also extends to any dragon carriage she pulls. As a black ground dragon, she belongs to a rare breed distinguished by higher intelligence and a stronger sense of pride than lesser dragons. She is sapient and capable of understanding complex human language. Note: You may choose whether you are the one Patrasche has bonded with, to be clear this does transfer ALL of her loyalties to you, forever, you may decide the implications of such a thing.
objects.title: Patrasche (Re:Zero)

objects.text: Alias: The Pursuer, Mr. S.T.A.R.S., Nemesis Alignment: Lawful Evil Sex: Male Gender: Male Age: Unknown Power: Nemesis is a Tyrant, a special Bio-Organic Weapon developed by Umbrella, and given the mission to eliminate all remaining members of the Special Tactics And Rescue Service, or S.T.A.R.S. for short. Injected with the NE-Alpha Parasite that functions as its new brain, Nemesis is both immensely strong and hyper-intelligent. Not only that, but he possesses a high level of regeneration, becoming a nigh-unstoppable force on the field. He is smart enough to effectively use heavy weaponry such as rocket launchers, miniguns, and flamethrowers. Should his regeneration be pushed to its limits, it will go into 'overdrive’ to keep Nemesis alive, undergoing rapid and unstable evolutionary changes, coming out even more dangerous and unpredictable for it. Civilian Identity: N/A Quality of Life: S.T.A.R.S.!
objects.title: T-103 Nemesis T-Type (Resident Evil)

Also had enough charisma, smarts and ruthlessness to manage becoming the president of the Citadel by killing those that opposed him.
Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: None

objects.title: 'Evil' Morty (Rick and Morty)

addons.text: Huntsmen and Huntresses-in-training rarely enter combat alone. They are typically accompanied by a more experienced Huntsman or Huntress, such as a Teacher or "Supervisor.” You can now choose such a “Supervisor” who would have accompanied Team RWBY in your selected world. The only requirement is that the Supervisor must be more experienced than the members of Team RWBY. Their alignment (good or evil), mastery (fellow student or veteran Huntsman), or lifestyle (Teacher or drunken bird) need not be considered.
addons.title: RWBY Supervisor

addons.text:
Somehow, against all logic and reason, you’ve managed to include an entire graduating class from Beacon Academy in your team. Realizing the absolute chaos this could unleash, the Headmaster stepped in and decided to send along several “Supervisors” to at least try and keep things somewhat under control.

Few can truly comprehend the kind of havoc a few hundred heavily armed, combat-ready college students can wreak. Let’s just hope they survive the ride... and that you survive the aftermath.
addons.title: Class Field Trip!!!

objects.text:
Name: Ruby Rose
Alias: None 
Alignment: True Good 
Gender: Female 
Sex: Female 
Age: 16 

Power: Ruby is a gifted Huntress-in-training with exceptional Aura control, mastery of armed combat, and a unique Semblance, Petal Burst, which grants her incredible speed and agility, allowing her to move so fast she becomes a blur of rose petals. She wields Crescent Rose, a custom-built scythe-sniper hybrid capable of delivering devastating melee and ranged attacks. Additionally, Ruby possesses Silver Eyes, a rare power that can weaken, petrify, or even destroy Grimm. Her youthful optimism, strategic mind, and natural leadership make her a beacon of hope and inspiration for her team. 

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Student and Huntress-in-Training Quality of Life: Good

Note: By default, this is Ruby Rose from Season 3. Optionally, you may choose which season she comes from instead.

Though mute, she excels in acrobatic close combat with her bladed parasol Hush, using speed, precision, and cunning to outmaneuver stronger foes. Her Aura and illusions, combined with tactical intelligence and ruthless creativity, make her a deadly and deceptive threat despite lacking brute strength.

Alias: Magical Science Project, P.E.N.N.Y.
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appears 17

Power: Penny is a synthetic being capable of wielding Aura and an unknown Semblance, giving her human-like soul abilities despite her mechanical origin. Her core weapon systems are floating blade drones connected to her via energy wires. She controls these blades with pinpoint precision, forming complex attack patterns, shields, and energy cannons for devastating effect. 

Penny also eventually inherits the powers of the Winter Maiden, granting her command over elemental magic, including storms, ice, and atmospheric manipulation.  Her combat style blends this magic and firepower with lethal, coordinated strikes that can overwhelm multiple enemies at once.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Huntress and Military War Machine
Quality of Life: Bad (Few friends while struggling to understand her and other’s humanity)
objects.title: Penny Polendina (RWBY)

objects.text:
Name: Glynda Goodwitch
Alias: Professor Goodwitch
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Mid-to-Late 30s

Power: Glynda is a veteran Huntress with incredible Aura reserves and a high-level practitioner of telekinesis via her Semblance. She can manipulate and reconstruct objects on a massive scale, often with surgical precision. She has lifted buildings, redirected missiles, and restrained opponents with ease, making her one of the most efficient and overwhelming combatants on the field. Her fighting style blends discipline, control, and raw force, often overwhelming enemies with elemental Dust attacks combined with raw kinetic control.

Outside of combat, Glynda is a cornerstone of operational stability. As Ozpin’s second-in-command, she balances tactical command with administrative authority, coordinating Beacon Academy’s operations while quietly managing broader Huntress deployments across the kingdom. Her no-nonsense discipline, paired with razor-sharp instincts and unwavering loyalty, makes her as formidable in politics and logistics as she is on the battlefield.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Combat Instructor and Deputy Headmistress of Beacon
Quality of Life: Bad (Constantly training huntsmen to send them into battle knowing they may not survive)
objects.title: Glynda Goodwitch (RWBY)

addons.text:
Once cursed by the gods and torn apart by grief, Salem and Ozpin now choose a different ending. In a rare moment of clarity and forgiveness, they take a path neither fate nor the gods intended.

Their curses are undone. Salem is freed from the madness of endless life, yet retains control of the Grimm. Ozpin is no longer bound to reincarnation, his past lives finally at rest. Restored and whole, their magic is stronger than ever and even further amplified in each other’s presence.

Together, they gain the ability to defy fate, destiny, and divine interference. This new force, born from their unity, rejects the paths laid before them and opens choices no other route can offer. Where others see enemies, they see potential. Where others fight, they speak. Where others fall, they rise—together.
addons.title: True Love’s Kiss

objects.text:
Name: Ozpin
Alias: Oz, Omza, The Old Wizard
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 5,000 Years (appears mid-40s)

Power: Ozpin’s soul is bound by an ancient divine curse that reincarnates him upon death, merging his essence with a new host while preserving his memories, identity, and skills. This massive chain of lifetimes grants him near-unparalleled wisdom, strategic foresight, and experience having lived through numerous battles and global conflicts.

In combat, Ozpin demonstrates supreme martial proficiency, wielding his Aura, cane, and numerous other weapons with exceptional skill. His true magic, used very sparingly but decisively, lets him teleport across the battlefield, conjure shields, and unleash elemental or concussive blasts with surgical precision. This fusion of immortal experience and versatile sorcery makes him a threat far beyond any conventional Huntsman or Huntress.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Headmaster of Beacon Academy and Leader of the order to oppose Salem
Quality of Life: Terrible (Cursed by the gods to suffer)
objects.title: Professor Ozpin (RWBY)

addons.text: Salem wanted, or at least wanted , to die. She had taken every action over the course of countless millennia to achieve this. Her curse, given to her by the Brother Gods, kept her from the sweet release that death would bring. The darkness from the pools she threw herself into so many years ago only fueled her hatred for the living. Normally, she'd continue down this path, even if it took another millennia to do so. But one seemingly normal day, Salem received a vision. In this vision, she learned of a new method to lift her curse. She simply had to find the person she saw in the vision, and it would come to her in due time. With her determination reignited, she left her residence and ventured back into the world. And then, at some point, she met you. That moment marked the beginning of change. At first, she stayed with you because you were the person from the vision, the one who would lead her to the death she craved. But as time passed, she stayed for gradually different reasons. What started as an attachment to you grew alarmingly fast into full-blown obsession. She found a new purpose in life: being with you, obsessing over you, loving you. Anything she perceives as a threat to your existence, or any possibility of you being taken from this world, from her will be eliminated with all the power she can muster. This includes any rivals for your affection, though she can be convinced to let them be, and eventually, maybe even join in on the obsession and love for you. You are far too important to her to risk losing, no matter how small the threat.
addons.title: The Sole Reason

objects.text:
Titles: The Girl in the Tower, The Witch, Queen of the Grimm
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Many Millennia

Power: One of the few left in her world gifted in the art of magic, she is a powerful sorceress, and by far the most experienced. However, after being cursed by the Brother Gods, she is also immortal, regenerating from any damage she accrues with a high resistance/tolerance to pain. After attempting to end her life by diving into the pools of darkness which spawn the Grimm, she was transformed into a ‘being with a desire for pure destruction’. She now spawns and controls the Grimm to do her bidding with absolute authority and flawless multitasking. She can create the pools of darkness from which the Grimm are spawned using her lifeblood, however this is very exhausting for her to do, often emptying her magic reserves just to create one.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A (Only a handful of people know she even exists)
Quality of Life: Quite Terrible
(Was rescued from being locked in a tower forever, lost her savior and lover shortly thereafter due to illness, and was cursed by the Brother Gods for asking to resurrect him. Attempted to end herself numerous times, all of which failed. Persuaded humanity to fight against the Gods, but everyone except her was erased. Ruled over the new humanity as a false god for a time, which ended after a serious argument-turned-fight-to-the-death with her husband who was brought back from death and tasked by the Gods to stop her. Having indirectly killed the four children she had with him in the process, she became jaded and full of hate, having had enough with life.)
(She now wages a history-spanning secret war against her reincarnating (ex?)husband and humanity as a whole in the effort to summon the Brother Gods back to their world so they can destroy the planet and end her life.)

Note: By default, this is Salem from Volume 3. Optionally, you may choose which volume they come from instead.
objects.title: Salem (RWBY)

objects.text:
Name: Summer Rose  
Alignment: Neutral Good  
Gender: Female  
Sex: Female  
Age: Mid to Late 20s

Powers:

Summer Rose was an exceptional Huntress, graduated from Beacon Academy and leader of team STRQ. Her Semblance, although not fully explored, is associated with rose petals, similar to her daughter Ruby's. Her weapon, Sundered Rose, is an axe that also functions as a rifle, showcasing her skill in both close-quarters and ranged combat. Additionally, she possesses the rare Silver Eyes, an inherited ability that allows her to weaken, petrify, and destroy Grimm.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Huntress  
Quality of Life: Ups and downs

addons.text:
You are more than just a Team of four Silver Eyed Huntsmen, you are part of something much larger as you have several dozens of Silver Eyes huntsmen who have banded together to protect themselves as a community and take down any threat.

The details are up to you but there is enough members to form a village with each one of them being just weaker than Maria and possessing their own personal weapons and Semblances.​
addons.title: Blessed Silver Hunts Clan

addons.text:
Hearing a whistle on the wind, you and Maria have undergone a transformative experience. To start off with, Maria has gained the mutated version of the Silver Eyes you possess, along with weakened versions of their addons (unless you can give her the required powers), but that is only the beginning.

The Silver Eyes have been strengthened, gaining the ability to weaken all forms of protection, immortality, and healing they can see. They can now selectively choose who is affected. While not as quick as Death's Sickles, they can be just as effective given time, and they open up opportunities for even normal weapons to deliver the finishing blow. They have also gained the ability to track targets and detect openings to land those finishing blows. The previous requirement to focus on life and that which you wish to protect has been removed; instead, thinking of these things strengthens their effect.

It is not limited to the Silver Eyes, but Maria's own weapons, Life and Death, have gained the same properties of Death's Sickles, albeit to a lesser extent. While not quite the same quality, they are still something Death would consider a handy tool.

Finally, any other companion with Silver Eyes will gain the same upgrades as Maria, with their Silver Eyes being upgraded and their personal weapons receiving Death's blessing.
addons.title: True Reapers

objects.text:
Name: Maria Calavera
Alias: The Grimm Reaper
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Mid to Late 20s

Powers: Maria is a truly exceptional Huntress with both formal training from a Huntsmen School and informal training from her father who she described as "an old soldier and an excellent teacher" which allowed her to outshine her peers. Her Semblance Preflexes enhances her senses to have greater awareness of everything around her and a type of limited precognition limited to her muscle memory, paired with her combat prowess she's a threat even blind. She wields Life and Death a pair of Kamas that can work individually or together as they can combine to form a staff and each having a hidden gun barrel in the skulls. And finally Maria possesses the rare Silver Eyes allowing her to weaken, petrify and destroy Grimm with years to master their use.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Huntress
Quality of Life: Ups and Downs

Note: By default this is Maria decades before canon RWBY started but you can give her the memories of herself from the canon time period.​
objects.title: Maria Calavera (RWBY)

objects.text:
Name: Raven Branwen
Alias: None
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Early-to-Mid 40s

Power: Raven is a skilled Huntress and the leader of the Branwen bandit tribe. Her weapon, Omen, is a single edged, one-handed sword with different blades made of different types of dust. Her semblance, Kindred Link, lets her make portals to anyone she has strong emotional connections to, letting her escape dangerous situations.

Raven has the power of the Spring Maiden giving her control over the elements, even letting her fly. Furthermore she was given the ability to transform into a Raven by Ozpin.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Bandit Leader
Quality of Life: Bad
objects.title: Raven Branwen (RWBY)

addons.text:
The company has been upgraded; no longer a replacement but the Schnee Dust Company at its peak and free of the sins that stained it under the leadership of the Usurper. It has become a multi-billion dollar megacorporation with a global reach and influence; on a more personal level, with Willow in control of her father's company, the depression she suffered under has lessened, allowing her own abilities to shine brighter and even undertaking Huntsmen training to keep fit.

Your own mastery of RWBY technology has allowed the company to rise to even greater heights, as it can now synthesize Dust in large quantities, along with other materials you know how to synthesize.
addons.title: Legacy Restored

addons.text:
Through communication and introspection, both as individuals and as a family, the rifts that once existed between those who carry the blood of Nicholas Schnee have been mended, with the family healing. With this, you also gain Whitley Schnee as a companion, as they all see notable improvements.

Having a genuine connection with her children, Weiss, Winter and Whitley, Willow's depression has been mostly conquered, with her processing and overcoming it, with all that remains being bad memories that can—at most—put her in a dour mood for a few minutes to an hour. But aside from that, her talents begin to truly shine, as her capabilities are both expanded and refined to allow her to be her best self, being a remarkable businesswoman, mother and huntress (even if she lacks the licence for the latter), with her daughters giving her the training required.

The renewed family bond has also allowed both Weiss and Winter to refine the use of their own Semblances to new heights, to the point they could take on a whole team of Huntsmen on their own without Dust, with little difficulty, their own individual skills being increased further and weaknesses covered. Thanks to this new betterment, they can train up security for their mother's business, effectively making them elites.

Whitley has received some Huntsman training himself, but where he truly shines is with administration and construction, a diamond in the rough with the potential to lead people, plan and build things that last. Allowed to grow into being his own person, Willow is able to see her own father in her son, Whitley having the potential to be even greater than his grandfather Nicholas.

Note: Should you have the addon Legacy Restored, these improvements are greatly enhanced, turning each member of the Schnee Family into effectively Renaissance (Wo)Men, and with these improvements, the Schnee Dust Company gains the full might and technology of the Kingdom of Atlas.
addons.title: A Family Healed

objects.text:
Name: Willow Schnee

Alignment: Neutral

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Age: In her late 40s

Powers: Although she lacks formal Huntress training and has no notable achievements, Willow possesses the Schnee family Semblance, known as Glyphs; this ability allows her to create flat glyphs that have a variety of effects, such as enhancing her speed, summoning avatars, forming dust structures, or acting as a solid shield or barrier. While she hasn't worked in a few years, Willow is a skilled businesswoman with the ability to run a successful multi-million-dollar corporation; taking her as a companion will make her the head of a decently successful company with influence across a whole region, with you and your companions as shareholders.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: Daughter of the founder of the Schnee Dust Company, and is closely affiliated with this corporation.

Quality of Life: Poor (Plagued by deep depression and melancholy due to her loveless and unhappy marriage, Willow resorts to alcohol as an escape from her pain)
objects.title: Willow Schnee (RWBY)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: Early to Mid Twenties Appearance: Beautiful Power: Winter is a trained military operative, extremely proficient in hand-to-hand combat, sabre fencing, and aura application. Her family semblance, Glyphs, lets her summon glyphs to achieve effects such as time dilation, gravity manipulation, and summoning, granting her unparalleled versatility in combat. She also possesses powers of the Winter Maiden, granting her the ability to fly, as well as a range of magical abilities mainly focused on cryokinesis. Civilian Identity: Atlesian Military Specialist Quality of Life: Varies (successful military career, estranged relationships with the rest of the family with the exception of her sister).
objects.title: Winter Schnee (RWBY)

objects.text: Alias: The General Gender: Male Age: In his 40s  Background James was born in the world of Remnant, plagued by the never ending horde of Grimm. Growing up to be a powerful Hunter, James eventually rose to the ranks of General in the Kingdom of Atlas, and the Headmaster of its Hunter Academy. Privy to the many secrets and threats to his kingdom and the world, James is willing to sacrifice anything to make sure his enemies won't win - no matter the cost. Powers James possesses the power of Aura (RWBY). He has two powerful revolvers called Due Process, each strong enough to withstand bone-shattering blows and deliver bullets with the same potency as anti-material rounds. James had the right side below his neck replaced with a prosthetic body, giving him super-human strength and allowing him to survive damage that would cripple him otherwise.
objects.title: James Ironwood (RWBY)

objects.text: Aliases: Dusty Old Crow Age: Early-to-Mid 40s Gender: Male Background Qrow Branwen is a veteran Huntsman and a former member of Team STRQ, known as much for his skill as for the misfortune that follows him. A lifelong agent of Ozpin, Qrow has spent decades operating in the shadows—fighting Grimm, gathering intelligence, and supporting the defence of humanity from behind the scenes. Despite his laid-back, often sarcastic demeanor, Qrow is deeply burdened by his own nature. His Semblance makes close relationships dangerous, leading him to distance himself from others even when he cares deeply for them. As a result, his life is marked by isolation, heavy drinking, and a constant tension between wanting connection and fearing the harm he might cause. Powers Qrow is an exceptionally skilled combatant, specializing in fast-paced, adaptive fighting. His weapon, Harbinger, is a versatile hybrid weapon capable of transforming between a greatsword, a scythe, and a shotgun form, allowing him to switch seamlessly between melee dominance and ranged pressure. His Semblance, Misfortune, passively generates bad luck in his immediate vicinity. Accidents, weapon malfunctions, environmental hazards, and small probabilities skew negatively around him. While indiscriminate and difficult to control, Qrow has learned to subtly position himself so that the worst effects tend to fall upon his enemies. Qrow was also granted the ability by Ozpin to transform into a crow at will, allowing him rapid reconnaissance, escape, and covert travel. He possesses exceptional reflexes, durability, and combat instinct, capable of fighting on par with elite Huntsmen and powerful Grimm alike.
objects.title: Qrow Branwen (RWBY)

addons.title: Island Beyond the Shallow Sea
addons.text:
With both Kali and Blake joining you, several others have decided to come along, more specifically, a village's worth of Faunus of many trades and disciplines who will aid you by any means they can, whether it's merchants, researchers, or Huntsmen that need to be called upon.

Due to their experience of being outcasts and facing discrimination, the village/community they form will be welcoming of others who have gone through similar experiences, becoming a refuge and home for those without anywhere to go.

Note: You can select any Faunus character from RWBY to be a part of this, so long as they're not listed as a companion.

addons.title: Mom Lore Update
addons.text:
In a strange twist of events, just as their daughters formed a team of Huntresses, Summer, Willow, Kali, and Raven have gained the knowledge and skills of their alternate counterparts who had done the same. The Team RWBY of the previous generation, so to speak.

Due to this, they have all become much more powerful and capable, with Summer and Raven being able to cut down hordes of Grimm that would require a small army to handle without needing special powers or equipment, while both Willow and Kali become legendary Huntresses in their own right, whose skills lie more in stewardship, organization, and planning. Each learning from one another to strengthen their fundamentals and cover their weaknesses, leaving big shoes for their daughters to step into.

You can decide if the versions of the characters you take on are originally from this AU or simply have their canon counterparts gain all their strengths and benefits.

objects.text: Aliases: N/A Age: Adult (late 30s to early 40s) Gender: Female Background A former member of the White Fang when it was still a peaceful organization, Kali would go on to become a pillar of her community and family, supporting them even with monsters—both literal and metaphorical—surrounding them. Powers Kali possesses above-average strength and is proficient with firearms, however, her main strengths lie in her diplomatic prowess and leadership abilities, which have made her a pillar of her community.
objects.title: Kali Belladonna (RWBY)

objects.text:
Name: Unknown
Alias: Squishy, Tickle Monster, Joy
Alignment: Neutral good
Gender: Genderless
Sex: Sexless
Age: Unknown
Appearance: Adorable

Power: Touching SCP-999’s surface results in an instant mild feeling of euphoria and comforting warmth, as well as an improvement in the subject’s mental state and mood. It also loves to play "tickle-wrestling," wrapping around the subject and tickling them until they ask it to stop. SCP-999’s surface emits a pleasant scent, which varies depending on whom it interacts with.

Personality: SCP-999's character is best described as "playful"; in some ways, its behavior resembles that of a dog. It is willing to interact with anyone, showing a particular interest in those who are unhappy or depressed. SCP-999 also loves all animals (especially humans), refuses to eat any meat, and will even risk its own life to save others—for example, jumping in front of a person to take a bullet for them. Its diet consists exclusively of sweets and candies, with M&M's™ and Necco™ wafers being its favorites. Its method of eating is similar to that of an amoeba.

Please do not give it drinks containing caffeine.

Quality of life: Good(It's happy and it spreads it's happiness to those around.)
objects.title: SCP-999 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
Name: Unknown
Alias: The White Dog
Alignment: Neutral 
Age: Unknown
Appearance: Scary

Power: SCP-1111's abilities are directly linked to his distance from his master. When by his master's side, SCP-1111 can reach a height of 1.5 meters, attain running speeds over 60 km/h, leap up to 6 meters into the air, and bite through 15 mm of titanium plating. As he moves farther away, his physical prowess, size, and speed diminish, becoming comparable to an ordinary dog beyond a 900-meter radius from his master

SCP-1111 can seamlessly shift between a solid and incorporeal form at will, becoming translucent at distances greater than 500 meters. In this state, conventional weaponry is completely ineffective as it passes harmlessly through him. SCP-1111 displays no need for food, sleep, or even air to function

Most notably, SCP-1111 can shield his master's soul from death as long as he remains within 900 meters, though he possesses healing abilities.

Personality: Loyal (Even after his master's death he wouldn't leave his side, still trying to wake him back up)

Quality of life: Bad (his master died)

Note: By default you are his new master.
objects.title: SCP-1111 (SCP Foundation)
