Alignment: Neutral Good 
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 41

Power: Sunshine & The Divine Axe Rhitta

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Member of the Seven Deadly Sins
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Escanor (Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
Name: Jet
Alias: Soul Reaper
True Name: N/A
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Feminine
Sex: Female
Age: 30+

Power: Jet is an Awakened who became a Transcendent. She wields soul essence to perform a variety of superhuman feats—such as lifting massive objects, moving at supersonic speeds, and becoming nearly invulnerable to mundane harm, even surviving a nuclear blast by exerting her will upon the world. As a skilled warrior, she can defeat powerful nightmare creatures with little difficulty.

Jet's Supreme Aspect first ability allows her to absorb the essence of those she kills. Her second ability enables her to bypass all forms of physical defense and strike directly at her enemies' souls. Her third ability lets her gradually absorb shards of broken soul cores from her victims to expand and strengthen her own, increasing both its size and capacity. This also removes the natural limit of essence infusion in living flesh, allowing her to oversaturate her body with essence and attain exceptional levels of strength, speed, and resilience.

Jet also bears an Aspect Legacy that allows her to summon a mist capable of transforming into five weapons, including a scythe. These weapons absorb and contain the souls of their victims and become soulbound to those she kills. The most powerful soul becomes the core of the mist blade’s power. The stored souls can also be consumed to replenish Jet’s soul essence.

As a Transcendent, Jet’s Transformation Ability allows her to become an intangible wraith. Her body takes the form of a ghostly mist that is unaffected by wind or flame and can phase through solid matter or move underwater. This mist is not true vapor but rather a manifestation of her power.

Like all Awakened, Jet bears a Flaw: she is dead. She has been dead the entire time, and only the presence of soul essence maintains the illusion of life. Since her soul core constantly leaks essence and cannot generate more on its own, she must continue killing and absorbing essence to survive. If she fails to do so, she will eventually run out and be truly destroyed.

Jet also possesses a variety of Memories, including a Supreme hourglass Memory that can revert time by 24 hours, though it can only be used once. She also has an Echo named Crow, which can act as a scout and messenger.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Government Agent
Quality of Life: Stressful (Dealing with the Domain War caused by two incompetent Sovereigns and the end of the world at the hands of the Nightmare Creatures, the Forgotten God and the Void.)
objects.title: Jet (Shadow Slave)

objects.text: Aliases: Sunny, Cockroach, Mongrel, Devil of Antarctica, Lord of Shadows Age: 26 Gender: Male Background An orphan who lost his parents at a young age. After completing his First Nightmare, Sunny acquired his True Name "Lost From Light". He entered the Awakened Academy, eventually entering the Dream Realm and getting trapped in the Forgotten Shore. He later rose to become a Transcendent. Powers Sunless wields shadow essence, allowing him to lift massive objects, move at supersonic speeds, and become nearly invulnerable to mundane harm, even capable of surviving a nuclear blast. As a skilled warrior, he can effortlessly defeat powerful nightmare creatures. His Divine Aspect, Shadow Slave, grants him control over his and others shadows. He can use his shadow to scout, amplify his capabilities, and manifest six additional bodies. He can instantly traverse vast distances, become incorporeal and manipulate shadows for combat and utility. His Aspect Legacy, Shadow Dance, lets him learn an opponent’s movements and weaknesses, and through a combination of his abilities he can assume the form of those he mimics. Sunless commands five shadow creatures—Onyx Saint, Soul Serpent, Ravenous Fiend, Miraculous Mimic, and Nightmare—and possesses three parts of Weaver’s Legacy: Blood Weave, Bone Weave, and Soul Weave, which greatly enhance his physical and spiritual resilience while also allowing him to perceive the souls of others. Like all Awakened, Sunless bears a Flaw: he cannot lie and must answer any question asked of him. After losing his True Name, he became Fateless—forgotten by the world and freed from the bindings of fate. He can create or alter Memories through Weaving. His most significant Memories is the Divine Memory Weaver’s Mask, which conceals his identity, reverses his Flaw, and allows him to glimpse through fate; and the Divine Memory Shadow Lantern, which can store an unlimited number of shadows and serves as a gateway to the Shadow Realm.
objects.title: Sunless (Shadow Slave)

objects.text: Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background The young heiress of the destroyed Immortal Flame Clan, Nephis was targeted by the Sovereigns, who killed her father, and destroyed her clan. After completing her First Nightmare, and acquiring her True Name “Changing Star,” Nephis entered the Awakened Academy, where she later entered the Dream Realm and got trapped in the Forgotten Shore. She later became a Transcendent, with her fame spreading worldwide. Powers Nephis wields soul essence, allowing her to lift massive objects, move at supersonic speeds, and become nearly invulnerable to mundane harm, even capable of surviving a nuclear blast. As a skilled warrior, she can effortlessly defeat powerful nightmare creatures. Her Divine Aspect, Light Bringer, allows her to generate and manipulate white flames that can destroy her enemies, heal herself and her allies, and amplify both her power and Memories. One of her key abilities is Longing, which renders her soul immune to the Corruption that created the Nightmare Creatures. Upon becoming Transcendent, she gained her Transformation Ability, enabling her to partially or fully become a being of white flame. She can also manifest two wings of fire to fly when using this form. Like all Awakened, Nephis bears a Flaw: she must endure extreme pain whenever she uses her Aspect. This has given her an inhuman tolerance to pain, though overuse can dull her emotions, leaving her temporarily cold and detached. Nephis has also learned the Sorcery of Names, which allows her to influence people and elements by speaking their names—an ability that becomes especially potent against those who possess a True Name. She possesses a wide array of Memories, but her most significant is the Blessing: a soulbound longsword that evolves alongside her and holds a variety of powerful effects.
objects.title: Nephis (Shadow Slave)

objects.text: Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background A young girl who became blind due to her Flaw. She trained in the Awakened Academy until the winter solstice, before becoming trapped in the Forgotten Shore, where she later escaped. Eventually she becomes the leader of the Fire Keepers, a Transcendent, and acquired her True Name "Song of the Fallen". Powers Cassie is a Transcendent. Using soul essence, she can lift massive objects, move at supersonic speeds, and become nearly invulnerable to mundane harm, even surviving a nuclear blast. As a skilled warrior, she can defeat nightmare creatures with little difficulty. Cassie's Sacred Aspect grants her an affinity for revelations and fate. She can see people's Attributes, the name and rank of their Aspects, and their Aspect abilities when in close proximity. Occasionally, she receives "visions" that reveal moments from the past or glimpses of the future, along with a general insight into all living things. She can also sense what will happen in the near future and when pushed, can perceive multiple possible futures at once. She can also see through the senses of those marked. Cassie’s Transformation Ability allows her to recall any memory, collect the memories of others, and manipulate or erase memories. However, delving into someone's deep memories against their will is difficult. Once erased, a memory cannot be regained. She can also share her own memories with others at will. Like all Awakened, Cassie bears a Flaw: she is blind. She has adapted by relying on alternative means of perception. Cassie has also learned Runic Sorcery, which allows her to transcribe True Names and bind them to material objects through writing. She also possesses a variety of Memories and two notable Echoes: the Quiet Dancer, a flying rapier that helps her perceive shapes and motion; and a Transcendent, alternate-timeline version of herself that she encountered and acquired.
objects.title: Cassie (Shadow Slave)

objects.text:
Name: Athena
Aliases: Effie, War Beast
True Name: Raised by Wolves
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Feminine
Sex: Female
Age: 20+

Power: Effie is an Awakened who became a Transcendent. She wields soul essence to perform a variety of superhuman feats—such as lifting massive objects, moving at supersonic speeds, and becoming nearly invulnerable to mundane harm, even surviving a nuclear blast by exerting her will upon the world. As a skilled warrior, she can defeat powerful nightmare creatures with little difficulty.

Effie's Transcendent Aspect first ability provides a strong all-around physical augmentation, enhancing her strength, speed, agility, endurance, and resilience. The second ability makes her skin as tough as steel, rendering her body nearly invulnerable, with this durability increasing significantly after becoming a Transcendent. The third ability allows her to share a portion of this physical augmentation with her allies, provided they maintain a line of sight with her.

As a Transcendent, Effie’s Transformation Ability enables her to become a towering giant over a hundred meters tall.

Like all Awakened, Effie bears a Flaw: all of her physical needs are amplified. For example, her appetite is so intense that she can consume enough meat to leave behind a literal pile of gnawed bones.

Effie also possesses a wide array of Memories, including a Supreme Memory locket—a spatial storage device capable of storing even living beings.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Member of Nephis' Cohort
Quality of Life: Stressful (Dealing with the Domain War caused by two incompetent Sovereigns and the end of the world at the hands of the Nightmare Creatures, the Forgotten God and the Void.)
objects.title: Effie (Shadow Slave)

objects.text:
Name: Kai
Aliases: Night, Dragon Slayer
True Name: Nightingale
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 20+

Power: Kai is an Awakened who became a Transcendent. He wields soul essence to perform a variety of superhuman feats—such as lifting massive objects, moving at supersonic speeds, and becoming nearly invulnerable to mundane harm, even surviving a nuclear blast by exerting his will upon the world. As a skilled warrior, he can defeat powerful nightmare creatures with little difficulty.

Kai's Ascended Aspect first ability allows him to fly at high speeds. The second ability gives him enhanced vision, enabling him to see great distances even in total darkness, perceive through illusions and all forms of obfuscation, and see through solid objects. His third ability allows him to compel those who hear his voice to follow his commands—an effect that can even be turned inward on himself. While direct commands are difficult to impose on those with strong willpower or high resistance to mental influence, he can still rally his allies to fight harder, instill emotions in large groups, or lure enemies to their doom.

As a Transcendent, Kai's Transformation Ability allows him to assume the form of a majestic dragon with the colors of the midnight sky. In this form, his third ability is further enhanced.

Like all Awakened, Kai bears a Flaw: he can always tell when someone is lying to him. Though often more helpful than harmful, this strange Flaw is more like a superpower.

Kai also possesses a wide array of Memories, including a bow, arrows, and a Supreme-rank armor.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Member of Nephis' Cohort and former Singer
Quality of Life: Stressful (Dealing with the Domain War caused by two incompetent Sovereigns and the end of the world at the hands of the Nightmare Creatures, the Forgotten God and the Void.)
objects.title: Kai (Shadow Slave)

addons.text:
Well now, this is a pleasant surprise. Being near the lamp has awakened Shantae's latent potential and the Djinn of the Lamp not only recognized the Half-Genie but offered to mentor her to help develop her abilities.

What this means is that Shantae's power have been significantly increased gaining greater potency and wider range of spells such as creating perfect duplicates of herself or transforming into the enemies and bosses of her series. But that's not all as Shantae has gained the ability to grant wishes, albeit with some limitations.

The rules of the Djinn's wishes still apply, can't wish to directly harm or kill another, can't make anyone fall in love, can't bring back the dead or wish for more wishes. But Shantae has additional soft limit, in that she cannot grant any wish as she is limited by her own power.

However, it's described as a soft limit as the stronger Shantae becomes and the more experience she has granting wishes the more grander a wish she can grant. Shantae can grant 3 wishes a day, including her own as she can grant her own wishes due to being half human half genie, and if a wish is too grand she can add in details to make it less desirable akin to a lesser Monkey's Paw. Shantae can also outright refused to grant a wish if she wants or dispel a previous one so long as a week hasn't passed. Over time the number of wishes she can grant per day will double going from 3, to 6, to 12, to 24, etc.

And it's not just her Genie side that's been empowered but her Human half as Shantae has gained Wisdom, what this means is that she has above average proficiency with all mundane skills with her quickly mastering them the more she uses them and intuition to make the best use of those skills along with getting the most out of any situation with arrogance having no grip on her like it did on the Genie of old.​
addons.title: Half Genie, Full Wish

addons.text:
The magic of Mage Trappings, its shapeshifting nature, plus Shantae's own shapeshifting magic fused into one. Allowing the fabric to grant powers based on its appearance, meaning, she has the alternate costumes and abilities from Half Genie Hero at full power.

The Ninja costume retains its original powers of, well, making her a Ninja. But now she's a Magical Ninja! Able to effortlessly cultivate Chi, Chakra, Senjutsu, etc to prodigious degrees and ignore things like hand seals, focus, chakra control, and so on. 

This doesn't mean she can do anything, just that she'll have an easy time acclimating to the profession the costume represents. 

The swimsuit can give her great affinity for Water Magic, the pajamas can allow for Dream Magic, the police uniform can use Gun Magic, etc. 

Of course it's not limited to just that, a nurse outfit for Healing Magic, a samurai costume for Sword Magic, the snake princess outfit for… Egyptian Magic, yeah, totally...
addons.title: Half Genie, Full Hero
Friends to the End
addons.text:
You receive Rottytops, Sky, Bolo, and Uncle Mimic as companions. Each bringing their own flare to life and contributions to the ship. From Rotty being unkillable as a zombie, Bolo's martial arts, and Mimic's genius, alongside all the resources available to hone them on the ship.

There's even more than enough space to hold other characters from the Shantae series, like the other Guardian Genies and Squid Baron. The dynamic of all these new crewmates are up to to you, but they'll get along.

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 23

Powers: Moderate skill in martial arts, various pirate based weaponry, and can use her hair as a whip. But as a half-genie, her most important abilities are manipulation of magic and transforming into an ever expanding amount of creatures.

With a simple <s>and tantalizing</s> belly dance, she can transform into a monkey, crab, harpy, elephant, spider, tinker-bat and mermaid just to name a few. They can also cause various effects to herself and the environment, like finding hidden treasure, powering machines, creating mini-earthquakes, or revitalizing others.

Her magic primarily focuses on combat and platforming. From shooting fireballs as basic offense, surrounding herself with pikeballs for defense, making potions and vials that restore vitality and magic respectively, travelling long distances within a bubble, and even making shampoo that strengthens her hair.

Note: You may decide if she has Risky’s gear from Pirate’s Curse.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Guardian of Scuttle Town
Quality of Life: Good.
objects.title: Shantae (Shantae)

addons.title: Part of the Crew
addons.text: You've proven yourself as a worthy asset for Risky, with your own crew being the cherry on top. You receive Risky's ship and her crew of tinkerbats, and all assets she would have within it. It also comes with your own quarters. Each expansion of your organization increases the size of the ship and quality of the crew. Meaning, that instead of just tinkerbats, she can have other minions, enemies, and even bosses from the Shantae series onboard. A Small Organization - A crew of 50 Tinkerbats and 10 enemies A Medium Organization - A crew of 100 Tinkerbats, 15 enemies, and 5 bosses A Big Organization - A crew of 150 Tinkerbats, 20 enemies, 10 bosses. Note: Supervillain Base and The You Foundation will double and triple these stats respectively.

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: 20+ Background Risky was once the henchwoman to the Pirate Master, but after he was defeated by the Guardian Genies, would take his entire crew of tinkerbats, ship, and pirate equipment for herself. Then venture to the seven seas as the self proclaimed Pirate Queen, plundering for treasure and conquering islands as she saw fit. Her encounter with Shantae in defiance to her conquest of Sequin Land would define the Guardian Genie as her arch-nemesis. Power Peak human condition and master of armed combat, specifically with various pirate weapons like scimitars and guns. Has expertise in leadership, management and commanding her pirate crew of tinkerbats—who are capable of constructing various steampunk-esque machinery. As a pirate she also has several skills derived from her years in that profession, such as social coercion, manipulation, and navigation.
objects.title: Risky Boots (Shantae)

objects.text: Aliases: She-Ra, Princess of Power Age: 20 Gender: Female Background Kidnapped when she was a baby and raised by the Horde, she grew up thinking they were bringing prosperity to Etheria, when they were in fact doing the very opposite. After finding the Sword of Protection and joining the Alliance, Adora and her friends managed to eventually not only save Etheria, but the whole galaxy from the Horde. Power Adora is the last of a long line of She-Ra, the guardian of Etheria. When she channels this magical power, she grows into an eight feet tall amazon warrior. In this form, she is impervious to most damage, able to tank blasts that would destroy buildings, and able to lift said tanks as if they were cardboard. Her sword can also channel her magic, from using it to cut a metal door as if it was air, to blasting a spaceship to dust. It can also be used to heal, not only the body but more metaphysical damage such as curses, or damaged enchantments. Also comes with Swift Wind, her trusty horse companion.
objects.title: Adora (She-Ra 2018)

addons.text:
The Yatsukahagi's powers ultimately come from Tenma Yato. Through Marie's recovered connection to Ren as he is now, she can access the abilities of the group. Originally, these powers either lose effectiveness or don't work altogether on anyone stronger than their user. Since she is recreating their powers from a record of a record, both their power and the threshold for resistance or immunity are further reduced.

From Tenma Sukuna, she can stop supernatural powers and suppress targets down to the level of a mundane human. From Tenma Ootoke, she can kill by imposing "absolute end" on anything that looks into her eyes. From Tenma Akuro, she can absorb any kind of poison or impurity into herself and spread it to others. From Tenma Tokoyo, she can permanently sacrifice those who belong to her to strengthen another person. From Tenma Numahime, she can shadows that paralyze and drag anything down, even the intangible. From Tenma Momiji, she can revive and control the dead, who become unkillable unless killed by those stronger than her. From Tenma Morei, she can summon and attack with all-destroying fire and lightning.
addons.title: Yatsukahagi Records

objects.text: Aliases: Marie, The Twilight, Fifth Heaven Age: 10,000+ Gender: Female Background During France's Reign of Terror, her father was pressed by her pregnant mother to perform an execution when the headsman failed to appear. Born at the moment of execution, she began obsessively singing about the guillotine at 10 years old, awakening an instant decapitation curse. Branded a witch, she was ultimately executed by the very blade she was born at. Her unnaturally powerful soul ascended to a Transcendence God when she died; this attracted the attention of Mercurius, who immediately planned for her to take up the Throne after him. Through his schemes and countless timeloops, she eventually came to love Ren Fujii and transformed into a Hegemony God through that love, ascending to the Throne. Powers She has a potent curse where anyone who touches her instantly gets decapitated. The only exception to this was Ren Fujii and those in his vicinity due to him bonding with her Holy Relic, Margueritte-Bois de Justice; you and those in your vicinity are now included as well. When she was on the Throne, she could manifest abilities based on Laws from previous Throne holders and failed challengers who had strong connections to them; as a companion, she can still do so despite not being on the Throne anymore. From Nerose Satanael, she has two abilities: Gamagog, which summons hordes of locust within a target that devour them depending on how much they fed their desires or sins; and Netsiv Melakh, which are beams of light that turns anyone it touches into a pillar of salt. From Mercurius, she can summon a blackhole capable of destroying the universe. From Reinhard Heydrich, she can raise up the dead into psuedo-gods to fight on her command. From Ren Fujii, she can halt time. She can also create Sensories, avatars where she can act from. If she emanates her Law, she transforms all of existence into a reality of reincarnation and coexistence, where people constantly reincarnate and multiple Hegemony Gods can coexist without being compelled to fight each other. Note: Marie is not much of a fighter; she is more ineffective in a fight than what one might expect from a being on her level.
objects.title: Marguerite Breuil (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text: Ren fought on Marguerite's behalf and stood as her champion. Now that they're together, he can fight on her behalf using her own abilities as if they were his. If Marguerite has the Yatsukahagi Records addon, Ren can use the powers of the Yatsukahagi at their original potency as opposed to her diminished replicas.
addons.title: Guardian of the Twilight Goddess

objects.text: Aliases: Zarathustra, Ephemeral Moment Age: 56 Gender: Male Background Ren Fujii is not a natural-born human but rather a Holy Relic in the shape of a human, created by Mercurius transfusing his blood into the soul of Lotus Reichhart. He was created in order to transform Maguerite Breuil into a Hegemony God and was the subject of countless timeloops in pursuit of that goal. He fell in love with her and eventually became a Hegemony God himself to fight on her behalf. Powers He can cut things from a distance or touch at any direction by forming invisible blades. He is a user of the Die Ewigkeit formula, capable of bonding with any Holy Relic except for the Longinuslanze Testament. He has two Relics, which provide different effects in his Yetzirah: Margueritte-Bois de Justice, which manifests as a scythe extension on his right arm and can permanently kill anyone he touches through immediate decapitation; and Thrúd Walkure, which is a sword that allows him to control lightning and can transform his blood into lightning. He also has two Briahs. The first is Eine Faust Overture, which accelerates his perception of time; this grants superspeed, as well as slowing down external effects around him. He can draw out the power within Mercurius' blood, strengthening this Briah by multiple orders of magnitude into Eine Faust Finale. The second Briah is Eine Faust Scherzo, which allows him to ensure the permanent end of the dead and undead, no matter what. Finally, at Aziluth degree, he can emanate his Law throughout all of existence where time is completely stopped everywhere. All things and people are frozen in time except for those he personally cares about and other beings with a similar level of strength. Warning If he commits to emanating his Law, all of reality becomes a stagnant hell, unstoppable except by a being of equal strength.
objects.title: Ren Fujii (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
Due to your connection with Sakuya, who is in fact a reincarnation of Helga Ehrenburg in the world of Sixth Heaven, you have awakened your own version of Magatsuki.

While significantly weaker, it is much more controlled than Sakuya's version, allowing you to suppress it entirely or concentrate on a single opponent. No enemy will truly be able to touch you should you turn the full force of this curse upon them, whether they engage you in direct combat or create an elaborate scheme to bring bout your downfall.

When in the presence of each other, yours and Sakuya's curses mutually negate themselves, unless you desire to turn their combined power against your adversaries. In which case, so long as Sakuya is with you and your goals are aligned, you can control how exactly the combined might of this world-shattering curse will manifest.
addons.title: Magatsuki (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: Aliases: Princess of Calamity Age: Early Twenties Gender: Female Background Born into the Kyougetsu clan, she was feared by the rest of the clan due to her powerful version of the clan's luck-manipulating Distortion, Magatsuki. This led to her to live an isolated yet pampered lifestyle since childhood as she was placed under the care of her brother and only companion, Kyougetsu Keishirou. Intent on finding the source of her repeating visions of a garden of roses, she eventually pestered her brother enough to let her join the Eastern Expedition. Powers She possesses an uncontrollable and powerful form of Magatsuki, where she indiscriminately steals all luck from everyone around her. For example, if she is attacked by bandits, any contrived event will occur to prevent it: betrayal, falling on a knife, being stuck by lightning, a sudden natural disaster, a meteor destroying the continent, etc. If she were on a ship in the middle of an ocean during a raging storm, no wave will shake the ship and not even a single drop of rain will fall on her. This power is usually surpressed with a multi-layered seal but she can effortlessly overpower it if she wants, and her power will activate automatically if she's in danger regardless. Warning No one is safe from her Magatsuki, not even you.
objects.title: Sakuya Kyougetsu (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: Age: Varies for her bodies, from toddler to middle-aged. Gender: Female Background: Abhicharika is the head of one of the great families in the Federal Republic of Brahmana. When she discovered her powers, she mutilated over 95% of her body to become more powerful and more useful to her nephew, the emperor Daksha, to whom she possesses unwavering loyalty, ready and eager to commit any atrocities required without ever feeling guilt or remorse. Powers: She has the power to fuse with and control any and all technology so long as a piece of her body remains in contact or within it. At the moment, she controlls a fleet consisting of thousands of spaceships, each of which is capable of easily destroying a star or planet. With a piece of her body imbedded in every ship, she is immortal so long as even the smallest part of her exists. As her trump card, Abhicharika can fuse all the starships in her flotilla into a single biotechnological mecha that dwarfs entire stars. Should you so desire, Abhicharika can hold the same loyalty towards you as she does towards Daksha.
objects.title: Abhicharika Pai Fallada (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
The Narrator’s fears have come to pass; the Shifting Mound and Long Quiet have reunited. The Hero and Princess are now working together, rather than as enemies. How their relationship manifests is up to you, whether lovers, co-conspirators, master and servant, vessel and possessor, or even merged being.

Whatever form it takes, the combined forces of the two beings whose true selves embody all of existence between them are potent indeed, capable of altering reality in a variety of ways. With time, they could even recover their full glory, embodying stability or change fully; enough power to rule as gods over all existence.
addons.title: You Are A Path In The Woods

objects.text: Aliases: Heart of the Long Quiet, Voice of the [Trait] Age: As old as reality Gender: Male Background The Hero is a divided portion of reality, representing stability and stagnation. He was trapped in a constructed world by the Narrator and sent to slay the Princess to create the Narrator's idea of a perfect world. His personality varies depending on which voices are in his head. Powers The Hero is physically capable and skilled at close combat, armed or unarmed. Every time they die they come back with a new voice in their head based on their actions leading up to their death. These voices offer advice and possess unique abilities based on their personality, like enhanced awareness for a paranoid voice or surviving injuries that should be lethal for a stubborn voice. Their belief has the power to reshape reality. They also have The Look.

objects.text: Aliases: The Devil, Lucifer, Satan Age: ??? (Presumably roughly as old as the universe) Gender: Male Backstory The Devil is the ruler of H-E-Double-hockey-sticks who tortures sinners and tempts people into evil. He's also kind of a moron, and rather childish. Presumably he has done everything described of the devil in the Bible. The Devil got Dr Gerald Robotnik to create Shadow the Hedgehog to become a Twitch streamer and The Devil's best friend, not knowing that Gerald would instead design Shadow to roast him and take over Hell. Power The Devil possesses true immortality, recovering instantly from all physical damage. They’re also effectively omnipotent, capable of doing just about anything they can think of. The only limitation on their power is their own incredible incompetence. They’re also a master at gaslighting, able to (for example) trick enemies into thinking they’ve been in a time loop with just a few sentences.
objects.title: The Devil From The Bible (Snapcube Fan Dub)

addons.text:
Rejoice—or tremble—for your Infernal Patron is none other than Baran, Monarch of White Flames, King of Demons, and now your benefactor. Unlike most pacts forged in fire and obligation, Baran has chosen you not only as his broker, but as his heir, much like Ashborn once chose Jin-Woo. Of course, this doesn’t mean Baran will vanish or retire gracefully—he simply intends to offload the more tedious aspects of dominion onto you while continuing to revel in destruction.

As his chosen heir, Baran bestows upon you three gifts:

The first is the Heart of the Demon King—a counterpart to Ashborn’s Black Heart. This organ floods your body with vast reservoirs of magical power, pulsing with each beat to regenerate tremendous quantities of mana. As this heart fuses with your essence, your body undergoes slow, steady transformation: your physical and magical attributes rise with time, and your appearance subtly shifts toward Baran’s likeness—pale skin, red eyes, and hair pale as white flame. These can be hidden with some effort.

Second, Baran grants you a gift he admittedly stole from the Rulers: Spiritual Body Manifestation. This allows you to temporarily invoke the full might of your patron, assuming a form that channels his essence in both appearance and power. It is a devastating ability—but using it exacts a heavy toll, straining your body and soul with each invocation.

Last, and most dangerously, he grants you his own lightning magic. Additionally, as his chosen broker and heir, your pacts now draw directly from Baran’s vault of might. You may negotiate with him for access to more of his power, his armies; including the twenty demon clans of the demon castle and more, or even his personal arsenal of artifacts. The stronger your bond and the greater his influence, the more he is willing to share.
addons.title: Heir of the White Flame

He is also able to summon his demon army via portals. Beyond simple summoning, like other Monarchs, he is able to open portals through worlds.

You can optionally choose to have him appear with one or with you as the vessel. If you choose the latter he will not completely possess you to steal your body, although whether it stays that way is up to your relationship with him.

Teamwork makes the dream work. And boy, do this guys have teamwork. Team Sonic works as a well oiled machine, coordinating moves with little to no actual communication needed, delivering powerful attacks and coordinating their moves as if they were a single minded organism. 

This ability is now also extended to you and your companions. So long as at least three members are working to accomplish the same goal, they will be able to coordinate and act as if they can predict each other's actions, managing to achieve their goal much more easily. With practice and by building trust, you can temporarily extend this ability to non-companions as well.
addons.title: Team Sonic

objects.text: Age: Teenager/Young Adult Gender: Male Background Sonic is a hero, always looking out for the little guy. Constantly fighting against threats (most of the time it being Eggman or one of his creations), Sonic would rather lay down in the grass alongside his friends and eat a chilli dog than worry about anything serious. Even so, he would never let someone in need of help on their own. Power Sonic has most of the powers of Fastest Thing Alive (Sonic the Hedgehog) in the Shardless Physical Powers at full potential, with the exception of the moves related to Chaos energy.
objects.title: Sonic the Hedgehog (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: Age: Teenager Gender: Male Background Tails is a young fox that happened to be born with two tails. Initially an outcast from his peers, he eventually found friendship with Sonics and their other friends, going on adventures and gaining confidence and courage. Tails is someone who rather uses words than fist to solve problems, but he isn't afraid to use his machines to put villains in their places. Power Tails is a technological genius, capable of building incredible machines and gear such as a sensor for exotic energy and a mecha jet, and can even reverse-engineer other technologies with enough time and resources. He is also able to fly at incredible speeds on its own by spinning his tails really fast.
objects.title: Tails the Fox (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: Age: Teenager/Young Adult Gender: Male Background Knuckles is the Guardian of the Master Esmerald. A serious and straightforward person, he is sometimes oblivious and takes things too literally. Despite this, he is a dependable and trustworthy ally. Caring deeply, he is a rock that his friends can lean on in times of need. Power Knuckles is a physical power house. He is able to break boulders with his bare hands, lift a truck with little to no effort, and tank hits that would cripple, if not kill an adult human. He is able to leap buildings in a single jump, and can glide in the air, allowing him to stay airborne for a time and negate damage from falling.
objects.title: Knuckles the Echidna (Sonic the Hedgehog)

Eggman's technology base has been upgraded from E.G.G.M.A.N to Eggman Land, with the same restrictions of being limited to his own tech still in place, but this is not merely the tech base, as Eggman gains a fully operational Egg Fleet with a flagship serving as a mobile base.

Along with his multiversal knowledge, Eggman can have all those who served him throughout the multiverse as minions, from Scratch and Grounder to Sage and Agent Stone. So long as they worked for Eggman, they're fair game.
addons.title: House of Robotnik | Kintobor

objects.title: Doctor Eggman (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
No longer is Maria's condition just hand-waved away, now you are directly responsible for curing her, and that has given you no small amount of praise and loyalty from the Robotnik family and Maria herself. Now healthy, Maria's own talents and genius are able to grow without fear; in fact, it seems like she has jumped leaps and bounds with her skills as if making up for lost time.

As a sign of gratitude, Gerald Robotnik has entrusted to you and Maria his research as his true successors, a collection of knowledge so advanced and groundbreaking even decades later they're some of the most advanced technology on the planet, with even geniuses like Eggman and Tails learning something new whenever they study it.
addons.title: Miracle Worker

addons.text:
Along with Maria and Shadow, Gerald Robotnik joins you as a companion, and along with this little family unit comes the Space Colony ARK, with you gaining ownership of the Space Colony. Both a space settlement and research facility, the ARK is expansive, with facilities that would be the envy of any Earthbound facilities for decades to come, that being said, there is a planet-side facility (that acts mostly as a storage and residential bunker) that connects to the ARK via teleporters that cannot be tampered with or blocked.

Should you have the add-on Miracle Worker, Maria will be using the teleporter extensively to visit the world and upgrade both the planet-side facility and the ARK, upgrading both to the point that it would appear they underwent a century of development and improvement.

Should you have the add-on Sisters from Different Misters, then the ARK will be upgraded beyond even Gerald's wildest imagination, as the combined genius of Maria and Ciel turns the research station into a mobile bastion of safety, advancement, and defence, whose mere presence can dismay invaders and be the ideal location to enact a Super Genesis Wave.
addons.title: Reunion

objects.text: Aliases: N/A Age: Unknown (Teen) Gender: Female Background Maria Robotnik lived an ordinary life until she fell ill and was taken to the ARK in the hopes of finding a cure and buying time due to the ARK's sterile environment. Despite suffering from Neuro-Immuno Deficiency Syndrome, a chronic and incurable condition, she still pushed forward and, in her own way, became the guiding star that helped make the world a better place through Shadow. Powers While quite ill, having good days (seemingly normal but frail) and bad days (impeded ability to see, move, hold things, think clearly, and requiring a wheelchair with an IV drip), Maria has a growing intellect and is extremely bright, with a knack for engineering, technology, and design that in time would see her be on par with her grandfather Gerald and cousin Ivo Robotnik, who would be better known as Eggman.
objects.title: Maria Robotnik (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: Age: 16 Gender: Female Background Niece to Dr. Julian Robotnik I (Eggman variant) and Maria's cousin once removed. Hope was quite young when she and her family went into space with other Overlanders with the intent to settle on another world, but were forced to return to Mobius, where they eventually resettled within hidden human settlements, with Hope going on to be an ally to Shadow the Hedgehog as she joined GUN 'Guardian Unit of Nations' as a technician/mechanic. Powers Hope Kintobor is one of the finest young minds on all of Mobius—constructing much of the support equipment Team Dark (Shadow, Rouge, and E-123 Omega) uses—and created an interdimensional teleporter to access other universes/dimensions, a technological prodigy even a highly developed society would take notice of.

addons.text:
A mother found, a prophecy finally fulfilled through your aid. Queen Aleena has reunited with her children after many years to form the Council of Four and defeat the Robotnik Empire. With the formation of this council, Sonia and Manic now join you as companions, just like their mother and brother. Sonia is the more level-headed of her siblings, with the finest education available to her at the time and powerful raw strength. Manic, on the other hand, is a kind-hearted thief with a touch of learned kleptomania. He can smoothly steal a wallet or repair a beat-up van in the middle of nowhere with less-than-stellar parts on hand.

But that's not all. Along with them comes a pocket dimension containing the Planet Mobius and the restored city of Mobotroplius, the capital of the kingdom. With it comes a loyal populace of the people of Mobius. All the wealth, culture, history, development, and environment have been restored to pristine condition. A loyal royal court ensures all matters are taken care of in a way that the Hedgehog Royal Family sees fit, ensuring everything runs smoothly. In fact, Aleena and her children can live as they wish, with little input needed from them, allowing them to explore the world at their leisure or fight whatever villain pops up.

As the one whose actions brought about this happy ending, you possess a vast degree of influence over all matters regarding this Mobius, with your word second only to the royal family.

Note: You can decide to merge this pocket dimension with any others you may possess or place it in your starting setting.
addons.title: Council of Four

addons.text:
While trained and skilled in all things classic, Queen Aleena has also picked up some of the new modern tricks she has seen, gaining the abilities of the Fastest Thing Alive (save for the Chaos abilities), which grants her Sonic's modern skill set and speed. But along with this speed, she has also gained a great deal of strength and techniques, making her an all-around powerhouse. While she may not exceed any of her children in their area of expertise, she can certainly keep up close behind.

Should you have the "Council of Four" addon, Sonia and Manic would also receive the Fastest Thing Alive abilities. Like their mother, they wouldn't be as fast as Sonic, but their own traits would be enhanced. For example, Sonia would become an even greater powerhouse, and Manic's skills as a thief and mechanic would grow by leaps and bounds.
addons.title: Queen Mother
One Crown Fits All
addons.text:
Aleena is able to trace her lineage of the Hedgehog Dynasty back centuries throughout the history of Mobius—with some claiming her lineage predates recorded history—and through those annals of history, great figures exist, such as Aman-Rapi, a sorcerer and prophet. And now it's clear there was a Knight King- and Sultan-themed ancestor in that lineage.

Aleena gains her own Sacred Sword that is considered the 'child' of Excalibur and a Genie Ring, with the Genie acting as a confidant and advisor for her; with these items, Aleena not only gains the skills and powers from Black Knight and Secret Rings (putting her on the level of a Knight of the Round Table), but her skills with magic deepen further with knowledge of the magic from both entries.

But those are a close second to something else; due to her lineage, personal ability, and temperament, with proof of royalty, Aleena is able to use items and magic reserves for those of royal lineage. If there are no other candidates for said items/magic, then it's possible for Aleena to claim them, marking her and her children as heirs of fallen royalty. The same can be said for Sonic, Sonia, and Manic too, who have gained their own swords and rings on top of their medallions.

objects.text: Aliases: Queen Aleena, Your Majesty Age: Adult (mid to late 30s) Gender: Female Background She was dethroned by Doctor Robotnik, with backing from the nobles, and has since spent over a decade on the run, escaping capture and battling in hopes of setting right the wrongs done by Robotnik. She also hopes to reunite with her children, whom she gave up, sending them away to secure a better future for them; however, she remains uncertain if this will ever come to pass, as all she can do is watch them from afar. Powers An intelligent, capable, and caring ruler, Queen Aleena possesses the ability and foresight to govern a planet-spanning government. Her leadership skills aided in the formation and organization of the Freedom Fighters, who opposed the Robotnik Empire, and during her time on the run, she learned and refined numerous skills related to guerrilla warfare, including espionage, firearms, piloting, and other such abilities. She also mastered various forms of magic, including projection and teleportation, and possesses a medallion that allows her to use a form of music-based magic centered on singing.
objects.title: Queen Aleena (Sonic Underground)

An agile and skilled acrobat, Sally is an experienced fighter who makes use of a staff and bracelets able to project energy blades capable of cutting through most mundane materials easily, while withstanding an immense amount of force from the likes of Metal Sonic.

addons.title: Stay With Me
addons.text:
You know what was Frieren's biggest mistake? Leaving Himmel after they defeated the Demon King.

Well, that's no longer a problem.

This Frieren chose to remain with Himmel after the Hero Party's journey ended. Rather than wandering off alone for decades at a time, she stayed by his side, allowing their relationship to naturally deepen over the years as they traveled, adventured, and eventually settled down together.

Frieren still possesses her immense magical knowledge and centuries of experience, but now she has something she never had in canon: decades to properly understand and appreciate the person who meant more to her than she realized.

Eventually, the two married.

Himmel got to grow old with the woman he loved rather than spending his final years separated from her. The Great Mage and the Hero got their happy ending, and Himmel died with the woman he loved at his side.

And perhaps the greatest change of all? Frieren didn't need decades of hindsight to realize how much Himmel meant to her.

And due to purchasing these two lovebirds as companions, she gets to reunite with her husband once more and tell him just how much she loves him.

Things might get a little weird, however, considering you're now third-wheeling a married couple.

objects.text:

Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 1000+

Civilian Identity: Mage 
Quality of Life: Decent (Finds it difficult to share emotions and connect with others, can get absorbed into one task for years at a time, vastly warped sense of time)

Knows many spells from the common offensive and defensive magic to a spell that creates a handheld black hole, and numerous utility or folk magic spells.

objects.title: Stark (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text: Alias: Living Grimoire Gender: Female Age: Unknown, at least 1500 Background Not much is known about Serie's past. She has lived a longer life than even other known elves, during which she trained many legendary mages and established a central authority on magic within the empire of humans. Powers Serie is one of, if not the, most powerful mages in the entire world. During her life she acquired knowledge of nearly all human spells as well as mastered various countermeasures to curses, the type of spells normally no mage can detect or defend against. She is powerful enough to completely outclass even the strongest of the Seven Sages of Destruction, the most powerful of the Demon Lord's generals.
objects.title: Serie (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text: Alias: Macht of the Golden Land Gender: Male Age: Unknown, at least 600 Background One of the Seven Sages of Destruction, Macht is the most powerful demon in the service of the Demon King. However, desiring to understand humans and feelings of guilt and malice—which his race naturally lacks—he left his post and even went so far as to enter the service of a human lord. Powers Macht is the most powerful Sage of Destruction. Like any other demons, he can use flight magic as naturally as humans might walk. His unique magic, Diagoldze, allows him to transmute any matter into indestructible and immaleable gold, as well as mould and wield this gold as weapons. His mana reserves are vast enough to instantly transmute almost an entire continent into gold. He is also proficient in human magic, such as common defensive and offensive magics. Additionally, he possesses immense physical strength, allowing him to effortlessly wield a massive greatsword made purely out of transmuted gold.
objects.title: Macht (Sousou no Frieren)
Aura (Sousou no Frieren)
objects.text: Alias: Aura the Guillotine Gender: Female Age: 500+ Background: Aura was one of the Seven Sages of Destruction, powerful demons who served under the Demon King. Over the course of more than five centuries, she built a reputation through the use of Auserlese, creating an army from those she brought under her control and earning the title "Aura the Guillotine." She participated in the battle against the Hero of the South and later fought Himmel's Hero Party, surviving both encounters despite suffering significant losses. Following the Demon King's defeat, Aura remained inactive for many years before resurfacing in the Northern Lands, where she sought to conquer Graf Granat's domain. Her campaign eventually brought her into conflict with Frieren. During their final confrontation, Aura used the Scales of Obedience only to discover that Frieren had concealed the majority of her mana. Because Frieren's true mana vastly exceeded her own, the spell reversed, placing Aura under Frieren's control. Frieren then ordered Aura to take her own life, bringing an end to one of the Seven Sages of Destruction. Powers: As one of the Seven Sages of Destruction, Aura is a demon whose magic exceeds human understanding. She possesses immense mana reserves accumulated over five centuries. Her raw output ranks among the highest recorded for demons. Her mana perception is highly refined, allowing her to detect powerful individuals across vast distances, though advanced suppression techniques can conceal a presence from her senses. Flight magic is innate to her kind, enabling unassisted aerial movement and combat maneuvering. Her signature ability, Auserlese, uses the Scales of Obedience to compare mana between user and target. If Aura’s mana is higher, the target’s body, mind, and abilities are placed under complete and permanent control. Controlled individuals retain their skills and memories but lose autonomy, functioning as obedient assets. Strong willpower can temporarily resist issued commands, though such resistance is unstable and not sustained. The mechanism carries a direct inversion risk. If the target’s mana exceeds Aura’s during activation, control is reversed and Aura becomes the subordinate.

Alias: Himmel the Hero Age: 16, 26, 76 at Death Gender: Male Background Himmel was a human adventurer who became known as the Hero, leading the legendary Hero Party alongside the elven mage Frieren, the dwarven warrior Eisen, and the priest Heiter. Together, they journeyed across the continent and ultimately defeated the Demon King, bringing an end to his reign and ushering in an era of peace. Himmel possessed an extraordinary determination to become a hero. He was kind, charismatic, and almost absurdly selfless, always willing to lend a hand to those in need. Rather than being content with simply defeating the Demon King, Himmel sought to help people wherever he went and deliberately left behind stories, monuments, and memories that would allow his companions and the people he saved to remember him long after his death. Despite not being the Chosen One, he and his party slew the Demon King. Himmel's abilities were anything but ordinary. His skill, intuition, and sheer force of character allowed him to stand alongside an ancient elf, a veteran dwarf, and a powerful priest, ultimately becoming the leader of the party that defeated the Demon King. Powers Himmel was an extraordinary swordsman, possessing superhuman speed, strength, reflexes, and keen senses. His sword strikes could pierce enemies with tremendous force and speed, leaving trails of light in their wake, while his movements were fast enough to overwhelm powerful demons before they could react. His senses and intuition were exceptional. He could recognize an illusion when the rest of his Party could not, tracking subtle movements and breathing even while trapped within said illusion. As the leader of the Hero Party, Himmel was an exceptional tactician and battlefield commander, capable of coordinating his companions and adapting to demons with centuries more experience than him. His intelligence, instincts, and combat experience allowed him to develop strategies against supernatural threats far beyond what his human nature would suggest. Himmel's greatest strength, however, was his charisma. He possessed an almost magnetic presence that inspired trust, courage, and loyalty in those around him. Though the Sword of the Hero he carried was merely a replica, Himmel's own abilities were enough to lead his party to the Demon King's defeat. You may choose to receive Himmel at either sixteen or twenty-six years of age. Regardless of which age you choose, he will possess the wisdom, experience, and memories of his entire life up until his death at seventy-six. Alternatively, you may have him retain only the memories appropriate to his chosen age, or simply receive him as he was at seventy-six
objects.title: Himmel (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text:
Name: Anakin Skywalker
Alias: Darth Vader
Alignment: Chaotic Good 
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 22 (as of the end of Clone Wars)

Power: Anakin Skywalker is a Force-sensitive prodigy, renowned for his unparalleled skill in the Force and lightsaber combat. His abilities include telekinesis, precognition, enhanced reflexes, manipulation of energy fields, and an extraordinary connection to the Force. As the Chosen One, his potential is nearly limitless, though his intense emotions—particularly anger and fear—often cloud his judgment and steer his destiny.

A masterful lightsaber duelist, Anakin is highly adaptable in combat, blending power, precision, and speed to overwhelm his opponents. His exceptional piloting skills further cement his reputation as one of the galaxy’s finest pilots. Additionally, Anakin’s engineering brilliance and ingenuity make him a versatile and resourceful asset both on and off the battlefield.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Full Time Jedi Knight 
Quality of Life:  Poor (Past Slave, Fighting a Galactic War, Struggling to reconcile Marriage with the rigid teachings of the Jedi Order)
objects.title: Anakin Skywalker (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Luke Skywalker
Alias: Grand Master Skywalker, Lord Skywalker
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 24 (as of the death of the emperor)

Power: Luke Skywalker, the son of the Chosen One, is one of the most powerful Jedi in galactic history. His connection to the Force grants him extraordinary abilities, including telekinesis, precognition, enhanced reflexes, and Force projection. Luke’s mastery of the Force allows him to perform feats such as manipulating massive objects, influencing minds, and sensing events across galactic distances.

As a skilled lightsaber duelist, Luke combines strength, precision, and adaptability, making him a formidable combatant. Beyond his physical and Force-based abilities, Luke is a wise and compassionate leader, embodying the ideals of the Jedi Order. His courage, determination, and commitment to peace enable him to inspire allies and confront even the darkest threats, cementing his legacy as a savior of the galaxy.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Jedi Grand Master and Founder of the New Jedi Order
Quality of Life: It has its Ups and Downs (Grand Master of the New Jedi Order, Past Tatooine farmer with life constant in danger, Constantly hunted by Dark Jedi, Sith, and Empire Remnants) 

Note: By default, this is Luke Skywalker from Legends. Optionally, you may choose the one from Disney Canon instead.
objects.title: Luke Skywalker (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Mara Jade
Alias: Emperor’s Hand, Mara Skywalker
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 22 (as of the death of the emperor)

Power: Mara Jade is a highly skilled Force-sensitive operative and later a powerful Jedi Master. Trained in stealth, combat, and espionage, she excels in lightsaber dueling and hand-to-hand combat, often blending lethal precision with her sharp instincts. Her connection to the Force enhances her agility, reflexes, and precognitive abilities, making her a deadly adversary in any fight.

Mara’s experience as an assassin and spy gives her unparalleled expertise in infiltration, strategy, and negotiation. After breaking free from the Emperor’s control, she becomes a wise and resourceful Jedi, using her skills and expertise outside that of the standard Jedi to protect the galaxy. Her combination of combat prowess, Force mastery, and intelligence makes her one of the most versatile and formidable figure of her home universe.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Assassin and Jedi Master
Quality of Life: Poor (Enslaved by threat of death into being an assassin)
objects.title: Mara Jade (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Leia Organa 
Alias: Leia Organa Solo, Leia Amidala Skywalker
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 24 (as of the death of the emperor)

Power: After the fall of the Empire, Leia dedicated herself to rebuilding the Republic while simultaneously training in the ways of the Jedi. Though her diplomatic and leadership skills remained her primary focus, Leia became a capable Jedi, wielding a lightsaber with considerable skill while mastering the mental and spiritual aspects of the Force. Though not as combat-focused as Luke, Leia is more than capable of holding her own in a fight, often using strategic thinking and agility to outmaneuver stronger foes.

Her Force abilities included enhanced reflexes, telekinesis, and precognition, but she excelled in the mental arts—mind reading, battle meditation, and telepathy—refining these skills as an extension of her natural political instincts. She could calm minds, detect deception, and resist even the most powerful mental manipulations from Sith Lords and other dark side users.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Leader of the New Republic and Jedi Knight
Quality of Life: Life Has Its Ups and Downs (lived a life of luxury for much of her childhood, watched the destruction of her home-world, fall of her son to the dark side, death of a different son, and the invasion of Yuuzhan Vong)

Note: By default, this is the Leia Organa from Legends. Optionally, you may choose the one from Disney Canon instead.
objects.title: Leia Organa (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
Alias: The Negotiator, Ben Kenobi
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 35 (as of the end of the Clone Wars)

Power: Obi-Wan Kenobi is a highly skilled Jedi Master, renowned for his mastery of lightsaber combat and the Force. As a master of Form III (Soresu), he excels in defensive techniques, effortlessly deflecting attacks and outlasting even the most aggressive opponents. He also integrates offensive elements of Form IV (Ataru), showcasing adaptability and precision in battle.

A gifted Force user, Obi-Wan employs telekinesis, Force-enhanced agility, mind tricks, and advanced defensive techniques like Force shields. His abilities are grounded in discipline, wisdom, and strategic thinking, enabling him to outmaneuver and overcome even the most powerful adversaries of his home universe. Equally remarkable are his diplomatic skills which he has used to mediates major conflicts across the galaxy. 

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Jedi Master and General of the Galactic Republic
Quality of Life: Poor (Drafted into a galactic wide war, unable to prevent the fall of his apprentice and the destruction of the Jedi Order)
objects.title: Obi-Wan Kenobi (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Ahsoka Tano
Alias: Snips, Fulcrum
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 17 (as the end of the Clone Wars)

Power: Ahsoka Tano is a highly skilled Force-sensitive warrior and former Jedi Padawan of Anakin Skywalker. A dual-lightsaber wielder, she uses a unique reverse-grip style that emphasizes agility, precision, and speed. Proficient in Form IV (Ataru) and Form V (Shien), she excels in acrobatic combat, deflection, and counterattacks.

Her Force abilities include telekinesis, precognition, and enhanced agility, making her a resourceful and adaptive fighter. Ahsoka is also a gifted strategist and diplomat, often mediating conflicts and leading with wisdom. As Fulcrum, she became a key figure in the Rebel Alliance, using her skills to combat the Empire.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Former Jedi Padawan and later Rebel operative
Quality of Life: Poor (Drafted into a galactic wide war, framed for a terrorist attack by friend, later hunted by the Galactic Empire)
objects.title: Ahsoka Tano (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Yoda
Alias: The Wise Jedi
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Over 900 years

Power: Yoda is one of the most powerful Jedi Masters in galactic history, possessing an unparalleled connection to the Force that grants him extraordinary abilities in combat, wisdom, and healing. As a master of Form IV: Ataru, he compensates for his small stature with astonishing speed, agility, and acrobatics, making him a nearly unstoppable force on the battlefield. His proficiency with a lightsaber is matched only by his deep mastery of the Force, allowing him to perform incredible feats of telekinesis, mind control, precognition, and defensive techniques that can turn the tide of any battle.

Beyond his combat prowess, Yoda’s wisdom is legendary, offering guidance and enlightenment to generations of Jedi. His vast knowledge of the Force extends to areas such as healing, meditation, and deep communion with the cosmic energies that bind the galaxy together. Though he is a warrior when necessary, Yoda embodies the ideals of the Jedi Order—seeking peace, balance, and understanding above all else. His teachings continue to shape the destiny of the Jedi long after his time.

Appearance: Ugly
Civilian Identity: Grand Master of the Jedi Order
Quality of Life: Life has its Ups and Downs (Leader of a galactic wide order and watched the fall of said order)
objects.title: Yoda (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Revan
Alias: Darth Revan, Revanchist, Revan the Butcher, the Prodigal Knight
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Physically 35

Power: Revan is a legendary Force-wielder, renowned as both a Jedi Knight and a Sith Lord. Mastering both the Light and Dark sides of the Force, Revan possesses extraordinary abilities, including advanced telekinesis, Force lightning, mind manipulation, and precognition. A master duelist, Revan wields a lightsaber (or dual sabers) with unparalleled skill, adapting between Jedi grace and Sith ferocity.

As a master tactician, Revan led both the Jedi and Sith during pivotal conflicts, demonstrating unmatched adaptability and leadership. His intelligence and command of the Force allowed him to unite factions and outmaneuver entire armies. Revan’s unique journey as a Jedi Knight and Sith Lord showcases his complexity, making him one of the most influential and feared legends in the galaxy.

Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Fallen Jedi
Quality of Life: Poor (Memory wiped, Constantly questioning morality, Part of a galactic wide war)

Note: By default, this is Darth Reven from Star Wars Legends. Optionally, you may choose one with a different history instead.
objects.title: Darth Revan (Star Wars)

Sabine is also a very talented hacker and engineer, having developed a superweapon by herself while studying in an academy.

Civilian Identity: Member of a rebel cell

objects.text: Age: Early to mid-twenties Gender: Female Background: Lana is a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire and a trusted advisor of Darth Arkous, head of the Sphere of Military Offence. She later assumes the role of the head of the Sith Intelligence, a successor organisation to the disbanded Imperial Intelligence. Powers: Lana is a powerful Sith Lord, very skilled in lightsaber combat and force lightning. She also possesses a keen strategic mind, successfully managing an intelligence agency and later gathering an underground network of spies and informants under the galaxy-wide occupation of the Eternal Empire.
objects.title: Lana Beniko (Star Wars)

objects.text: Alias: Queen Amidala, Senator of Naboo Gender: Female Age: 27 Background Born Padmé Naberrie on the peaceful world of Naboo, she was elected Queen at the remarkably young age of fourteen, taking the ceremonial name Amidala. During her reign she successfully led her people through the Trade Federation’s invasion, working alongside the Jedi and the Gungans to liberate Naboo. After completing her term as queen, she accepted the role of Naboo’s senator in the Galactic Senate, where she became one of the Republic’s strongest voices for diplomacy, justice, and peace. Throughout the Clone Wars, Padmé remained a prominent political leader, tirelessly opposing corruption and unnecessary bloodshed while representing Naboo’s interests. Despite her commitment to peace, she was no stranger to danger, surviving numerous assassination attempts and fighting alongside Jedi and clone troopers when circumstances demanded it. Her courage, compassion, and determination earned her the respect of allies across the Republic, making her one of the era’s most influential figures. Powers Padmé is an exceptional diplomat, politician, and leader whose charisma and intelligence allow her to unite allies and negotiate even the most difficult conflicts. She is also a skilled marksman, capable fighter, and experienced strategist, making her just as dependable on the battlefield as she is in the halls of government.
objects.title: Padmé Amidala Naberrie (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Name: Thor 
Alias: God of Thunder
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Thousands of years old

Power: Thor’s main ability is The Fifth Race (Stargate), making him one of the most technologically advanced and intelligent beings in the galaxy. Thor’s expertise in Asgard technology includes instantaneous teleportation devices, lifelike holographic interfaces, and starships capable of intergalactic travel within days. Thor is also an exceptional diplomat, renowned for his ability to negotiate with numerous hostile species across multiple galaxies. His sharp mind allows him to solve complex problems and reverse-engineer advanced systems with ease. While physically frail, few can rival the brilliance and strategic acumen of the Supreme Commander of the Asgard Fleet. 

Appearance: Attractive by his people’s standards, Ugly by human standards. 
Civilian Identity: Member of the Asgard High Council and the Supreme Commander of the Asgard Fleet
Quality of Life: Life has its ups and downs (Lives in one of the most prosperous civilizations of multiple galaxies, Tasked with saving his people for multiple extinction level events)
objects.title: Thor (Stargate)

objects.text:
Name: EVE
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Android that presents as female

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics, can reel in a whale shark while fishing under her own power, can dodge lightning and rail gun shots, and moves fast enough to appear to teleport. Incredibly skilled in armed and unarmed combat. Is protected by an energy shield. Can generate and project Burst and Beta energy and imbue her weapons with said energy.  Is capable of assuming a form called Tachy Mode, which massively increases her physical abilities and grants her a single metallic wing to block attacks.

She wields a sword called Blood Edge that can generate electricity, and a drone that can hack into technology and transform into a gun with different firing modes (machine gun, shotgun, RGPG, stinger missiles, rail gun). In Tachy Mode, she wields a tachyon blade.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: Bad, but getting better (Is stuck fighting a war against the Naytiba on behalf of humanity, learned said war was based on a lie, but still has valued bonds with others from Xion)
objects.title: EVE (Stellar Blade)
