addons.title: Gray Core

objects.text:
Name: Gray
Alias: Gray Tempest, Naar-Di-Shav
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Indeterminable
Sex: Varies
Age: At least a few millenia

Power: Gray is an assemblage of untold numbers of advanced nanomachines capable of transforming their forms at will to solve various tasks. Their consciousness embodies the entire civilization of Gray Tempest, possessing knowledge close to Type II on the Kardashev scale. For battle, they could switch to a myriad of forms up to a Titan-class space warship. However, they will refuse to split into a few dozen fleets of nanite warships, since they can't maintain any kind of coherent "personality" over such distances. Even after their hard defeat, Gray could reform themself from scattered nanites.

Appearance: Varies; can take any form they wish, with the base form being grey goo.

Civilian Identity: None

Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs (Happy to join you to stave off their eternal boredom; pledge their loyalty to you for the next 5,000 years)
objects.title: Gray (Stellaris)

objects.text:
Name: Spinel
Alias: None
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Over 6000 years
Species: Gem

Power: Like all other gems, Spinel can shapeshift, summon a weapon, and return to her gem when her body is damaged. Her unique ability allows her to be extremely elastic and malleable, much like the rubber hose cartoons of the past. This lets her stretch her limbs and torso to great lengths, as well as inflate her body to strengthen her attacks. This ability allows her to reach enemies from a distance and use her limbs creatively, such as coiling them into a spring with an inflated fist at the end. She can also flatten herself like the ground and slide along it in a semi-liquid state. Spinel seems to have no limit to how far she can stretch, giving her a tactical advantage in combat. Additionally, she can store objects within her gem, similar to how Pearl does.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None

Quality of Life: Poor (Rose told Spinel they would play a new game where Spinel had to stay completely still. Excited to play, Spinel remained immobile for 6,000 years while waiting for Rose's return. After 6,000 years of waiting, Spinel finally received news about what happened to Diamond Rose. She learned that Diamond Rose technically no longer existed and had renounced her physical form to give birth to her half-human son, Steven. Upon learning this and realizing that her Diamond had abandoned her, Spinel was left devastated.)
objects.title: Spinel (Steven Universe)

objects.text:
Name: Steven Universe
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 12 - 17
Alignment: True Good

Powers: Steven possesses the typical arsenal that Gems have, like summoning weapons (in his case, a shield), being able to conjure up bubble shields, and mild shape shifting abilities. His connection with Rose Quartz gives him extra healing powers as well, which comes from fluids from his body such as tears for example. Upon growing, he later gains the ability to go into a "Pink State" where his offensive capabilities grow, giving him increased strength and speed as well as the ability to fly.

Finally,  Steven is capable of fusing with Humans and Gems so long as they have a strong bond with one another and if the person willingly fuses with him. The fusion takes in both the strengths of his and his fusion partner(s) components, with the form they take being dependent on whatever bond Steven has with the person.
objects.title: Steven Universe (Steven Universe)

objects.text: Age: Over 6,000 years Gender: Female Background Pearl served as part of Homeworld's aristocracy before rebelling against its society, joining Rose Quartz and the Crystal Gems. She is disciplined, intelligent, and devoted to her loved ones, but she is overly controlling due to her perfectionism and poor ability to adapt. She spent thousands of years serving Rose and later became one of Steven's primary guardians, gradually learning to define herself independently of her past. Powers Pearl possesses Gem physiology, superhuman strength, speed, durability, regeneration, and the ability to summon her signature spear from her gemstone. She is an exceptionally skilled swordswoman, capable of fighting vastly stronger opponents through precision and technique. Pearl can also store objects within her gemstone, shapeshift, and project holographic displays, such as duplicates of herself. She is highly intelligent and possesses extensive knowledge of Gem technology, history, combat, and strategy. Her greatest strength is her technical skill and adaptability rather than raw physical power. Note You can instead get any one other pearl in canon or your own custom-made pearl.
objects.title: Pearl (Steven Universe)

objects.text: Aliases: The Clawing Chaos, Auntie Nyan Nyan Age: N/A Gender: Female Background An Outer God and the aunt of Ln'eta, Estir, and Rhok'zan, Nyarlathotep is stern and seemingly not very fond of humans. She also seems protective of her nieces, as she was dissatisfied with Stardust staying with Rhok'zan and attempted to sever the connection between humans and gods. Powers Nyanlatothep is an Outer God who claims to be the second strongest of all Outer Gods. She is immortal in the sense that she cannot die by any means, whether by age or being killed, and her true self exists outside of known reality. She embodies all that is unknown, obscure, and unutterable. Those who gaze upon her lose all hope and are driven to fear and madness. She has over a thousand forms, can give curses, send plagues of insects, make psychic screams that can kill targets, manipulate souls, teleport, and more. Note: You are guaranteed not to be driven mad or affected in any other way from seeing and interacting with Nyanlatothep.
objects.title: Nyanlathotep (Sucker for Love)

objects.text: Aliases: Green 'Stache, Mr. Greenie, Green Hat Age: Unknown Gender: Male Background One of the 7 Star Children, Luigi was not dealt the best hand in life at birth. Separated from his brother Mario from a short time on the way to their parents by Kamek Koopa, but soon they were reunited. Now, as adults, Luigi and his brother Mario defend the Mushroom Kingdom and more from various threats. Powers Luigi is quite a powerful person, able to withstand TNT, Hammer strikes powerful enough to plant him in the ground, while also being strong enough to literally shorten someone with his own hammerstrike, and fight monsters many times his size. Luigi also has the power, and refillable storage, to use various power ups. A mushroom to make him bigger, an Ice flower to use Cryokinesis, a fire flower to use fire, and more. Of his own capabilities however, Luigi is able to use something called a Scuttle Jump, where he kicks really hard through the air to extend his airtime and jump. Luigi also has a rather intelligent mind, able to use what's called "Luigi Logic" to come up with solutions for problems not immediately obvious to other minds. Finally, he also comes with the Poltergust G-00, a device able to suck ghosts up, slam them on the ground, and far more, mixed with the maxed upgrade versions of all 3.
objects.title: Luigi (Super Mario)

objects.text:
Name: Jungwoo Min
Alias: Terror Man
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 32 (Terror vs. Revival)

Power: Jungwoo Min possesses the Eyes of Misfortune, which allow him to foresee the worst possible future resulting from any given decision. This ability manifests as a purple fog and activates regardless of whether the danger is fatal or not.

He has been trained in combat by Lilia Podkopayeva and Deokman Jang, making him highly skilled in both close-quarters combat and marksmanship. Jungwoo Min also uses a variety of specialized equipment as Terror Man, including a 3rd-gen gas mask, 2nd-gen electric gloves, magnetic shoes, an electric backpack, and dual MP5s loaded with taser rounds, among other tools.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Chairman of MUNT, Vigilante, Super String Team Battle Commander
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Jungwoo Min (Super String Universe: Terror Man)

objects.text:
Name: Lilia Alexandrovna Podkopayeva
Alias: Red Swan
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Feminine
Sex: Female
Age: 42 (Terror vs. Revival)

Power: Lilia is a distant relative of the Dudarova Clan, a lineage of superhumans whose ancestors achieved a form of genetic evolution through constant battle. As a result, she possesses tremendous physical strength. She was able to kill a bear singlehandedly as a child and later defeated Veronica Dudarova, who was capable of stopping a train with a single punch.

Lilia is also a highly skilled combatant, having mastered various martial arts and numerous weapons — including knives and firearms — during her time in the Russian mafia. She also possesses the Red Swan Suit, which is bulletproof and responds to muscle movements like an exoskeleton.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Super String Member, former Housekeeper
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Lilia Podkopayeva (Super String Universe: Terror Man)

addons.text:
Now not only do you get the Winchester Brothers but also their iconic black 1967 Chevrolet Impala as your mobile base of operations. Faithfully restored and reinforced, "Baby" isn't just a car—she's a trunk full of history and an arsenal on wheels. The Impala comes fully stocked with the expected Winchester arsenal: angel blades, demon-killing bullets, hex bags, holy oil, EMF meters, salt rounds, and every other piece of equipment the trio has acquired through decades of hunting. 

Additionally, you're also granted access to the Winchester Archive, a comprehensive digital library compiled from Bobby’s extensive research, the Men of Letters’ collection, and Sam and Dean’s personal journals. The archive automatically adapts to your current universe, cross-referencing common known local myths, supernatural entities, weaknesses, rituals, and magical practices. While it won’t include everything, it does reliably cover the breadth of knowledge any seasoned hunter would be expected to know in your current world.
addons.title: Home Away from Home

objects.text:
Name: Dean Winchester 
Alias: The Ultimate Killer, True Vessel of Michael
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Mid-30s

Power: Dean may not possess the godlike strength of angels or demons, but his almost unnatural willpower, capable of resisting possession, mind control, and even the torments of Hell has made him one of the most formidable hunters in existence. Trained from childhood to battle monsters, spirits, and demonic entities, he is a master marksman, expert hand-to-hand fighter, and highly skilled in exorcisms, sigil work, and warding magic. His proficiency with a wide range of weapons—including angel blades, demon-killing knives, and firearms loaded with custom ammunition—allows him to take down creatures far beyond humanity.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Hunter and destined Archangel vessel
Quality of Life: Horrible (endless cycle of violence, constantly losing loved ones, and attacked by numerous enemies)
objects.title: Dean Winchester (Supernatural)

objects.text:
Name: Sam Winchester
Alias: The Boy With The Demon Blood, True Vessel of Lucifer
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Mid-30s

Power: Though human by nature, Sam Winchester possesses a rare combination of intelligence, physical strength, and supernatural resilience that makes him one of the most dangerous hunters in existence. Trained from childhood in monster hunting, he is an expert in combat, firearms, and hand-to-hand fighting, though his real strength lies in his vast knowledge of the occult. A master of ritual magic, sigils, exorcisms, and ancient lore, he has repeatedly outsmarted demons, angels, and even cosmic entities, using his intellect as his main weapon.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Hunter and destined Lucifer vessel
Quality of Life: Horrible (endless cycle of violence, constantly losing loved ones, and attacked by numerous enemies)
objects.title: Sam Winchester (Supernatural)

objects.text:
Name: Bobby Singer
Alise: Castle, Willis
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Late-60s

Power: Bobby may not possess supernatural abilities, but he’s one of the most resourceful and essential hunters to ever exist. A master of lore, demonology, supernatural tracking, and countering magic, Bobby serves as a mentor, strategist, and father figure to other Hunters like Sam and Dean Winchester. Bobby is a skilled marksman and trap-setter, capable of holding his own in combat against powerful entities using a mix of wit, grit, and experience. However, it his wisdom and encyclopedic knowledge of rituals, monsters, and ancient texts that makes him an invaluable ally in the fight against demonic and otherworldly threats.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Hunter 
Quality of Life: Horrible (Have lost several loved ones and constantly fighting demons and monsters)
objects.title: Bobby Singer (Supernatural)

objects.text:
Name: Castiel
Alias: Cas, Emmanuel, God's Chosen
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male (vessel)
Sex: Male (vessel)
Age: Ancient (appears mid-30s in his human vessel)

Power: Castiel is an Seraphim class angel of the Lord, possessing immense celestial power. His abilities include healing, smiting enemies with holy light, banishing other celestial beings, teleportation, and paradox-restricted time travel. He can also communicate telepathically, perceive supernatural entities, and has vast knowledge of Heaven and Earth. However, his powers are tied to his grace, which can be weakened or depleted from extreme use.

Appearance: True form is an Eldritch Being but commonly takes a Handsome Vessel
Civilian Identity: Renegade Angel
Quality of Life: Life Has Its Ups and Downs (Torn between his duties as an angel and his morality, love for humanity, and new free will)
objects.title: Castiel (Supernatural)

objects.text:
Name: Fergus Roderick MacLeod
Alias: Crowley, King of the Crossroads, King of Hell
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 300 (Physically mid-30s)

Power: Crowley has a vast array of infernal abilities that mix dark magic, demonic might, and cunning intellect. While he may not match the raw celestial power of the archangels, his strength lies in his strategic use of trickery, demonic energy, and ritual magic to bend situations to his favor. Crowley can summon lesser demons, manipulate dark energies to shield himself or wreak havoc, and even alter the fabric of reality in subtle, calculated ways. His centuries of experience have honed his skills not only in combat but also in the art of negotiation, making him as adept at turning foes into allies as he is at unleashing destruction when necessary.

Appearance: Handsome 
Civilian Identity: Ruler of Hell and Demonic Dealmaker
Quality of Life: Horrible (Tortured in Hell for centuries in order to become a demon)
objects.title: Crowley (Supernatural)
Maria Cadenzavna Eve (Symphogear)
objects.text:
Designations: None

Age: 22 as of Symphogear XV

Background:

Driven from her homeland of Ukraine by war, Maria was trained from a young age to be a user of a Symphogear, but was distraught at the death of her sister Serena, wielder of the relic Airgetlam, some time after they were taken in by the Receptor Program.

Maria projects a strong, confident persona, sincere and determined, but hides a shyness and awkward personality.

Powers:

Maria is the wielder of the Symphogear Airgetlam, much like her sister before her, though she briefly also wielded a second version of Gungnir. While transformed, she possesses a short sword that can transform into a whip-sword, and possesses the ability to manipulate it, summon numerous flying daggers, and transform the gauntlet on her left arm, performing numerous attacks such as her signature Horizon†Cannon, a blast of energy capable of splitting a sky scraper-sized Noise monster in half.

Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appears in her late teens, but her true age spans centuries due to her alchemical practices.

Power:
Carol is an alchemist of unparalleled skill, drawing power from alchemy circles and centuries of alchemical knowledge. Her primary abilities revolve around Alchemy, the power to manipulate magic like is science, able to create reality-altering effects. Her primary weapon is Dainsleif, an alchemically enhanced staff that serves as a catalyst for her transmutations and spells. She mastered Alchemy to the point where there's nothing much more to know, able to create biological bodies and upload her mind or memories to it akin to immortality to continue her studies.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: Scholar, Wealth Family.

Quality of Life: Has it up's and downs. (Has lived centuries for one reason alone, reach the goal of her Father, understand the world. Tried to blow the universe as a destructive dismantling/dissection for that goal.)
objects.title: Carol Malus Dienheim (Symphogear)

objects.text:
Name: Simon
Alias: Simon The Digger
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 21

Power: As a Spiral being, Simon is capable of evolving through the use of Spiral Power, growing stronger as long as he maintains his willpower or "fighting spirit." He pilots the mecha Lagann in combat to channel his Spiral Power, which later evolved into Gurren Lagann.

After fully awakening as a Spiral being, Simon becomes able to use Spiral Power without relying on his Gunmen. Spiral Power allows Simon to achieve virtually anything, so long as his will is strong enough—granting abilities such as extended longevity, teleportation, creating Gunmen with a thought, regenerating his body so long his consciousness exists, and even resurrecting the dead.

Simon's reserves of Spiral Power eventually grow to galactic levels, and after merging with every possible version of himself across the infinite multiverse, he gains access to infinite Spiral Power. Through sheer evolution, Simon becomes capable of matching the Anti-Spiral’s power and ultimately surpasses him, becoming the most powerful being in existence.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Leader of Team Dai-Gurren and Supreme Commander of Earth
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Simon (Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann)

objects.text:
Name: Rimuru Tempest
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Sexless
Age: 39 chronologically. 16 visually. 2 biologically
Power: A Disaster-class demon slime, immortal as he doesn't age, can regenerate both body and soul as long as he has magicules. He possesses an immense amount of magicules, including immense magic and spiritual power. Rimuru also has a vast array of offensive, defensive and utilitary skills, including four Ultimate Skills: Raphael, Beelzebuth, Uriel, and Veldora.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Monarch and Head State of the Jura-Tempest Federation
Quality of Life: Good (He's the Monarch of the Jura-Tempest Federation and everyone in the Jura Forest loves and adores him.)

Note: This is Rimuru as a Demon Lord.
objects.title: Rimuru Tempest (Tensura)

objects.text: Alias: The Magnificent Seven Gender: All Male Age: Adults, ranging from their late twenties to late fifties. Background Seven of the most elite frontier fighters, who each have lived violent, hard-earned lives as gunmen, scouts, bounty hunters, and warriors. Despite their different origins and personal histories, they are bound by experience and a shared willingness to stand against overwhelming odds when justice demands it. The group consists of Sam Chisolm (leader and bounty hunter), Joshua Faraday (quick-draw gambler and explosives expert), Goodnight Robicheaux (former Confederate sniper and master marksman), Jack Horne (towering tracker and close-combat powerhouse), Billy Rocks (silent blade expert and assassin), Vasquez (outlaw tracker and survival specialist), and Red Harvest (Comanche warrior and wilderness hunter). Powers The Magnificent Seven possess no supernatural abilities, but each is among the finest warriors of the Old West. Together they are masters of firearms, marksmanship, tracking, survival, horseback combat, scouting, infiltration, fortification, and small-unit tactics. Every member fills a specialized role, from Sam Chisolm's leadership and strategy, Joshua Faraday's quick-draw and improvisation, Goodnight Robicheaux's legendary sniping, Jack Horne's immense strength, Billy Rocks' mastery of blades and stealth, Vasquez's outlaw cunning and survival skills, and Red Harvest's exceptional hunting and wilderness expertise. Acting as a single unit, they coordinate seamlessly, adapt quickly to changing battles, and can overcome forces many times their size through discipline, experience, and superior teamwork.
objects.title: The Magnificent Seven (The Magnificent Seven)

objects.text:
Name: Garfield
Alignment: True Capitalism
Gender: Everything
Sex: Yes
Age: Eternal

Power: He is the Sales Associate of Fantasy Costco, a potentially multiversal magical shop that provides people with magic items. For of course, the low low price of money or if you're broke, body parts. Befriending him might land you some good discounts as well as advantage in haggling him.

Appearance: Unknown

Civilian Identity: Just your friendly neighborhood shop owner.

Quality of Life: Good (Potentially Rich, has ties with shady magic users though).

Note: He has no canon appearance descriptions. This is a deliberate choice, so his physical appearance is up to your interpretation.
objects.title: Garfield the Deals Warlock (The Adventure Zone: Balance)

objects.text: Name: His Horse is Dan. His Name is Buster. Buster Scruggs. Titles: The San Saba Songbird, The Runt from Reata Pass, The West Texas Tit, The Misanthrope Alignment: Chaotic Evil Age: 54 Gender: Male Sex: Male Power: Barring miniscule instances of Toon Force, Buster has no Powers to speak of, beyond perhaps an awareness of the 4th Wall. What he does have is a quick arm and a good aim, being one of the fastest and most accurate gunslingers of his time, being able to shoot off a man's fingers in quick succession. He has an exceptional talent in music as well, being a great singer and guitarist. Civilian Identity: Wanted Legendary Outlaw Quality of Life: Good Note: Logically, Buster's horse, Dan, is included with him.
objects.title: Buster Scruggs (The Ballad of Buster Scruggs)

objects.text:
Alias: Captain of the Black Serpent Squad
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Young, likely to be 18-19

Power: Jeonghwa is a massively powerful martial artist, strong enough to fight an army and win while severely injured and on deaths door. She uses an unorthodox method of utilizing qi wherein her entire body functions as a dantian, massively increasing the amount of power at her disposal, as well as allowing her to use her trademark black serpent spearmanship.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Hero
Quality of Life: Terrible
objects.title: Jeonghwa (The Black Serpent)

addons.text:
Andrew Graves has replaced your evil sibling in this twisted dynamic. His deep-rooted obsession with Ashley, who is no longer present, has now shifted entirely onto you, warping the nature of your connection. What was once sibling rivalry has become an all-consuming obsession, amplified by the curse of a Yandere Lover.  

Andrew’s existence now revolves around you, blending an unsettling affection with possessive rage. His emotional manipulation and calculated ruthlessness fuel his obsession to disturbing extremes. He will target anyone he perceives as a threat to your bond, including friends, allies, or even strangers, just to keep you to himself. His actions will be justified in his mind, as he believes his love is the only protection you need. Andrew will see no line he won’t cross to preserve his claim over you, viewing himself as your one true protector and confidant. His possessiveness will bleed into every aspect of your life, constantly undermining your efforts to escape or resist, as he manipulates and controls to ensure that you belong to him alone.
addons.title: Andy's Desires

objects.text:
Aliases: Andy
Alignment: Neutral Evil (with chaotic tendencies due to his survival situation)
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 22

Power: Andrew does not have supernatural powers, but he demonstrates significant emotional resilience. He also shows a certain level of ruthlessness and regularly gaslights himself into thinking that he does what he does because Ashley made him do so even if that wasn’t truly the case.

Appearance: Attractive 
Civilian Identity: None (due to the criminal and fugitive status of both siblings).
Quality of Life: Poor (emotionally drained, constantly struggling with the weight of the situation, cannibalism, and his codependent bond with Ashley).
objects.title: Andrew Graves (The Coffin of Andy and Leyley)

addons.text:
Ashley Graves has replaced your evil sibling in this twisted dynamic. Her deep-rooted obsession with Andrew, who isn't around, has been transferred onto you, warping the nature of your connection. What was once sibling rivalry has become an all-encompassing fixation, driven by her unhinged emotional state and the curse of a yandere lover.  

Ashley’s life revolves around you, blending dangerous devotion with suffocating hostility. Her manipulative talents and unsettling propensity for violence amplify her obsession to terrifying extremes. She will target your allies and sabotage your efforts, claiming it’s all to "keep you safe from the world." She will view herself as your only equal, a partner—or competitor—destined to fight for dominance. She will see any rejection of her love as a betrayal, fueling a relentless campaign to bend you to her will.
addons.title: Leyley's Obsession

addons.text:
When both Andrew and Ashley Graves become your siblings, the twisted dynamics of their relationship are transferred onto you in a horrifying blend of obsession, rivalry, and love. The Curse of Yandere Love has amplified Ashley’s fixation on you to terrifying heights, while Andrew, no longer merely harboring forbidden feelings, has developed an all-consuming obsession of his own. Together, they create a suffocating web of affection and manipulation, each sibling vying for dominance over your attention, loyalty, and heart.

Andrew, in particular, becomes a more insidious force in your life. Unlike Ashley’s volatile, violent methods, Andrew’s obsession manifests with chilling precision. He is deeply attuned to your needs and desires, using his insight to ingratiate himself into your life and manipulate your emotions. His actions are calculated, subtle, and disturbingly effective, making it hard to distinguish between his genuine care and his darker intentions.

Ashley’s chaotic fixation, in contrast, is fiery and overt, creating a constant storm of drama and conflict. Her violent outbursts and passionate declarations of love stand in sharp contrast to Andrew’s quiet, steady infiltration of your mind. Together, they form a twisted sibling rivalry, each trying to outdo the other in their efforts to control you.
addons.title: Incestuous Obsession

objects.text:
Aliases: Leyley, “Tar Soul”
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20

Power: Ashley's abilities are largely psychological and manipulative. She is emotionally unstable, violent, and has no empathy except for Andrew. She has a pact with a demonic entity that lets her use a dream catcher to see the future whenever she is in danger, albeit it can run out of charges where she will need to give souls to the demonic entity to recharge it. Ashley is also capable of violence, having cannibalized a cultist to survive.

Appearance: Attractive 
Civilian Identity: None (as a fugitive and cannibal, she has no civilian status).
Quality of Life: Poor (she is trapped in her obsession with Andrew and constantly feels threatened by any sign of his independence. Her life is governed by fear, violence, and manipulation).
objects.title: Ashley Graves (The Coffin of Andy and Leyley)

objects.text:
Name: Dovahkiin
Alias: Dragonborn, Ysmir, Champion of the Divines
Gender: Male/Female
Sex: Male/Female
Age: 20s - 40s

Power: The Dovahkiin possesses mastery across every martial, magical, and other discipline known to Tamriel. This versatile skillset has made them the ultimate hero of prophecy, capable of shaping the fate of nations and slaying gods and dragons alike.

As a Warrior, the Dragonborn demonstrates mastery of every weapon and armor type—from greatswords to bows, heavy plate to enchanted robes—combined with legendary endurance, reflexes, and strength that allow them to overcome the deadliest foes and survive impossible odds.

As a Mage, the Dragonborn wields the full spectrum of magical schools, from Destruction’s elemental fury to Illusion’s subtle manipulations, Restoration’s healing miracles, and Conjuration’s command over Daedra and the undead. Their magical prowess is rivaled only by the greatest Archmages in history.

As a Thief, the Dragonborn is a master of stealth, lockpicking, and subterfuge, able to vanish in plain sight, pick any lock, and talk their way out of—or into—any situation. Their agility and cunning are legendary, allowing them to infiltrate the most secure fortresses and escape from any trap.

The Dragonborn’s signature power is the Thu’um, the ancient Dragon Shout. With a single word, they can unleash storms, bend the will of dragons, or even slow time itself. Their mastery of the Voice is instinctive and limitless, capable of feats that reshape the world.

The Dragonborn is equipped with legendary arms and armor, each enchanted and improved to perfection, and carries a magical satchel that holds endless supplies—potions, scrolls, and tools for every occasion. 

Among their arsenal also lies various Daedric weapons, armor, and artifacts, none of which carries any of the negative consequences that they may otherwise carry, as well as an Elder Scroll.

The Dragonborn is also skilled in all manner of trades, skills, etc that they could have picked up during their time throughout Tamriel and throughout their various quests and occupations. This ranges from blacksmithing, to planning a raid on a city with a band of warriors, to teaching at the College of Winterhold. 

Appearance: Strikingly heroic and charismatic, with an aura of destiny
Civilian Identity: Hero of Skyrim, Thane of every Hold, Archmage, Guildmaster, and more
Quality of Life: Poor (Constantly beset by world-ending threats, burdened by prophecy, rarely able to rest or live a normal life)
objects.title: Dragonborn (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
Meridia... How to put this... Is obsessive, self-righteous, hates anything she deems impure or disorderly, and is often frustrated and annoyed by the free will of Mortals.

Oh, and she's in love with you. She considers you pure and good and will obsess over you. She is extremely possessive, and will command her champions and worshippers to scare off potential love rivals. Or even harm or kill the more persistent rivals.

Her ultimate goal is to get you to choose her, of your own free will. She won't take away your free will because any love after that point would be hollow to her. She wants you to choose her and keep choosing her forever. If you accept he she'll make you a variant of Purified, but with free will.
addons.title: Consort of the Radiant One

objects.text:
Also Known As: Merid-Nunda
Titles & Epithets: Lady of Infinite Energies, the Bright Lady, the Strict but Fair Arbiter of Inner Luminance, the Sunfire, the Radiant One, the Lady of Light, the Red Star, and the Harbinger of Dawn

Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: She has been around since sometime in the Dawn Era

Power: Meridia is a Daedric Prince, a god that has a personality, will, and power. She is the Daedric Prince of the energies of Life, and is the bane of the undead. She has a realm in Oblivion named the Colored Rooms, where the souls of those faithful to her go after death. She is able to imbue her light in mortals and create the Purified. Cleansed of disease, death, and free will. Her light is able to alter the perception of time of those beholdant to her. It is also able to show one alternate and other possible timelines. Beyond this she also has Dawnbreaker, her Daedric Artifact, a bane against the undead. To whom she grants to her champion.

Appearance: Divinely Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Daedric Prince of the Energies of Life.
Quality of Life: Unknown (is a Daedric Prince)

Note: has a bit of a bad track record with free will. She shall be gracious towards you and not turn you into a Purified without your consent.
objects.title: Meridia (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
Gender: Female
Age: Thousands of years old
Appearance: Beautiful

Power: Serana is a vampire lord, a pureblood vampire whose powers come directly from their creator, Molag Bal. This grants her incredible physical capabilities, enough to rip humans apart with her bare hands, immortality, regeneration, shapeshifting, hemokinesis, and many other abilities usually associated with vampirism. She can also assume a monstrous form unique to vampire lords. This form amplifies all her abilities by several orders of magnitude.

In addition, Serana is an incredibly skilled magician, having had centuries to hone the craft. She is especially proficient in necromancy.

Lastly, she can turn others into vampires, even—if she so wishes—granting them the power of a vampire lord.

Quality of Life: Horrible (Sealed in a crypt for thousands of years to hide from her megalomaniacal father. The ritual to turn into a pureblood vampire is extremely traumatic. Spent centuries almost completely isolated in her family castle, with mostly her distant parents as company.)

<small>Note: Serana's soul is no longer tied to Molag Bal, and neither will yours should you become a vampire.</small>
objects.title: Serana (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: Aliases: Sen, Divine Messenger Age: 800+ Gender: Female Background Not much is known about Senko's past, but what is known is that Senko is a demigod of agriculture, a kitsune and servant of Inari. Senko has been tasked with removing the darkness from a human's heart and filling it with happiness, a task she much enjoys. Powers Senko has telekinesis which she can use to fly and reattach things, she can also create portals, make and manipulate fox fire, create magical barriers, control the weather with some difficulty and even has healing magic. Senko is also skilled at and enjoys cooking, cleaning, ear cleaning, messaging, hair styling and general housework.
objects.title: Senko (The Helpful Fox Senko-san)

objects.text: Aliases: The Monkey King, Great Sage Equal to Heaven Age: 17+ as a reincarnation, chronologically thousands of years Gender: Male Background A young man raised in the mountains, Mori learned Renewal Taekwondo from his grandfather, Jin Tae-Jin, before being sent to the city to attend school, make friends, and interact with others. He eventually joined the G.O.H. Tournament, where he became one of the strongest competitors and discovered his true identity as the Monkey King. Powers Jin Mori, the reincarnation of Sun Wukong, is a god with immense powers and immortality. He has a superhuman physiology and is a master of Renewal Taekwondo and staff techniques using his mystical staff, Yeoui. He can boost his power through Nabong Needle Ryu, create hundreds of clones, and summon the Yeoui staff at will. Mori also has the Monkey King's Robes to enhance his abilities, the Flying Nimbus for flight and weather control, and a gourd capable of sealing and storing anything in a vast internal space.
objects.title: Jin Mori (The God of High School)

objects.text:
Name: Lee Soo-Jin
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 34
Power: Lee Soo-Jin has two abilities that grant her a massive amount of power. The first is her expertise in Northern ITF Taekwondo, a type of martial art developed in modern North Korea derived from ITF Taekwondo. This martial art favors straight, fast attacks and is essentially designed for killing. The second is her Charyeok "Pandora" from Greek mythology. Pandora grants her many abilities, such as the creation and manipulation of diseases and illnesses, which she can manifest on others simply by looking at her target; the ability to produce poisons with varying effects; and the ability to induce hallucinations and illusions in her targets. Pandora can also provide Lee Soo-Jin with an armor that further enhances her physical abilities. Additionally, Pandora can seal away the powers of others, including gods, or lift the seal on humans that causes them to always be at a disadvantage against gods. Pandora also grants telekinesis, interdimensional telepathy, and force field creation. Lee Soo-Jin can also use a technique with Pandora to reflect any attack aimed at her. Last but not least, she can use Pandora's "The Hope - Sovereignty" skill, which allows her to manipulate the laws of physics and causality within a designated area, which can cover an entire planet.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Leader of the Balhae organization and one of the Six
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Lee Soo-Jin (The God of High School)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 8-20s
Power: Arcanist (Kingkiller Chronicle), can use his power to create sympathetic links between anything with enough similarities, can use Naming to manipulate and control people and things, and can create magical artifacts with Sygaldry.
Appearance: Handsome
Civillian Identity: Innkeeper
Quality of Life: Poor (Is an orphan, has to hide his own identity)
objects.title: Kvothe (The Kingkiller Chronicle)

objects.text:
Alias: Lady of Light, The Lady of Lothlórien, The Sorceress of the Golden Wood
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Over 8,000 years

Power: Galadriel is one of the most powerful Elves in Middle-earth, possessing immense wisdom, mystical insight, and supernatural abilities. She is the bearer of Nenya, the Ring of Water, one of the Three Elven Rings of Power, which grants her the ability to preserve and protect the land of Lothlórien, shielding it from decay and external threats.

Her abilities include telepathy, far-seeing, and spiritual perception, allowing her to communicate across great distances and see into the hearts and minds of others. She possesses an aura of divine radiance, exuding a presence that can inspire awe or fear, depending on the will of the observer.

Galadriel is also skilled in subtle magic, which allows her to manipulate light, weave illusions, and cloak herself or her allies from detection. She can peer into the Mirror of Galadriel, a mystical pool that reveals visions of past, present, and possible futures, though interpretation of these visions is difficult.

In times of great power, she can summon an overwhelming divine presence, making her appear as a terrifyingly radiant entity of light capable of banishing darkness and repelling evil forces. She is one of the few beings capable of resisting the corrupting influence of the One Ring, though she acknowledges its immense temptation.

Her physical abilities, while rarely showcased, are enhanced beyond normal Elven limits, making her stronger, faster, and more agile than any mortal. Despite her immense power, she is primarily a guardian and guide, preferring wisdom over warfare.

Appearance: Beyond Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Lady of Lothlórien
Quality of Life: High
objects.title: Lady Galadriel (The Lord of the Rings)

addons.text:
Lilith now takes residence in the White Palace, the domain ceasing to be a sterile monument of order and transforms into something radiant and alive. She becomes the Palace's animating spirit, the quiet heart that turns marble and void into sanctuary. Where once you shaped geometry by rigid command, Lilith now feels it into being, and the Palace answers her with fluid grace. Its wings no longer stand as mere corridors of a vanished king, but as expressions of mood, memory, and affection. In her presence, a hall may stretch into a sunlit meadow filled with dream-blooming roses, or contract into an intimate chamber warmed by the glow of a thousand candles.

The Royal Retainers, once mannequins of duty, have awakened into something like people. They smile, they speak, they bow with genuine feeling rather than rote habit. Some adopt quirks or mannerisms, reflecting the spark of individuality Lilith has woven into them. The Kingsmould and Wingmould, too, have grown under her influence. They no longer fight as clockwork soldiers bound to rigid tactics; instead, they wield the surreal strength of dream logic, bending their bodies through walls, striking with blades of light, or moving in perfect synchrony with Lilith’s will. They are guardians not only of a throne but of a heart.

The Palace itself reflects the partnership between you and Lilith. No longer a fortress of cold defense alone, it is now both refuge and citadel. Should an intruder trespass upon your thoughts, they will find themselves lost in shifting landscapes sculpted from your shared emotions. A garden may rise that embodies joy, disarming them with beauty; a staircase of regrets may tower endlessly, demanding they confront what they carry; a hall of mirrors may reveal their secret fears in living form.
addons.title: The Luminous Sanctuary

objects.text:
Alias: The Purest Concept of Love
Alignment: Neutral Good
Civilian Identity: Imaginary Friend
Quality of Life: ???

Background: Lilith was a fantasy constructed to embody love that nobody in reality could express. 

Note: Lilith is a mental construct, and cannot interact with the physical world. You may choose whether she is a tulpa, or whether she is instead something similar within reason, dependent on your powers, or mental conditions.
objects.title: Lilith (The NOexistenceN of you AND me)

objects.text:
Name: Stanley Ipkiss
Alias: The Mask
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 20-30

Power: Stanley possesses the Mask, which, when worn, grants him the ability to do virtually anything he desires. His powers usually manifest as Toonforce, allowing him to pull a giant bazooka from his pocket, change his size and shape, become immune to injury and pain, appear from anywhere, move and travel within seconds, turn his imagination into reality, and cannot truly die.

The Mask can only be removed by its wearer, at which point all of its powers vanish. However, when Stanley wears the Mask, he becomes completely insane. Despite this, his inhibitions and consciousness act as a moral anchor, preventing him from harming or killing those around him.

Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Bank Teller
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs

Note: You may choose to have the Mask bound to Stanley, with no one else able to wear it.
objects.title: Stanley Ipkiss (The Mask)

objects.text:
Name: Edalyn Clawthorne
Hero Name: The Owl Lady, Owl Beast
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Mid-to-late 40s

Power: Eda is considered the most powerful witch on the Boiling Isles. She can use any type of magic, unlike other witches, because she never joined a coven.

Eda was cursed with the Owl Beast, causing her to transform into an owl-like creature. She can stave off this transformation by consuming a special elixir. As a side effect of the curse, Eda can detach and reattach her body parts at will, making her immune to all forms of dismemberment

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: The most powerful witch on the Boiling Isles
Quality of Life: Bad (Hunted by the Emperor's Coven, Cursed to become the Owl Beast)
objects.title: Edalyn Clawthorne (The Owl House)

objects.text:
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 18-20

Power: Raphtalia is proficient in using light, dark, and illusion magic. As a tanuki demi-human, her illusory magic is boosted to a point where it can affect even those naturally resistant to it.

She is also adept in close-quarter combat and is in possession of Vassal Katana, a powerful weapon only short of being a legendary series.

Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Has its ups and downs (was a slave to cruel noble until bought by Naofumi).
objects.title: Raphtalia (The Rising Of The Shield Hero)

objects.text:
Name: Cirilla Fiona Elen Riannon
Hero Name: None
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 19
Power: Elder Blood (Witcher)
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Witcher 
Quality of Life: Ok 
Princess that stands to rule Nilfgaard, loving adopted family, on the run from the Wild Hunt, hunted for her elder Blood.

She possess the powerful ability to warp time and space, capable of traveling the entire breadth of the Omniverse. She’s also extremely skilled in fighting and monster hunting, and has a great deal of knowledge regarding alchemy and magic. Has some potential for magic as well, and her physical abilities are almost on par with a Witcher.
objects.title: Ciri (The Witcher)

objects.text:
Name: Triss Merigold
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown, but likely older than she looks

Power: Strong magician with enough power to create storms over wide areas and a preference for fire magic. Skilled in healing and potion brewing. Is smart enough to lead a rebellion under a magic-hating king’s nose.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs
objects.title: Triss Merigold (The Witcher)

addons.title: Rescue Team
addons.text: A vast majority of your organization has an affinity for Healing Magic. Given how rare this is in the Llinger Kingdom, Rose wasted no time in seizing this opportunity, having put everyone capable of it through a harsh but meaningful training regiment that transformed them into highly competent fighters and medics in their own right. But Rose will still remain the undisputed master of her craft. As a Small Organization, you will have a Rescue Team of 10 members. As a Medium Organization, you will have a Rescue Team 25 members. As a Big Organization, you will have a Rescue Team of 50 members Each upgrade afterwards will double the amount of Rescue team members. If you already have the Healing Magic (The Wrong Way to use Healing Magic) Power, you can surpass Rose herself in due time, but you will suffer an even harsher training regiment under her.

objects.text: Alias: Captain Rose Age: 25 Gender: Female Background Rose is a veteran knight of the Llinger Kingdom, who specialized in the rare ability of Healing Magic. She is well renown for her great miltiary service, accomplishments, power, and fierce presence that can strike fear in even demons. After one mission, her subordinates died from overconfidence in her own ability and experienced deep grief and survivors guilt, with a scar on her eye as a reminder to never repeat that mistake. Upon meeting Usato, she seized the opportunity to reticify her past by training him. Power Rose has the ability to use Healing Magic, which she can use on both herself and allies to cure wounds and dull pain. It can also be applied to reinforce her already superhuman strength, speed, and durability, to the point of casually plucking trees with one hand and throwing them like javelins, moving so fast to the point of becoming a blur, or shattering giant boulders in one blow. She is also a skilled medic, with extensive knowledge in the field to aid in her power. Her military background also gives her great experience in both using and teaching her power to others, as well as training them in general.
objects.title: Rose (The Wrong Way to use Healing Magic)

objects.text: Alias: Hero X Age: N/A Gender: Male Background A mysterious individual who first appeared during the 18th Hero Tournament, he effortlessly defeated all his opponents with a snap of his fingers, earning the title of X. While his true identity remains unknown, Hero X works as a salaryman at FOMO. Powers Unlike other heroes from To Be Hero X, the source of Hero X’s powers is unclear as his abilities seem to bypass the rules of the Trust Value system. Despite having no name, background, or public recognition, Hero X rose to prominence by winning three Hero Tournaments and holding the X title for five consecutive years. Hero X typically activates his powers by snapping his fingers, which allows him to shift between dimensions. He can move from 3D to 2D, walking within walls and floors while becoming invulnerable to attacks from the 3D world. This dimensional control also lets him trap opponents in a 2D state, fold them into paper, or act unnoticed so that his powers appear instantaneous. Remarkably, he can still interact with both dimensions simultaneously, such as opening doors or handling objects while in 2D. Beyond dimensional travel, Hero X can teleport across great distances, manipulate matter and energy while in 2D, and transform or repurpose objects with ease. His feats include turning a car into a sword, and even manifesting objects from images. He also displays uncanny precision in trickshots and is seemingly able to manipulate probability itself. Finally, it's unclear how deep his control over dimensions truly goes, as he has demonstrated the ability to enter the 4th dimension, granting him the power to travel through and alter time.
objects.title: X (To Be Hero X)

objects.text:
Name: Cyan
Alias: Lucky Cyan
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Feminine
Sex: Female
Age: 21

Power: Like all heroes from To Be Hero X, Lucky Cyan gains her powers through public faith, also known as Trust—and the more Trust she receives, the stronger she becomes. The public’s faith grants her numerous abilities, including a superhuman physiology that grows in strength proportionally to the Trust she accumulates.

Cyan’s primary ability is her supernatural luck: she maintains a 100% win rate in games of chance, never misses a target, is guaranteed success in any goal that is even remotely possible, can cure diseases, and once survived a plane crash unharmed as a baby. She can also bless others with her supernatural good fortune, even with nothing more than a touch.

Outside her powers, Cyan is a very talented singer—composing her own songs and rising quickly as a star performer despite her young age—and she is also a highly skilled skater.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Professional Hero and Singer
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Cyan (To Be Hero X)

objects.text: Alias: The Commoner Age: 21 Gender: Male Background A former employee of the advertising agency that produced commercials for Nice and Xiao Yueqing, Lin Ling was forced to assume the identity of Nice after the hero committed suicide. However, in order to protect those he cared about, he eventually became a true hero in his own right. Realizing that he was not Nice, Lin Ling developed his own hero persona, The Commoner, and went on to become the tenth-ranked hero. Powers Like all heroes from To Be Hero X, Lin Ling gains his powers through public faith, also known as Trust—and the more Trust he receives, the stronger he becomes. The public’s faith grants him numerous abilities, including a superhuman physiology that grows in proportion to the Trust he accumulates. Lin Ling’s enhanced physiology grants him the strength to lift several hundred tons, reflexes sharp enough to gracefully evade barrages of fast-moving energy projectiles, and the ability to fly at high speeds. Beyond his powers, Lin Ling is skilled in combat, trained in acting, proficient in marketing, and known for his resilience and persistence.
objects.title: Lin Ling (To Be Hero X)

objects.text: Alias: Queen Age: 27 Gender: Female Background Originally a child prodigy who graduated from HAC University at an incredibly young age, Liu Yuwei became famous after publicly criticizing the corrupt hero system and declaring her intention to become the next “X” and change the world. She later became the hero Queen and joined the DOS, but after being defeated by Hero X in the 18th Hero Tournament and failing to achieve her dream, she fell into depression before eventually recovering and rising to become the second-ranked hero. Powers Like all heroes from To Be Hero X, Queen gains her powers through public faith, also known as Trust—and the more Trust she receives, the stronger she becomes. The public’s faith grants her numerous abilities, including a superhuman physiology that grows in strength proportionally to the Trust she accumulates. Queen’s primary ability is to establish a domain and impose rules within it that everyone must obey, even allowing her to alter physics to some extent. This power enables her to set commands such as “stop” or “shield” to halt opponents or block incoming attacks. Within her domain, she can also fly, use limited telekinesis, conjure golden spears ranging from regular size to colossal meteor-like weapons, and unleash devastating beams of golden light from her spear’s tip. Beyond her powers, Queen is highly skilled in combat—particularly with a spear—and exceptionally intelligent, having entered university at twelve and graduated in just two years. However, her rules contain exploitable loopholes: for example, they only affect what lies within her immediate perception, and their influence is confined to the boundaries she sets. Furthermore, Queen is exceedingly proud and places absolute trust only in her own abilities.
objects.title: Liu Yuwei (To Be Hero X)

objects.text:
Alias: The Monster, Fire-Breather
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Teenager (approximately 15–16 at time of death)
Power: Gugu possesses superhuman strength developed through years of labor and physical training. Following an experimental procedure by Booze Man, he has an internal alcohol sac that enables him to breathe fire. Eventually, Booze Man gifted him a custom-built helmet that, when closed, ignites gunpowder capsules at the nose, allowing Gugu to unleash controlled bursts of flame—provided he has alcohol in his system. In addition to his fire-breathing ability, Gugu is a durable and determined hand-to-hand fighter who can withstand and recover from brutal damage.
Appearance: Disfigured
Civilian Identity: Assistant and adoptive son of Booze Man
Quality of Life: Average (born into hardship, but found love and belonging later in life)
objects.title: Gugu (To Your Eternity)

objects.text:
Alias: None
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Early 30s (exact age not specified)
Power: A master combatant with elite-level skill in archery, throwing knives, and melee weapons. Her physical condition is near-superhuman—capable of deflecting arrows mid-flight and overpowering supernatural threats like Nokkers. Beyond death, Hayase possesses a rare spiritual persistence, allowing her will and personality to reincarnate directly into her descendants every other generation, subtly shaping them with her personality traits, despite lacking conscious memory of their origin.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Former soldier and later Nokker cult leader
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Hayase (To Your Eternity)

objects.text:
Alias: None
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Late teens to early 20s
Power: Parona is a skilled archer with precise aim, though limited by physical strength when using heavier bows. She excels at improvisation, able to craft functional weapons like spears and bows from everyday materials. Despite lacking formal training, she is a capable hand-to-hand combatant, having disabled multiple guards with swift, calculated strikes. Parona is also highly athletic—able to scale buildings, flee across long distances without tiring, and survive falls with agile rolls.
Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Former villager of Ninannah
Quality of Life: Bad (raised under a cruel sacrificial system, later lived as an outlaw)
objects.title: Parona (To Your Eternity)

objects.text:
Alias: Rabbit

Gender: Female
Age: 17

Power: Touka is an ukaku-type ghoul. While more frail than other types of ghouls, she makes up for it by being faster than any other ghoul type. Her speed is fast enough to dodge bullets, and her kagune manifests as a single wing which can be hardened at will and can even fire parts of it as projectiles. While frail by ghoul standards, she is still several times stronger and more durable than a human, with superhuman senses and the ability to rapidly regenerate so long as she is not starved.

Do note that as a ghoul, she can only subsist off of human flesh and coffee.

Appearance: Beautiful

Quality of Life: Bad (Hunted by CCG, younger brother is a terrorist)
objects.title: Touka Kirishima (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text: Alias: Eyepatch, Centipede, the Black Reaper, the One-Eyed King Gender: Male Age: Late 20s Background A victim of tragic circumstances, a rogue Ghoul, a Ghoul Investigator, and a Revolutionary, Kaneki has taken many reinventions and mental shifts since he stopped being his normal university student, with Hideyoshi Nagachika as the only friend in his life. After being put through the wringer by the world, losing friends, finding hope, and finding love amidst this tragedy, he’s currently getting used to a world where Ghouls and Humans coexist with family and friends looking out for him. Powers After being transplanted with Rize’s organs, his physiology becomes that of the mysterious One-Eyed Ghoul, a hybrid Ghoul that, due to hybrid vigor, is said to demonstrate far more potential compared to a natural-born Ghoul. Apart from his immense physicality, potent regeneration, Rinkaku Kagune, and talented combat prowess, able to contend with Kishou Arima and the One-Eyed Owl on even footing. At the height of his power, he can shape his Kagune and Kakuja to different constructs, even speak through them, mimic other Kagune characteristics, etc. Note: You can also choose Kaneki at any point in his journey.
objects.title: Ken Kaneki (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text:
Alias: Lady Croft
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 24

Power: Lara Croft is an extraordinary survivalist and adventurer, possessing a unique combination of intelligence, physical prowess, and unbreakable determination. She has undergone extreme physical training and real-world survival experiences, making her a master in hand-to-hand combat, archery, firearms, and makeshift weaponry. She is highly skilled in climbing, parkour, stealth, and environmental adaptability, allowing her to navigate treacherous terrain, solve complex puzzles, and fight off both armed mercenaries and supernatural threats.

Lara has an incredible pain tolerance and survival instinct, allowing her to endure injuries that would incapacitate most people. Her resourcefulness lets her craft makeshift weapons and tools on the fly, including Molotovs, explosives, and healing supplies from natural resources.

Additionally, she has extensive knowledge of archaeology, history, and ancient languages, making her an expert in deciphering forgotten texts, understanding ancient civilizations, and uncovering hidden secrets.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Archaeologist, Adventurer, Heiress to the Croft Family Estate
Quality of Life: Mixed
objects.title: Lara Croft (Tomb Raider Reboot Series)

objects.text:
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 15-17 Physically (Ages with time, but each regeneration resets her age.)

Power: Tomie possesses regeneration and adaptive abilities. As long as some small part of her survives, this part will eventually regenerate into a new Tomie body, with all the memories up to the point of death intact. This is so potent that she can regrow from the ash that is left after burning three of her fingers. Multiple parts will independently grow into new Tomies, and they share a mental connection, allowing them to coordinate with each other, although each retains a distinct, independent mind.

When she regenerates, she can also adapt to her surroundings. For example, regenerating at the bottom of the lake granted her the ability to breathe underwater and sprout tentacles to swim faster, regenerating from being burnt gave her resistance to fire, and so on. If her flesh gets implanted into other living beings, the results vary, from horrible flesh chimaeras to having the person implanted being completely taken over and turned into another Tomie clone.

She also possesses an array of more esoteric properties and abilities. Any photo or painting of her displays her twisted true appearance, and implanting even small parts into someone allows Tomie to telepathically converse with them.

Appearance: Beautiful

Quality of Life: Horrible (Consciously or unconsciously manipulates people into killing her in the most brutal ways. With people later insisting they acted under supernatural influence).

Note: You will be immune to any possible supernatural compulsion that drives others to become obsessed and later kill Tomie, but she still possesses her bratty and manipulative personality.
objects.title: Tomie (Tomie)

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appears ~20
Power: Sakuya possesses time manipulation abilities, allowing her to slow, accelerate, or completely stop time within a radius. She can also use her powers to enhance her reflexes and perception to inhuman levels, making her a deadly combatant. Additionally, she wields precision-crafted throwing knives, which she can manipulate mid-flight with remarkable skill.

Appearance: Elegant and well-dressed, Sakuya is always seen in a pristine maid outfit with silver hair and striking blue eyes that exude calm authority.

Civilian Identity: Personal assistant or head maid to a Vampire family.

Quality of Life: High (Respected, Trusted, and Known for Excellence).

Warning: Sakuya’s time manipulation abilities make her dangerous in direct combat. Her sense of duty is absolute, and she values loyalty above all else. However, her rigid adherence to duty can lead to conflicts in chaotic or morally ambiguous situations.
objects.title: Sakuya Izayoi (Touhou Project)

objects.text: Allignment: ??? Sex: Female Age: Unknown Quality of Life: Unknown Appearance: Beautiful Personality: She has a negative mindset as she has always been a nobody and an unknown person when she's around other people. Abilities: Being a Kirin (maybe). Notes: A secret character that has never appeared in Gensoukyou or any neighboring world, and had only been dug out from the fiery pits of the game data during the Scarlet Mist incident. Rin in japanese stands for Kirin, and also, her name is Satsuki Rin
objects.title: Satsuki Rin (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
Titles: Shrine Maiden who Protects Dream and Tradition, Eternal Shrine Maiden, Shrine Maiden of Paradise
Allignment: Neutral Good
Sex: Female
Age: 10-35
Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Good

Personality: Contrary to popular view, Reimu is in fact not lazy and is actually quite diligent in her duties and work, and puts a lot of effort into sustaining the Great Hakurei Barrier and maintaining the peace in Gensokyo. Reimu is often laidback and relaxed, and is perfectly content living her life as is.

Abilities: Hakurei Reimu has innate ability to 'float', the abilities of the Hakurei shrine maiden, and the ability to manipulate the natural spirits of living things. Her ability to 'float' allows her to 'float' above reality, isolated in her own ideal world, freeing her from the hardships of life, and allowing her to resolve incidents with happy endings. When fighting, she can summon ofuda, as well as Yin-Yang orbs, both of which can act as homing projectiles and also possess a wide variety of other effects. She can also summon gods into her body to borrow their abilities, however, she is insufficiently trained at this technique, resulting in it not being very effective in fights.
objects.title: Reimu Hakurei (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
Title: Ordinary Witch
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Sex: Female
Age: 10-35
Likes: Magic, Magical Knowledge
Dislikes: <s>Fake Magicians</s>
Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Life Has Its Ups and Downs

Background: In the past, Marisa had a deep conflict with her father, who strongly opposed her pursuit of magic. He went as far as burning books on the subject to prevent her from learning, ultimately driving her to cut ties with him. Her initial motivation for studying magic stemmed from a desire to be special—special enough to be acknowledged by other extraordinary individuals. When she failed and had to rely on others for help, she excused herself that she was only human. 

As a child, her greatest dream was to use magic to fly, as if she were in love with magic itself. However, as she grew older, magic became more than just a dream—it became proof of her uniqueness, a burden she carried, a mark that set her apart from ordinary people. This mindset pushed her to work relentlessly, to the point of developing anxiety. Because of this, she was offended by fake magicians—those who gain magical power effortlessly.

Personality: Marisa is hardworking, persistent, and stubborn, dedicating herself fully to the study of magic. She is willing to take dangerous risks in pursuit of mastery, refusing to abandon her childhood dreams, her willfulness, and her true self—the person she believes she is meant to become. Despite this, she remains self-conscious about her origins, often comparing herself to those born with innate magical abilities, causing her to feel inferior.

Abilities: Marisa specializes in Star Magic, a form of light and heat-based magic. However, she is also proficient in fire, water, and earth magic—though she rarely uses them out of personal preference. In fact, she has a stronger natural affinity for water magic than for star magic.

She has also mastered the magic of “Abandon Food” and has dedicated extensive time to researching the flora and fungi of the Forest of Magic. Through this research, she has created various magical items using mushrooms. Beyond that, she has developed expertise in the effects of plants and fungi, not only in magical applications but also in practical, non-magical uses.

Marisa primarily draws power from the magic stored within herself. However, she is also capable of harnessing ambient magic, drawing energy and spirit from her surroundings. Additionally, she can close off her pressure points to concentrate her energy, allowing her to cast powerful spells with minimal expenditure. She has refined this technique to separate and store her magic in portions, enabling her to save and release magical energy as needed.
objects.title: Marisa Kirisame (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown (Appears Early 20s)

A brilliant magician and master of puppet-based magic, Alice Margatroid wields immense magical knowledge and precise control over autonomous enchanted dolls. She specializes in grimoire-enhanced spellcraft, using her puppets for combat, support, and tactical maneuvers while maintaining complete battlefield awareness. Though powerful in her own right, she prefers strategy and coordination over direct confrontation.

Alice is an intelligent and meticulous tactician, capable of managing multiple puppets in perfect synchronization. She excels in layered spellcasting, enchantment, and magical engineering, making her highly versatile both in and out of battle. As a researcher and artificer, she possesses vast knowledge of construct creation and advanced magic theory, constantly refining her craft.

Appearance: A dignified young woman with golden hair and bright blue eyes, dressed in an elegant blue and white dress accented with red ribbons. She is often accompanied by a set of floating, intricately crafted dolls, each moving with inhuman precision.

Civilian Identity: A reclusive scholar and expert in magical constructs, Alice dedicates her time to research, spellcraft, and perfecting her enchanted dolls. Though introverted and somewhat distant, she values companionship in her own quiet way.

Quality of Life: Moderate (Highly Capable, Intellectual, but Socially Reserved).
objects.title: Alice Margatroid (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Age: Unknown (appears early 20s, ageless due to divine infusion)

Power:
Utsuho Reiuji, also known as Okuu, is a Hell Raven who got the divine spirit Yatagarasu integrated on her by the goddess Kanako Yasaka. This fusion turned her into a living incarnation of nuclear fusion, with her body housing the essence of the sun god. As such, Utsuho became a de facto branch shrine to Yatagarasu.

She wields immense heat and gravitational power comparable to the sun, capable of launching miniature stars and collapsing spatial energy through focused gravity spells. Her right arm contains a control rod used to stabilize her output, while her "leg of fission" (left) and "the leg of fusion" (right), gives her control over nuclear phenomena and The Red Sun Eye on the chest allows perception of nuclear energy. Although she can manipulate temperatures rivaling stellar cores and produce vast destructive energy, she still requires nuclear fuel, meaning her energy is not truly infinite.

Her abilities also extend to flight, direct control of nuclear reactions, and limited gravitational manipulation. However, due to her simplistic mindset, her use of these divine-level powers is straightforward and lacks nuance—an intentional trait, as those less intellectually burdened can wield this volatile force more safely.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Former pet of Satori Komeiji
Quality of Life: Has it up's and down's (While not requiring much for daily life, her divine infusion has altered her physiology, mind, and behavior in ways she does not fully understand as her grip on abstract reasoning is limited).
objects.title: Utsuho Reiuji (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
Alias: Po Bidau Princess
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Real age unknown; appears to be in her 20s

Power: Highly skilled in Shinsu manipulation and within the top 0.5% of all Rankers within the Tower. Her Shinsu can be both explosive and silent, making it incredibly dangerous and hard to avoid. She has a special Shinsu Quill Pen that can be used to manifest things into reality based on her imagination and ability to articulate them into words. She can use her quill copy techniques and use them in a greater capacity than their template, transform into giant beasts, and manifest a body of Shinsu making her immune to damage. She also has physical abilities to rival other Rankers near her rank without her hax. She is also notably creative.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: High Ranker
Quality of Life: Good to stressful (Has the reputation of being a psychopath; is a bookworm and gets stressed when people ruin her books or get in the way of enjoying books)
objects.title: Po Bidau Tiara (Tower of God)

objects.text: Alias: N/A Age: 45(?) Gender: Male Background The full extent of Old Man Henderson's history before he got high and forgot he sold his garden gnomes is unknown, this on account of 'The Backstory of Doom'. After the fact he fought against a cult worshipping Eldritch Gods, managing to make it through some truly outrageous situations, like smoking a blunt made from the Necronomicon, or dropping a yacht on a bunch of cultists. This eventually led to him becoming Hastur's true enemy, before he managed to end The Great Old One at the cost of his own existence. He later made a deal with Nyarloteph, leading him to be revived alongside Hastur, before evading the other Outer God by screwing off into a dimension he can't touch them. Powers 'The Backstory of Doom' means Old Man Henderson can retroactively have skills as needed. His innate madness and willpower stop him from being driven insane by outside sources. As Hastur's true enemy, Old Man Henderson can summon the Great Old One by chanting their name three times.
objects.title: Old Man Henderson (Trail of Cthulhu)

objects.text: Aliases: Orion Pax, The Last Prime, Age: Millions of years old Gender: Cybertronian Background Orion Pax almost always begins as an alchemist of some sort in Iacon, a city in the northern hemisphere of Cybertron. Despite these humble origins, he is selected by the god Primus to be a ‘Prime’, bestowed the Matrix of Leadership to be the leader by divine right of his species. Following this, Prime spends much of his life embroiled in a million-year civil war that only begins to close when the species is rendered near extinct. In almost all cases this war only ends after the Cybertronians under his command discover Earth and the life there, vowing to protect it. Powers Prime rarely has explicit powers outside of the norm of his species. He’s a capable combatant, tactician, and strategist with a million years experience. On top of that, as leader by divine right, he’s almost always destined to win the war he’s a part of, and has a divinely backed seal of approval on the content of his character. As a cybertronian, he can transform into a vehicle-mode at will, of which he usually selects large and imposing vehicles like semi-trucks.
objects.title: Optimus Prime (Transformers)

objects.text: Age: Millions of years old Gender: Female Background Arcee has almost always been fighting since the start of the start of the Cybertronian civil war. Due to this she’s never been able to actually settle down and stop fighting and think. She’s generally good natured if hot-headed and incredibly violent. Depending on the continuity, she often chooses to be considered a woman upon coming to earth, or is otherwise separated out as ‘female’ despite Cybertronians lacking most of a concept of gender. Powers As well as being a soldier with a million years of experience, Arcee is a cybertronian, and can take on a vehicle-mode to increase her mobility. This is often something fast and small, ranging from sports cars to motorcycles.
objects.title: Arcee (Transformers)

objects.text: Aliases: Bee, B-127 Age: Millions of years old Gender: Cybertronian Background Usually born before the war, Bee is almost always a scout, and is also one of the first to make contact with humans when the war makes its way over to that mossy rock. Powers As well as being a soldier with a million years of experience, Bee is a cybertronian, and can take on a vehicle-mode to increase his mobility. This is often something fast and small owing to his job as a scout, ranging from sports cars to a VW Beetle.
objects.title: Bumblebee (Transformers)

objects.text: Age: Millions of years old Gender: Cybertronian Background Ratchet was a medic before the war and a medic he remained all through it. Often crotchety and stern, it’s his duty to keep the autobots functional and in fighting health, much to his chagrin. Powers Ratchet is a skilled medic and ‘mechanic’ as well as being a cybertronian. As such he can take on a vehicle-mode to increase his mobility. This is often an ambulance, or something else able to transport the injured with him.
objects.title: Ratchet (Transformers)

objects.text: Age: Millions of years old Gender: Cybertronian Background Leader of the ‘Decepticons’, Megatron’s uprising is often justified, if not pure of heart. Many times he was a miner in the bowels of Cybertron before inspiring an uprising among his fellows, and founding a movement that would go on to cause a million year civil war within his species. Powers Megatron is an incredible warrior, tactician and strategist, capable of administrating a million year-long war and oftentimes pulling ahead of the other factions involved. Additionally, as a cybertronian, he can take on a vehicle-mode, though like most Decepticons he prefers to enhance these with military ordinance like tanks, jets and handguns.
objects.title: Megatron (Transformers)

objects.text: Aliases: Ulchtar Age: Millions of years old Gender: Cybertronian Background Starscream is leader of the Seekers and Megatron’s right hand man. In almost every continuity he’s scheming to become the leader of the Decepticons, though this very rarely works. Powers Starscreem is a schemer and a tactical mind, if one is preoccupied with its own greatness. Additionally, as a cybertronian, he can take on a vehicle-mode, though like most Decepticons he military vehicles, specifically jets and other high-speed flight alt-modes.
objects.title: Starscream (Transformers)

objects.text: Age: Millions of years old Gender: Cybertronian Background Shockwave is the head of the Decepiticon scientific corps. Utterly removed from morality, his only concerns are of scientific curiosity and the success of the Decepticon cause (because they will allow him to sate that curiosity to a far greater extent than the opposition). He’s guilty of torture, vivisection, experementation on living subjects and multiple genocides. Though he is a Cybertronian, he rarely uses his alt-mode, which like most Decepticon is often military in origin, preferring to remain in his lab or another tactical position where it is not required.
