objects.text: Age: 18 Gender: Female Background She was born as the culmination of the Ryougi family's efforts to birth a child with the Origin of 「　」, the Root. She had three personalities: a female one, Shiki, who lives her everday life; a male one, SHIKI, who embodied her murderous impulses and ultimately sacrificed himself to save her; and her "true self" in a way,「Shiki Ryougi」, who represents her connection to 「　」. In order to somehow bring back SHIKI and train her Mystic Eyes, she came to work under Touko Aozaki's contract agency Garan no Dou. Powers She possesses the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, which allows her to see the "lines" and "points" of death in all things, even the undying or immaterial. By tracing or piercing these lines, she can kill anything, even things that only exist in the abstract. Born into a Demon Hunter family, she possesses superhuman abilities that allows her to endure extreme pain and disfigurement as if it's nothing while moving and reacting at supersonic speeds. Her swordsmanship is refined enough to earn her the title of Sword Saint, enabling her to rival even Heroic Servants and strike directly at the soul, even without her Mystic Eyes. 「Shiki Ryougi」is connected to the Root and can be considered the closest thing to a representative or avatar it can have. Through that connection, she can effectively do anything with near-limitless capability, provided she finally chooses to step out of dormancy and actually wants to do it.
objects.title: Ryougi Shiki (Type-Moon)

objects.text: True Name: Nanaya Shiki Alignment: True Unknown Gender: Male Sex: Male Age: ~17 Power: Within Shiki dwell two distinct personas: Tohno Shiki,an ordinary high schooler with no memory of his origins, and Nanaya Shiki, a ruthless assassin shaped by early life in the Nanaya demon-hunting clan. Though his memories were sealed through hypnosis, the deadly instincts and techniques of the Nanaya remain etched into his body, surfacing in moments of crisis. A natural prodigy, Shiki is said to surpass even his father in talent, Nanaya Kiri—the clan's head and the most feared hunter in the history of the Demon Hunter Organization. Trained from childhood, he possesses peak human physicality, masterful knife skills, and an instinctive grasp of the Nanaya Assassination Arts. Later, as Tohno Shiki, refining his instincts under Aoko Aozaki, learning martial arts from her. In battle, Shiki fights with precision, agility, and patience. He relies on speed and evasion to survive, observing his opponent carefully and striking only when the moment is right. While physically limited by human endurance, he becomes exponentially more dangerous when pushed near death. The Nanaya persona reawakens, transforming him into a relentless predator. His movements become inhuman—spiderlike dashes across walls and ceilings, blinding bursts of speed, afterimages flickering in his wake. He overwhelms his enemies with disorienting agility and lightning-fast strikes, wielding the clan's signature Flash Sheath techniques with deadly precision. Even when gravely injured, he continues fighting through sheer willpower, giving the illusion of defying death until his target is eliminated. Regardless of which persona is dominant, Shiki wields the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, allowing him to see the "lines" and "points" of death in all things. By tracing or piercing them, he can kill anything—be it physical, spiritual, conceptual, or abstract. Even the undying and immaterial are not beyond his reach. Appearance: Handsome Civilian Identity: "Ordinary" high schooler Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups and Downs Note: Shiki also possess "particular" urges while near those of supernatural or inhuman origins. addons.text:
The fae that once resided within your arm is supplanted by Morgan le Fay, a figure of tragedy. Once a powerful fairy sorceress and ruler of her kingdom, Morgan has declared you her beloved, binding your fate to hers in a manner that transcends mere affection.

However, do not succumb to complacency; the adoration she has is tinged with an undercurrent of obsession. Morgan's fixation on you may initially seem like tender devotion, but beneath the surface lies a complexity rooted in her long history of loss. Having ruled over a realm that ultimately fell into ruins, she bears the weight of millennia on her shoulders, and her happiness has become deeply intertwined with your existence. While her promises of protection and loyalty may appear sincere, it is essential to recognize that such an attachment can become a double-edged sword. Being the source of a witch's obsession can be just as much a curse as it is a blessing.

Through Morgan's replacement of the fae within your arm, she has enhanced the power bestowed upon you and significantly amplified the abilities granted by the Black Crown. She is eager to teach you the magic she has dedicated so much time to perfecting. Additionally, she can manifest her spirit outside of your arm.

Quality of Life: Bad (Her husband died while trying to prevent a war, an event that drove her to—start a war—spending 20 years relentlessly pursuing vengeance against his killers—one of whom was her own brother.)
objects.title: Kriemhild (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Brynhildr
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Centuries-old from her time as a Valkyrie, most likely.

Power: As a Servant and former goddess of war, Brynhildr possesses exceptional combat experience and expertise. During her time as a Valkyrie, she observed, recorded, and internalized the techniques of countless warriors, refining her skills to near perfection. This has made her an extraordinary hand-to-hand combatant, capable of delivering strikes with such ferocious speed and precision that even Arthur Pendragon struggled to follow her movements. However, her tendency to rely on repeating attack patterns can render her predictable if her opponent endures her initial assault.

Brynhildr's power increases when facing "true heroes," particularly those reminiscent of her beloved and despised Sigurd, driving her into a frenzy to want to kill them. Beyond her martial prowess, she is also a skilled mage, having been trained in magecraft and runecraft by Odin himself. While she commands the power of the Primordial Runes, her abilities are now limited due to the sealing of her Divinity by her father.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Bad (Driven by heartbreak and betrayal, she killed her beloved husband Sigurd after his treachery and then ended her own life in despair afterward.)
objects.title: Brynhildr (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Siegfried 
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Late 20s to early 30s (?)

Power: Servant Physiology, Siegfried, the legendary hero of the Nibelungenlied and slayer of Fafnir, stands as one of the greatest swordsmen in history, rivaled by few in skill and surpassed by fewer in power. After bathing in the blood of the fel dragon, he gained a near-impervious body that reduces even the mightiest blows to mere scratches and the most fatal attacks to minor wounds. However, he bears on his body a single weak spot on his back in the shape of a linden leaf.

Siegfried wields Balmung, the Holy Sword, which gained the attribute of a dragon-slaying blade after it used to fell the sky demon, Fafnir himself. This act has imbued the blade with a conceptual advantage over all Dragon-Kind, making it a weapon of unparalleled effectiveness against such foes. Comparable in power to the legendary Gram, from which it was derived.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Bad (Died because didn't want wife to start a war, she started one anyway because of his death.)
objects.title: Siegfried (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Sigurd
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Late 20s to early 30s (?)

Power: Servant Physiology, Sigurd, the legendary hero of Norse mythology from the Völsunga Saga and Der Ring des Nibelungen, stands as a counterpart to Siegfried and is renowned for his unparalleled skill, intellect, and power. Known as the slayer of the fel dragon Fafnir, the gifts he gained from this feat differ from those of Siegfried. By consuming Fafnir's heart and blood, Sigurd was bestowed with the dragon's wisdom and strength. These gifts granted him the Crystallization of Wisdom as a bound artifact and a dragon's core, providing him with immense power and an inexhaustible well of magical energy.

Not only was Sigurd a masterful swordsman, but he also excelled as a magus, having learned the secrets of the Primordial Runes from Brynhildr, which he wields to great effect.

Among Sigurd's arsenal is Gram, the Demonic Sword, reforged after being shattered by Odin's spear, Gungnir. Despite its destruction, the sword retained its immense power, taking on a new form—a blade comparable to the legendary Excalibur. After being quenched in Fafnir's blood, Gram gained the special property of a Dragon Slayer, making it a weapon uniquely potent against all Dragon-Kind.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Bad (Was tricked into becoming an amnesiac and was made to betray his beloved before dying at her hands.)
objects.title: Sigurd (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Merlin
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Old

Power: Merlin is a supreme caster—one worthy of the title of Grand, though she has no desire to claim it. Unlike her male counterpart, she aligns more closely with the Beast class—a fitting fate for a failed Anti-Christ. Capricious, apathetic, and endlessly carefree, she exists solely to amuse herself, incapable of comprehending humanity or others in any way beyond detached objectivity.

In the realm of magecraft, you'll be hard-pressed to find anyone better than her. Renowned as one of the greatest sorceresses in history, her mere appearance on the battlefield can shift the tides of war, capable of crafting grand displays of illusions that blur the lines of reality and perception, controlling the minds of friend and foe alike to simply draining their magical energy with but a glance. This is without even accounting for her unparalleled mastery of magical craftsmanship, allowing her to construct a vast array of mystic codes with nothing more than a wave of her staff.

Furthermore, she possesses clairvoyance on par with Solomon and Gilgamesh, granting her the ability to perceive everything within the universe, as well as distant worldlines and parallel worlds. However, her sight is bound to the present, unable to pierce into the past or future.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: It Has Its Moments (She is very carefree and won't hesitate to do something if she thinks it'll entertain her.)
objects.title: Merlin (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Name: Barghest
Alias: Fairy Knight Gawain
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 417+

Power: Barghest possesses superhuman strength, durability, and speed, ranking among the strongest Servants. She grows stronger by consuming her enemies, inheriting their powers and abilities, and as a Magical Energy-eater, she can drain the life force of those with low Magic Resistance. As the leader of the Black Dogs, she can transform humans into her followers. Her skills include Magic Resistance (Rank C), Mad Enhancement (Rank A+), and Numeral of the Saint (Rank B), which boosts her abilities during the day but hinders her nocturnal nature. Her Wild Rule (Rank C) heals her with each attack while absorbing her opponent’s strength, and Foul Weather (Rank A) creates a protective Fae Domain for allies. Her Noble Phantasm, Black Dog Galatine (Rank A), is an Anti-Army attack using a blazing horn modified into a sword. Unleashing it removes restraints on her power but sacrifices her sense of reason, leaving her driven by primal instincts.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Member of Faerie Britain's Knights of the Round Table
Quality of Life: Bad (Barghest is fated to over time become a Calamity that will destroy the Britain Lostbelt. She is also tormented by a recurring urge to prey on a mate. If this impulse is not resolved promptly, she descends into madness, transforming into a Berserker who indiscriminately slaughters everything in her path. These repeated episodes leave Barghest deeply traumatized.)

Note: You won’t become a target for her predatory urges if you become her mate, as she will never feel the impulse toward you.
objects.title: Barghest (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Name: Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg
Alias: Old Man of the Jewels, Zelretch of the Jewels, Kaleidoscope, The Father of Jewel Magecraft
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Over 1,000 years old

Power: Zelretch is one of the most powerful Magus in existence and one of the few to attain the title of Magician, signifying mastery over a True Magic, a magic beyond magecraft. His dominion is over the Second Magic: Kaleidoscope, an ability that grants him unparalleled control over parallel worlds. Through this mastery, he can observe, traverse, and manipulate alternate realities at will, bending the fabric of existence to his advantage. There is no point in the multiverse beyond his reach—whether in space, time, or possibility itself.

Beyond his command over the Second Magic, Zelretch is also a master of Jewel Magecraft, an ancient and powerful discipline that allows him to store, refine, and unleash immense magical energy through precious gemstones. His expertise gave rise to two legendary creations: the Kaleidosticks, sentient Mystic Codes with vast potential, and the Jeweled Sword Zelretch, a weapon capable of drawing infinite magical energy from countless parallel worlds, allowing its wielder to wield near-limitless energy.

Despite his overwhelming abilities, Zelretch is infamous for his role as a cryptic mentor, offering guidance laced with riddles, cryptic knowledge, and occasional pranks. Although normally very solemn, his mischievous nature and steadfast adherence to morality makes him unpredictable, however none can deny his influence across the multiverse, commonly shaping the fate of countless worlds.

Appearance: Average 
Civilian Identity: The Wizard Marshal - Leader of the Clock Tower, One of the three most powerful magical organizations in the world. 
Quality of Life: Good (Rich, Powerful, Keeping global balance between good and evil)
objects.title: Zelretch (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Titles: Beast of 666, Sodom’s Beast, Enemy of God, Nero Draco
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Chronologically thousands of years old; physically varies by form

Power: As the juvenile form of Beast VI/S, Draco embodies depravity and divine blasphemy, and is a manifestation of the corrupt apex of human civilization. Her power originates from the Seven-Headed Beast of Revelations and the potential of Emperor Nero to become a Beast.

Draco possesses incredible physical strength, able to shatter the battlefield with her bare limbs. Her draconic body parts—arms, legs, and tail—can shift size, shape, and mass, letting her impale, crush, and cleave with terrifying power. She can also fire energy blasts from her fingertips and tail, and manipulate a corrupted Holy Grail filled with black sludge that can attack autonomously or bombard enemies with light-based strikes.

Her Skill Independent Manifestation allows her to exist across all time and space, rendering her immune to temporal paradoxes and death from time-based attacks. Nega-Messiah grants her immunity to blessings from religious faith, and an inherent advantage over savior-type entities, weakening their divine gifts.

As a Beast, she also possesses Authority of the Beast, which protects her from all who are aligned with humanity. Her Noble Phantasm, Babalon Domus Aurea, is a twisted parody of her imperial theater—she traps enemies within a golden hall and then annihilates it, symbolizing a “salvation through despair” as opposed to Nero’s salvation through beauty.

Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Poor (Draco is burdened by her nature as a Beast, the embodiment of humanity’s corruption and rejection of salvation. She exists to observe the fate of the humans who once overthrew her, but can no longer revel in their decay. Though once laughing in depravity, now she remains emotionally torn—still monstrous, but no longer joyful in that monstrosity. She longs silently for redemption through others, but cannot permit herself to express it.)

Note: You may optionally choose to summon Draco in her Geocentric Form. In this form, she appears as a more regal and adult version of herself, wearing a black and red cuirass, long fur coat, and wielding the Aestus Estus: Terminus Fire, a massive reforged sword imbued with end-times flame. Her fiery dragon-headed Bestia Coccinea now fight alongside her, and her personality becomes more refined, balanced between cruelty and love. As the impossible Nero who overcame her cursed destiny, this version of Draco is arrogant yet selfless, cruel yet loving, and willing to walk beside humanity rather than stand above it. However, she demands attention and care—neglect her, and you’ll quickly remember that the heart of a Beast still beats within.
objects.title: Draco (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Name: Medea
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: Highly skilled magus from the Age of the Gods with the ability of High-Speed Divine Words, can manufacture a wide variety of magical items, carries Rule Breaker which can destroy any form of Magecraft.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs
objects.title: Medea (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20 (Stopped physically ageing at 12)
Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Bad (insane due to root connection)
Civilian Identity: Magus

Power: Manaka is a superhuman magus who is proficient in every magecraft in the entire world, with talent that surpasses even the magi from the Age Of Gods. While her magic circuits are lacking in quantity, their quality is beyond measurement and their composition is an abnormal, never before seen precedent.

Manaka was born with a connection to The Root, and as such is effectively a nigh omniscient and omnipotent magus, only limited by the output of her magic circuits.

She could undo the last 1500 years and establish an Eternal Camelot, she just does not have the energy output needed to challenge the quantum time-lock to maintain it as the counterforce would just undo it. In a world without a quantum time lock equivalent or something similar this is no longer something beyond her power.

Despite this she is still physically a 12 year old girl without superhuman physical attributes.

Note: If you choose her she will be as obsessed with you as she was with Prototype Arthur Pendragon. she can become incredibly jealous and while she will act innocently she is a monster at heart, potentially driving her to kill her sister because she talks with you.

In addition, without blank or other means to prevent her from reading your mind, she will read your mind and work towards ensuring your dreams are achieved regardless of consequences or collateral damage.
objects.title: Manaka Sajyou (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Also Known as: Universal Genius, Da Vinci-chan
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Sex: Female 
Gender: Female
Age: Mid 30s (?)

Powers: Heroic Spirit Physiology, Natural Born Genius, Master of Magecraft. Can create artificial bodies to house her spirit if her original body is destroyed. Performs admirably in combat but excels in the support role and in weapons development. Has a gauntlet which can fire elemental effects out of it.

Has a Noble Phantasm which when activated reflects opposing Noble Phantasms back at the opponent. When the Noble phantasm is weakened, it can fire a magical attack which ignores defences.

Civilian Identity: None 
Quality of Life: Good (No major hang-ups, in a body she admires)
objects.title: Leonardo Da Vinci (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Luviagelita Edelfelt
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ~20

Power: Luviagelita Edelfelt is a prodigious magus, a rare genius of the prestigious Edelfelt lineage, specializing in Jewel Magecraft—a costly but highly versatile form of thaumaturgy. Her refined technique and innate talent have earned her recognition as one of the Clock Tower's brightest rising stars on par with the likes of Rin Tohsaka, one widely seen as a future figure who'll have a hand in leading its hold.

She is also considered a potential successor to the Second Magic alongside Rin Tohsaka—a level of talent that drew the attention of none other than Zelretch himself.

Beyond magecraft, Luvia is also an expert practitioner of the Lancashire-style martial art, an English-origin combat style resembling professional wrestling. This unorthodox but ultimately effective method allows her to stand toe-to-toe with Mage Enforcers in close combat for a decent amount of time—an impressive feat for any magus.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Rich heiress
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Luvia (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Sakura Matou
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ~18

Power: Sakura Matou, once Sakura Tohsaka, was born into the Tohsaka family—a miraculous girl with the potential to rival her sister. She should have soared far above the skies, but instead, she became a dying bird, forsaken and forced to swim, drowning in torment, her talents left to rot, uncultivated. With barely an ounce of formal training, she could, at best, be considered third-rate in her current state.

Yet, if given the chance, Sakura could become a formidable magus, possessing a natural affinity for Imaginary Numbers alongside an instinctive grasp of the Matou family's Absorption attribute. Unfortunately, her deep-seated resentment toward magecraft makes that task a difficult one to accomplish.

But that isn't all she is. She is also the Lesser Grail—a vessel with the latent power to end the world. Should her true nature awaken, she could become a corruptive force of pure malice, a being of ruin, hell-bent on dragging the world she hates so much down with her.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: High school student
Quality of Life: Horrible (Zouken)
objects.title: Sakura Matou (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Tohsaka Rin
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ~20

Power: Heir to the Tohsaka family, Rin is a prodigy in magecraft with an affinity for all five basic elements, specializing in Jewel Magecraft. Her refined technique and innate talent have earned her recognition as one of the Clock Tower's most promising young magi—rivaling that of Luviagelita Edelfelt—one widely seen as a future figure who'll have a hand in leading its hold. She is currently an apprentice studying magecraft under the tutelage of the Wizard Marshal alongside Luviagelita, having even drawn his attention through her talent.

Beyond magecraft, Rin is also a practitioner of Super Bajiquan, having learned the style from Kirei. It's a direct and efficient martial art, focused on ending fights quickly and decisively, allowing her to go toe-to-toe with Mage Enforcers in close combat—an impressive feat for any magus.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Poor College Student
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups And Downs
objects.title: Rin (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Emiya Shirou
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ~20

Power: A third-rate magus with a limited attribute and specialty, the only form of magecraft available to him is his unique version of Projection known as Tracing—a byproduct of his Reality Marble, Unlimited Blade Works: Infinite Creation of Swords. An inner world filled with an untold number of weapons, allowing him to store and replicate any bladed weapon he sees or touches. Through it, he gains complete understanding of a weapon's history, composition, and design—even those adjacent to it—though the farther an object strays from the concept of a sword, the more magical energy is required to manifest it in the real world.

Because of how Tracing works through his Reality Marble, Shirou's projections can persist indefinitely—unless damaged enough to break, in which case they vanish, or if he willingly dismisses them. Though swords are his forte, anything he fully comprehends can be replicated, albeit with reduced efficiency if it's not some form of blade.

In combat, Shirou is a capable fighter, able to match Servants for a time and read the experience of a weapon's past wielders to augment his skill. However, he remains vulnerable against Enforcers, whose tactics specialize in the elimination of magi. He also shows remarkable aptitude with the bow.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: College Student
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups And Downs
objects.title: Shirou (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ~18

Power: A first-rate magus, Illyasviel von Einzbern, was made to be the perfect Master—and the ideal vessel—for the Holy Grail. To that end, much of her body has been converted into Magic Circuits, which also function as her Command Spell. The result of extensive bodily modification and inhumane experimentation. These enhancements, however, came at the price of shortening her lifespan and constant pain.

As the Lesser Grail, Illya possesses an immense reserve of magical energy, enough to sustain a Servant like Heracles entirely on her own without support from the Greater Grail, though doing so places severe strain on her body. Like all Einzberns, her magecraft is rooted in Alchemy, but she is also adept at the creation and deployment of familiars for reconnaissance or combat.

Additionally, Illya possesses the Mystic Eyes of Binding, which allow her to paralyze/bind opponents by injecting her magical energy into their bodies, hijacking their nervous systems and rendering them immobile.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Kid
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups And Downs
objects.title: Illya (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Kotomine Kirei
Alignment: Chaotic Evil (?)
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 37

Power: An executor of the Holy Church and a master martial artist who has spent over a decade hunting magi and the undead. Whilst unable to contend with a Servant in direct combat, he can nonetheless hold his ground against them for a respectable amount of time. His prowess in Super Bajiquan enables him to rip entire trees from the earth with his bare hands, shatter trunks with a flex of his arms, run and maintain speeds of 50 km/h through dense forest foliage, leap ten meters into the air in an instant, etc.

Combined with his use of Baptism Rites and Black Keys, makes him a formidable opponent for most of those he faces. Beyond that, Kirei is also an exceptional Spiritual Doctor—capable of healing others by mending the soul, fixing both spiritual and mental wounds at a bishop level. Able to even surgically graft the arm of a compatible Heroic Spirit onto a living person. Such is his skill that you'd be hard pressed to find anyone of his caliber within this specialty elsewhere.

And as the Church's overseer of the Holy Grail War, he's entrusted with all the leftover Command Seals from past wars. Which he can use to perform magecraft, empower himself, or command any Servant or familiar bound to him.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Priest
Quality of Life: Currently living his best life.
objects.title: Kirei (Type-Moon)

objects.text: True Name: Okita Souji Alignment: True Neutral Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: ~25 (At time of death) Power: Okita Souji is a genius swordswoman and manslayer whose life was tragically cut short by illness—a sickness that still haunts her even as a Servant. Her constitution remains frail, and her Endurance is low, occasionally leading to unpredictable drops in performance. While this curse is manageable, it's not without risk. Thankfully, Okita possesses a Noble Phantasm—Coat of Oaths—which, when worn, grants her a Rank Up in all her Parameters and armaments, helping to counteract the effects of her lingering condition. However, as a more modern Heroic Spirit, Okita suffers from notably low Magic Resistance for a Saber-class Servant. Despite her physical limitations, Okita's skill with the sword is extraordinary. She is fast, precise, and brutally efficient—able to match even Oda Nobunaga in combat. Her instincts are razor-sharp, with an uncanny sixth sense for danger that allows her to read and react to threats in an instant. Her most feared technique, however, is her secret art: Lightness, Three-Stage Thrust. This technique begins with her movement skill, Reduced Earth, which allows her to instantly close the distance between herself and her target in just three steps. In that same breath, she then delivers three simultaneous thrusts at the exact same point in space and time. This move disrupts causality itself—resulting in an unblockable attack that pierces through any defense. She also possesses a second Noble Phantasm: Flag of Sincerity, which allows her to summon the spirits of the Shinsengumi within a certain range of the flag once raised. Though these summoned allies are not in peak condition and lack their own Noble Phantasms, many will answer her call—drawn by their loyalty and admiration for Okita, who remains beloved among the Shinsengumi even in death. Appearance: Beautiful Civilian Identity: None Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups And Downs
objects.title: Okita Souji (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Jeanne d'Arc
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ~19 (Physically)

Power: Jeanne Alter is a powerful Avenger-class Servant, a manifestation of vengeance and rage given form. She wields flames born from hatred to incinerate her enemies until naught, but ash remains. Her Noble Phantasm channels the accumulated grudges of both her own and her surroundings into magical energy to create flames so intense that it rivals the breath of a first-rate dragon. Fueled by wrath alone, she continues to burn even without a Grail or Master to sustain her, so long as her target of vengeance still lives.

In battle, she is a formidable combatant and a capable tactician, able to contend with high-tier Servants on equal footing—and possibly overcome them. Her fury is not without precision, after all.

She also possesses a unique form of Charisma, particularly effective against those of Dragon Kind, compelling them to obey her will without question.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups And Downs (Got burned alive—wasn't very happy about it.)
objects.title: Jeanne Alter (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Name: Melusine
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power:  Superhuman physical characteristics, with speed surpassing 500 km/s, the ability to nullify air resistance, and high levels of aerial agility. Is capable of creating Fairy Sword Arondight out of her skin and magical energy, which is used for the Innocence Arondight Noble Phantasm. Can also create armor through similar methods.

Due to being the Left Hand of Albion, possesses a dragon’s magical core. Can also transform into a smaller version of Albion, allowing her to break the sound barrier in 0.3 seconds, fly faster than Mach 2, and absorb energy from the surrounding atmosphere. Her Noble Phantasm Hollow Heart Albion lets her concentrate energy in her core to release a thermic ray from her mouth with power on par with a Divine Construct.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs (Lived in Faerie Britain, reliant on an abusive narcissistic parent figure for her sense of self, now lives in Chaldea and is developing healthier relationships)
objects.title: Melusine (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Name: Kukulkan
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics, with enough power to knock out Divine Spirits with a single blow, able to run several hundred kilometers in the blink of an eye, and the ability to fly at Mach speeds. Has the ability to manipulate nuclear energy with enough output to destroy Fantasy Trees, which emulate the power of galaxies. Can also manipulate winds into cutting discs and tornadoes, and can manipulate crystal, albeit not to the same extent as ORT, being only able to create constructs. Her skills allow her to resist instant death attacks, emulate the Authorities of the Winged Serpent in other myths, and increase energy acceleration efficiency in the space she occupies.

Her Noble Phantasm Kinich Ahau Impact orallows her to draw power from leylines to assume a form similar to the Luminous Body state of True Ancestors, being akin to a mixture of sun, flame, plant, and mineral. This form possesses an internal pressure of 200 million,  a temperature of 16 million degrees Celsius, and is 160 times denser than water and can be equated to the sun. Can also be used as Last Sun Xibalba, which appears to be a smaller scale representation of ORT’s initial impact that had enough power to burn the entire Pangaea supercontinent for millions of years. 

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs (Lostbelt King of one of the less outwardly horrific Lostbelts, gained sentience in a time of war that her worshippers were losing, had her kingdom razed by ORT and sacrificed her Lostbelt to destroy it, formed a friendship with Chaldea and is working with them to protect humanity alongside her idol Quetzcoatl)

Note: She does not have any connection to ORT if you end up going anywhere in the Nasuverse.
objects.title: Kukulkan (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Name: Baobhan Sith
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power:  Wields the Noble Phantasm Failnaught due to having Tristan’s saint graph. Is capable of causing her shoes to grow blades for kicking attacks. Can grow and shoot spikes from her body. Is a powerful albeit unskilled user of magecraft, capable of manipulating blood, releasing magic bullets, and increasing her speed through an arcana known as Grimalkin. Is capable of sucking blood akin to a vampire, but dislikes using this ability.

Her Noble Phantasm, Fetch Failnaught, allows her to use magecraft to create a double from a target’s flesh, and curse the target to death via killing the double. This can bypass durability.


Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs (Lived in Faerie Britain, traumatized from multiple mutilations by faeries, had a loving, albeit distant and depressed parental figure in Morgan, ended up being mutilated again and thrown into a pit, now lives in Chaldea and is starting to heal her trauma alongside her fellow Tam Lin and Morgan)

Note:  The magecraft used in Fetch Failnaught would ordinarily rot the user’s soul with each use, but that is no longer the case for Baobhan Sith. If somebody else ends up using said magecraft, they will suffer the usual effects.
objects.title: Baobhan Sith (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Name: Caenis/Caeneus
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: Ambiguous, seems to identify as female
Sex: Female

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics, capable of catching a cannonball from Napoleon and moving at speeds close to the speed of light. Wields a spear and shield with great skill. Has the blessing of Poseidon as the Neptune Blessing Noble Phantasm, which grants her invulnerability to any attack below the output of an Anti-Fortress Noble Phantasm. This also grants her the Sea-Crossing authority that allows her to cross any border, even the ones between Lostbelts. Finally, she has powerful hydrokinesis and electrokinesis through the blessing of Poseidon and her Poseidon Maelstrom Noble Phantasm.

Finally, her third Noble Phantasm Lapithae Caeneus grants her the ability to transform into the "bird with golden wings" that she transformed into upon death, and dealing damage to the enemy by assaulting them while soaring.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: Bad, but getting better (Is still deeply traumatized by Poseidon’s actions, but can still form connections with others based on mutual respect)

Note:  You will have exceptionally high compatibility with her, so you won’t have to worry about her Mad Enhancement kicking in and causing her to attempt to kill you.
objects.title: Caenis (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
These two Objects have been further empowered and have accumulated enough mystery to become Noble Phantasms.

The Knife of Jack the Ripper not only has its base effects increased but now causes eternal damage that cannot be subverted by the likes of prosthesis. Not only that, but the condition of “The target has to be a woman” is removed from Maria the Ripper.

The Phantom of Whitechapel gives Jack a set of shapeshifting clothes that enhance her Noble Phantasm, The Mist. Its acidic mist damages spiritual beings and is lethal for normal people who remain exposed for extended periods of time. The Mist is also now twice as big and can be controlled on a micro and macro level.

The monocle also allows her to detect any Servant with Presence Concealment C+ and below.
addons.title: A Gift…

addons.text: Somehow, Jack the Ripper has become a dual-class Servant of both Assassin and Berserker, gaining their Skills and Noble Phantasm. Not only that, the Noble Phantasm “From Hell's” range has expanded from a radius of 5 km to 10 km.
addons.title: ...From Hell

objects.text:
True Name: ???
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Sex/Gender: Female
Age: ???
Appearance: Scarred
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Bad

Powers: Jack the Ripper possesses superhuman strength, endurance, and extreme speed. She is a Servant of the Assassin Class with Presence Concealment (A+), capable of hiding even from the enhanced senses of other Servants.

Her personal skills include:

Murder on a Misty Night (EX): Allows her to always get the first move on an enemy.

Mental Pollution (C): Grants resistance to mental alterations.

Information Erasure (B): Causes all information about her to disappear the moment a battle ends.

Surgical Procedures (E): Basic medical treatment slightly enhanced with magic.

Noble Phantasms:

Maria the Ripper
Possesses a conceptual advantage over women and can instantly kill a target if three conditions are met:
“It is nighttime”
“The target is a woman”
“The environment is misty”

The Mist
A persistent mist made of sulfuric acid created with magical power. It affects the agility of those inside it. Jack the Ripper can control who is and isn’t affected by the mist.
objects.title: Jack the Ripper (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Shuten-Douj
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Sex/Gender: Female
Age: Biologically: 20–21
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Great

Powers: Shuten-Douji is an Assassin-class Oni Servant with immense Strength and Magical Reserves, and incredible Endurance and Agility. She has Presence Concealment (C) and Divinity (C) as her Class Skills.

Personal Skills:

Intoxicating Aroma of Fruits (A): From Shuten-Douji—be it the tone of voice, a sigh, or even a gaze—any targets without magical protection become drunk.

Oni-Kind Demon (A): Represents that Shuten-Douji is an Oni; acts as a mix of the skills Natural Demon, Monstrous Strength, Charisma, and Mana Burst.

Battle Continuation (A+): Shuten-Douji, in legend, was capable of fighting a prolonged battle against Minamoto-no-Raikou even after having her head chopped off.

Oni’s Head (EX): A further enhanced version of Battle Continuation, specifically for her head, and allowing for speech.

Noble Phantasms:

Multitude of Colors – Providential Oni Poison (B+): A poisonous sake that was originally drunk by Shuten-Douji. By manipulating its concentration, it acts as a debuff or even an outright acid that leaves only bones. It affects the surrounding area, making it capable of destroying an army.

Bone Collector (B): A technique that allows Shuten-Douji to ‘debone’ a person without spilling a drop of blood. This technique is almost always lethal, but Shuten-Douji can optionally leave the target alive—albeit without their bones.
objects.title: Shuten-Douji (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
True Name: Hassan-i-Sabbah
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Female
Age: Unknown, Physically in early 20s

Power: Servant Physiology, highly trained assassin, gifted liar and deceiver, able to shapeshift her appearance at will as long it's close to her natural physique, has A-rank Presence Concealment, master of dagger combat. Her Noble Phantasm, Zabaniya: Delusional Poison Body, makes every part of her body lethally toxic—any contact, however small, results in death.

Civilian Identity: None
Quality Of Life: Bad (Lived as a mindless assassin. She deeply craves human touch and affection, but despairs knowing her poisonous body will always kill those she loves.)

Note: You have the option of becoming completely immune to Serenity’s poison. If you do, her loyalty is almost guaranteed.
objects.title: Hassan Of Serenity (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Also known as: Faker, Heroic Spirit Emiya, Wrought Iron Hero
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male

Power: Heroic Spirit physiology, Reality Marble (Unlimited Blade Works), master of swordplay and tactics, expert in Projection and Reinforcement magecraft, high-level Independent Action, extreme durability and stamina, and the ability to replicate legendary weapons he has personally encountered. Possesses centuries of combat experience.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Miserable (Stuck in a cosmic dead-end job)

Note: you can choose either EMIYA or EMIYA Alter
objects.title: EMIYA (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: One Radiant Thing, Ultimate One of the Oort Cloud
Alignment: None
Gender: N/A
Sex: N/A
Age: Millions of Years

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics, with multiple sources stating that no being born on Earth could defeat it. Despite being a living creature, it doesn't have a concept of death or vital organs, being able to rapidly regenerate from a single cell of its body. 

ORT has demonstrated the power to replicate the abilities of the entities it devours, improve upon them, disassemble any negative effects applied to itself, as well as turn them into strengthening effects.

It's capable of interstellar travel past the speed of light and supersonic movement on solid ground, with Galactica Supercell allowing it to bend space to evade attacks and emit cosmic rays through nuclear fusion, which can reach 1 trillion degrees.

ORT can deploy an ability akin to a reality marble called Crystal Valley, capable of rewriting physical laws to passively transform the area around ORT into an alien crystalline substance. This substance is said to be beautiful yet horrendous and disturbing at the same time, as it makes up the environment ORT lived in on its homeworld.

Appearance: Terrifying

Civilian Identity: N/A

Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs.
(Currently in hibernation in South America since before the Common Era, after accidentally arriving five thousand years too early in preparation for the Promised Time.)

Note: ORT can shift into its ORT Xibalba form if you find a 100-meter-tall giant alien spider a bit inconvenient.
objects.title: ORT (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: King of the Demon Gods, Human Order Correction Ritual, Beast I
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male?
Sex: N/A
Age: Thousands of Years

Power: The Demon King bearing the Logos of Pity, the aggregate form of Solomon's seventy-two Daemons in a hive mind fashion, each of whom has as much magical energy as Kingu, who was using a Holy Grail as their Magical Reactor Core. 

Goetia possesses superhuman physical characteristics and is skilled enough in combat to face a coordinated assault of several powerful Servants at once.

He wields a godlike level of Magecraft, akin to the rank of a Grand Caster, and has several personal and class skills such as Independent Manifestation, Summoning, Nega-Summon, Clairvoyance, Territory Creation, High-Speed Incantation, and Item Construction.

He can also control and negate any and all Magecraft performed by mankind due to the nine rings of Solomon in his possession.

He possesses two Noble Phantasms: Ars Almadel Salomonis, an aggregation of hundreds of millions of beams of light, cast over the satellite orbit and with a size close to that of North America. Each of these lines carries extreme damage values comparable to Excalibur, as well as Ars Paulina, a miniature conceptual universe that exists in the Imaginary Space outside the normal flow of time that continuously revives the 72 Demon God Pillars, making him immortal.

Appearance: Intimidating

Civilian Identity: N/A

Quality of Life: Bad
(Devised a thousand-year-old plan to remake humanity due to their shortcomings, only to fail due to his arrogance.)

Note: This Goetia has grasped the nature of human emotions due to briefly having a finite life after his battle with Chaldea, allowing him to reach an epiphany. Thus, he may assume his Human King Goetia form at will if you wish.
objects.title: Goetia (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: Beast IV, Cath Palug, Primate Murder
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male 
Sex: Male
Age: Hundreds of years 

Power: The juvenile Breed of Calamity bearing the Logos of "Comparison." Despite its unassuming appearance, this cute little fellow bears the characteristic of "ever exceeding the strength of an opponent."

This, in turn, allows him to become stronger over time by resurrecting and becoming immune to previous methods used to kill it, growing into maturity through the conflict that arises among men, feeding upon their envies and regrets.

Fou's skill, Murder of Primates, is counted as one of the strongest because he has absolute murder privilege against Prime species, which grants him a super advantage against them.

Cath Palug also possesses many other undisclosed abilities such as teleportation, keen senses, and creating brief time loops.

Appearance: Cute

Civilian Identity: N/A

Quality of Life: Good
(After being released from the Garden of Avalon by Merlin, who insisted that he seek out "that which is beautiful," he is in good care under Mash and Ritsuka.)

Notes: You are perfectly able to understand what he says.
objects.title: Fou (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: Voyager 1, Little Prince, Pran, The 'Final Servant'
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Around 8 years old physically 

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics: Voyager is a Voyager-class Servant embodying the Voyager 1 Space Probe, gaining a spiritron body equivalent to a human body in order to communicate better with his Master.

Despite being a relatively new Heroic Spirit, Voyager is capable of flight even in space, has keen senses that give him directional and spatial awareness to keep him from ever getting lost, and possesses an exceptional memory, allowing him to remember anything he hears. Even though he has a limited vocabulary, he is versed in various languages.

Among his skills are Voyager of the Stars, a limited version of the skill Pioneer of the Stars; Swing-by, a specialized combat maneuver in which the target's kinetic energy is either taken away or imparted to change their speed beyond the usual limits; Protection of World's End (Space), Independent Navigation, and Contact with Civilization.

His Noble Phantasm, Pale Blue Dot: O' Distant Blue Star, is a faint, tiny light Voyager barely saw when he turned around to look after traveling six billion kilometers. The thoughts of the people who sent him out into the unknown—all of their hopes and dreams for the future—live in that tiny 0.12-pixel photo, contained within his golden record. Representing humanity's hopes and possibilities, it encourages his allies and lowers his enemies' will to fight.

Appearance: Cute

Civilian Identity: N/A

Quality of Life: Good
(A bit clueless sometimes because of his age, but in good care under Erice.)

Notes:  A young boy drifting among the stars... A traveler who, though his heart is youthful, truly understands the meaning of solitude.
objects.title: Voyager (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: Olga, President of Earth, The VII of the End, Alien God
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 22-23 years old physically

Power: The famous Director of CHALDEA, who went through many misfortunes. A specialist in Animusphere Astromancy Magecraft, which focuses on predicting the future and observing the planet.

She became an UnBeast possessing a Saint Graph with Stellar Output. She can manipulate spacetime and gravity, create pseudo black holes, and manipulate tachyons to stop time locally. 

She is also able to create avatars through her Noble Phantasm: Four Elements - The Great Enemy, and also reenact all disasters that have ever befallen Earth through her second Noble Phantasm, Planet Olga Marie.

Appearance: Beautiful 

Civilian Identity: Olga Marie Animusphere 

Quality of Life: Horrible
(Abandoned by her father, self-loathing issues, supposedly killed and then tortured, the universe seems to absolutely hate Olga Marie with a burning passion. She really needs a break.)

Notes: She retains all her memories and powers as an UnBeast, as well as being perfectly healed in body, mind, and soul.
objects.title: U-Olga Marie (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Original Name: Elesia
Gender: Female
Age: 25 Chronologically, Teenager Physically
Appearance: Beautiful

Power: Ciel is an extremely skilled combatant, proficient with nearly all types of weapons and martial arts, and possesses a peak human physique and magical reserves that far outstrip any other magi. When reinforced by magecraft, she can effortlessly hurl multiple tonnes of weight around and move faster than the eye can see.

She also possesses a nigh-absoute immortality that halts her ageing and allows her to regenerate almost instantly from any damage and even revive after death.

Quality of life: Bad (Traumatised, guilt-ridden, and near-suicidal after her actions when she has been possessed by Roa)

Civilian Identity: Member of the Burial Agency

Note: Her connection to Roa has been cut, but she still retains her immortality.
objects.title: Ciel (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: Castor and Pollux, the Gemini Twins.
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Male/Female
Sex: Male/Female
Age: Early twenties physically

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics and Servant Physiology. The Dioscuri are a pair of Saber-class Servants, armed with a sword and shield. Having been trained under the mentorship of Chiron, there are few who can handle their combined efforts in direct combat.

They both possess divinity due to being children of Zeus, Magic Resistance A, Riding B, Mana Burst, and the Guardian of Sea Voyagers skill, which instills people with hope and determination to overcome the challenges facing them.

Their Noble Phantasm allows them to momentarily recover their full power as Divine Spirits, vastly increasing their strength. They may even unleash an attack at light speed at the cost of irreversibly breaking their Saint Graph.

Appearance: Handsome/Beautiful

Civilian Identity: N/A

Quality of Life: Neutral
objects.title: Dioscuri (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: The Last Hero, Beast I: Lost
Alignment: None
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Millions of years (early thirties physically)

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics. Camazotz underwent a transformation in order to defeat ORT, becoming a Beast-class Servant after the sacrifice of all the population in his kingdom to empower him, turning him into an unkillable monster.

Camazotz is a bloodsucking monster. He can drain people and turn them into Dead Apostles, though only at the level of Ghouls, low-tier Familiars. Camazotz can also use Necromancy Magecraft to have dead Spirits possess the cadavers of the Ka'an Human warriors, using both the 100,000,000 souls of the Ka'an people that make up his being, as well as anyone he has ever consumed in his journey.

Camazotz's Imperishability Authority makes him completely unkillable, which allowed him to push past his guilt and defeat ORT after a gruesome battle. It can only be nullified if Camazotz is forced to remember his past. He can change between his true form and humanoid for at will.

Appearance: Handsome/Horrifying 

Civilian Identity: N/A

Quality of Life: Terrible (He had to battle an almost unstoppable Type by himself for an undetermined amount of time. He constantly tries to forget the past and his people, for if he remembers them he will give in to despair.)

(Note: You may choose if he managed to move past his guilt and despair while maintaining his authority, or his canon variation.)
objects.title: Camazotz (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: King Hassan, Grand Assassin, Old Man of the Mountain, Hassan-i Sabbah
Alignment: Lawful Evil 
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Unknown 

Power: Superhuman physical characteristics. As the only Heroic Spirit in existence to have ever qualified for the title of Grand Assassin, it goes without saying that his skills are unrivaled.

With his ability to bring "Death" similar to the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception through his Noble Phantasm, Azrael, he has been shown to be capable of eliminating abstract concepts such as the communication signal between Ritsuka and Mash with Chaldea, and Ereshkigal's alliance with the goddesses opposed to Babylonia.

His Presence Concealment allows him to become undetected and unnoticeable to anyone besides his victim, who always hears the sound of an evening bell tolling. He has immunity to any form of charms, mind attacks, or instant death effects.

Appearance: Terrifying

Civilian Identity: N/A

Quality of Life: N/A
objects.title: First Hassan (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Aliases: Magus Killer Age: 29, 34 at time of death Gender: Male Background Kiritsugu Emiya was raised on a remote island by his father, a magus obsessed with forbidden research. After his father’s experiments destroyed their home, Kiritsugu killed him and was taken in by a mercenary who had been hunting him. Under her guidance, he became a ruthless assassin who targeted other magi. He later married into the Einzbern family and acted as their representative in the Fourth Holy Grail War, pursuing his wish of world peace. Powers Kiritsugu specializes in assassination tactics that combine magecraft with modern weaponry. His signature ability, Time Alter, allows him to manipulate his own personal time to enhance his speed and reaction time. He uses Origin Bullets made from one of his own ribs that can cripple a magus by destroying their magic circuits and magic crest. He is highly cunning and capable of exploiting loopholes in magical contracts.
objects.title: Kiritsugu Emiya (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Alias: Meltlilith, Alter Ego S Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Classified as a High-Servant, she was created from BB by accessing the Moon Cell's Servant Archive and selecting goddesses compatible with Ego from inside of it, reproducing their data, and using it to create Meltryllis as a Composite Divinity of Artemis, Leviathan and Saraswati. Prideful, she considers herself a perfect being and capable of accomplishing everything she sets her mind to. Often, she behaves like some sort of prima donna, with the world being her stage. Besides holding her ballerina skills in high regard, Meltryllis's sense of touch is degraded, particularly in her hands. More specifically, she has almost no sensation in her fingers. This as well as her sadistic "hobby" involving dolls was likely born from her thinking, "I can't sense the presence of others by myself." This has led her to be active in trying to interact with the outside world. Powers Meltryllis is an Alter Ego focused on pure offense, possessing poisonous nectar capable of melting anything, and metal legs able to slice apart all they touch. She has the characteristics of a liquid, as her body is technically fluid, capable of shapeshifting, phasing through physical attacks, or becoming the sea itself if completely matured. She possesses All Drain/Melt Virus, which allows for enemy parameters to be stolen at that time, such as "experience points," "skills," and "capacity." After that, she absorbs, converts, and turns the parameters liquefied by her virus into a part of herself, strengthening her. She technically has the power to manipulate anything that "flows," including natural phenomena like wind or water, and also other things like music, speech, and prose, due to a Hindu Goddess of rivers being one of her components.
objects.title: Meltryllis (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Aliases: Rider, True Rider Age: Physically appears to be 18-20 years old, is likely older mentally Gender: Female Background Hippolyta was born from the union of the god Ares and Otrera, a priestess of Artemis. She would go on to become a priestess of Ares and a queen of Themiskyra, ruling with might and wisdom. Due to the machinations of Hera, she was killed by Heracles, who took her sash to complete his Ninth Labor. Powers Hippolyta is an extremely formidable Servant due to her status as a demigoddess and a powerful warrior, albeit not at the level of Servants like Gilgamesh and Alcides. As the former queen of the Amazons, Hippolyta is naturally a skilled warrior. Her preferred forms of combat are hand to hand, spears, battleaxes, and archery to the point where she could be considered for the Archer class. She is also an extremely skilled horseback rider, to the point that she and her horse Kalion can operate in complete synchronization comparable to a centaur. Aside from Kalion, Hippolyta possesses two Noble Phantasms. Her first Noble Phantasm, Goddess of War, is a sash that contains an abnormal amount of Magical Energy. Hippolyta is able to channel this energy to enhance her Divinity along with her Strength, Endurance, Agility and Mana parameters. When using the sash, she can perform feats like punching someone hard enough to destroy a mountain behind them. She can also use the energy to enhance Kalion to the point where they can ride across boulders in midair, and empower her weapons, performing feats like breaking through multiple shield Noble Phantasms at once and cutting through wind generated by Gulganna’s hurricane. Her second Noble Phantasm Húbrin Anatropón Erinyes is a greataxe strike that has been perfected over generations of Amazons, to the point where it’s been described as having the power to cleave the world in a manner similar to Excalibur.
objects.title: Hippolyta (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alias: François Prelati
Age: 1000+ 
Gender: Female

Background: Born of the Greek Goddess of Madness and Folly, Francesca is half human and nature spirit. She would eventually gain the power of Magecraft and use it in order to explore the world, leaving havoc in her wake.

Under her cutesy tone and childish mannerisms, lies a truly ugly personality. Francesca will cause suffering and despair for her own enjoyment, being an unmatched hedonist; She lives to cause chaos and to make things "interesting", including purposely pushing bitter rivals together or creating things like a corrupt holy grail war. 

Powers: Though she has lost much of her power, Prelati is still an exceptional magus, specialising in Merlin's signature illusion magic. Prelati can, at her peak even fool the laws of the world but it would take preparation to enact this at a large scale. 

Francesca also has a form of immortality. She can implant parts of her magic circuits into children or homunculi all over the world, and upon her death, reincarnate all of her memories, knowledge and magic crest within one of them.
objects.title: Francesca Prelati (Type-Moon)
Ibaraki-Douji (Type-moon)
objects.text: Aliases: Ringleader of Mount Ooe's Oni, Banana Oni Gender: Female Age: 1,000+ Background: Ibaraki-Douji was the true leader of the oni of Mount Ooe, a powerful demon who commanded a formidable band during the Heian period. Though often regarded as Shuten-Douji's subordinate, she actually ruled their forces, maintaining order while her sworn sibling indulged in her pleasures. A fearsome commander and ruthless predator, Ibaraki established a stronghold atop Mount Ooe and led her followers in countless atrocities against Kyoto. Confident in her strength and tactical cunning, she believed her forces could overcome Minamoto no Raikou and her Four Heavenly Kings. Her reign ended when Shuten-Douji, seeking a final encounter with Sakata Kintoki, allowed Raikou and her warriors into their stronghold. The ensuing assault devastated Mount Ooe, leaving Ibaraki as its sole surviving oni. Seeking vengeance, she confronted Watanabe no Tsuna at Rashomon, only to lose an arm. Though Tsuna kept it as a trophy, Ibaraki eventually recovered it and vanished from the Imperial Capital. Her ultimate fate remains unknown, and her death was never confirmed. Despite her reputation, Ibaraki has a childish personality, prone to boasting, pettiness, and an insatiable appetite for sweets. Beneath this temperament lies a genuine sense of responsibility toward her fellow oni and unwavering devotion to Shuten-Douji, whose happiness remains her greatest desire. Powers: Ibaraki-Douji possesses immense physical strength, speed, reflexes, and endurance, allowing her to contend with powerful Heroic Spirits. Her high-ranking oni nature grants her vast magical reserves, supernatural senses, and resistance to physical and magical attacks. She can enhance her strikes with destructive bursts of magical energy. Ibaraki-Douji can also shapeshift with incredible skill, taking on forms ranging from a child to a giant. Ibaraki-Douji is a sharp-witted and fierce commander whose specialty is guerrilla warfare. Her tactical intelligence and ability to lead other oni make her a formidable threat beyond her individual combat prowess. Her Noble Phantasms, Great Grudge of Rashoumon and Great Flame of Mount Ooe, allow her to detach and freely manipulate her right hand and unleash ten consecutive attacks of scorching heat, respectively. She typically combines the two, assaulting her enemies with her independently controlled hand while it’s covered with flames.

objects.title: Angra Mainyu (Type-Moon)
objects.text: Alias: Avenger, All the World's Evil, The Weakest Servant Gender: Male Age: Unknown Background: Angra Mainyu was originally an ordinary villager randomly chosen by his community to become the source of all evil in the world. He was tortured throughout his life, forced to bear every sin and curse imaginable, and eventually died of old age and became a Heroic Spirit. During the Third Holy Grail War, the Einzberns summoned him as the first Avenger-class Servant, believing they had summoned the evil god. In reality, he was the nameless human given the name Angra Mainyu. He was exceptionally weak and quickly defeated, and when absorbed by the Greater Grail, transformed into the genuine embodiment of All the World's Evil and a Beast Candidate. Powers: Angra Mainyu is exceptionally weak by Servant standards, possessing poor physical abilities and little conventional combat power. His greatest strength lies in his nature as All the World's Evil. He possesses instinctive knowledge of the "rules" associated with his existence, making him a Servant specialized for dealing with humans rather than fighting other Heroic Spirits. He possesses the standard Avenger Class Skills: Avenger, Oblivion Correction, and Self-Replenishment (Mana). His personal skills are Tawrich, Zarich, and Annihilation Wish. Tawrich and Zarich represent his personal weapons, and are ritualistic weapons rather than any form of Noble Phantasm. Annihilation Wish allows him to disregard his body's limitations, temporarily increasing his speed infinitely and allowing him to temporarily fight at the level of a first-rate Servant. His Noble Phantasm, Verg Avesta, records wounds inflicted upon him and reflects their pain back onto the attacker, with the effect persisting until his wounds are healed or he dies.

objects.title: Hakuno Kishinami (Type-Moon)
objects.text: Aliases: Master of the Moon, Hakunon Gender: Male/Female Age: 20 Background The protagonist of Fate/EXTRA. A nameless Master who was an amnesiac student passing their time at a school inside SE.RA.PH until they became involved in a Holy Grail War, contracted a Servant while remembering only their own name, and ultimately won the Moon Holy Grail War. Extroverted and active, perhaps because their identity was ambiguous, Hakuno’s concerns are always exteriorized and directed toward others. They themselves do not realize it, but fundamentally they like humans to the point that, even when they were troubled over who they were, they did not avert their eyes from the worries of others. Powers Supernatural charisma, despite being given a servant body, they can act as an independent organism and doesn’t need a mana supply or a keystone to stay in this world due to Independent Manifestation EX. They are experienced practitioners of code cast, an electronic magecraft involving programmable spells. They may also briefly summon their former servants in order to deliver attacks, and as great tactician, using them with great efficacy. As the bearer of the Regalia of the Moon, they have a natural advantage against most servants due to their sheer battle experience, and they are able to briefly call upon the Moon Cell to release an unstoppable attack by using the energy behind the Quantum Time-Locks, which serve as anchoring bands to fixed human history.

Name: V1
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: N/A
Sex:  N/A

Power: Possesses physical capabilities far beyond a human due to artificial physiology. Has enough strength to parry attacks from creatures the size of buildings, and can move faster than bullets. Is fueled by blood, and can use it to repair itself and its weapons in the middle of combat. Has multiple systems dedicated to improving movement, allowing for air dashes, wall jumps, etc. Is an incredible marksman, capable of flawlessly ricocheting gunshots off of multiple coins. Wings function as matter-energy conversion storage system, allowing it to store weapons without weight constraints. Possesses its full arsenal from the game and the skill to make the most of every single weapon.

Appearance: N/A
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: Unknown (Forced to breach into Hell in a desperate attempt to acquire the blood it needs to survive, but doesn’t really express whether it finds its current state of existence to be terrible)

Note: It will consider you an ally, so you don’t need to worry about it attacking you for your blood. This does not apply to others in the general vicinity.
objects.title: V1 (UltraKill)

objects.text: Aliases: The Puppet of Resurrection Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Vatista is an Autonomic Nerve, an ancient biological weapon created to act during the Hollow Night. She awakens when abnormal activity is detected and carries out her role of eliminating threats such as Voids. Despite being a weapon, she operates with a degree of independence in the current era. Her personality is reserved and literal, with limited understanding of human behavior, though she is capable of forming responses and showing restraint. Compared to other units like her, she is somewhat irregular, requiring rest and sustenance to maintain optimal function. Powers Vatista wields FLS (Full Limit System), allowing her to restrict and interfere with the abilities of others. She uses Crimson Wings: Seven Flowers, an external unit that generates and controls high-output energy for beams, projectiles, and area attacks. She is capable of levitation, sustained ranged combat, and precise battlefield control. Her body is highly durable and designed for continuous operation, making her difficult to disable in prolonged engagements.
objects.title: Vatista (Under Night In-Birth)

objects.text:
Villain Name: The Fallen Human
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: ? 
Sex: ?
Age: ?
Power: Determination, Knife skills
Appearance: Androgynous
Civilian Identity: The First Human in the Underground
Quality of Life: Bad (hated humanity, died, sociopath)
objects.title: Chara (Undertale)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Unknown
Sex: Unknown
Age: Unknown, appears to be between 10 and 14
Power: Frisk has the ability to SAVE, LOAD, and RESET. They can set a SAVE point in time and space, which they will automatically return to upon death. They will not truly die unless they will it. Creating a new SAVE point permanently erases the previous one. At any time, Frisk may choose to RESET, sending them back to the moment they were first encountered, along with the knowledge and experiences accumulated across timelines.
Appearance: Androgynous
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Varies

Note: You may choose any alternate version of Frisk from any AU (Alternate Universe).
objects.title: Frisk (Undertale)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Unknown
Power: Sans can manipulate personal gravity, allowing him to alter the direction in which a target experiences gravitational pull. He can make enemies fall sideways into walls, upward into ceilings, or slam them around the battlefield with sudden shifts in orientation.

He also commands a variety of bone-based attacks, which he can launch at high speed or shape into barriers.

In addition, Sans can summon Gaster Blasters—floating, skull-shaped weapons that fire concentrated energy beams with devastating power.

His attacks have a property to them Karma, which causes his attacks to deal greater damage to those who have committed more harm. The more evil the target’s actions, the more punishing the effect.
Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Bad

Note: You may also select any alternate versions of Sans from any AU
objects.title: Sans (Undertale)

objects.text: Aliases: Idunn's Warrior, Idunn's Legion Commander, God of Battles, God of Conquest, God of Meetings Age: 20+ Gender: Male Background The world’s greatest pro gamer in Dark Age, Lee Tae Ho died during an international competition and was brought to Valhalla by the Valkyrie Hildegarde. There, he became a warrior of Valhalla and joined Idun’s legion, gradually gaining real combat experience and increasing the synchronization rate with his Immortal Warrior Saga. Tae Ho was eventually recognized by Cú Chulainn as the successor of Erin and was the one who ensured that Odin survived his foretold fate of being devoured by Fenrir. He went on to tame the dragon Nidhogg, saved Asgard from the giants, rescued Olympus from Nyx, defended the Temple from its enemies, and ultimately brought Ragnarok to an end, becoming the savior of all realms. Powers Lee Tae Ho possesses the Immortal Warrior Saga, which gradually grants him the powers of his game character from Dark Age through a synchronization rate that increases in percentages. This Saga also grants Tae Ho multiple additional Sagas, including one that functions as an inventory. Tae Ho experienced countless battles and near-death encounters as a warrior of Valhalla, granting him more combat experience than figures such as Achilles, Heracles, and Cú Chulainn. He eventually learned to draw the goddess Idun's power in combat, and acquired a piece of Gáe Bolg—eventually collecting them all. He became the inheritor of the dead world Erin, trained under Scáthach, discovered Caliburn, and later evolved it into Excalibur. For his achievements and his unbroken record in battle, he ascended as the God of Battles and Conquest. He was then chosen by Odin as the new ruler of Asgard, gaining even greater power, and was ultimately recognized as the true ruler of Erin by its previous sovereigns. Tae Ho also possesses an unprecedented number of Sagas. These include The Warrior Who Had a Goddess Meet Him, which allows him to summon a clone of any goddess he has met and received a blessing from (and led to him becoming the God of Meetings), and The Hall of Valhalla, which enables him to transform any land into Asgard or Erin, granting buffs to allies and debuffs to enemies. After achieving 100% synchronization with his Immortal Warrior Saga, which grants him all the powers of Kalsted, Tae Ho also obtained every Saga associated with Kalsted. In addition, he wields powers from Erin, such as the Geas and the Sentence of the Milesians, which enhance his weapons. He also possesses multiple divinities, including the power of the God of Light inherited from Lugh. Lastly, Tae Ho commands numerous legendary items, including the weapons of the Knights of the Round Table, the Shield of Achilles, a scabbard crafted by Hephaestus that empowers all his weapons and can slay gods, and the dragon sword Astelone, Kalsted’s primary weapon.
objects.title: Lee Tae Ho (Valhalla Saga)

objects.text: Age: Hundreds of years Gender: Female Background Heda was a Valkyrie of Idun's legion and the daughter of the original Idun and the god Bragi. After the complete destruction of Idun's legion and the deaths of her parents at the beginning of Ragnarök, Heda, now the last surviving Valkyrie of her legion, underwent a forced ceremony that transformed her into the new goddess Idun. However, because she was not mentally stable, the ritual resulted in the creation of a second consciousness within her body. Powers As a Valkyrie, Heda is a goddess with a superhuman physique, eternal youth, and great battle experience. After inheriting the mantle of the Goddess of Life and Youth and awakening a second personality known as Idun, she acquired the ability to manipulate life force, allowing those who draw upon her power to become much harder to kill and to gain strength that rivals that of a god. Heda/Idun can also use this power to heal injuries, and she possesses the knowledge required to cultivate the Golden Apples of Immortality, which grant a great amount of vitality to those who consume them and bestow eternal youth upon mortals. Even mere slices of a golden apple are enough to sustain gods such as Odin and Thor.
objects.title: Heda/Idun (Valhalla Saga)

Power: WALL‑E is a powerhouse of mechanical resilience and ingenuity. His reinforced chassis, hydraulic arms, and compactor grant him strength to compress, lift, carry, push, and throw massive trash cubes and industrial debris. He integrates a retractable laser for precision cutting. He can traverse rugged terrain as well as dig and burrow through dirt in seconds. He has extremely high durability—surviving crushing machinery, lightning strikes, close rocket blasts, vacuum exposure, and intense heat. Equipped with solar panels and long-lasting batteries, WALL‑E operates autonomously for days and self-repairs using scavenged parts. He also exhibits unique intelligence and emotion for a robot, collecting human artifacts, nurturing a plant, recording songs, and forming genuine bonds.
