objects.text:
Alias: Tenno

Gender: Unknown (Varies)

Sex: Unknown (Varies)

Age: Unknown (Possibly hundreds of years old, biologically early teens)

Powers: The Operator is a Void-born warrior and one of the legendary Tenno, survivors of a catastrophic event that granted them immense power. Their abilities stem from their deep connection to the Void, an eldritch and unpredictable force that allows them to manipulate reality itself.

Their primary ability is Transference, enabling them to control Warframes—bio-mechanical exo-armor designed for combat—remotely, making them nearly unstoppable on the battlefield. However, even outside of their Warframes, the Operator is a formidable force. They can generate concentrated Void Beams capable of disintegrating enemies, shift into an untouchable Void Form to evade attacks, and execute Void Dashes to teleport short distances in an instant. Their mastery over the Void also allows them to manifest Void Shields, granting them additional resilience against both physical and supernatural threats.

Through the use of specialized Amp weapons, they can refine and amplify their Void energy, increasing its destructive potential. Additionally, they can harness the teachings of various Focus Schools, allowing them to further customize their abilities for offense, defense, mobility, or support.

Their connection to the Void grants them an unnatural resistance to mind control, corruption, and physical decay, making them effectively ageless. However, this same power alienates them from ordinary existence, trapping them in a cycle of endless war and conflict across the Origin System.

Appearance: Unknown (Varies)

Civilian Identity: None

Quality of Life: Poor
objects.title: The Operator (Warframe)

objects.text: Aliases: The Master of Mankind, The God-Emperor of Man, Revelation, The Anathema, Neoth, and countless others. Sex: Male Age: around 50,000 years Background It is unknown how the Emperor came to be, and several theories attempt to explain his origin. Some believe he was born long before humanity developed written language, created through the voluntary ritual sacrifice of every proto-psyker among early humans. Others argue that he was engineered during the Golden Age of Humanity, a time of unparalleled technological advancement. Following the catastrophic uprising of the Men of Iron and the onset of the Age of Strife, the Emperor came to a pivotal realization: he could no longer remain in the shadows. Determined to guide humanity toward its destined ascension, he resolved to take direct control of its future. This decision marked the beginning of the Great Crusade, a galaxy-spanning campaign to reunite and elevate the scattered remnants of human civilization. Recognizing the immense scale of this endeavor, the Emperor sought commanders of extraordinary strength and intellect to lead his armies. With the aid of the Perpetual Erda and the geneticist Amar Astarte, he created the Primarchs—twenty immortal, demi-god sons, each designed to embody a facet of his vision. However, this grand plan unraveled when his favored son turned against him, allying with his greatest enemies, the Ruinous Powers. This betrayal ignited the Horus Heresy, a devastating civil war that ultimately led to the Emperor’s entombment upon the Golden Throne. and he would Endure for over 10 thousand years, for he saw himself and all of his creations as mere tools for Humanities future. Powers He is the greatest psyker ever born of humanity, perhaps even surpassing those yet to come. As a Perpetual—an immortal subspecies of humanity—he possesses an existence that transcends the normal bounds of life and death. His mind is likewise among the most formidable ever produced, shaped by experiences that stretch back to the Golden Age of Humanity. This immense span of knowledge grants him an understanding of science, technology, and the immaterium so profound that it appears indistinguishable from magic to those who witness it. Among his many abilities and talents, his mastery of psychic disciplines is unparalleled. Of these, his greatest strength lies in divination, allowing him to perceive potential futures and guide his actions with a foresight few could comprehend. This gift, combined with his intellect and immortality, makes him a being of extraordinary power and influence, standing far beyond the limits of ordinary humanity. Note: You may choose whether he remains bound to the Golden Throne, in which case the Throne itself accompanies him. Under these circumstances, he would begin a gradual recovery, and after approximately five years, he would return to the state he was in just before his final confrontation with Horus. Alternatively, he may appear in his TTS interpretation, if that version better suits your preference. no matter what he will view his apearence in Humanities past/future as a possitive thing.
objects.title: The Emperor of Mankind (Warhammer: 40K)

His strength is overwhelming, his forces countless, and his charisma and leadership skills more than enough to lead his army effectively. His presence in the Ork unconscious is felt throughout the galaxy, calling more Orks to his side. Along with his monstrous strength, he possesses a concerning level of Kunnin’, cementing him as one of the best warbosses in Ork history. Occasionally, Ghazghkull receives visions and wisdom from his Gods, leading him into new campaigns and seeking more opponents, for fighting is just as important to an Ork as food is to eat, and grog to drink.

addons.text:
The tension, the stares, the awkward battlefield banter, it’s all real, and it’s official now. No longer a whispered meme in the shadowy corners of the fandom, the Primarch of Ultramar and the Emissary of Ynnead are confirmed as an item, and a happy one at that.

That's right, Guilliman and Yvraine are now in a relationship. This enhances them in several ways. Both gain a boost in psyker power, Ephrael Stern (Warhammer: 40k), Blank (Warhammer: 40k), and can revive from death once per year, so long as the other is still alive.

Yet more astounding, this relationship of theirs has resulted in something thought impossible: biological and reproductive compatibility between the two of them.

That's right, human eldar hybrids are back.

All this because you picked both of them as companions, and someone gave Yvraine a copy of Birds and the Bees and then convinced Guilliman to read her a 3-year-long love poem.

<s>THIS IS NOT FUCKING CANON</s>
addons.title: Ship Sails

objects.text:
Titles: The Blade of Unity, Master of Ultramar, The Avenging Son, The Victorious 
Alignment: Neutral Good
Age: ~400+ Years Old
Gender: Male
Sex: Male

Power: Guilliman is one of the <s>20</s> 18 Primarchs born using The Emperor of Mankind’s gene-seed, granting him the strength, durability, and speed to surpass even the mightiest of Space Marines by a mile. Each Primarch harbored a unique specialization or ability. In Guilliman’s case, this was his proficiency in analyzing and organization, making him one of the best strategists, statesmen, and leaders in the Imperium of Man. Along with his willingness to listen to others and being arguably the most level-headed of the Primarchs, often makes him stand out compared to his brothers.

Guilliman has access to countless powerful weaponry, including the flaming sword used by The Emperor of Mankind during his Great Crusades. Currently, he often uses this sword alongside the Hand of Dominion, a high-quality power fist with a built-in bolter. He dons a heavily modified set of artificer armor called the Armour of Fate, which protects him from even the most powerful of blows, making him an unstoppable force on the battlefield.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Primarch of the Ultramarines, Son of The Emperor of Mankind
Quality of Life: Stressful
objects.title: Roboute Guilliman (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Name: Celestine
Titles: Living Saint, The Holy Light of the Emperor
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown (appears mid-20s to early-30s, but functionally immortal)

Powers: Celestine is less a warrior and more a walking miracle. She can heal from wounds that would kill anyone else, rise again from death, though it does take time to do so, and bring with her an aura of faith that can turn despairing troops into zealots ready to fight to their last breath. She fights with the Ardent Blade, a flaming relic of the Emperor’s light, and a master-crafted bolt pistol, both of which she wields with uncanny skill. Even without her weapons, her strength and speed put her on par with the Emperor’s finest Space Marines, and that’s before the divine protection that seems to hover around her like invisible armor. She is never truly alone, for the Geminae Superia, her two resurrected bodyguards, fight and die at her side again and again, sharing in her miracles and ensuring she is always shielded by loyal steel and faith. Wherever Celestine walks, the impossible becomes merely difficult, and the faithful know they are not abandoned.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Living Saint of the Adepta Sororitas
Quality of Life: Bad
objects.title: Saint Celestine (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Like in If-the-Emperor-had-a-Text-to-Speech-Device, Sanguinius and Celestine are engaged in a relationship. This has resulted in both of them growing stronger in a variety of ways.

Celestine is now physically on par with Sanguinius and shares in his precognition. Further still, her Geminae Superia are both enhanced to be on the same level as the greatest of Sanguinius’ sons, Dante.

Sanguinius, meanwhile, is now able to call upon the power Ephrael Stern (Warhammer: 40k), can rise from the dead once per year so long as Celestine is alive, and has the ability to break fate.
addons.title: Courtship Flight

objects.text:
Name: Sanguinius
Titles: The Great Angel, Angel of Baal, Lord of the Blood Angels
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ~200+ years (at time of death)

Powers: Sanguinius was one of the Emperor’s most gifted sons, and his angelic wings were only the most obvious of his blessings. Like all Primarchs, he possessed strength, speed, and resilience beyond imagining, but his gift for foresight set him apart. He could glimpse possible futures and prepare for them, even if he rarely liked what he saw. His combat skills were legendary, his grace and precision on the battlefield so breathtaking it bordered on the supernatural. Armed with a Blade Encarmine, he could cut down foes who would have crushed lesser Primarchs, and his very presence inspired hope and devotion in all who served under him. Even when weighed down by visions of tragedy, Sanguinius remained noble, selfless, and impossibly charismatic, a shining figure who embodied everything the Imperium could have been.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Primarch of the Blood Angels Legion, Son of the Emperor of Mankind.
Quality of Life: Stressful
objects.title: Sanguinius (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: Alias: Vulkan, The Lord of Drakes, The Hammer of Salvation, The Promethean Fire, The Dragon Age: At least 1,700 years old Gender: Male Background Vulkan was kidnapped by the forces of chaos as a child and sent to the world of Nocturne. Reaching adulthood in mere three years, Vulkan quickly learned and improved his people's metalworking skill, and with his immense strength and intellect, unified the world with him as a leader. Eventually, when his True father came to the world disguised and tested him, the father and son came to respect each other, and together left to unite humanity under the Emperium banner. Milenia passes, and Vulkan still stands kind. An oddity among the Primarchs, Vulkan values all human life, regardless how small and plebeian they might be. His empathetic nature often comes to weigh on him, for while he is loyal to the Empire, he is not blind to the atrocities he had to commit in its name. Powers Vulkan is one of the 20 18 Primarchs born using The Emperor of Mankind’s gene-seed, granting him physical and mental abilities far beyond what a mere baseline mortal could achieve. He can fight for days without rest or sustenance, lift an anvil above his head for half a day without getting tired, identify someone by their footsteps, and much more. On top of that, Vulkan is also a Perpetual. No matter how badly his body is damaged, eventually Vulkan will always regenerate or resurrect, either close to where he died or somewhere else. Vulkan is a master craftsman, able to create masterpieces from mundane means to extremely advanced technology compared to the Empire of Man, with a focus on personal weapons. His intellect goes beyond crafting, as he was able to bring a world stuck with primitive blacksmithing methods to an industrial revolution in a handful of years. Vulkan is an incredible warrior, and comes equipped with all his named gear, such as his warhammers Dawnbringer, and Doomtremor; his personal armor The Draken Scale, and The Furnace's Heart, a gun crafted by one of his own brothers.
objects.title: Vulkan (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: Adventure! It seems Vulkan Perpetuity rubbed on Corvus! While not as strong, Corvax can defy death once a year, returning to pristine condition near Vulcan, and so can Vulkan resurrect near him if he so desires. If less than a year has passed before he dies again however, this ability will fail.
addons.title: Bro Trip!

objects.text: Alias: The Liberator, The Deliverer, The Raven-Lord, Chooser of the Slain and The Shadowed Lord Age: A few thousand years Gender: Male Background Like his brothers Primarchs, Corvus was kidnapped from Earth, still an infant, being sent to the moon of Lycaeus. A penal mining colony, Corvus was rescued and taken care of by its prisoners, despite their meager resources. This selfless decision was repaid years later, as Corvus used his Primarch abilities, and gift for stealth, to lead a revolt and free the moon from its tyrants. That revolt wasn't bloodless however. Many died, and many more died as Corvus bombed the cities that once slaved Lycaeus. Corvus isn't a happy man. A man more sensible than he appears to be, he is plagued by his mistakes from the past, bitter and depressed, and prone to bouts of anger. Despite all this, he is a determined man, steeling himself to achieve any goal or mission he might have. Beyond that, he is capable of caring, treating his subordinates with kindness. Powers Corvus is one of the 20 18 Primarchs born using The Emperor of Mankind’s gene-seed, granting him physical and mental abilities far beyond what a mere baseline mortal could achieve. He can fight for days without rest or sustenance, punch through Space Marine armor, move fast enough that you can only see a blur, have bullet proof skin, and more. Corvus is also blessed with the power to become “invisible”, by making the mind of those who see him to ignore him. Despite being almost three meters tall, Corvus is a master of stealth. Even without the use of his powers, he can move without making a sound and swiftly enough to not be seen. When used in combination with his powers, he can kill swats of enemies in moments without them even realizing it. His planning and sabotage skills, more than his physique, are his greatest weapon. Corvus comes with his personal gear, such as his Raven Talons, the Sable Armour with his jetpack, and a myriad of personal weapons called The Panoply of the Raven Lord.
objects.title: Corvus Corax (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: Aliases: None Age: Unknown Gender: Male Background An enigmatic Aeldari Harlequin Solitaire, and present in the Dark City of Commorragh following the betrayal and capture of the newly raised Rogue Trader of House von Valancius by the Drukhari Haemonculus Tervantias the Archmachinator. Nocturne helped the Rogue Trader and their retinue escape Commorragh after aiding them in reuniting. Nocturne speaks only in riddles. He always makes clear what he is trying to say by gestures if he is not understood, but his dialogue is never obvious. He's affable and mysterious, as befitting a servant of the Laughing God, easily amused and not sharing much of the arrogance of most of his kin. Powers Nocturne is a Harlequin Solitaire, the pinnacle of his faction and capable of duelling Keeper of Secrets or mowing through hosts of lesser warriors through skill alone. Empowered by Cegorach, he has an unspecified and mysterious ability of misdirection and subterfuge that makes him an exceptionally slippery foe. His wargear, therefore, includes the usual armaments one would expect. This includes a dazzling Holo-Suit that transforms him into dazzling blurs of light, a monofilament wire Harlequin's Kiss, a Harlequin's Caress to elegantly match any power weapon & a Flip Belt that enables him to jump and pirouette with preternatural grace.

Powers:

Caine is the first Vampire in World of Darkness, meaning that his vampiric powers and skills are much stronger and more refined than any others. He has mastered every discipline and form of blood magic available in World of Darkness, and can even create entirely new disciplines on a whim if he so wishes.
