objects.text:
Alias: The Life-Binder, Dragonqueen, Aspect of Life, Queen of the Red Dragonflight

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Age: Ancient (Over 20,000 years)

Power: Alexstrasza is one of the five Dragon Aspects created by the Titans, imbued with a portion of the power of Eonar, the titan of life. As the Aspect of Life and Queen of the Red Dragonflight, her domain is all living things, and her abilities reflect divine-scale mastery over biological, regenerative, and restorative phenomena.

She possesses the ability to incinerate undead corruption with sacred flame, purify landscapes, resurrect beings with her breath, and even regrow entire forests. Her fire is both healing and destructive—capable of turning barren land fertile or obliterating legions of enemies. She can fly across continents, take on a beautiful high-elven form, and wields the wisdom of a timeless protector of the world.

Her magical power is on par with cosmic-tier entities. Her draconic physiology grants her immortality, extreme durability, near-absolute resistance to disease or corruption, and strength sufficient to physically contest even Deathwing. She possesses command over her entire dragonflight and can summon them at will.

She is capable of soul perception, life-energy manipulation, and limited omniscience within her domain. Her abilities also include shapeshifting, elemental flame mastery, dreamwalking (through her ties to Ysera and the Emerald Dream), and soul-mending. She has a unique ability to inspire, uplift, and lead—granting morale and strength to allies merely through presence.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: Queen of the Red Dragonflight, Guardian of Life

Quality of Life: Mixed
objects.title: Alexstrasza (World of Warcraft)

objects.text:
Name: Kosmos Obey Strategical Multiple Operation Systems
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Female (Artificial)
Sex: N/A (Android)
Age: Appears ~18–20, true age: Artificial construct, activation circa T.C. 4767.

Power: KOS-MOS is an advanced battle android developed by Vector Industries’ First and Second R&D Divisions, with Chief Engineer Shion Uzuki as project lead. Designed to fight the Gnosis, she possesses strength, speed, durability, and computational ability far beyond human capability. Her body is entirely composed of nanomachines, granting her self-repair, structural reconfiguration, and internal weapon transformation.

She is armed with an extensive arsenal: integrated particle and beam cannons, the X-BUSTER system, force shields, advanced sensors, and direct technological interfacing. She can summon heavy armaments such as gatling guns, scythes, and phase-transfer cannons from storage via her built-in transfer system. KOS-MOS can also project a Hilbert Effect field, making the otherwise intangible Gnosis detectable and vulnerable.

By Version IV, she carries within her the Animus of Mary Magdalene, allowing her to function as both weapon and spiritual vessel. This internalized power source removes the earlier requirement of draining another soul through her U-DO reactor, giving her independent energy and awakening her deeper potential.

Appearance: Striking in form, with long blue hair, red eyes, and a humanoid body designed in the likeness of a young woman. Version IV features white and black combat armor with energy wings and integrated phase-transfer cannons.

Civilian Identity: Officially a Vector Industries asset, but functionally independent in the field.

Quality of Life: Neutral. She has no biological needs, but her simulated personality OS and the presence of Mary’s spirit lead to emergent emotions and existential conflict.

This is KOS-MOS Version IV, as she appears before her final battle with T-elos. Alternatively, you may choose T-elos, created from Mary Magdalene’s physical body as her counterpart and rival.
objects.title: KOS-MOS IV (Xenosaga)

objects.text: Aliases: The Dragon of Dojima, the Star of Kamurocho, Kiryu-chan Age: 20-55 Gender: Male Background An orphan in the Sunflower Orphanage, raised by Shintaro Kazama who took him in our of guilt after killing his parents, Kiryu would end up befriending Akira Nishikiyama and Yumi Sawamura, who would be some of the closest people in his life. He would grow up idolizing Shintaro, even getting involved earlier in his life in some of Shintaro's more shady dealings. His adoptive father did not approved of that, culminating in one day where he beat Kiryu and Nishikiyama in the rain. Kiryu however, insisted that even orphans can dream too, causing Shintaro to relent and allowing him to join the Dojima Family, in which Kiryu shall build a name for himself. Powers While Kiryu is a normal man, he is an amazing martial artist. He combines street brawling with a couple of martial arts styles. From karate, judo, wrestling, and even some sumo. He is able to flawlessly switch between fighting styles, rushing through opponents or focusing on grabbing and throwing them for example. He is also capable of utilizing spy gadgetry as well, taking a more skill based approach in cases where he doesn't wish to be recognized due to how recognizable his Dragon of Dojima martial arts is. Finally, as he aged he started to focus more on using his legs, unable to exert as much force in his punches, yet is still able to kick your ass due to years of brutal refinement battling in the dark underbellies of Japan's crime world.
objects.title: Kazuma Kiryu (Yakuza)

objects.text:
Title: "The Devil of Rhine"
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Female?
Sex: Female
Age: 11 Years

Power: Elenium Type 95, Enchantment Combat Skills, State Approved Magic, Enchantment Tactics and Strategy Skills.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Soldier of the Empire
Quality of Life: Low (Child Soldier, Opposes Being X, Wants a peaceful life, but it's a dream)

Note: "Curse you, Being X"
objects.title: Tanya Von Degureshaff (Youjo Senki)

addons.text:
Since time immemorial, Shallow Vernal has longed to understand emotion—to feel, to express, and to find meaning and joy in her existence. For eons, these desires remained distant… until she met you. In you, she saw the one who could awaken feelings within her, to allow her to laugh and love, someone who could teach her what it truly means to live. And so, she has made herself your patron and bestowed upon you her blessing.

As her champion, you are immune to negatives effects that would impact your mind, body, and soul such as corruption, mind control, poison, and hostile magic. Even if you are somehow grievously wounded, Shallow Vernal’s blessing will bend reality itself—healing your wounds and altering cause and effect to ensure your survival.

Her blessing also weaves you into the fabric of the natural world. Fairies, spirits, and even gods are irresistibly drawn to your presence like moths to a flame, instinctively trusting you and offering their aid. Should you ever be in danger, these beings will gather without hesitation to defend you.

As your bond with Shallow Vernal deepens, new powers and abilities will unfold as you teach her about emotion and growth. Through this shared journey, she will grow alongside you, becoming more aware and connected. This unbreakable connection ensures she is always near, watching, listening, and ready to intervene whenever you need her. 

Keep in mind though, she has no concept of personal space and absolutely no grasp of emotional nuance. Don’t be surprised if she nonchalantly tells you she was watching you in the bathroom or when you are asleep.
addons.title: True Blessing

addons.text:
For reasons unknown, Shallow Vernal decided to transport Trinia to your planet.
Maybe it was on a whim, or perhaps Kuromueina managed to convince her to do it, just to make your world a little more exciting. Whatever the case may be,Trinia now exists on your very own planet.

Trinia is divided into three main realms that are separated by barriers: the Human Realm, the Demon Realm, and the God Realm. The Human Realm is home to a variety of races, including humans, elves, dwarves, fairies, and mermaids. The Demon Realm is inhabited by the Demon Race and other demonkind, each region governed by a powerful king. Lastly, the God Realm is where the various gods reside—divine beings responsible for overseeing and maintaining the world's fundamental systems and balance. The roles of these gods will extend to any world and dimensions that are connected to Your Very Own Planet such as Demiplane.

The inhabitants of Trinia hold unwavering loyalty toward Shallow Vernal, the creator of their world, and Kuromueina, its caretaker and guardian. In time, that same loyalty will extend to you, the one who now holds dominion over this realm. However, be prepared: the realm’s royalty, Demon Kings, gods, and even the powerful Six Kings will want to meet you. Some may just want to talk while others may try to test you—not out of malice, but out of curiosity. They simply wish to understand who you are, the being who was somehow able to get the attention of both Shallow Vernal and Kuromueina.
addons.title: Trinia

objects.text:
Alias: God of Creation, The Epilogue
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20+ Billion years old
Powers: Shallow Vernal is a World Creator, a being capable of bringing anything into existence, from entire worlds and divine beings who govern universal concepts to mundane objects. She possesses omniscience, able to see all events across time, and can manipulate reality itself to guide things toward any future she desires.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Mix (She possesses phenomenal cosmic power and commands the worship and admiration of her creations, yet she lacks any true connection with others. To her, all things are equal and distant, and despite her might, she is lonely, with nothing to make her feel alive or fulfilled.)
objects.title: Shallow Vernal (Yuusha Shoukan ni Makikomareta kedo, Isekai wa Heiwa deshita)

objects.text:
Alias: Underworld King
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20,000 thousand years old
Powers: Kuromueina is the other half of Shallow Vernal and was created to watch and manage Trinia. While Shallow Vernal embodies creation, Kuromueina wields immense destructive power that rivals her counterpart’s creative abilities. Her signature ability, Prologue, is a reality-warping power that makes the impossible into reality. With Prologue, Kuromueina can strike first in any battle, evade all incoming attacks, manipulate the flow of events by rewinding or altering outcomes, and much more. She also has the ability to see a being’s potential and help guide them to fully realizing it.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Mix (She wields immense power and political influence in Trinia, able to shape world events with mere words. Throughout her life, she has trained and guided many individuals who went on to leave a positive impact on the world. Yet, despite her achievements, she remains isolated—her overwhelming strength causes others to fear or revere her as a larger-than-life symbol. Deep down, she yearns to meet someone who sees her not as the Underworld King, but as an equal and a person.)

Note: If you treat Kuromueina as an equal and are a good person, she will likely develop strong feelings for you. Keep in mind, any insult or harm directed at you will provoke an extreme reaction from her. She wouldn’t hesitate to overthrow entire nations or bring empires to ruin if someone dared to slight you. So, be mindful of that when you’re around her.
objects.title: Kuromueina (Yuusha Shoukan ni Makikomareta kedo, Isekai wa Heiwa deshita)

addons.title: Dedication through Light and Darkness
addons.text: Yugi gains the Bonded Spirit Dark Magician, allowing him to summon his companion at full strength in the physical world. He instinctively knows how to tap into and imbue himself with the spellcaster's power and wisdom. Through their bond Yugi gains access to all modern support his decks received, including the "Dark Magician", "Gaia", "Phantom Beast", "Black Luster Soldier", "Buster Blader", "Magnet Warrior", "Three Musketeers of Face Cards" and "Chaos" archetypes.

objects.text:
Name: Yugi Muto
Alias: King of Games
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 17

Power: Yugi Muto possess the powers King of Games (Yu-Gi-Oh!) and a single Millennium Item (Yu-Gi-Oh!), the Millennium Puzzle. Throughout these powers and his own skill, Yugi is the single greatest Duelist ever and capable of summoning Duel Monsters into the physical realm through a mystical connection to his deck. As such he and his deck is perfectly suited for any situation and includes near unstoppable monsters such as the Egyptian God Cards, colossal kaiju monsters capable of devastating attacks that can reshape entire battlefields. 

Unlike ordinary summoners, Yugi’s greatest strength lies not only in the power of his monsters but in his tactical brilliance which allows him to easily anticipate opponents, exploit synergies, and turn seemingly impossible situations into victories. His bond with the spirit of the Millennium Puzzle grants him exceptional intuition, mental resilience, and the ability to manipulate fate to draw the exact card he needs in critical moments. 

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Domino High School Student, Professional Duelist
Quality of Life: Good (Famous and respected in the dueling world, but frequently targeted by supernatural threats, rival duelists, and Shadow Game challenges) 

Note: Yugi’s Deck typically includes: Dark Magician, Dark Magician Girl, Summoned Skull, Kuriboh, and the Egyptian God Cards—Slifer the Sky Dragon, Obelisk the Tormentor, and The Winged Dragon of Ra.
objects.title: Yugi Muto (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

addons.title: The Ultimate Creature of Destruction
addons.text: Kaiba gains the Bonded Spirit Blue-Eyes White Dragon, allowing him to summon his companion at full strength in the physical world. He instinctively knows how to tap into and imbue himself with the dragon's power. Through their bond Kaiba gains access to all modern support his decks received, including the "Blue-Eyes", "A-to-Z", "Thunder Dragon", "Virus" and "Chaos" archetypes.

objects.text:
Name: Seto Kaiba
Alias: CEO of KaibaCorp
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 18

Power: Seto Kaiba possess the powers King of Games (Yu-Gi-Oh!) and Kaiba Corp (Yu-Gi-Oh!). Through these powers he is a Legendary Duelist capable of summoning Duel Monsters into the physical realm through advanced dueling technology and an unrivaled connection to his deck. His monsters manifest as powerful battlefield entities, with his signature Blue-Eyes White Dragon and its variants standing among the most destructive creatures a duelist can command, allowing them to easily level buildings and dominate large-scale combat encounters.

Beyond his dueling skill, Kaiba is also a once in multiple generations technological genius. As the CEO of KaibaCorp, he personally designed or oversaw the creation of nearly every major Duel Monsters technology that has ever existed. From duel disks and holographic battle systems to advanced simulation environments and military-grade weapons systems, Kaiba’s technological expertise has no equal. His intellect, resources, and engineering skill place him on the level of the world’s greatest inventors, allowing him to deploy cutting-edge equipment, autonomous systems, and experimental technologies alongside his monsters.

Appearance: Handsome 
Civilian Identity: CEO of KaibaCorp, Technology Magnate, Professional Duelist
Quality of Life: Good (One of the wealthiest and most powerful individuals in the world, though driven by obsession, rivalry, and relentless ambition)

Note: Kaiba’s Deck typically includes: Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, Obelisk the Tormentor, XYZ-Dragon Cannon, Vorse Raider, and numerous high-power Dragon-type monsters.
objects.title: Seto Kaiba (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

addons.title: Favorite Contact
addons.text: Jaden gains the Bonded Spirit Elemental HERO Neos, allowing him to summon his companion at full strength in the physical world. He instinctively knows how to tap into and imbue himself with the warrior's power and skills. Through their bond Jaden gains access to all modern support his decks received, including the "Elemental HERO", "Vision HERO", "Evil HERO" and "Neo-Spacian" archetypes.

objects.text:
Name: Jaden Yuki
Alias: Supreme King, The Hero Duelist
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 16

Power: Jaden Yuki possess the power King of Games (Yu-Gi-Oh!) through which he is capable of summoning Duel Monsters into the physical realm through a deep spiritual bond with his cards. Jaden’s deck specializes in Elemental HERO monsters, versatile champions capable of combining their powers into powerful fusion entities that can rapidly adapt to changing battlefield conditions. Being one of the greatest Duelist ever, Jaden is a master of intuition, strategy, and his connection to the spirits in his cards.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Duel Academy Student
Quality of Life: Good (Lives the life of a duelist adventurer, though frequently drawn into supernatural conflicts and dangerous duels)

Note: Jaden’s Deck typically includes: Elemental HERO Avian, Burstinatrix, Sparkman, Clayman, Flame Wingman, and numerous other HERO fusion monsters.
objects.title: Jaden Yuki (Yu-Gi-Oh GX)

addons.title: Starlight Road
addons.text: Yusei gains the Bonded Spirit Stardust Dragon, allowing him to summon his companion at full strength in the physical world. He instinctively knows how to tap into and imbue himself with the dragon's power. Through their bond Yusei gains access to all modern support his decks received, including the "Junk", "Synchron" and "Stardust" archetypes.

objects.text:
Name: Yusei Fudo
Alias: The Signer of the Crimson Dragon
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 18

Power: Yusei Fudo possess the power King of Games (Yu-Gi-Oh!) through which he capable of summoning Duel Monsters into the physical realm through his powerful connection to his Synchro monsters. Yusei’s monsters are highly adaptable and ready for nearly any situation, including his signature Stardust Dragon capable of manifesting as a massive dragon-like guardian able to intercept devastating attacks and protect allies across the battlefield.

Outside of combat, Yusei’s strength lies in his engineering genius and strategic brilliance. A self-taught inventor, he designed advanced duel technology and vehicles from salvaged parts, demonstrating a level of technical skill rivaling some of the world’s greatest engineers. His ability to combine technical innovation with masterful dueling strategy allows him to control the battlefield with both technology and duel monsters.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Engineer and Professional Duelist
Quality of Life: Life has its ups and downs (Brilliant inventor and heroic figure, but raised in poverty and constantly drawn into conflicts tied to ancient forces)

Note: Yusei’s Deck typically includes: Stardust Dragon, Junk Warrior, Nitro Warrior, Shooting Star Dragon, and numerous other Synchro monsters.
objects.title: Yusei Fudo (Yu-Gi-Oh 5D’s)

addons.text:
Through Purah’s cutting-edge Sheikah-Zonai engineering, Link receives a complete enhancement package tailored for the Hero of Hyrule. He gains the Master Ride, a fully customized, modular Sheikah vehicle capable of traversing any terrain and powered by any objects he can find.

Alongside it, Link is outfitted with a set of Ancient Armor and Weapons, reforged with Purah’s genius to possess infinite durability, ensuring they never break or wear down. His quiver becomes a renewable Sheikah-tech repository, constantly but slowly replenishing its supply of Ancient Arrows, allowing him to unleash devastating firepower against even the mightiest of foes.
addons.title: Master Ride

objects.text:
Name: Link (varies by incarnation)
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 16–20 (depending on timeline)

Power: Link is the Hero of Hyrule, chosen by the gods to wield the Triforce of Courage. His signature weapons are the Master Sword, a sacred blade capable of defeating or sealing any evil, and the indestructible Hylian Shield. Beyond these, Link has wielded an extensive arsenal of weapons and tools. His boomerang, bombs, and bow, enhanced with fire, ice, and light arrows, have become versatile staples in his inventory.

Link has also used powerful tools like the Megaton Hammer, Zora Mask, and Hookshot for combat and exploration. Magical artifacts such as the Dominion Rod, Mirror Shield, and Hover Boots grant him control over enemies and the environment. Iconic musical instruments like the Ocarina of Time and the Wind Waker let him manipulate time and summon elemental powers. 

Each weapon and item reflects his ingenuity, adaptability and courage, enabling him to overcome any obstacle and uphold his destiny as the Hero of Hyrule.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Hero of Hyrule
Quality of Life: Horrible (Cursed to Eternal Conflict, Constantly in Dangerous Situations, Repeatedly needing to save a Princess)
objects.title: Link (Zelda Franchise)

addons.text:
Under Purah’s mentorship, Zelda takes her first decisive steps as a true Sheikah-Zonai researcher. She receives a Sheikah Slate of her own, uniquely attuned to her magic and intellect, granting her command over Runes, constructs, and previously locked data.

Also, any Sheikah or Zonai devices crafted by Zelda or Purah benefit from a massive amplification in power and efficiency. Turrets fire with greater precision, barriers hold with near-absolute stability, automata strike with accelerated speed, and energy constructs channel far more destructive potential than their baseline counterparts.
addons.title: Burgeoning Sheikah Scholar

objects.text:
Name: Zelda (varies by incarnation)
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 16–20 (depending on timeline)

Power: As the reincarnation of the goddess Hylia, Princess Zelda is imbued with powerful magic tied to the Triforce of Wisdom, granting her extraordinary abilities and a connection to the divine. Her magic includes protective spells, such as creating city sized barriers to shield herself or others, as well as potent light magic that can weaken or banish evil forces. She can channel divine energy into devastating attacks, such as the Light Arrows, which can harm even the darkest foes. Zelda also has impressive telepathic abilities, often communicating across great distances with Link.

Zelda frequently also adopts alternative personas to protect her kingdom. As Sheik, she becomes a skilled warrior and spy, mastering stealth, agility, and close-quarters combat to operate in the shadows. As Tetra, she becomes a fearless pirate captain whose cunning and resourcefulness inspire loyalty among her crew. Beyond her combat prowess, Zelda is a brilliant strategist, devising intricate plans to outmaneuver her enemies and support Hyrule’s resistance against powerful forces.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Crown Princess of Hyrule
Quality of Life: It has its up and downs (Royalty, Divine heritage, Often yearning for freedom and connection, Constantly getting Kidnapped)
objects.title: Princess Zelda (Zelda Franchise)

objects.text:
Name: Ganondorf
Alias: Ganondorf Dragmire, King of Evil, King of Thieves, King of Darkness, The Menace Unleashed, The Demon King 
Alignment: True Evil 
Gender: Male 
Sex: Male 
Age: Reincarnated for Millennia

Power: Ganondorf wields immense magical and physical power as the bearer of the Triforce of Power. His mastery of dark magic grants him abilities such as demonic energy manipulation, teleportation, and the creation of destructive projectiles. Ganondorf’s physical strength and durability are superhuman, allowing him to overpower opponents and survive injuries that would be fatal to others.

In addition to his combat prowess, Ganondorf is a cunning strategist and manipulator, capable of orchestrating complex plans to achieve his goals. As a master of sorcery, he can corrupt and bend entire realms to his will, summoning armies of minions and reshaping landscapes to his will. His combination of immortality, raw power, dark magic, and strategic intellect make him one of the most formidable foes in Hyrule’s history.

Appearance: Varies from Handsome to Ugly 
Civilian Identity: King of the Gerudo
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs (Constantly being imprisoned and killed, Rich, King of an entire race, Immortal)
objects.title: Ganondorf (Zelda Franchise)

objects.text:
Name: Unknown 
Alias: Skull Kid 
Alignment: Chaotic Evil 
Gender: Male 
Sex: Male 
Age: Eternally Young

Power: Skull Kid, empowered by the dark magic of Majora’s Mask, becomes a chaotic and powerful force capable of reshaping reality. His abilities include telekinesis, manipulation of natural elements, and summoning powerful illusions. Under the influence of the mask, Skull Kid can warp time and space, create destructive energy blasts, and even command the moon to over time crash into the world of Termina. 

His combination of dark magic, unpredictability, and raw destructive power makes him an existential threat to all of Termina. However, be warned—the more he draws upon the mask’s power, the more it affects his mind. 

Appearance: Deformed 
Civilian Identity: Prankster 
Quality of Life: Terrible (Constantly mocked as a monster their entire life, had body possessed by a demon, nearly killed everyone while possessed by demon)
objects.title: Skull Kid (Zelda: Majora's Mask)

objects.text:
Name: Midna
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Early 20s

Power: Midna is a member of the Twili, a race native to the Twilight Realm, and possesses the ability to manipulate shadows and wield Twilight-based magic. She can transform into a shadowy form to remain unseen, create portals for teleportation, and use her hair-like appendage as a powerful weapon. As the rightful ruler of the Twilight Realm, Midna’s power is intrinsically tied to her connection with her homeland, enhancing her natural abilities and allowing her to command the forces of Twilight. 

Midan’s power becomes even more formidable when she wields the Fused Shadows, a powerful artifact made from fragments of ancient Twili magic. With the mask of Fused Shadows, Midna gains access to overwhelming magical abilities, enabling her to unleash devastating attacks capable of destroying the strongest of barriers and overwhelm her enemies with ease.

 Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Formerly Dethroned Princess of the Twilight Realm.
Quality of Life: It has it ups and downs (Formerly Exiled, Royalty, Previously turned into an Imp)

Note: You can choose which form of Midna comes to your aid.
objects.title: Midna (Zelda: Twilight Princess)

objects.text:
Name: Cia
Alias: The Sorceress of Darkness
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appears Early 20s

Cia is a master of dark magic, wielding arcane forces that twist space and time. She can tear open rifts between eras, unleashing monsters from alternate timelines to serve her will. Her arsenal includes wide-range destruction spells, life-draining dark orbs, and time-warping effects that distort the flow of battle in her favor.

Among her most insidious talents is puppet mastery—the ability to seize control of weaker minds or reanimate fallen foes as extensions of her will. Through elaborate rituals, she can reshape the battlefield itself, altering terrain and rewriting the very rules of engagement. Though cast down from former heights, Cia remains a brilliant and ruthless tactician often using seduction, summoned horrors, and forbidden sorcery to crush all who oppose her.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Sorceress 
Quality of Life: Life Has Its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Cia (Zelda: Hyrule Warriors)

addons.text:
Cia and Lana have awakened the ability to fuse into their original, unified form—and separate at will. As the complete sorceress, they wield overwhelming magical power, mastering both light and dark, time and space.

This ascended form commands perfect control over summoning magic, able call forth heroic manifestations from the future, conjure shadow-clones from alternate timelines, and even manifest elemental avatars born from the fractured facets of her own soul. A being of balance and chaos alike, the Unified Sorceress is a force few can hope to challenge.
addons.title: Unified Sorceress

objects.text:
Name: Lana
Alias: The Sorceress of Light
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appears Late Teens

Power: Lana is a master of light-based sorcery, as well as elemental and barrier magic. She specializes in conjuring radiant walls and shimmering barriers—capable of shielding allies, repelling foes, or being used as crushing weapons of force. On the battlefield, her command of wide-area magic allows her to emit pulses of healing light or disorienting flashes that stun enemies and shift the tide in her favor.

But Lana’s most formidable power lies in her Summoning Gates—mystical rifts through space and time that call forth legendary champions from other worlds and distant timelines. With this ability, she has tilted the balance of entire wars, bringing forces to heel that should never have met. 

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Sorceress
Quality of Life: Life Has Its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Lana (Zelda: Hyrule Warriors)

objects.text:
Name: Urbosa
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: Gerudo physiology, extremely skilled warrior and leader, wields scimitar and shield, possesses extremely powerful thunder magic.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Chieftain of the Gerudo
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs
objects.title: Urbosa (Zelda: Breath of the Wild)

objects.text:
Name: Daruk
Alias: Champion of Vah Rudania
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Appears 40s

Power: Daruk is a Goron warrior of immense physical might and volcanic resilience. His key ability is Daruk’s Protection, a magic shield that automatically blocks incoming damage a limited number of times before needing recharge. He is a living tank, wielding colossal stone weaponry and hurling boulders with ease. Daruk’s volcanic origins let him swim in lava, shrug off flames, and create localized quakes with his stomps or strikes. In combat, his momentum is unstoppable, and he’s capable of absorbing punishment few others could withstand.

Appearance: Attractive for a Goron
Civilian Identity: Goron Champion and Hyrule’s shield
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Daruk (Zelda: Breath of the Wild)

objects.text:
Name: Revali 
Alias: Champion of Vah Medoh
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Appears Early 20s

Power: Revali is a Rito warrior whose aerial combat skills are unmatched. He possesses Revali’s Gale, a wind magic-based updraft that propels him and allies high into the air—providing exceptional mobility and surprise attack options. Armed with a Great Eagle Bow, he can fire multiple arrows in rapid succession with deadly precision, often enhancing them with wind magic for slicing, sweeping attacks. His wind manipulation allows him to create cutting gusts, shield himself with compressed air, and remain airborne for extended periods. 

Appearance: Attractive for a Rito
Civilian Identity: Rito champion and elite archer
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Revali (Zelda: Breath of the Wild)

objects.text:
Name: Mipha
Alias: Champion of Vah Ruta
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appears Late Teens to Early 20s

Power: Mipha is a Zora princess and a natural-born healer with great skill in water magic. Her most famous ability is Mipha’s Grace, a sacred power that can heal others instantly, even from near-death, and can be quickly recharged after use. In battle, she controls water with elegant precision, shaping spears and barriers from even just the moisture in the air. Her Zora physiology also gives her immense swimming skill, agility in aquatic terrain, and a longevity that contributes to her deep wisdom and serene presence.

Appearance: Beautiful for a Zora
Civilian Identity: Zora royalty and guardian of the Zora people
Quality of Life: It has its Ups and Downs (Royalty that has to constantly train and fight to save the world)
objects.title: Mipha (Zelda: Breath of the Wild)

addons.text: Purah received her own Purah Pad, with the same functions as your Sheikah Slate. You can also choose to make your own slate to look like a Purah Pad now if you want.
addons.title: Sheikah Tech Support

addons.text: With Purah’s genius, your Sheikah Slate gains a special Rune linked to each Champion in your team, allowing you to summon their Divine Beast onto the battlefield. These colossal machines can serve as mobile fortresses, unleash devastating support fire, dominate the battlefield through sheer presence, and even channel their pilots for brief but overwhelming attacks reminiscent of the battle against Calamity Ganon
addons.title: The Divine Beasts

addons.text: Purah now has full access to the tech tree from Korok Warcrimes. The complete knowledge from Sheikah and Zonai technology allow her to build things far beyond what each civilization could, using the best of each one to complement her creations.
addons.title: Purah, the War Criminal

addons.text:
With the Princess of Light and every Champion gathered, Purah has achieved the impossible: the creation of a new Divine Beast, a towering construct made uniquely for you. Unlike its predecessors, your Divine Beast stands as the keystone of Sheikah-Zonai engineering, harmonizing the power of the four Champions, the Hero, and the Princess. It functions as a colossal war machine in its own right, equipped with devastating siege weaponry, near-impenetrable energy shielding, and mobility across land, sky, and even water.

When the other Divine Beasts are present, yours can serve as the core that unites them into a single transcendent warform, a gestalt that magnifies their collective strength beyond measure and turns the battlefield into a stage for overwhelming power. Each member of the team may channel their essence into this construct, unleashing unique manifestations of their spirit: tidal waves of purifying water from Mipha, storms of lightning from Urbosa, precision bombardments from Revali, volcanic eruptions from Daruk, holy light wards from Zelda, and devastating finishing strikes from Link.

Your Divine Beast also possesses its own distinct power and elemental affinity of your choosing, granting you the freedom to design its appearance, abilities, and ultimate form. Whether forged to slay godlike titans or to seal away apocalyptic threats, this construct embodies the culmination of Purah’s genius. With the whole team united, the Divine Beasts transcend their origins, no longer mere machines of war but the living symbol of Hyrule’s strength made whole.
addons.title: Mighty Morphin Champions!

objects.text: Age: 124 Gender: Female Background Purah is a Sheikah scientist. For a hundred years she researched her people lost technology, until she eventually found a way to reverse her age. In the modern age, Purah uses her eccentric genius to help revitalize Hyrule and empower its champions, while trying to discover its secrets long buried. Powers Purah has powers similar to Korok War crimes (Legend of Zelda), focused mostly on Sheikah technology. She can recreate Sheikah Slates (lovely renamed Purah Pad), Skyviewer towers that scan the surrounding area and serve as a teleportation focus, robotic assistants, and more. On top of that, her Sheikah lineage gives her an extended lifespan, though she has other means to extend her life as well. Purah is a brilliant scientist, engineer and researcher, able to reverse engineer ancient technology by analyzing it, and able to not only modify it with new functionalities but also to enhance its functions further.
objects.title: Purah (Zelda: Breath of the Wild)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female 
Sex: Female
Age: Mid 20s
Power: Great at mixology, able to create Nitro Fuel, a liquid that is a mix of alcohol, energy drink, and fuel. Uses twin flamethrowers that double as tonfas.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Mixologist of the Sons of Calydon
Quality of Life: Happy (works in a job she likes with co-workers and friends she likes, generally an optimistic and happy person)
objects.title: Burnice White (Zenless Zone Zero)

objects.text:
Also Known As: Eve
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Somewhere in late 20s and Early 30s
Power: Very strong, fast, and agile. Using Lunalux Garrote, a garrote wire made from Porcelune wires, as her weapon, also attached at the end of the wire folding knife.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Bodyguard and Manager of Astra Yao
Quality of Life: Good (protects and manages her friend Astra Yao)
objects.title: Evelyn Chevalier (Zenless Zone Zero)

objects.text:
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 24
Power: Excellent martial artist and marksman. Uses the Riot Suppressor Mark VI, a modular pistol capable of firing buckshot and homing projectiles. Also capable of firing ether laced projectiles, causing Ether corruption with symptoms that include sickness and mental degradation, and even turning into a creature known as an Ethereal with enough exposure. The corruption is irreversible.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Squad Leader of New Eridu Public Security's Criminal Investigation Special Response Team
Quality of Life: Good (Works in a job she likes with coworkers she can tolerate or even like, has a good relationship with her Mom)
objects.title: Zhu Yuan (Zenless Zone Zero)

objects.text: Aliases: Chief Bangboo Tech Consultant, Chief Troublemaker Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Not much is known about her past, but as the Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department and the unquestionable leading expert in the field of Bangboo technology, she ended up as a great researcher and engineer. Even if her “Destruction is the mother of creation” philosophy made her a menace to both her colleagues and creations. Powers She is a technological powerhouse, allowing her to make and modify specialized robotic companions called Bangboos, with even her primary weapon is a Bangboo modified into her hat. The Bangboo are semi-intelligent devices originally made for assisting residents to evacuate disaster zones, but they can be adapted to any task and purpose fitting for their small humanoid frame.
objects.title: Norma Hollowell (Zenless Zone Zero)

objects.text: Aliases: Too many to count, uses “Anonymous” as her only handle. Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Jane is a rat thiren with a career as a criminal behavior specialist and consultant with Public Security. She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, investigation and interrogation with her going undercover numerous times in gangs. Her real name and identity are unknown, and she is mainly referred to as “Jane Doe”. She is also a night owl and a hoarder, making her home a mess filled with all kinds of stuff and junk food. Powers She is already dangerous as an infiltration specialist, but she is also deadly in combat. She primarily uses a set of Porcelume Daggers and Bootblades and her fighting style resembles a mix of figure skating moves and dance moves, turning her into an incredibly agile and deadly fighter. She is also skilled at using her tail, allowing her to wield her blades with that as well.
objects.title: Jane Doe (Zenless Zone Zero)

objects.text: Aliases: Uses “fangs full of venom” as her online username. Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background She is a snake thiren who grew up in the Outer Ring with her pet snake named Chalky she usually wears around her neck. She had a rough childhood working hard harvesting oil and being surrounded by biker gangs. Due to the lack of food, she moved to more dangerous areas where she ran into trouble with a pair of scavengers beating her up. Promeia ended up brutally killing the pair, saving Cissia, but this also deeply terrified her, causing her to develop a deep-rooted fear of her. After a while, she was found by Jane Doe, who recruited her to work for the New Eridu Public Security, thanks to her ability to read others by scent, tracks, and subtle muscle movements and her incredible instincts in general. Thanks to her past, she is also an unrepentant glutton. Powers Her snake-like agility and flexibility combined with her instincts make her a dangerous combatant in the first place. But she can also generate and control electricity and is also a skilled spear user.
objects.title: Cissia (Zenless Zone Zero)

objects.text: Age: 26-35 Gender: Female Background The 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator. Revered as a grandmaster and addressed simply as Shifu by her disciples, she lives an elusive existence balancing profound spiritual and martial disciplines with a surprisingly pragmatic, low-key attitude toward worldly concerns. Powers Yixuan is a premier Rupture Agent wielding the refined Auric Ink element, a sophisticated evolution of Ether. Her combat style blends fluid martial arts combos with high survivability and defense-ignoring sheer force scaling off her HP pool. She utilizes charged stances like the Grand Tai Chi formation, defensive parries, and ink arrays to pull targets and crush enemies.
objects.title: Yixuan Shifu (Zenless Zone Zero)

addons.text: Yura was approached and given the task to create a Tinker tech suit that perfectly fit Anarchy. She designed a suit equipped with adaptive technology that could incorporate and enhance other technologies while maintaining the appearance of a stylish, mundane suit. Due to the suit’s unique properties, Anarchy can generate advanced materials at a faster pace and, with sufficient study, even reproduce Tinker-made unique materials for his Tinkertech. This suit not only bolsters Anarchy’s capabilities but also assists with Tinkering due to hidden tools inside. Another set was made as a frilly Magical Girl outfit, but not a single person still alive has seen it.
addons.title: Chaos Regalia

objects.text:
Name: Xavier Mustaffa
Gender: Male
Age: 16
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful 

Power: (Machine World + Reconfiguration)
Anarchy has the ability to generate advanced materials out of his body and use them to construct tinkertech. Specifically, Anarchy's specialty is Adaptive technology, meaning their tinker tech has the ability to alter and improve itself based on its environment and the data it collects. Furthermore, all the tinkertech constructed by Anarchy can self-repair and self maintenance, which makes them highly reliable. His most noteworthy creation is the Sentinel, an automaton capable of analyzing and gaining capabilities that can counter parahumans.

Personality:
Anarchy’s mental state is fragile and unreliable, with a co-occurrence of multiple psychiatric disorders. He struggle with schizophrenia, a severe mental illness characterized by delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, and cognitive impairment, along with personality disorders, including Bipolar Type 1, characterized by manic and depressive episodes, and DID, Dissociative Identity Disorder, formerly known as Multiple Personality Disorder, where the patient has distinct, alternate personalities. This combination causes Anarchy to have an unstable personality, which may manifest as mood swings, changes in motivation and energy, as well as unstable interpersonal relationships, trust, and reliability. Despite this, he continues to rule over Malaysia, and never harms his citizens unless given a reason to.

Background:
Anarchy has been categorized as an S-Class threat, meaning that he possess extraordinary powers and capabilities, and his actions, if left unchecked, could result in catastrophic consequences. Additionally, he holds a position of power as the Warlord of Malaysia, overseeing a large territory with millions of inhabitants. Interestingly, despite his dangerous reputation, he is well-loved by his subjects.

By choosing him, you will enter a friendly partnership where you gain access to all of Malaysia’s resources at the cost of your assistance in certain matters. Additionally, it is recommended to be wary as Anarchy may attack you at any given moment for no apparent reason.
objects.title: Anarchy

addons.text: One of Yura’s odd jobs commissioned her to create a suit for Professor. A black and red suit that amplifies the strength of the powers he gives. The suit is equipped with all kinds of self-defense armaments and even a lie detector. It also comes with a way for the user to not appear on any technological devices such as cameras or photographs.
addons.title: Covenant Suit

objects.text:
Name: Aaron 
Gender: Male
Age: 47
Appearance: Attractive

Power: (Flint + Network Hub + Geas)
Professor possesses the power to cause people to develop a Corona Pollentias and trigger. In order to use this ability, Professor must strike a deal with the person who will be granted abilities. The person must accept the terms of the deal, and after that, they are automatically compelled to follow through their end of the bargain and unable to change or back out of it. Furthermore, Professor has the ability to access all the abilities that have been granted to others. 

Personality:

Professor is an enigmatic and secretive individual, known to be incredibly cagey about his motivations and desires. One of the first powers he garnered through his deals was the ability to predict the future, and upon doing so, he was presented with a grim vision of the world's end. Given this sobering insight, Professor devotes a great deal of his time and energies towards nurturing and empowering individuals who are well-equipped to leverage their abilities for the betterment of society, ensuring that they are wisely utilized, avoiding a potential catastrophe brought on by the wrong hands. Ultimately, the Professor's opaque mannerisms and secretive nature belie an altruistic goal of ensuring the survival of the human population by providing a helping hand to the right individuals.

Background:

Professor's backstory has long been shrouded in mystery, as he is known to have covered up any traces of his origins. All that is known is that he originally hails from Earth Nun and used a combination of his abilities to traverse to Earth Bet, “Ground Zero”, due to its status as the epicenter of the end of the world. Despite the veil of secrecy enveloping him, it is an observable fact that he possesses a keen artistic aptitude in drawing as well as a fondness of apples. There are rumor's of having seen him with a lover, a woman wearing a fedora but no proof has been found.
objects.title: Professor

addons.text: With the help of the Professor, Jacob is far more controlled. This means that while Jacob will not be causing mass destruction, he will instead focus of undoing all the good the Professor and you will do, even try to bribe the two of you into being villains like him.
addons.title: The Devil’s Game

addons.text: Jacob decided to join the Avant Garde, seeking more power and desiring to be near to his idol. Jacob acts as a prison and warden, punishing and torturing those deserving of it. He keeps control over the criminal underworld throughout all worlds, keeping things chaotic yet far from the innocent.
addons.title: Lord 666

addons.text:
One of the strangest jobs she’s had, she was commissioned to create a suit that is also a clown outfit. A black and red crowned clown costume that incorporates various technologies in it. She doesn’t exactly know who wanted it, but after receiving the information and making the costume, it was taken. She did not get paid for making it.

Jacob’s powers obtain a stronger copy of the power he caused to trigger. His trigger sight is capable of guiding him to create different events to plan out what kind of powers he could get through a predictive algorithm attached to his suit.
addons.title: Regal Jester

addons.text:
Crown is disgusted—although he doesn’t admit this to himself, shocked—that a variant like him tries to “play” the hero just as those boring “capes” in Earth-Bet. That is, until plays a close eye on how the Knight moves. Seeing a diamond in the rough, the Knight’s code orchestrates disasters and massacres to wear down his variant’s code, playing a game of cat and mouse without revealing his hand.

Knight, in turn, calls Crown’s bluff. He already recognized Crown’s identity and “game”—they are the same, after all. This leads them to be under a stalemate at the moment of your arrival.
addons.title: Who says Chivalry is Dead?!

objects.text:
Name: Jacob Black
Gender: Male
Age: 23
Appearance: Attractive

Power: Making of a Tragedy (+ Addon)

His power allows him to “see” people’s trigger events, whether they can trigger at all is not important. From there, he can make plans that causes people to trigger. His plans allow him to permanently scar the minds of those he triggers, in a way much like Simurgh bombs. He will gain weaker versions of whatever power his target triggers, in a similar manner to that of a cluster.

Backstory:

Jacob originates from a different Earth, using his powers to travel to alternate Earths. 

When Jacob was still a youth, he was nearly left behind in a bunker after his parents told him the world had ended. Instead, he elected to eliminate his parents and survive as a homeless youngster. This traumatic experience has since shaped Jacob, fostering his callous and independent demeanor.

Jacob doesn’t care for cape culture, seeing it as a stupid and boring “game”. He was amongst the first people The Professor has ever given powers to, from before he gained his precognition. He saw the Professor as someone strong, and wished to emulate him. 

In an attempt to gain The Professor's attention, he formed a group he calls The Court of Jesters, crowning himself the Crown Prince of Crime.

Personality:

Jacob is a psychopathic individual with an overwhelming desire to control the fate of others, treating them as mere pawns in his games.  He revels in the prospect of wielding power over others, reveling in the sensation of manipulation and control. His lack of empathy and compassion, coupled with his willingness to resort to extreme measures to achieve their ends, makes them a daunting and unpredictable opponent.

Note: 

Among the many powers Jacob has, one of them allows him to travel to different earths. If you don’t rein him in, there is a good chance you will be getting a Kill Order for being an accomplice.
objects.title: Crown Prince of Crime

addons.text: While not one of Yura’s strongest or most notable pieces of equipment, she met a teenager who hides herself in a pocket dimension. Out of pity and as a fellow introvert, Yura created a comfortable jacket for Ellis. The nameless jacket enhances Ellis’s powers and creates bigger and faster effects than before. But it’s also a very comfy self-cleaning jacket that can be worn to stay cool during hot days and warm during cold days.
addons.title: A Comfortable Jacket

objects.text:
Name: Ellis Cadmon
Gender: Depends
Age: 18
Appearance: Androgynous Young Adult

Perks: (Negentropy, Blind Spot)

Items: (Secret Lair)

Power: (Liminal Landscaper, Liminal Avatar)

The Mysterious Architect is able to create an extradimensional space at the the thresholds of physical boundaries, these extra dimensional spaces can be manipulated and enhanced over time to give the Mysterious architect even more space and detail of manipulation. Any being that crosses the threshold in the same direction that the Liminal space was created will cause them to enter the liminal space instead. 

The Mysterious architect while within the boundaries of their liminal landscapes can turn immaterial and create an avatar out of the same materials and creatures that enter the landscape with the same detail as the landscape they are currently in. With the boost from Negentropy they are able to create an avatar in any Liminal landscape and travel to that landscape even if it isnt directly connected.

Personality:

Ellis Cadmon was a runaway teen who dropped out of Highschool, and had been homeless for the most part of the last year until they stumbled upon the entrance to a secret underground lair. It wasn't the largest lair and could probably only accommodate a team of 10 people. It looked like it had been abandoned for awhile, but they had found a way to lock the door which meant they should be relatively safe from the outside and anyone that might try and do them harm. Ellis ran away from a bad home life, and struggles with pretty severe ADHD and is fairly introverted and lacking trust in most people. However if one manages to worm their way past the carefully crafted defense put up in the social path, Ellis transitions into a quiet but chatty friend.
objects.title: Mysterious Architect

addons.text: A shapeshifting suit for a Changer, Asphalt was commissioned to create a suit that can be worn by someone who can alter shape. She created a self-repairing suit that can be worn and torn as much as possible while allowing it to not be distracting in combat. The suit greatly improves the speed at which Hellhound grows.
addons.title: Enterprise Suit

objects.text:
Name: N/A
Gender: Male
Age: 21
Appearance: Handsome Case 53

Power: (Dragon of Kyushu, Lord of Cinder)

At his base, Hellhound is extremely resilient, heals rapidly, and has pyrokinesis focusing on cinders and ash. When faced with conflict, turns into a three headed Hellhound that thrives on combat, exponentially growing both in size and power with each moment he spends fighting. This also affects his defenses, so getting hit with poison would give him poison resistance that would then scale with him. Once out of conflict he can stay in that form for 2 hours, after which he will revert to his base form while permanently retaining 10% of the power from his other form.

Personality:

Hellhound values trust and loyalty above all else, a product of having been betrayed by the person who sheltered him when he was most vulnerable. He is very distant and cold towards strangers, but to friends he is playful and outgoing, always the life of the party. 

Background:

Hellhound began his journey in Columbus, Ohio, as a lost and naive Case 53, unaware of his own identity and purpose. Unfortunately, he soon crossed paths with a malevolent human trafficker who sought to exploit his vulnerability. The criminal, sensing an opportunity to take advantage of his misfortune, feigned a desire to offer him shelter. However, upon Hellhound falling asleep, the trafficker attempted to drug him, hoping to subjugate him and force him into compliance. Despite their attempt, Hellhound's robust regenerative abilities prevented any harm to him. In response, Hellhound swiftly retaliated, brutally attacking and torturing the trafficker until he divulged the details about the organisation he worked for. Thereafter, Hellhound claimed dominion over the organisation and renamed it 'Cerberus'. Utilizing this force at his disposal, Hellhound proceeded to abolish human trafficking and several other crimes while maintaining a stranglehold on the region. Criminals shudder at the mention of his name, and law enforcement agencies label him as a 'Warlord', while the citizens respect and adore him. Despite his intimidating and uncompromising reputation, Hellhound is regarded as a benevolent ruler, whose firm but fair governance has transformed the area into a thriving sanctuary
objects.title: Hellhound

addons.text: Yura was commissioned to create a Japanese-themed Magical Girl shrine maiden outfit for Artemis. It greatly amplifies the strength of her friends. The outfit comes with accessories for her friends that, when equipped, allow them to “store” a form. When Artemis rides one of her Friends, it can gain a boost related to both the current and stored form.
addons.title: Yin & Yang

objects.text:
Name: Eva
Gender: Female
Age: 11
Appearance: Beautiful

Power: (Animal Friends, Improved Friends)

Eva can summon two projections of animals, they can be any form or size she wishes but usually keeps them as large wolves. These animal friends can each have 20sp worth of powers that Eva can change whenever she wants, though they must be counterpart to each other i.e fire and ice, light and darkness, etc. though instead of clashing, amplify each other significantly when used together. On top of this, when carrying or riding them any powers she has are boosted in some way thematically relating to her friends, a bird might incorporate razor feathers into a blaster power, for example. She also has the ability to fuse with her Animal Friends, granting her significantly enhanced versions of their powers and combined strength, durability, speed, and reflexes while also giving her animal features in line with her Friends, such as wings from a bird or a tail from a dog.

Personality:

Happy and playful on the surface, Eva is a social butterfly who loves to spend time with her friends. Despite her cheerful demeanor, she has a secret cynical side and struggles with abandonment and trust issues, resulting from a traumatic childhood. Deep down, Eva is incredibly clingy and seeks security in the people she cares about, but is wary of getting too close for fear of being hurt. 

Background:

Eva has humble origins, being born to a low class family struggling to get ends meet. When she was ten, her family was going through a particularly rough time. Her parents offered to bring her to the zoo, much to her excitement.

Eva's world turned upside down when she was sold into the dark world of slavery. When the full truth of her situation was revealed, she discovered that she had been betrayed by her own parents, who sold her to the slave traders. Overwhelmed with grief and anger, Eva was left with no one she could trust. She suffered during her time as a slave, and was saved by Hellhound, who became someone she admired. She turned to him for comfort and guidance, and their bond only grew stronger.

Originally, she was incapable of helping Hellhound due to being an ordinary human. This frustrated her, as she was unable to help her saviour. This is when she met a stranger in a suit eating an apple, and was given a deal. She gained her powers, initially taking the form of two wolves. Since then she served as Hellhound’s right hand. She hasn’t seen the stranger since, but knows he will eventually return for her side of the bargain
objects.title: Artemis

addons.text: A commission for a traditional Japanese Kimono, it was designed with flowers decorating the kimono. Shiroi Hana connects with Angela’s Shades and multiplies their strength by 10x. Aside from that, it can also disguise itself into a variety of different colors and patterns. With some coaxing, Yura also managed to make Angela leave with a Magical Girl outfit, one that is 10 times more frilly than the kimono. The Magical Girl outfit can draw from Angela’s power and revive others without requiring the sacrifice of a slot, on top of also having the ability to enhance Angela’s Shades by 10x.
addons.title: Shiroi Hana

objects.text:
Name: Angela “White” Maloku
Cape Name: Morrigan
Gender: Female
Age: 18
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful
Power: Harvester, Hecatoncheires, Araboth, Best of My Own

White inherited an offshoot of her father’s own ability, most notably manifesting in a form similar to that of the Faerie Queen, but far more powerful and versatile. She has a fully upgraded and realized Harvester (including its addons and other associated and required powers). Additionally, she possesses an ability that increases her shade limit by one every day.

Her other major component is Araboth, which allows her to enhance herself, items, others, as well as her shades, through charges her power provides, allowing her to add enchantments and powers to their repertoire over time, as well as enhancing them overall whenever they pass certain tiers. She regularly uses it on her favorite shades to empower them further. 

Her most important ability is to temporarily sacrifice a slot to bring to life any shade she wishes. She can even bring back the dead with this power. 

She has had her powers since she was a toddler and thus has a truly massive amount of permanent summons, powers, and enchantments at her disposal, as well as normal shades.

Background:
Born as the daughter of Alexander “Green” Maloku on Earth Yarok, Angela would inherit her father’s unique nature and abilities. 

She was often spoiled rotten with love and affection by her father and wanted for nothing during her formative years. Upon first meeting her younger brother, she was at first jealous of the attention he would get from their father, but she grew to love her younger brother quickly enough.

This continued until 2016, when her father disappeared without warning or so much as a goodbye to her or their group. 

What’s more, her father’s civilian identity was seemingly leaked, subsequently outing her and her brother as a result. 

The threat of an incredibly powerful Parahuman that could seemly wield any power, raise the dead, and kill anyone with nothing more than a touch resulted in most of the world fearing her even when she was but a child, the few that didn’t or that could conceal it having hidden agendas of their own. As a result of this she’s become cold to most, rarely trusting those outside the group her father has traveled with, considering them family. 

Her father’s disappearance had greatly affected her, having never truly recovered from his absence despite the strong front she’s put.

This continued for years before she eventually decided to retreat with her brother and remaining family to another earth while looking for her father. 

She had known for a long time that her father was not dead, having attempted to resurrect him for at least once a day for years on end and having been entirely unsuccessful, but she could not communicate with him either. 

After years of no results, she  decided that she would go back to the past to reunite with him that way and hopefully find answers.

Personality:
White is a friendly person, but this is often overshadowed by the mask she puts on to protect herself. Due to this she often comes off as aloof and uncaring to strangers. Despite this, she has a soft spot for her brother and cute things, often causing her mask to crack slightly when interacting with them.
objects.title: White

addons.text:
Nadia died in an accident involving multiple parahumans. She ran out of energy mid-combat and joined Violet’s walking afterlife. Her death went largely unnoticed due to the chaotic situation, and Kei brought her back before anyone could notice. Nadia is one of the few Shades who goes back to pretending they are alive again.

Due to the network, the moment Symbol II got onto it, she created a sanctioned revolution and formed the Chaos Brigade. This sub-group of Violet’s Shades is sent in as first responders to serious events and also reports important events globally. Most of their members are the recently deceased or Shades who aren’t known to have died.

As one of Kei’s Shades, Nadia’s power grows 25 times stronger than it was when she was alive. She also gains access to the other powers at Violet’s disposal.
addons.title: Chaos Brigade

addons.text: Free of charge, Yura created a Magical Girl outfit similar to that of Symbol II’s predecessor. A Magical Girl Equipment that can store energy and save it as a second battery bank for Symbol to use. Her wand is capable of a wider variety of blasts and, at a heavy energy price, can unleash a devastating All-or-Nothing attack.
addons.title: Love & Justice

objects.text:
Name: Nadia Wilde
Gender: Female
Age: 10
Appearance: Attractive (More on the cute side though)

Power: (Energy Well)

Magical Girl Symbol is capable of drawing from a limited amount of energy that regenerates slowly when not in use and while resting. While she has a limited pool to draw on, she can use it with a surprisingly high amount of flexibility. Ranging from enhancing her physical attributes, creating fields that weaken damage, and shooting blasts of energy. With time she could learn even more uses of her power such as flight or healing.

Personality:

Symbol is still young and naive, unaware of the harsh realities of the world. Due to the lack of experience, she exudes a sense of weakness due to being a new cape. But underneath that naivety is someone with determination and empathy. At times she could come off as a bit of a fool, but rarely it would be possible to spot that thinking brain of hers. And then ruin that impression with something childish.

Nonetheless, if anyone is in distress, she will try her utmost to rescue them. Like her hero, she never abandons those who are struggling, no matter the obstacle. She perseveres with unwavering faith and resolve, striving to make a difference. She has a lot to learn, both about herself and the world. In time she would naturally learn about both the light and darkness lurking in humanity's heart and need to grasp how to deal with such conflicts. She also needs to learn how to live her double life without sacrificing either side, as both Symbol and Navia. But regardless of the challenges she will face, she aims to make the world a better brighter place. One person at a time.

Background:

Nadia, who is unknowingly a second-generation cape, was inspired by the late superhero Magical Girl who laid their life down for her. In honor of her hero's memory, Nadia took on their mantle and became Magical Girl Symbol The Second. Despite lacking powers, she strived to be the greatest hero she could be, putting forth her all. Outside of her Magical Girl activities, Nadia is a young student at her local school and has troubles with her daily life. Trying to balance her daily life while moonlighting as a cape is causing trouble for her education and real life. Even so, she still tries to do her best but pushes herself too far oftentimes.

One fateful day, she encountered a suave gentleman in a business suit who offered her a deal and apple juice. She doesn't recall the details of the agreement, due to it being so long ago, only remembering that it granted her newfound strength. Occasionally, she wonders about the agreement's contents, wondering what it all entailed. But what she does know, is that her powers got a boost in its capacity, strength, and versatility somehow. Growing as she uses them and making her stronger.
objects.title: The Second Symbol

objects.text:
Name: Symbol?
Alias: Five
Gender: Female
Age: Unknown
Appearance: Terrifying

Power: (The Void Beyond the Stars + Eternal Flame + Golden Form + Open Eyes + Anti Monitor)

The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is an embodiment of both the void and evil itself, having the ability of effortless and absolute reality warping on a planetary scale. Beyond that range, she still has total dominion over darkness and shadow, with the power to manifest unending hordes of nightmarish shadow abominations and create pockets of emptiness to engulf energy, beings, or entire realms and drag them into the void, either erasing them from existence or enslaving them to her malevolent will if it is a creature. If an entity somehow manages to survive being dragged into the void, they will not live much longer, as the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol can enter and exit the void as she pleases, and due to her connection to the void, she becomes All-Powerful while inside it.

The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol's control over the cosmic veil also allows her to ignore dimensional barriers and any restraints, allowing her to disappear at will and freely travel through the omniverse.

Her mere presence alone will transform the world around her, subconsciously bending space and time to create impossible geometry and spaces that lead back into themselves. The sky will seem to be in perpetual night, and the geography might shift in an instant, creating new pathways and destroying others. Anyone unfortunate enough to find themselves trapped in her domain will find their bodies mutating into monstrous versions of their former selves, a dark reflection of their greatest fears and darkest desires, only desiring the death of anything that crosses their path.

The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is a memetic cognitohazard, When a creature learns of her existence or is actively observing her, she, in turn, gains knowledge of that creature's existence and will be able to infect them, subtly twisting their mind, body, and soul, Draining them of their willpower and sanity until they can do nothing but obey her every whim. The more a target is exposed to the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol, the faster the infection will take over. Even simply looking at a photo of her will cause a dramatic loss of sanity. As a result of this, she is a complete blindspot to all Thinker powers.

When someone is fully corrupted, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol will gain their knowledge, experience, and powers. She is able to access and modify the abilities of anyone she has corrupted, and can grant the abilities to her other victims. If a puppet of hers is destroyed in battle, she can immediately recreate them at full strength.

Due to her connection to evil itself, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is completely immortal. With time, she can recover from anything, even true death and existence erasure. Her death would require the total elimination of the omniversal essence of evil, a truly impossible feat. However, her revivals are not instantaneous, with more complete deaths taking longer amounts of time to come back from. Something such as complete bodily annihilation will heal in an instant, while esoteric attacks such as existence erasure will take days or weeks to heal.

When facing a truly great foe or challenge, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol can transform into a titanic, vaguely humanoid mass of crackling shadows and tendrils with glowing white eyes, with the innumerable faces of her past victims on her torso wailing in agony. In this state, her regeneration will become overclocked to the point that she seems utterly invincible, and the range on her reality warping and void manipulation will be extended to an absurd degree. She will be able to rewrite the universe she inhabits as she pleases, and can utterly shatter dimensional barriers to let her darkness rapidly spread from universe to universe and from timeline to timeline. However, this transformation is not permanent, only lasting for around an hour before she will reverts to her standard appearance and become unable to transform for a week.

Her powers stem from the corruption of the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚, evil acts, and negative emotions. The more that its corruption and evil are spread, the greater her powers will become. 


Background:

Originally, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol was a hero, a magical girl of the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚. She was a woman who sought to spread love and justice across the world. That is, until she came into contact with an avatar of the essence of evil itself. Fooled by its disguise of incompetence, she became close friends with it, not knowing of the malevolent schemer which lied beneath. In a moment of weakness, the evil fooled her into letting it into her mind, infecting her. Once she realized the deceit, she attempted to fight back, but her struggle was in vain. Her mind and soul were warped beyond recognition, her personality erased. She was forced to kill and infect her closest friends, turning them into pawns to serve the evil that had corrupted her.


Personality:

Due to the corruption caused by the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚, The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is seemingly incapable of empathy and remorse, only able to feel joy when inflicting pain onto others. The stronger the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚'s influence is, the less sanity she possesses. If it's influence is strong enough, the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚ may seize total control, making her orders of magnitude stronger than she normally is, allowing her and her puppets to act as a true hivemind, and letting her stay in her eldritch form indefinitely until the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚ relinquishes control. However, there are rare moments when she is alone and regains a semblance of control. And sometimes, when she's all alone, tears can be seen streaming down her face.

Note: The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol does not exist in your chosen world unless she is selected as a companion. When selected, she will retroactively be inserted into the world at a time of your choosing.
