Due to feeling bad for him, Yura created Cloudy Skies for him. It’s a floating halo that stays above him and generates a Stranger effect, making it hard for Michael to be detected. It has a secondary effect of reducing the strain Michael’s powers have on his eyes.
addons.title: Cloudy Skies

objects.text:
Name: Michael
Gender: Non-Binary
Age: ???
Appearance: Monstrous
Powers: Michael is a case 53 who is a massive ball of flesh covered in dozens of eyes, surrounded by a total of six pairs of wings. Each pair of wings has a wingspan of 10 meters. Each feather of these wings is adorned with an eye, each one possessing the ability to function similarly to human eyes, allowing them to see through them regardless of the feather’s distance from their main body. Not only that, but they can use telekinesis to control these feathers with incredible precision within a 1-kilometer radius of their location. Their wings are stronger than steel yet completely weightless. This enhanced durability also extends to the eyes on the feathers. 

Beyond that, Michael has a Trump power that gives them an ability for each eye they have. These powers are always sight-based, such as clairvoyance, petrification gaze, etc. However, they must always have a power active in each of their eyes, resulting in them accidentally using their powers on others. Having the same power active in multiple eyes increases its strength exponentially, at the cost of mental distortion, leaving many problems such as the inability to tell time, read faces, recognize faces, etc.

Personality: Michael is curious, rather childish and kind. However, they have a rather inhuman mindset, having trouble comprehending certain concepts. They genuinely wish to help others, but the way they do so can be morally incorrect, such as feeding the poor with the corpses of criminals, or mind controlling criminals to make them upstanding members of society. 

They have a hobby in reading and writing, particularly enjoying poetry. 
Background: Michael was discovered injured in a destroyed building, with the building itself having been transformed by Michael's powers into a bizarre, otherworldly mess. Despite suffering grave bodily injury, Michael managed to escape the building and was caught on camera in the process. Due to Michael's actions, appearance, and striking resemblance to the entity known as the Simurgh, they were quickly labelled as a villain - an undeserved title that Michael would do anything to shake off.

Michael's reputation as a villain continued to grow, as they were later seen launching brutal attacks against other supervillains and subsequently attempting to "rehabilitate" criminals. With their unorthodox methods and lack of concern for the consequences, Michael's actions earned them further scorn and fear, cementing their position as a scourge within the criminal underworld. Yet, what they truly sought was not chaos and disorder, but justice and retribution - a desire that many did not understand, and one that ultimately served as the driving force behind their destructive and disruptive behaviour.
objects.title: Lucifer

addons.text: A commission from a man with blonde hair and glasses, Yura had to create a suit to match the coldly professional businessman Salvatore. While not frilly, The Suit is capable of helping Salvatore grant more wishes per person every month. Later, after some events, Salvatore offered her wishes, but he couldn’t accomplish what she wanted.
addons.title: Bellbringer

objects.text:
Name: Salvatore "Sal" Carloni
Gender: Male
Age: 36
Appearance: Masculine, Attractive

Power: (Master) Geas + (Master) Mascot + (Thinker/Stranger) Taboo + Don't Speak Her Name! + (Stranger/Thinker) Discount Genie + Prayers received, Wishes granted. + Monkey Paw + Genie from Wish.com

Sal possesses the ability to fulfill wishes, for himself and others, within certain constraints. The wishes he can grant are limited to 3 wishes per person per month (including himself) and they must be theoretically possible for him to have completed within a year. If these conditions are met, reality will alter to fulfil the wish according to either the desires of the individual or Sal himself. Sal can also enforce binding contract agreements between others and himself for each wish he grants. If all parties agree to the contract, they will be bound to fulfil the terms due to a Master effect.

Sal also possesses a strong secondary Thinker power: a multiversal awareness of whenever someone is referring to him, be it by his name, title etc. This awareness extends to the location of the individual as well as the context in which his name was used. He can use this connection to temporarily express a projection of himself in a 20-metre radius around the person who used his name, permitting him to offer and use his wish-granting abilities.

Skills: Connection, Presentation, Polyglot

Background: 

Salvatore "Sal" Carloni was born on Earth Taw, an earth technologically equal to the early 1900s and going through a slow industrial revolution driven by electricity and renewable energy instead of fossil fuels. Sal triggered at a young age when he had a major altercation with his parents as a teenager, resulting in him becoming disowned and homeless. He entered into a life of crime, using his power to work his way up until he was the head of his own powerful, widespread organisation.

Sal was contacted by Cauldron as a young adult, becoming aware of the multiverse. Striking a deal, Sal would offer wishes to individuals on behalf of Cauldron for 'favours' when they did not desire power vials. In exchange, he would gain access to other Earths and remain an independent contractor. Through this, word has spread through hundreds of Earths of the "Goodfellow" who can grant wishes for a price if you speak his name.

Sal's true power comes from the sheer number of 'favours', connections and influence he has built up over almost two decades across the multiverse, dramatically expanding what he is theoretically capable of doing within a year and so the potency of his wishes. He can sometimes be spotted having a drink with a man with blonde hair and glasses, and a woman wearing a suit and a fedora.

Personality: 

To most, Sal gives the impression of a coldly professional businessman, particularly when engaging in deals for wishes. Typically apathetic and indifferent, Sal's decades of granting wishes in return for 'favours' across the multiverse have caused him to develop a level of callousness, particularly concerning his work with Cauldron although he's sociable to some of their members.

He remains independent and elusive to most, maintaining his privacy to the vast number of people he has met over the years, but for a few select individuals to whom he considers close friends. He typically respects the spirit of any agreement he enters into and expects others to do the same. He has a knack for dry sardonic humour.
objects.title: Mr. Goodfellow

addons.text: A strange skeleton covered in some kind of slime, when they first met, Yura got jumpscared. But after that initial meeting, she came to see him as a nice individual. As an apology for stabbing him with a sword, she created Glimmer. A strange small orb the size of a marble that Gello keeps within his eye socket. It can store and compress slime inside of itself and greatly expands the range he can control it.
addons.title: Glimmer

objects.text:
Name: Gello
Gender: Male
Age: ???
Appearance: Attractive

Power: Slime, (Changer) Self-Biokinesis

Gello is a case 53, his true body is a black skeleton. By itself, he is unable to move or do anything, and is extremely vulnerable to blunt damage.

He is capable of creating white, semi-translucent slime-like substance that he can control telekinetically within a 5 meter radius. This slime has the ability to mimic biological lifeforms, which Gello uses to create a pseudo human body around his skeleton to move and see. In combat, he uses it to create claws, wings or stingers. A fun fact is that his slime tastes like Mayo, hence his cape name.

Backstory:

Gello’s first memory is a traumatic one, awakening in a coffin within an unmarked grave. It took hours of perseverance to escape the claustrophobic space, leaving him with a permanent fear of enclosed areas. Despite the fear, Gello joined the Wards, determined to uncover his past and learn more about himself. He can sometimes be seen meeting with a well dressed man, always returning from said meeting with a well drawn, hand sized painting and looking more determined to help others.

Personality:

Gello is a gentle, kind and supportive individual who is willing to put others' needs above their own. Despite a slight aversion to taking risks, Gello is dedicated and loyal to his friends. Their well-being is his top priority, and he will go to great lengths to protect and help them, even if it requires making sacrifices.
objects.title: Mayo Lich

addons.text:
A commission to slow down or halt the process of Maria’s body being converted into Shard-matter. Maria was swept away by Yura’s descriptions of the necessity of frills and left it to Yura’s choice. Due to this, Yura was given full creative freedom and created Defragmentation. A blue Magical Girl outfit that stabilizes faulty Shard connections and slowly reverses the crystalline state she is in. Defragmentation is equipped with a variety of scanners that send data directly to her mind for the purpose of gathering more detailed information.

Yura was able to figure out how the broken shard link works and overlaid its functions onto Maria’s Magical Girl outfit. The more it gets damaged, the more it converts to Shard-mass, which grants improved defense. After some time, the mass will be refined into the outfit. Using the mass on itself, it can gain the properties of Maria’s powers, and the more mass it has, the more powers it can have.
addons.title: Defragmentation

objects.text: Name: Maria Cruz Other Aliases: Myriad, [&#^^&$@^*(%] Gender: Female Age: 28 Appearance: Attractive (Deformed) Power: [C53: Lucky Mutation "???" | SHARD: Split + Connection + [Query] [Response] + Unnamed anti-Trump/Master (~20 SP; "Broken"); Assorted low-mid T1 powers (~100 SP)] Sliver's power is a complex affair, due to the nature of her Shard's malfunctioning; her "core" power that she would have obtained had her trigger been normal would have been a Trump/Thinker ability to allow her to obtain the memories and skills of a target by contact, on top of any powers they might've had. While she still mostly retains this aspect - having collected a considerable array of street-tier powers from lesser Capes over her time as a Parahuman - the unintentional jailbreaking and faulty connection she experienced expanded her powers far beyond previous limits. In addition to her base power and her collection, the malformed [Passenger]-[Host] link has granted her a trio of potent supplementary "powers", effectively weaponized Shard Deviancy: First is a Thinker/Trump ability to [Ping] other Shards for information, gaining knowledge on other [Hosts], their [Passengers] and their power expressions, enabling use of her core power beyond touch-range via proxy, if at reduced efficiency. Second is a Trump ability to modulate the [Data] flow and [Communication] of her own [Passenger], fine-tuning their link in order to loosen or release limitations beyond what the cycle should allow, at the expense of furthering their mental degredation and increasing the risk of fugue-states. Third is a host of anti-Trump/Thinker/Master protections focused around favorable priorities; simply put, attempts at stealing or transferring her powers will fail unless brute-forced by a more powerful opposing Shard or an Entity due to lack of administrative access, and attempts at copying will similarly fail unless the power expressions are manually analyzed. Similarly, Thinker/Master effects that attempt to gather info or manipulate her through [&#^^&$@^*(%], such as [Broadcast], will also fail due to lack of access. Lastly, the faulty trigger and connection has left her as a Monstrous Cape after a fashion; due to having experienced a sort of "half-Broken" Trigger, her original body is actively being replaced with Shard-matter in a crystalline state - slowly but surely, and with every injury taken, granting her low-level regeneration, increased durability and longevity. Background: Originally a college student out on the west coast, Maria's life was painfully mundane, with only slightly above-average intelligence and minor paranoid and anxious tendencies marking her life pre-trigger. Her Trigger was even somewhat of a fluke; while having a Corona Pollentia, the backend of her connection was ruined by Eden's crash, and it was only due to luck that her shard still functioned enough to make a connection under its own power as she was caught up in a life-and-death fight between the local independent heroes and a ruthless villain who tried to lay claim to her town. As she was held as a hostage alongside several others, and the minutes dragged on into hours of negotiation, something inside her shifted when the situation turned sour as her Shard finally managed to establish a [CONNECTION]. As one of the few Shards to survive Eden's crash without being completely crippled, [&#^^&$@^*(%] was left unstable but still operational, with several safety features - both to prevent the [Host] from being too disruptive, and to keep the [Passenger] from going into territory outside of the cycle - completely disabled or removed, effectively undergoing the Shard equivalent of getting a reformat to directives/priorities and full administrative access to itself outside the Network, yet also a sort of partial Titanhood as its [Passenger]-[Host] connection had the metaphorical "floodgates" thrown open, with all the fighting for control - at least, at first - and mental corruption that followed. Personality: Maria is, in so many words, extremely damaged; between overuse of Split and the surges of new memories it inflicts, her abuse of Connection to push her powers even higher, and the lingering trauma from her Trigger Event, she's ended up developing several assorted neurotic and borderline-PTSD tendencies, alongside a growing lack of/disconnect from humanity. While at her core a genuinely compassionate and altruistic person, wanting to right wrongs and prevent further ones however she can, Maria is plagued by anxiety, twitchiness and manic energy, and a general grudge against and distrust of Capes - especially those who act two-faced - though not Parahumans as a whole. Additionally, due to the effects of her "broken" power blurring the lines between her and her Passenger, she occasionally lapses into "Shard-brained" fugue states, with her and [&#^^&$@^*(%] being unable to distinguish between each other and acting in an inhuman "results-come-first" manner, taking on a much more cold and pragmatic approach to her normal attempts at heroism, and adding both a compulsive need to acquire more [DATA] and a more warped logic to her decisions that most tend to have a hard time grasping.
objects.title: Sliver

addons.text: A commission for clothing that appears casual but has some fancy tricks stored in its pocket. Heart of Cards is an outfit that can change its appearance freely while having a pocket dimension allowing the storage of various equipment if needed. Though Yura was not even sure if Luthor was a Parahuman in the end, she did manage to create neat, comfortable, and casual clothing for her client. She also managed to incorporate a somewhat generic feature that boosts any Parahuman powers Luthor may have.
addons.title: Heart of Cards

objects.text: Aye, siwmae! How can we help each other? Name: Luther Penndraigg Gender: Nonbinary Age: 17 Appearence: Attractive Power: Perfect Host + Alloy Fusion Luther exists in a highly specific quantum superposition. While this is almost useless as he is constantly under observation from himself. It makes him the Perfect Host for a number of outside entities due to the subtle changes in him as a physical and metaphysical entity. While this does nothing on its own, it allows anything that needs a partner or ‘Host’ to operate to view him as an ideal candidate, and use Luther with greater efficiency. The ability to close off this favourable connection ensures more sentient beings ‘deal’ rather than take. Background: Luther Penndraigg was a relatively normal child before he fell directly into a live piece of Tinkertech designed by his father to create ‘infinite’ energy by syphoning it from other possible realities. After being hospitalised for a number of years as a result, he found the tools and artefacts of his, now very deceased, father’s lab aren’t as volatile as one would expect from tinkertech abandoned for almost a decade. Personality: Luther is a smarmy git. Slow, observational and careful he often believes himself to hold most cards in any room unless it’s significantly weighted against him. That said, when stressed this quickly becomes a tendency to violence and a scramble to hold leverage once again. The transactional relationship with his father and a number of years in the foster system has led to a feeling of safety being correlated to said leverage.
objects.title: Luther Penndraigg

objects.text: What am I, Chopped liver? Cape Name: Taliesin Gender: Male Age: 23 Appearance: Ugly (case 53) Power: (Master/Trump) Scepter of Power (+ Remembrance + Archive of Expressions + Royal Scepter) + (Trump/Shaker) Don't mess with a white mage (+Celestial Intervention) Backstory: Maegwynn Lascarii is a Welsh Case-53 that by all accounts does not remember most of his life. Appearing on the outskirts of a village in North-Wales, Maegwynn quickly attracted the attention of UK-based cape team ‘The King’s Men’. Reaping the benefits of an unusual body plan and a magic-seeming set of powers, Mae was fashioned into a Druid-esc figure in the King’s Men’s lineup. After the group was opened to private investors during Austerity, he has a moderately successful merchandise line. Personality: Maegwynn is a willful but deeply insecure person who struggles to balance a genuine desire to live a completely mundane and normal life with a deep seeded need for validation and the everyday struggles of existing as an ‘unappealing’ ‘Monster Cape’. Mae does not like the term ‘Case 53’ and would honestly rather be called a slur.
objects.title: Maegwynn Lascarii

objects.text: “Worse things happen at sea, you know,” Name: Mita Ocondria Cape Name: Twrch Trwyth Gender: Male Age: 19 Appearance: Ugly (case 53) Power: (Changer/Trump) Pokemon, (Master/Trump) Pokémon Go, Pokémon: Let's Go! Backstory: Mita Ocondria found themselves dropped unceremoniously into the centre of Belfast ten years ago. Understandably based on their appearance, they were quickly ‘acquired’ by the King’s Men during its brief period of ownership by the British Government. After it went private during Austerity, Mita lost much of the enthusiasm towards the group after he and… select co-workers began being sidelined into a ‘B-Team’ after ‘Persistent Market Research’ showed they had low marketability. Personality: Bouncy and loud, Mita can often be found socialising with whoever and whatever crosses his path. He shares a london flat with three housemates (although he is allegedly a bad roommate) and earns enough to make a habit of seeing Crusaders football matches live when able (much to the chagrin of Matty matthews, one of the aforementioned roommates).
objects.title: Mita Ocondria

objects.text: “Symbols live forever” Name: Flint Adeboye Cape Name: Splitscreen (IV) Gender: Male Age: 26 Appearance: Average Power: (Master/Tinker) The Spark of Life + (Shaker/Striker) Mechanicus Aura + (Striker) Machine Spirit + Spirit of All Things + (Trump/Tinker) Enhancer Backstory: Splitscreen is a legacy monaker, first belonging to a german Tinker during the first emergence. After his death, another tinker took his cape name and armour, believing he was worth more as a symbol than a martyr. Splitscreen II (Formerly Cortechs), being an informational tinker developed a device to amalgamate the memories and ‘experience’ of each Splitscreen mantle, one all later splitscreens have used/maintained to ensure it can be used later. Splitscreen III (Formerly Nightrider), being a more combat focused Tinker updated the armour to its current standard. Following her own death, the title has passed to the Birmingham-based Overclock. Overclock was a mechanic-turned-Support member of the King’s Men, possessing both the ability to create transforming machines and a Tinkertech-maintenance and enhancement aura to ensure their continued function. He actively took the mantle of Splitscreen following the active refusal of Nightrider’s ‘preferred’ candidate (A Brute named Blockade). Naturally, the identity of ‘Splitscreen’ is a closely guarded secret, though it is widely acknowledged within the cape scene there must have been at least two. This, however is due to the fact in late 2010, a disgruntled PRT employee leaked the digital reproduction of Split Screen IV as of the most recent backup, leading to multiple black market ‘copies’ of varying quality, make and use. Toybox’s policy of selling these copies at a premium is one of the many reasons they garner large-scale attention from the King’s Men when cells are discovered. Splitscreen is largely deployed ‘alone’ with an entourage of robots created by Overclock’s power. Most commonly accompanied by at the very least two, though commonly up to five, this does tend to make Splitscreen a force multiplier of sorts. This is largely unremarked upon, it’s assumed Splitscreen merely constructed these robots during ‘post-endbringer leave’, after all his ‘specialty’ isn’t publicly known. Armoured in Nightrider’s (adjusted) armour and armed with both Faux-tinker tech he makes an imposing figure. Personality: Splitscreen VI is conflicted. Much of their time is given to deciphering which parts of their memories and history is ‘Overclock’ and what belongs to ‘Splitscreen’. It’s a legacy that’s swallowed his entire life, mind and soul, crawled into his skin and looks out of his eyes to tell him what to do. As with most SPlitscreens, he’s on the lookout for a ‘successor’ should the worst come to pass, despite Blockade’s active insistence on letting the mantle die as a ‘Cancerous growth’.
objects.title: Splitscreen (IV)

objects.text: “I’m smokin’ that shit that makes the primordial stillbirth regain it’s consciousness!,” Name: Dadriel ae Tamoth! Cape Name: N/A Gender: Be Not Afraid Age: Questionable Appearance: Average (Case 53) Power: Magitek Nouliths + Nexus Arcanum + Familiar (One Object) x 2 + Reincarnated as a [REDACTED] but my [REDACTED] is [REDACTED] and the prom is tomorrow! Backstory: Dadriel is a small creature that nonetheless has been alive for several centuries. Part of a species of consummate scavengers, they ride the trail of Entities for easy meals, scavenging the remains, and potentially finding separate hosts to parisitise. This relationship is similar to that of pilot fish. Unfortunately, Dadriel got caught in the jetstream and arrived far too early, crashing to earth. Luckily there are many valid hosts, and their species do seem notably gullible. Currently it’s under Cauldron observation, but is allowed to roam free on the Scottish highlands due to the fact it’s really not any form of major issue. Personality: Dadriel believes it’s far more impressive than it is. To hear it say, it’s a being of incredible primordial might and power capable of feeling civilisations with a fitting host. This is patently untrue. It claims to have taken part in intergalactic wars for the fate of galaxies. This is also untrue. Very few of its words should be taken as true, in fact. It enjoys annoying people and praise and it will make this fact whoever's problem feels correct at the time. It’s current host is one Jaheda Salik who is in the unfortunate position of modulating it’s outbursts and impulsivity Given she still has to sleep when it does not, this is quite difficult.
objects.title: Dadriel, the Parasite

addons.text:
Welcome to the King's-Men, the UK’s (formally) government sponsored cape team with branches around the country. These divisions are usually situated directly on top of cities with broad jurisdiction within them. 

The general training for a King’s Man consists of general combat and arrest training similar to metropolitan police supplemented with a period acting as ‘Squire’ to an established member (usually all completed within the Central Office in London) before full graduation to the team and assignment to a location. Young and Junior members meanwhile are required to stay on as a ‘Squire’ until Sixteen or Twenty depending on various circumstances and factors.

Unfortunately, as of the 2010 Cameron-Clegg coalition, and the Austerity measures introduced therein, the King’s Men have started to take corporate and wealthy singular sponsors out of necessity, leading to a wider ‘commercialisation’ of the team, much to the chagrin of many. 

It is generally unusual for King’s Men to keep their public and private identities separate, but not unheard of, especially for those in more public positions or with a background in American Heroics.
addons.title: The King's Men

objects.text: ”The more the merrier,” Name: Guitulth Ddraigg Gwyn Cape Name: Ddraigg Gwyn Gender: Male Age: Unknown Appearance: (Case 53) Power: (Trump/Master) Butcher + Pillage + (Changer) Bio-Assimilation Backstory: The beast that would become known as Gitulth awoke in London shortly after the Simurgh’s 2008 attack. Unfortunately for everyone involved, the United Kingdom’s reluctance to quarantine the city lead to multiple unopposed ‘simurgh-bombs’. Guitulth, being assumed to be unaffected due to his non-existence on Earth-Bet during the attack, was quickly bundled into a Kings-Men taskforce to ‘deal’ with these individuals. This Is when his main power made itself known, actively and disgustingly growing organs, pieces and on one occasion even a full head for each parahuman killed. In the following years, his easy draconic marketability and field experience made him a shoe-in for leadership in the South-West Kingsmen during it’s separation from the welsh-branch. Currently Gitulth is housed in Bristol, having three children, Oen, Pynkh and Grekkle. Personality: Imperious and relatively introspective for a dragon the size of a Subaru Outback, Guitulth has repeatedly ‘made lemons’ out of the situation handed to him. That said, as with much of the South-West Kings men, he’s not nearly as enchanted with the organisation under austerity, and the Cameron Government’s insistence the organisation seek ‘investment’. Not the least of his issues is that he actually has to read over and approve his team’s merchandising rights. It certainly forms an opinion to see your organisation saving money on merchandise manufacturing costs by claiming you don’t count as human.
objects.title: Guitulth Ddraigg Gwyn

objects.text: "Nothing Stays," Name: Marcus(?) Gender: Nonbinary Age: Questionable Appearance: Ugly (case 53) Power (Self-Rewrite + Self-Inserting for Days + New Game + (Master/Trump) Drawing Board + Rewrite) Marcus has a near-unlimited control over his own physical form and capabilities as well as their own history. Specifically they tend to prefer non-obtrusive changes to history just to streamline their life and existence, especially considering any new form they find themselves in. A true Retroactive Shapeshifter. Backstory: Marcus Mask was a child when Scion appeared. This is a lie. Marcus Mask was trapped beneath the radioactive rubble in New York. This is a lie. Marcus Mask was a founding member of the Protectorate. This is a lie. Marcus Mask is a nascent endbringer. This is a lie. Marcus Mask is the Entities attempt to preserve causality. This is a lie. Marcus Mask is a refugee from another universe. This is a lie. Marcus Mask has been drifting to and from a thousand bodies over a thousand lifetimes for a thousand reasons. Unlimited Power Bores Absolutely. Recently, Marcus has been experimenting with global edits and insertions. Personality: Marcus Mask is mercurial to a fault. Easily bored and flighty he whips from lie to lie and shape to shape to find some core to hold on to for a time. If he ever actually gained a reason or a cause, he’d be a force to be reckoned with, but as it is, he’s nothing but a wanderer only bound by fleeting interest.
objects.title: Marcus Mask

objects.text: Beginning trial 53... Name: Wren House Gender: Male Age: 51 Appearance: Average Power: (Tinker) Oh the Humanity, (Tinker) Bloody Tinker Backstory: Dr Wren House spent most of his life in and out of hospitals and research clinics at the behest of his father. When he was old enough, he specialised in biochemistry at his university, and completed a separate MD. He’d had Lymphocytic Leukemia since he was a boy, and spent much of his career as a researcher specialising in the disease, and much of his career as a doctor specialising in its treatment. When an interesting startup calling itself ‘Haemat’ reached out to him while searching for researchers, the money was too good to meaningfully ignore. Unfortunately, as he was working his condition continued to worsen, not helped from the remote location in the Welsh countryside and the long hours he kept. That was until one day, Wren made a breakthrough, every analysis confirmed it, and he was assured of his own success, submitting it in its totality to his superiors, not realising what he had actually accomplished. Haemat management took one look at the documentation, and the secondary testing, and sent it up the chain. Unfortunately, TinkerTech isn’t well known for being mass producible, reliable, stable, or profitable given the numerous legal statutes designed to protect consumers from “Tinkertech” remedy scams. Thankfully, under the table, it would be incredibly profitable in higher quantities. Thus, after making brief contact directly with Dr House, the board unanimously set aside a black budget and a blanket permission, selling the facility into a shell-company. And Doctor Wren House was left alone in the summer of 1992 in the welsh wilderness with several million pounds and no oversight, as long as he produces his remedy quota. And so he began to unravel. He made clones of himself by the dozen, making tweaks, adding new technologies and tests into each batch to see if they’d fare any better. He tested the boundaries of his specialty and the clones abilities besides. The more notable clones tended to leave what was rapidly turning into a compound. Wren 3, Wren 21, Wrens 55 & 58, but there were ever more being born each year, each more experimental and infused than the last. Losing a few wasn’t of consequence. If losing the children was ever of consequence he’d probably have removed the Leukemia from a few. Personality: Wren House is a cult leader. He’s spent the last twenty years alone but for the odd corporate visitor and a series of clones, his primary concern is his ‘work’ and the fact that after several decades of trying his own supply, his Leukemia has progressed from the mundane to truly esoteric. The clones are always a means to an end, but he knows better than to give them an alternative. They were born in the compound and they exist by his graces, they’re well by his graces. For the few with some true tinkertech integrated into them the only reason they can still function is because he deigns to spend his time with them, they’re favoured, they’re his favourites. And children should never disappoint their father. Outside of his ‘family’, he’s quiet. Any form of social grace he had has long since left him sometime in the last two decades. Brusc, and to the point, quick to anger and slot to forget. There’s an implication that he really does hate what his life has become, but if it’s going to be fixed then he has to be the one to fix it. It must be within his control, utterly and completely, and anything beyond that control must remain outside of his walled garden.
objects.title: Wren House

objects.text: Sometimes the only way out is as a carcass,” Name: ‘Alpha Iota’ (Wren House 46) Gender: ??? Age: 19 Appearance: Average Power: (Tinker/Master) Machine World, C53: Robotkin, Secondary Powers Alpha Iota fundamentally can extrude technology they understand from themselves, including the very helpful secondary ability to understand most tinkertech once they can take it apart, even if it stops working the near instant it’s fully extruded. Unfortunately they have also actively abandoned their body and become completely digital and reliant on a series of ‘temporary’ units that are technically owned by the King's Men as an organisation rather than themself. Backstory: Wren House Senior is a cloning tinker. This is widely considered a bad thing for everyone involved. Needless to say the compound in rural Wales where he keeps the cavalcade of Wren-Juniors only kept within means of control by Tinkertech ‘gifts’ and near death (and not so near death) experiences, sees its fair share of crisis points. As all the Wrens contain Corona Pollentias, they all have the capacity to trigger, even if few have to date. Alpha Iota immediately jetted his brain into the information superhighway at mach speeds, striking deals with whatever agency he needed to be as far away from Ceredigion as possible. Very unfortunately this led him to the King's Men, where he currently works as Tinker and Chief against all better judgement and thought while pulling in a tidy sum based on merchandising his different bodies. Personality: Alpha is difficult to work with. He’s abrasive, snarky, and just the right side of attracted to drama and gossip that were he born a decade later he’d make an astounding twitch streamer. Unfortunately as he is, in his current situation (attempting to find a stable and permanent physical body that isn’t technically owned by corporate ‘sponsors’) he’s filled with a form of impotent desperation and contempt found most commonly in particularly stressed badgers.
objects.title: Alpha Iota

objects.text: Name: Benjamin Hall Gender: Male Age: 23 Appearance: Attractive Name: Jennifer Hall Gender: Female Age: 19 Appearance: Attractive Powers Benny: Harem (Grrl Power), Ten Commandments, Power of a Human Sacrifice, Ringbearer, Manus Superior, Jenny: Osmosian (Ben 10), Across the YOU-niverse + Into the You-niverse, Manus Superior, Forma Dominae Backstory: Benjamin and Jennifer Hall were accepted into the Nelson School for Gifted Youth from their previous occupation, which was setting various foster homes on fire for perceived slights. Benjamin and Jennifer Hall went on a roadtrip with their grandfather Mark and found something strange in the Romanian woods. Benjamin and Jennifer Hall stand together in their room. It just so happens today is their birthday. Benjamin and Jennifer Hall broke their place in the universe in some fantastical ways. Between Benny making the portal and Jenny’s gauntlet guiding them, they’ve been traveling universes longer than either of them can actually remember meaningfully, looking for something that interests them, or at least holds them for a while. Any bond, any connection they can scrounge, but every time without fail they always find an excuse to leave, because no matter where they go, they always have to take themselves with them. Personality: The two have been jumping from world to world never setting down anything they can’t pack up immediately. Incursive, Transient, and unattached. To Benny it’s almost academic, a test to see how far he can go and how much he can do on an infinite canvas. To Jenny it’s running from tragedy to catastrophe one after another never stopping for a minute to think about everything they’ve seen or done. It’s their lives, and they have to live it. Benny is wandering through, trying on new masks every universe, sometimes more. Duke, Damocles, Dogma, Dagnues, Diesel, Dexter again and again finding something that fits for a time and reshaping himself to match. He supports himself, he doesn’t want nor need anyone else’s assistance. When his arm was blown off he reshaped a sphere and kept moving. It’s all momentum, like a shark/ Keep swimming or you drown. Jenny jumps in, always her, always unapologetic. Collecting bodies and shapes to try on and insisting each is still her (even in spite, or perhaps because of the rapidly maturing intelligence on her wrist). She wants to break out while still having the stability to move. When her arm was blown off she still needed help from her brother, always falling back on the same people in the same way forever. It’s all impulse, sudden motion and never the inertia to actually consider.
objects.title: The Twins

objects.text: ‘I’ve killed more men than you’ve had hot dinners, how about you don’t question my age at least,’ Gender: Male Age: 12 (physical), 63 (actual) Power: Raptor Amulet (Marvel) Backstory: Sec is a decorated member of the Fraternity of Raptors and a true zealot for the cause. As the Raptors fundamentally exist in order to progress Shi’ar interests, Sec’s service is almost exclusively limited to destabilising their enemies. Notably however, this comes at a strange price. Using the Raptor Amulet that is one part religious relic and another war machine, does not allow the Raptor’s body to age while it is used. This means Sec, who has spent the better part of five decades in service to the fraternity still barely pubescent outside of it. Personality: Sec is a zealot through and through. The advancement of the Shi’ar and the Raptors as a result is his duty and a duty he has continued to follow for many, many years. This has however rendered him quite strange. The Shi’ar consider the creation of most forms of art ‘mental deviencies’, yet Sec sings while he works, The Shi’ar is a monoculture, but he does not worship their gods. It’s highly likely that were he born anywhere else, he would not be as lenient to the Shi’ar, but he is a Raptor, and Raptors serve the Shi’ar.
objects.title: Raptor Sec

objects.text: ’In retrospect, Fireball was the correct option,’ Gender: Wizard Power: Wizard (Lucky Mutation), Archmagus (Lucky mutation), (Trump) Arcanist, (Trump/Tinker) Artificer, (Trump/Tinker) Armiger, Archmage Backstory: Magus awoke in the Outer Hebrides in 2005. It took a full year for it to be reported to the King’s Men, having constructed a rather large and isolated tower oozing a strange mist that covered the landscape. Initially, this causes quite a bit of contention with the King’s Men as a reclusive ‘Tinker’ that builds a large base in a remote location is not usually something that appeals to the vast majority of powers. Magus, However, managed to attain a relatively lucrative deal, supplying equipment and arms to the Kings’ Men as an organisation in exchange for an ‘exclusivity deal’ of a kind, that being that their works will not be sold through Toybox (whom the Kings Men still pursue rigorously following the Splitscreen incident) and that any works that disseminate outwards are Magus’s responsibility to retrieve. While this was initially thought to be in the King’s Men’s favour, the first time it rendered a would-be thief to just another portion of his mist, this position became more strained. Like many British Case 53s, Magus is a creature of vaguely worrying appearance largely filtered through a twee and mystical lens. For Magus, this is largely relegated to being ‘The Wizard’. While not officially a member of the King’s Men, virtually all of Magus’ human contact is with Kings’ Men contacts or the exceedingly small population of the island they built their tower upon. Personality: Magus is a solitary creature. Not exactly introverted but rather just deeply strange. They construct sentences as complete run ons and ramble and rant to nobody in particular. It can be quite affable if approached on good terms, but is also prone to startling and nervous movement. Magus quite enjoys being remote, annoyed by loud sounds and comforted by habit and strict routine.
objects.title: Magus

addons.text: One of the sample equipment stolen from Yura’s shop while she wasn’t looking, was further modified to be on par with Yura’s commissioned equipment. This unknown piece of equipment with an unknown name contains all the standard equipment that is expected from Asphalt while containing more stranger features. Such as an on-command surreal 360 speaker that allows anyone can hear the user’s voice from large distances. This equipment also possesses an unknown quantity of pockets that contain all kinds of strange devices of questionable purposes. As a side note, there seems to be a button on the wrist that summons 40 cakes from anywhere in the world. That is as many as four tens. And that’s terrible.
addons.title: EVIL!!!

addons.text: Nadia’s eternal rival, Netty spouts strange but factually incorrect information about her. Or rather most of it is just wrong? Since Nadia does not remember ever blowing up the moon. Regardless, as Nadia’s eternal rival this leads to conflict. One attempts to cause as much trouble as possible and the other wishes to stop her. While it happens every week, it always seems to end without much damage.
addons.title: Rivals

objects.text:
Name: Unknown
Alias: Netty
Gender: Unknown, replies "EVIL!" when asked
Age: Adult
Appearance: Androgynous

Power: (Clarktech + Reproduction + Shadow Stalker)

Netty is a tinker who specializes in the extremely broad and powerful category of Clarktech, technology so advanced that it's indistinguishable from magic. With this, Netty can make basically anything they want with enough time and effort. Ranging from relatively simple creations such as a machine that creates muffins on command to an esoteric contagion that turns infected victims into bloodthirsty clones of Santa. In addition to their primary specialization, Netty can replicate any Tinkertech they've analyzed and improve it to a substantial degree.

Aside from their tinker powers, Netty can meld into shadows and travel through them.

Background:

Not a lot is known about Netty's origins, aside from the fact that they suddenly appeared one day and started causing trouble with their inventions. When asked about their past, Netty claimed that they are, in fact, an avatar of evil itself, saying they hailed from a dimension of pure concentrated darkness, and that they have come to conquer the universe in its name and subjugate all things under their heel. Their story has been regarded as delusional ramblings.

Personality:

Netty can best be described as a massive chunnibyo with a penchant for long, dramatic monologues about their latest and greatest superweapon which more often than not blows up in their face when the heroes quietly steal a vital component while Netty monologues. Much to their chagrin, Netty's escapades are more comical than anything else, with them frequently achieving none of their evil goals and being more of an inconvenience than anything else.
objects.title: YOUR DOOOM!!!!

addons.text: Because of the people around her, Yura begins to slowly piece her life back together, and the spark of her passion reignites. Encouraged by a newfound friend who recognizes her potential, she starts to clean and organize her Tinker base. She ventures into creating new designs and new works on new technology. Gradually, the vibrant energy she once possessed returns, and she finds joy in her craft again. Her reputation begins to be restored as word spreads about her return. Yura is no longer the broken shell of her past but instead begins forging a bright new path.
addons.title: Courage & Passion

addons.text:
Asphalt died in a series of events that involved people attacking her with the hopes of getting her equipment. Having embraced death, she did not expect to find herself in a strange afterlife. However, being here cheered her up as she was finally able to achieve her life’s goal and reunite with those she had lost.

Yura now operates as leader of the Innovation Brigade, a collective of normal people and Tinkers who share their specialties to create equipment for each other. The Innovation Brigade serves as a supplier of Tinkertech equipment for Violet and the rest of her Shades.
addons.title: Innovation Brigade

objects.text:
Name: Yura Escritora
Cape Name: Asphalt
Gender: Female
Age: 22
Appearance: Attractive (Disfigured)

Powers: Cache (Personalised, Amplifier & Dampener, Artisan, Weaving)

Yura is a tinker who can create anything she wants, working best with personalizing equipment. She can craft equipment for specific people in mind that greatly amplifies their power if she gets enough time to study the person. Her personalized equipment is capable of precisely suiting the wielder’s needs and can grant abilities that supplement them. For example, Brutes can have anti-gravity ribbons for increased mobility and flight. 

Her specialty is designing artistic and functional clothing that are both beautiful and practical. She can compress an insane amount of technology into the weaves of clothing and despite looking soft they can easily take a lot of damage. Her Magnum Opus is the Magical Girl Series, by adding more frills it adds even more area for her to work with to create even stronger equipment. And every Magical Girl Series equipment she makes directly connects to a person to instantly quickly change into it no matter where they are by being stored in Shardspace. Having mastered the art of this clothing paired with the data she can analyze of a person, she can boost the strength of someone’s powers by 1000%. The only thing she cannot do is revive the dead.

Background:

Yura is an independent Tinker who specializes in creating Magical Girl equipment for others. For males, she offers the Magical Girl Series B equipment, which resembles a suit and tie. Although Series B isn’t as strong as Series A due to the lack of frills, it still provides significant enhancements. Yura was widely respected and relied upon for her powerful, albeit uniquely frilly, cape costumes.

As a cluster cape and the last one remaining, Yura’s inherited power has grown stronger. However, the tragic loss of those she held dear shattered her spirit. The death of the original Symbol has greatly impacted her. Overwhelmed by grief, she closed down her business and withdrew from cape activities. Convincing her to return to her craft will require assistance, as she has trouble grappling with her sorrows.

Personality:

A complete mess who has lost her purpose in life, Yura is unsure where to go from here. Her Tinker base is in disarray, mirroring her current state of mind. Once an introvert who was brought out of her shell by a hyperactive extrovert, she now feels utterly lost without that guiding presence. Her once meticulous personality has become fragmented, and she struggles to find the motivation to continue.

Despite her current state, there remains some hope. Yura’s innate talent for art and the workshop she created still hold potential. With the right support and encouragement, she might find a new path forward, rediscovering her purpose. The journey to reclaiming her place as the de facto costume Tinker will be challenging, but it is not impossible.
objects.title: Asphalt

addons.text: The first outfit Yura ever made. A formal black suit with a white cape made of a unique blend of unstable molecules and high-strength fibers. It was designed with a mix of a fancy black tie suit but with elements of a cape and frills. It’s a suit that can take in and use three of Mary’s slotted powers even if they are not active. Despite looking like an ordinary suit, it possesses an exoskeleton made of weaves that augments Mary’s physical prowess and advanced nanotechnology that allows it to self-repair. The inside of the capes also has pockets for various objects.
addons.title: Suits & Frills

addons.text:
Mary died in a battle while trying to save as many people around her. While she successfully saved them, she also died trying to keep people smiling. Having finally died, she was unable to see the impacts of her death until years later when Kei claimed her. Mary didn’t make much impact on Kei because Mary felt like her journey was already over, and is thankful that Kei let her get the unique opportunity to see how the people she loves continue without her.

She serves as a member of the Wild Hunt Brigade, the majority of Kei’s Shades that wait to be called for whenever an important battle is needed. But aside from that they mostly stay in the Afterlife. But because there are many Mary knows who often heads outside of it for various tasks, she would occasionally go on trips to know her family, since she’s Violet’s distant relative. Though she says that, her actual actions are hanging around with the people she knew after they died. Unofficially, she tends to be one of the first people to meet when they die and she helps them get oriented after they die and is considered a rather trustworthy leader in times of need if you ignore her nonsense. As a Shade, Mary’s power becomes stronger giving her an endless number of slots by borrowing from Violet that she can use to grow powers.
addons.title: Wild Hunt Brigade

objects.text:
Name: Mary Solomon
Gender: Female
Age: 25
Appearance: Attractive

Powers: Manager [*Garden Bed]

Mary possesses the ability to copy and steal the powers of any Parahuman she touches as well as being able to distribute them to others. 

She has 15 slots to store powers, but can only have 5 of them active at a time. 

She can alter the expressions of her powers at will, as well as alter them at will by limiting and boosting different aspects of her power. Multiple compatible powers can occupy the same slot.

She also possesses the ability to seed her slots with power, gaining a 1 SP power that will slowly grow and mutate at a rate of 1 SP every week for 20 weeks. These powers are treated like any other ability that she copies or replicates, capable of being handed out at will.

Compared to the powers Mary copies, these powers can get even stronger and adapt to threats and will continue to mutate over time even after reaching maturity, albeit not necessarily at the 1 SP a week pace as before. 

She can discard powers at will, but she will have to regrow, and/or copy or steal them again to use them.
Background:

Born from an accident, she was an unexpected addition to her small family. With just her, her mom, and her younger half-sister Mira, they had only each other as she saw her mom have difficulty raising them. She’s drifted through life unsure of what she wanted to do, going through the steps that should needed to do instead of what she wanted. Nothing in her life stood out though, taking the time to watch the films early in the morning but having to leave before finishing each episode. Her life could be considered largely uneventful and her mom wants her to go to a big college for a brighter future. 

In college, Mary became roommates and close friends with a Yura. They were roommates who got to know each other. But when one of Mary’s classmates that she knew, Timothy, was triggered by the stress and tried to destroy the college, she watched as the people around her were getting hurt. Herself, Yura, and the villain. And in the chaos, both Yura and Mary cluster triggered. Only shortly after superheroes began stepping in and trying to stop the supervillain from lashing out.

With both of them being friends and cluster triggering, Yura and Mary teamed up together to form a team as well. With Mary being in the forefront and Yura acting as support, they did mostly modest things that didn’t stand out much like saving cats from trees. But her personality tied with the equipment Yura made for her gave Mary the reputation as the “Nonsense Magical Girl”. Initially, she resisted this title, but over time she embraced this identity and became the Nonsense Magical Girl Symbol. She would later tell her mom about things like this, revealing her powers and activities to her only family member. But her mom was also hiding a secret from her. She was the illegitimate daughter of Eidolon and this was never planned to be revealed until Mary decided to reveal herself to her mom.
 
However, Symbol would later make the mistake of giving someone she met a power. Taking pity on a boy in trouble, she gave him the power to manipulate space. Unaware of that this led to a string of murders and by the time she realized what was going on, she was incapable of stopping him. His spatial manipulation grew to where she couldn’t reach him to claim it back, and it made her powers unable to stop him. But in trying to save more people, she would die of the serial killer known as Vade.

Personality:

Mary is a cheerful Magical Girl who is nostalgic about all things shounen and Tokusatsu. Taking the messages that they gave her and using them as inspiration for the kind of hero she wants to be. Even with their decline post-Leviathan, her enthusiasm went undiminished. Though if not for Yura’s insistence on Magical Girls she would sport a Kamen Rider-like suit so they compromised into a suit with a cape. The frilly hairpiece she wore seemed to give more Magical Girl vibes leading to her reputation though. 

Despite being known as the “Nonsense Magical Girl”, she never quite forgot her origins and trigger. Despite her whimsical actions leading to a nonsensical reputation, there are times when her personality to do the right thing shines even brighter. She would go on a journey with changes every day, maybe it was an old lady who needed help holding groceries or helping a school gather funds for a field trip. She happily takes on these mundane activities.

(Note: Mary died, but purchasing this companion will change fate. Or you purchased her corpse for Tinker or Necromancy purposes.)
objects.title: Symbol

addons.text: As one of the younger Capes, even though Evelyn doesn’t often act as a Hero, she leads Symbol II to find her and asks her to join the team. Initially, Evelyn didn’t care much about it, but watching a young child fight against thugs all by herself left a sour taste in her mouth. Ignoring the fact that Evelyn herself is also a young child. This led Evelyn to take on a more supportive role, buffing Symbol’s firepower and only stepping in once Symbol’s energy started to deplete. Because they are now a team, Evelyn starts acting more like a hero instead of occasionally saving the day, but that could just be because Symbol dragging her everywhere.
addons.title: Order & Responsibility

addons.text:
In a fight due to an ambush from Cursed Child and Berserker, Evelyn was caught off guard and killed while trying to protect the civilians around her. If it had been one or the other, she was sure she could have survived or even won. But even when they were both weakened by her abilities or attempted to be controlled with her Master power, their madness and slowly ramping power proved too much. Eventually, she was killed after leading them out of the city with some effort. In doing so, she found herself becoming one of Violet’s Shades and eventually a part-time member of the Chaos Brigade.

Despite her initial misgivings, Violet really let her do what she wanted since no one knew she had died. Luckily, Cursed Child and Berserker were both too insane at the time to realize she had actually died and instead thought she barely managed to survive. One thing she has trouble explaining is why she can no longer be detected by the other Clustermates. As one of Kei’s Shades, Evelyn’s power is 25x stronger than it was in life as well as having a lesser version of all the powers Kei has. Not only did it greatly improve her range and power, but it also mutated her abilities to do things she couldn’t before.
addons.title: Part-Time Chaos Brigade

addons.text: Instead of a commission, Yura crafted Evelyn a frilly Magical Girl outfit at the behest of Symbol II’s request due to their friendship. Because it’s Symbol II, Evelyn was forced to receive a frilly yellow Magical Girl outfit. Empyrea is a mobility-focused Magical Girl outfit capable of ripping space apart to close vast distances or tear apart objects. It greatly enhances Evelyn’s abilities, allowing her to reduce Capes to between 5% and 2500% of their power and multiply her range by 10x. Similar to the other Magical Girl outfits, it can be stored in Shardspace and called upon whenever needed.
addons.title: Vanguard

addons.text: With Jacob’s ability to see Trigger Events, he instantly identifies Evelyn’s and guesses her powers. He notices one power in particular that, when used with her power battery, could create a wave of loyal soldiers spreading like a virus under her command. Seeing this potential, Jacob wishes to manipulate her into embracing this chaos. To him, her moral actions, saving those around her, and sense of responsibility are all meaningless facades. He wants her to see the chaos people hide within themselves, believing that everyone is simply a monster in disguise. In his eyes, Evelyn is a powerful pawn, and he aims to manipulate her to greater heights for his own twisted games.
addons.title: A Jester's Gambit

objects.text:
Name: Evelyn Caprison-Jones
Gender: Female
Age: 14
Appearance: Attractive (Cute)

Powers: Golem, Goddess (*Mine, Mine, Mine!), 100th Strike, Debuff, Internalized Knowledge, Dress Up!, Fluctuation

Evelyn is part of the KitKat Cluster consisting of 12 members, granting her multiple powers. Her primary ability allows her to reshape nearby objects and materials into armor, which can absorb and control any mechanical device. She can temporarily enhance her equipment for greater power, altering its appearance. Additionally, Evelyn can influence anyone in her vicinity and use telekinesis to fly and manipulate objects. She can adapt her defenses to attacks and possesses a danger sense. Evelyn can also gain the strength, speed, and durability of everyone within a 10-meter radius.

Another power enables her to weaken her attacks and release the accumulated energy with a multiplier. She can apply debuffs to anyone she touches and weaken parahuman powers within a 50-meter radius by 50% to 250%. Finally, Evelyn has the ability to understand and correct any faulty knowledge she possesses, helping her acquire new knowledge and improve old ideas, and has a power battery that can enhance the powers she possesses for a limited time before needing to recharge.

Evelyn’s fighting style involves getting up close and personal with her opponents. She prefers quick, light attacks to apply constant debuffs before delivering a single massive attack. Using her telekinesis, she can move around quickly and manipulate objects to her advantage. Her ability to adapt her defenses to attacks and sense danger makes her difficult to take down. Due to her Shaker powers, anyone near her can become up to 50% weaker, while their strongest and fastest are added to her own. While she can influence people to swear loyalty to her, she doesn’t like using that power unless absolutely needed.

Background:

Evelyn was born on an unnamed alternate Earth and had a happy life in a quiet neighborhood called Maplewood. She lived in a home where the warm sun painted her humble abode and the gentle chime of her family’s old grandfather clock would ring every morning. Her life was a life of simplicity and seemingly would never change. At school she would go with her friends, Lily and Jasmine, all three of them sitting in the far back and laughing as they tried to hide their actions from the teacher. During recess, they would share their silly games and trade stickers. The school bell would ring at the end of and signal Evelyn to go back home. Dinner conversations about her day would meander through topics of school and her parent's work. Her dad, with his old glasses that sometimes fall off his face, would read storybooks to her as she went to bed. Days like that would go by without any sign of change.

But last year, a supervillain battled against a superhero during a field trip to a KitKat factory. The resulting clash caused a nearby large device from the supervillain to break down the fabric of reality. The fractured rift tore the surroundings apart as Evelyn and her parents were sucked into it along with everything else nearby with enough force to drag cars. The rift made her head hurt, her mind felt sick and her body drenched. It was like she could see agony and smell the red. The rift caused the nearby surroundings to explode, and in the damaged surroundings Evelyn could only hear the sound of red water on her cheek and the empty gaze. She could only scream. 

[Destination] 
[Agreement]

For 9 months after that incident, she lived alone in the streets somewhere. Unsure what to do and avoided everything around her. She had powers, and she never got more hungry than when she first got her powers. She was approached by one of the figures she could sense, Jeremiah Jones. He gave her a place to stay, a warm bed, a console she doesn’t recognize or use, and visits her sometimes in between his tired and exhausting schedule or disappearances. Even 3 months later, she hasn’t forgotten the sound of dripping water.

The place she stayed at was in the heart of the city. A nice building that doesn’t get much sun due to the towering constructs nearby. When she first came to live there, shadows clung to the cobwebs and there was barely anything inside. The mornings began with a digital alarm blaring against her ears every morning, she never got used to it. No sound of the chime, no brass pendulum swaying in a rhythmic comfort. Just the beep of the digital alarm clock. It wasn’t a bad home though, she had anything she needed and more. She even was one who helped decorate the place. She has a new identity, an allowance, a warm place to stay, and even a video game console in the living room. Not that she ever used it except a few times. At school, she was a solitary figure, in her experiences, she could never find it in herself to smile. The other children were afraid of her, hushed whispers in places they thought they couldn’t hear. And even when she tries to stop bullies from messing with other kids, they fear her more than the bullies. The school bell felt more like a liberation. Evelyn enjoys storybooks, even if she is too old for them now. Maybe she could ask Jerimiah to read a story? Evelyn decided against it, she already had enough.

Personality:

Evelyn possesses a maturity that belies her appearance. Yet she remains a child at heart even with the precociousness caused by her unique circumstances and powers. Months ago, her life took an unexpected turn after Jerimiah found her in an alleyway. Initially, she found forming a bond with her new adoptive father daunting. The memories of her late parents were still fresh and accepting someone else in their place seemed unthinkable. However, as she spent time with her adoptive father she began to let her guard down around him. Eventually even slotting him as a third parent.

While she will never forget her biological parents, but her second father became an integral part of her life. Providing for her and finding the time to be around her even despite his busy schedule. Evelyn is slowly learning to navigate all the changes that happened recently in her life, and she’s thankful to her new dad for accepting her. She also finds solace in reading, which helps her get along with her new dad and cope with her emotions.

While Evelyn is not an active Cape, she sometimes goes out because she found someone being mugged.
objects.title: Sitra

addons.text: The 2 or so years that Archie has spent as a cape thus far were unforgettable. So much laughter, a lot of highs and lows, and so many sleepless nights tinkering away at yet another addition to his Legion of The Lost. And between it all was a companionship many often dream of, but something few can truly say they have in earnest: a wonderful friend that you cherish as much as they cherish you, and in Archie’s case, he found this in Dragon. While they don’t spend a lot of time together, what little they did was some of the best times Archie’s had in his life. So when one day, Dragon revealed who she truly was to him, Archie saw nothing different in her, as her not being human didn’t suddenly change who she was on the spot. She was more than human enough for him, she was still his friend, and that was all that mattered to him. Soon after, on a whim, he asked her if she had a proper body to enjoy the human experience in. Surprised that she didn’t, he immediately offered to remedy the problem by creating a specialized android just for her. Now, in the present day, Dragon can be seen in person, flying across the world with a pair of steel wings in a new body, on par with a high-end brute. To the wider world at large, they were told that an experimental Tinker surgery had been successfully able to transplant her consciousness into a new body so she could go out with her Dragonflight. To the very few that knew her true nature, however, they knew that it was the aid of a close friend who gave the Greatest Tinker Alive a real body to live inside. These two companions now stand together as the best of friends, through hell and high water, and nothing will ever change that.
addons.title: A Bond Forged of Steel and Kindness

objects.text:
Real Name: Arch E. Calaway
Nicknames: Archie, Archimedes
Gender: Male
Age: 18
Appearance: Attractive, Androgynous

Skill: Mechanical Engineer
Powers: (Tinker) Detection and Analysis + Redundancy + Manton Limits + Style + Robots (+ FaeR Automata) + Techie
Personality:
Arch is a reserved, but social young man who, despite his tired and sometimes emotionless visage, is quite active and loves to spend time with the confidants and allies that he’s made over the years when he’s not tinkering. Each friend he makes, he treasures it dearly, valuing every second he spends with them. Unsurprisingly, Arch gets very heated about the topic of not only recently deceased heroes, but also the deaths of regular people in the area. He hates overlooking each life lost like they’re another article in a newspaper, and takes a little bit of time every day to reflect on the people who helped create who he is today. He is willing to bend, or outright break the law if it means that he could use his creations (whom he privately calls his ‘Legion of The Lost’) to save more innocent lives.

Backstory:
Arch E. Calaway was born in Flint, Michigan in December of 1992 with a father and no mother, for she had died in childbirth. Arch had shown signs of having above-average intelligence in his childhood, and was raised with becoming a scientist in mind. When the rise of capes had properly started and the Protectorate was formed, Arch had already latched onto the idea of capes being unforgettable legends who upheld truth and justice. Luckily having relocated to Detroit about a year before Flint became a Containment Zone, Arch had made up his mind to devote his life studying in robotics, with his life’s goal of creating the world’s first artificial parahuman <s>(imagine automatically failing in your life’s goal the moment you started working towards it)</s>.

When he was 14 years old in 2007, Arch had bore witness to the death of a beloved local hero, who had given their life to save a group of innocent people trapped under a collapsing building. The city and its residents went into mourning, but from how Arch had seen it, it almost felt like the people of Detroit had simply moved on after a couple weeks. As if it had been a common occurrence. Why had these people, who owed their safety to these pillars of society, forgotten them in such a short time? It baffled him greatly, and remained a question that he found himself asking again, and again, and again, witnessing more and more examples that itched and nibbled at his mind. Until eventually, he couldn’t hold in all the pent up confusion and anger, wanting to create a permanent reminder to the world to remember the heroes who had fallen in the effort to uphold the greater good.

And that is when Arch triggered. When he was in the right head-space to test out what he had gained from reaching his breaking point, he had received what he had asked for and more: to some, what he received would be called a ‘Tinker Jackpot’. Technically there was only one or two specialties he could truly use on their own, with the rest being specialties that filled a supporting role to the primary ones, but Arch would never complain about the powers he gained. Resolving himself, he vowed to keep the memories of fallen heroes alive. Not by making statues or memorials, but by creating androids that emulated the powers and theme of the fallen capes so that they could, in spirit, continue protecting society from evil.

Following the next few years, Arch, going by the cape name of Memoriam, has become a popular but controversial independent cape due to his creation of robots with power-emulating tinkertech designed to look fairly similar to deceased capes. He doesn’t take any criticism or insults people say on PHO to heart, but he tries his best to make sure his professional relationship with the Protectorate doesn’t sour from his actions. Well, beyond what already generates from the idea of a Tinker who analyzes the powers of dead capes and makes robots with similar powers to them.
objects.title: Memoriam

objects.text: Name: ??? Age: ??? Gender: Female Appearance: Beautiful Power:(Cypher (*Babel2), A Thousand Souls (*Fractured but Whole, *Thousand Masteries), Ouroboros - The Snake That Bites Its Own Tail (*Archetype : The King of Pentacles), Mind’s Eye, Archive (*Library of Alexandria), The Best Of Both Worlds, Madness of Enlightenment (*Lotus of Fractured Insight), Spirit Sight (*All Seeing), Me And The Devil, Dimensional Dominion, Reaction Room (*I Make The Rules Here), How Heavy Are Your Dumbbells? (*University), World Spirit, Shard Automation (*Catalogue), Shard Feedback, TRUTHS BEST FORGOTTEN, Laplace Determinism) The Symbol of the Mer'ge Requ'Est controls the Mer'ge Requ'Est, and is one of the many dimensions she controls. She has connected the Mer'ge Requ'Est to a reaction theatre, a university, and her own inner world. Within her dimensions, nobody can be harmed, unless she permits it. She can control any experiences that others have when they're inside her dimensions, and also, she is able to accommodate any special needs or requirements others have and can neutralise any harmful aspects or qualities others possess, whether that be due to powers, or something else. Alongside this, she can also project more understanding and comprehension onto others who are inside of her dimension and improve the speed of their learning multiple times over. She is able to bring anyone, including herself, from anywhere into her dimension, and send them back when and where they were before. She is also able to create new dimensions, further expanding the domain she controls. Her powers stems from the profane knowledge, maddening revelations, enlightening cognitions, fundamental truths and eldritch understandings that come from a deep, unconscious realm, a sunken depths, a hollow abyss, unreachable by and beneath even the primordial, transient faith that resides deep within the subconsciousness of humans. Using this knowledge, she is able to subtlety infect, parasitise and transform the world around her, changing the essence of reality. Through her dimensions, she is able to communicate and teach this knowledge and understanding to others. It describes and details the impossible coincidences, illogical paradoxes, screaming fractals and the seams of reality in simple notions, such that any practitioner, even one that has just started, becomes capable of minor reality warping. Not only this, but she can also describe reality and existence of anything she comes across in similar terms and notions, thereby becoming able to express any power, whether scientific or esoteric in expressions of similar knowledge and understandings. Through her influences and actions, including her various dimensions and those she teaches, she is able to comprehend and analyse the reality of the universe, and realities of other, further universes, and places beyond them. She is also capable of making imperceptible, invisible facsimiles of others that can assume control of their original's body. They have the exact same power and skills as their original's but at tens of times the output. The personality and temperament of these facsimiles tends to be more sinister and sadistic when compared to their originals. Background: The Mer'ge Requ'Est is a construct that exists where things aren't supposed to exist. It exists in nonexistence, beyond reality, in a place with no space, nor time, where errors in the code of the universe, and secret developer rooms that aren't supposed to exist, exist. It is an unsettling space that connects the omniverse together. It is a subliminal space of MR, the backrooms of reality. A place that stores knowledge of the changes within reality. It can represent unsettling and uncomfortable realisations. So when the announcement came of this unreal construct being owned, possessed and created by somebody, it left many in the omniverse frightened. Before her debut, there was no Symbol of The Mer'ge Requ'Est, she simply didn't exist. There was no trace of her existence or origin before the moment she announced herself. It was as if she appeared out of thin air, just like the Mer'ge Requ'Est she owns. Nobody knows her name, or who she was, or whether there was a was. The only thing they knew, was that now she existed, and she was here to stay. Personality: The most prominent traits she possesses is being considerate and being caring. She is also very understanding, and can empathise with any experience, whether it was as mundane as another day of work, or whether it was brutal and excruciating torture. She always seems to know what to say, and always makes whoever she talks to feel better and feel comforted. However, if you're always with her, sometimes she may show subtle changes in her behavior, whether it was a difference in her the pacing of her gait when she walks, or simply placing her hands in her laps when sitting when she didn't before. Small, subtle differences. She is a great person to be around, and is hard-working, endearing and always tries her best. She has great work ethic, and always does her best to contribute to group tasks, and takes care to maintain the relationships in a group.
objects.title: Symbol of The Mer'ge Requ'Est

addons.text: As it turns out teaming up the Tinkertech reverse-engineering specialist with access to vast amounts of specialized materials with the nanotech manufacturing specialists that just needs useable blueprints and materials to produce almost anything works out extremely well for all involved. Michelle gaining access to the resources the Guild has not only vastly increases their output of technology, their backing keep certain interested parties-- "Cough CUI Cough" "Cough PRTeam Cough" "Facepalms" --away from them. And the access to mental health professionals and conflict resolution training helps them work with each other more effectively. Likewise, Dragon gains direct access to improved armor derived from Lernaean's outer coating and improved multitasking and automation software from their AI cores, working around her biggest weakness as a limited multitasking AI... just don't tell Saint.

A commission to Asphalt to bring in new designs and ideas. Together they created the Dragon Heart, a forge made from a collection of Lernaean’s nanomachines. It can do “alchemy”, tearing apart and splicing together atoms to create entirely different materials so long as they have an abundance of other materials. It allows Lernaean to turn lead into gold and dirt into steel. Although while they were working together, Asphalt kept glancing at Michelle with a confused expression. It was only after a couple of weeks did she commented about improving her Master defenses and making the door larger to accommodate more kinds of customers. Sadly that comment got out onto the internet somehow and she suffered a couple of weeks for huge shaming. It was only with Michelle’s help that Asphalt managed to recover her damaged reputation.
addons.title: Dragon Heart

addons.text: Michelle's shard has added a few new tricks it picked up from close proximity to you, specifically cribbing an alternate expression of Hydra heads. Now, in addition to the toxic capabilities of the standard version, each one of Michelle's primary heads can instantly split up into a maximum of four slightly smaller heads for a maximum total of 12. With each sub-head able to independently think and react to surroundings it can easily more than quadruple their mental and physical capabilities... except for the nasty side effect of giving killer Thinker headaches to whichever primary personality created them the longer or the more heads they have active for a given time, starting at about 10 minutes of painless use at the full four heads per personality. Thankfully, with practice the amount of time it can be used can slowly be increased.
addons.title: Lernaean, Literally

objects.text:
Name: Michelle 
Gender: Female(s)
Age: Unknown (Young Adult Case 53) 
Appearance: Giant Rubber Hydra Robot Thingy Average Case 53

Power (Dragon Robot Chassis + Animatronic Mutation), Handmade, True Tinker + Internalized Knowledge,
Mental Computer, Rubber Ducky, Sandevistan, Gut Instinct, Autopilot, Organized Mind, Swift Insight, John 2:1-11, Dare to be Stupid, Immune Response, Gomu Gomu no Mi, You Are A Dragon And That's Okay, Force Multiplier [Restriction: No Energy Constructs, No Self Charging] Pressure Hull, Mundane Savant, Nano Cells

Lernaean is a Case 53 Brute/Tinker hybrid whose robot chassis is coated in what appears to be some sort of soft rubber-like material but is in fact a large colony of nanomachines that both serve as their nearly indestructible outer coating and the source of their “tinker” powers. Specifically, they are used to manufacture large quantities of mundane items out of whatever materials they absorb. They are also surprisingly good at creating new designs of non-tinkertech devices and materials, especially when multiple heads work together on the designs in question.

Technically, they can also reproduce tinkertech that others have reverse engineered into non-tinker equivalents such as Containment Foam. Although trying to do the reverse engineering themselves runs into the same problems that most non-tinkers do when they attempt to do so. They also have one rather annoying caveat to their nano-tinkered goods, without extreme effort on their part everything they make will share the same bright color scheme as Lernaean’s external chassis making it blindingly obvious where it came from.

With that said the real meat of their powerset comes from just how much of a defensive brute they are, being functionally immune to kinetic damage and highly resistant most other forms of “conventional” physical damage, only the most exotic of powers or tinkertech can directly harm them, and if it doesn’t outright kill them, they can eventually build an immunity to said threat thanks to the Nano Cell coating.
