This resistance even provides partial immunity to other esoteric powers, such as master effects, so long as they can physically block them from getting in their head, which being robots can be done by simply switching off the affected sensory inputs as needed.

Interestingly, other than the ability to move extremely fast in short bursts, their main offensive power, besides being their main body being the size (And most of the mass) of an African Elephant ironically requires their ability to take a beating to work, the ability to absorb any attack to charge up a reserve of power to make themselves more powerful or converting into a powerful blaster attack from their mouths.

As far as more minor powers they have a few thinker powers optimized towards cognition and multitasking, which due to their unique natures are just important towards their daily lives as they are in direct combat.

There's is one other power of note, a strange, always on, master power that convinces all who are not resistant to master powers, that they are just normal people that need accommodations instead of an elephant sized robot Case 53 trying to interact with society. So long as they don't attack or blatantly use their other powers the effect holds, but if they do start using parahuman powers people will react as normal to that, and that alone. And when things calm back down, they're just another normal parahuman.... 

With all that said, the mental mapping effect would still have the Empire 88 hate them for not being white, for example. Though somebody who calls them out for being huge would probably get yelled at for fat shaming or the like. Meanwhile, the three heads are initially unaware of it and wonder why people act like this is normal.

Personality: Lernaean’s personalities would be the better way of describing them, specifically because while they did suffer from the same memory loss that’s trademark to all Case 53’s what few memories that each head retained are different fragments of the one person they used to be, which ironically unites them more than being literally joined together at the shoulders. For better or worse, the only way they are going to learn who they really were, besides their name would be to work together.

And therein lies the rub, while they make a point of showing a united front in public, they are ultimately different minds that are slowly differentiating themselves into different people, meaning that disagreements, while rare, do happen and their body’s control is split evenly between the three heads, meaning that all non-autonomic functions need a majority of the heads operating on said task to agree or abstain in order to do anything. If a task can’t reasonably be automated by their minor Thinker powers, this often leads one head specializing in a given task to guarantee uninterrupted control so long as the others don’t butt in. Of course, this leads to more differentiation and more motive drift over time exacerbating their problems…

That said the few memories of Michelle that all three heads do share, tend to color their personalities as more laid back and passive people that really don’t want to fight and generally just want to be left alone. Now if only they weren’t larger than an elephant, Hazmat Yellow and Black, and having an extremely desirable powerset on Earth Bet… “I’d like my old body back more than anything else.” “Or at least some usable thumbs.” “Amen to that.”
objects.title: Lernaean

objects.text: Name: Tenma Emmel Seraphina Gender/Sex: Genderfluid Age: Immortal Appearance: Unknown Powers: (Special Case + Ether Brew) Ahem. ”Tenma is a type of fae-adjacent, whimsical patron deity known as a Special Case, representing the letter E for their Concept of “Ether." They cannot be killed by conventional means, mundane or supernatural, so long as they maintain their sense of self. Through making pacts with sapient beings, Tenma can grant powers using their Ether Brew, a Schrodinger’s Fluid produced from an internal reservoir of unfiltered, unlimited, dreamlike chaos known as a “Muse." As a Special Case, they can be summoned by saying or thinking their True Name, with even minor intent catching their attention and granting them a perfect, nigh-omniscient understanding of the summoner.” Background: ”No peeking, the story has yet to be written. Let’s assume there isn’t one for now, so just make something up.” Personality: Well, that’s certainly forward. How about this? "Their presence shifts to influence and accommodate their chosen victi-...persons of interest. While mostly neutral and somewhat prone to whimsy, Tenma is totally harmless. They like to write, read, and drink their mysterious Ether Brew. Humorously enough, they are very particular about their Ether Brew, to the point that they refuse to make alcohol. Any alcohol. It would take a severe amount of vitriol for them to serve even a sip of cheap beer to themselves or their Ether Drinkers, even if they show none of their contempt and grant the request anyway." That should be enough.
objects.title: Emmel, The Muse of Stories

objects.text:
Name: Isla Alvarez 
Gender/Sex: Female, She/Her
Age: 22
Appearance: Beautiful

Powers: (Alt. Ideal Time) Isla’s powers are simple — She can warp herself across space and time to any “ideal" location, whether that be somewhere safe, somewhere that furthers her goals, or even across dimensional and temporal barriers as she discovers them. 

Background: She is a Parahuman from an unknown branch of Earth Bet, from a time where Gold Morning and the era of Titans are little more than unpleasant history taught to children. As a former child actor who fancied herself a diva, Isla decided to travel back to the Dark Age of Parahumans to see what early superhero culture looked like without historical bias getting in the way. Being relatively immortal, Isla has dabbled in everything under the sun, from heroics to villainy to even merc work as a founding member of Cauldron.

Personality: Isla is a very mischievous, flighty woman. She’s never been one to stay in one place too long or form connections outside her family, but she is very loyal to those she takes a liking to.
objects.title: Isla Alvarez

objects.text:
Name: Anton Alvarez
Gender/Sex: Male, He/Him
Age: 45
Appearance: Handsome

Powers: (Alt. Sage) Anton is a lot like Myrddin in the sense that his powers lean more toward magic and mystery despite being Shard-based. Referred to as “Computational Runecraft," Anton can draw symbols into reality that function like Tinkertech, mimicking pretty much any power available to Parahumans. These Runes are precise and work in clusters and feedback loops to bridge the gap between an infinite amount of malleable pocket dimensions full of energy and matter, tying them to the physical world through Shardspace. 

Background: A movie director, actor, and self-proclaimed Weaverdice aficionado, Anton Alvarez is perhaps the only living human of his time period who actually remembers Khepri, much less her career as a Ward in Chicago. As a passionate content creator determined to understand Dark Age superhero culture, he spends his time filming niche movies based on the true stories of his time travelling daughter, Isla.

Personality: Anton is a passionate man, fiercely loyal to his family, always looking for ways to improve and gain fame. He is an expert in reading both people and his environment, and has a knack for breaking down complicated Shard dynamics into their base components. He one day hopes to create a blockbuster franchise known all throughout his world, eventually adapting the stories of Earth Bet through books and music.
objects.title: Anton Alvarez

objects.text:
Name: Alonso Alvarez
Gender/Sex: Male, He/Him
Age: 17
Appearance: Attractive

Powers: (Alt. Only Same Man) Alonso is perhaps the Only Sane Man in a world gone mad. His Shard was all too eager to agree, so his power reflects this. Alonso experiences reality in two filters: What’s actually happening, and what “should" be happening if the world was completely and utterly mundane. He is immune to all supernatural effects, and can interact with Parahumans as if he himself were the Only Sane Man. Combat Thinkers flail about uselessly, portals can be open and shut like actual doors, Tinkertech falls apart like cheap plastic, and Endbringers can be shot to death by an ordinary handgun because Kaiju aren’t real and guns are a threat to anyone sane.

Background: Gold Morning is a distant memory. The age of Titans is long gone. So much time has passed that his Earth doesn't even have a designation. Yet somehow, people still believe that superpowers are real! Alonso Alvarez is a firm believer that Earth Bet and all its nonsense is little more than grimderp sci-fi bullshit his big sister Isla made up to help their father make movies. She’s a grown woman who disappears at odd times, only to come back with fantastical stories about Parahumans and Endbringers and Nudist Space Whales and he’s getting sick of it. Unfortunately for his sanity, his Shard thinks he’s hilarious and plays into his self-delusion.

Personality: He’s a teenager living in a futuristic world still clinging to old media out of a sense of nostalgia. His elder sister is a brat. His movie director dad thinks his CGI special effects are real. His mom tried to get him on medication. Alonso is absolutely done with everything, but at least his imaginary friend believes him.
objects.title: Alonso Alvarez

objects.text:
Name: Gabriella Alvarez
Gender/Sex: Female, She/Her
Age: 42
Appearance: Beautiful

Powers: (Tinker to Victory) Gabriella is basically a Tinker version of Contessa. Instead of gaining perfect step-by-step information to accomplish a task, Gabriella instead can Tinker up any solution she needs for any problem she has, pulling from the Entity's entire tech database. However, she does not understand the tech trees she pulls from, and upon changing trees, can only maintain and modify what already exists. Nonetheless, her only real limitation is the Tinker cycle.

Background: On an unnamed Earth in a future far beyond the shadow of Gold Morning and its fallout, Gabriella Alvarez freely spends her time creating quirky gadgets and quick-fix solutions for barter. As her world’s most powerful and versatile Tinker, she funds most capes getting their start as independents free of corporate and military influence, having built a global network over twenty-five years of painful compromise. “Sin Nombre," they call her, "The Nameless Tinker.” What the world does not know is that this seemingly tough-as-nails, ruthless, self-made woman of legend is actually a frazzled wife and mother to an eccentric Khepri stan, a time-travelling diva, and a delusional schizophrenic who thinks Parahuman society is a Deep State fear-mongering campaign run by Canadians. Her family is absolutely insane, but Gabriella would sooner drown the world in nuclear fire than let them go a day without love and affection.

Personality: Ridiculously competent and affectionate Super Mom. That’s it. That’s her personality. She loves her family and has basically adopted an entire generation of Parahumans as her babies.
objects.title: Gabriella Alvarez

objects.text: Real Name: Verin Hemlock Sinclare Gender: Male Appearance: Beautiful Age: 24 Powers Perfect Condition + Incubator + I Do Not Judge, I Merely Accept + Idol + Eternal Flame + Magician [Lunarian] + Sailor Guardian [Moon Princess] + Sailor Cosmos + Awakener [Faustian Bargain] + Conversion {Silver Crystal} Maecenas had the extraordinary fortune of the Silver Crystal merging with his body and soul, an event that bestowed upon him immense power and heightened intelligence. This fusion transformed him into a being of remarkable capability, granting him extraordinary physical strength, limitless stamina, the ability to fly, project beams of radiant light, and conjure powerful protective shields. However, these abilities quickly became secondary in Maecenas's eyes when he discovered something far more significant: the ability to bind others to himself in exchange for granting them a portion of his power. This binding allowed him to create an army of loyal followers, enhancing their capabilities while ensuring their unwavering allegiance. His fascination deepened further as the Silver Crystal began to reveal vast reservoirs of knowledge to him, enabling him to pioneer the creation of Magitech—a seamless fusion of magic and technology. Despite his extraordinary potential and intellect, Maecenas's personal combat skills remain underdeveloped. He has chosen to rely on his Magitech creations, his loyal Magical Girls, and an elite force of mercenaries to fight on his behalf. While his inherent powers could make him a formidable force on the battlefield, he prefers to act as the mastermind, orchestrating strategies and manipulating events from behind the scenes, all while leveraging his boundless intelligence and his ever-growing arsenal of Magitech innovations. This approach has allowed him to channel his energies into expanding his influence and perfecting his creations, ensuring his dominance without ever needing to step into the fray himself. Personality The personality of Verin could be and has been described as toxic. He is a master manipulator who thrives on control, deriving a sadistic pleasure from the suffering and subjugation of others. He has a sharp tongue and enjoys belittling those he deems beneath him, particularly those in desperate situations. Wealthy from inheritance and savvy investments, he has long used his financial power to coerce people into performing dangerous, humiliating, or otherwise degrading tasks, always ensuring payment is genuine to maintain the allure of his "generosity". If he can get away with it he often offers people money if they do something for him. This is either diffuclt, dangerous or just humiliating but the payment is true, though he derides people before, during and after these things. He often makes recordings if he can, not for blackmail or anything, but as a memento and a gallery for his perusal afterwards. With the acquisition of supernatural powers, Verin has taken his manipulative tendencies to an extreme level. He seeks out the broken and desperate, offering them a wish that can transform their lives—but at the cost of binding their loyalty to him. As Magical Girls forged from Star Soul Seeds, those who accept his deal become pawns in his elaborate games, wielding great power but firmly under Verin’s control. He crafts the illusion of choice, finding amusement in their belief that they act of their own free will. Verin is a sadistic voyeur of misery, recording the struggles of others not for leverage but for personal entertainment. His charisma and cunning allow him to cloak his manipulations as benevolence, but beneath the facade, he remains a tyrant who views others’ lives as pieces in a game where he is always the victor. His ultimate joy lies in pulling the strings, ensuring the narrative of every victory, failure, or transformation revolves around him. Background Verin was born into staggering wealth—the kind that guarantees a life of unparalleled luxury and privilege. His parents, shrewd and ambitious self-made magnates, were acutely aware of the pitfalls of raising a spoiled heir. Determined to ensure Verin would one day maintain, if not expand, their empire, they took deliberate measures to shape his character. While they indulged his every whim, they also exposed him to the harsh realities of the world. Charitable galas, philanthropic ventures, and visits to impoverished areas weren’t designed to instill empathy; they served one purpose: to teach him that wealth equals power and its loss equals suffering. The lessons stuck, though not in the way his parents intended. Verin internalized the connection between money and control, finding a twisted delight in wielding his privilege to manipulate others. Even as a child, he experimented with his influence, bribing classmates to perform degrading acts or betray their friends for pocket change. When his parents died in a parahuman incident, leaving him their vast fortune at the age of eighteen, Verin had already honed his skills as a master manipulator. Recognizing that his immense wealth painted a target on his back, he fortified his empire with cutting-edge security measures, employing a private army of mercenaries and advanced technology to ensure his safety. His life took a dramatic turn one night when he witnessed a falling star crash nearby, its brilliance searing through the night and momentarily blinding him. When the light faded and his senses returned, Verin felt an unbearable heat in his chest. Clutching at the searing pain, he realized the star’s core—a crystal of immense, otherworldly power—had fused into his very being. The crystal became a permanent part of him, pulsing like a second heart and fundamentally altering his existence. He was no longer entirely human; he had transcended into something greater. The fusion unlocked incredible abilities: flight, enhanced strength, nearly limitless stamina, and an intellect so advanced it seemed otherworldly. But the crystal also imbued him with a profound understanding of Magitech—the merging of magic and technology. With this newfound mastery, Verin began crafting devices and tools that defied the laws of science and magic alike, pushing the boundaries of what was thought possible. Through experimentation with the crystal’s energy, Verin uncovered secrets of Lunarian technology, drawing on principles of purity and power that granted him access to unparalleled advancements. Unlike traditional Lunarians, who required "Pure Lands" to survive, Verin was free of such limitations. This evolution made him nearly unstoppable: a being of immense physical, magical, and intellectual might. With his newfound capabilities, Verin expanded the scope of his ambitions. He established the Bewitched Battalion, a mercenary organization unlike any other, outfitted with advanced Lunarian-inspired Magitech. His Magical Girls, bound to him by his sadistic manipulation of power, became not only instruments of humiliation but also highly trained operatives wielding cutting-edge equipment designed by Verin himself. The Battalion’s arsenal was a blend of Lunarian ingenuity and Verin’s own cruel creativity. Soldiers were equipped with tools like Veils of Moonlight, devices that enabled instant teleportation across short distances, ensuring tactical superiority in combat. The Battalion also deployed Magitech Barriers, capable of concealing entire facilities or shielding troops from devastating attacks. These advancements gave the organization an edge over even the most sophisticated militaries, allowing Verin to sell his services at a premium—or use them to further his personal agenda. Despite the fantastical nature of their equipment, Verin ensured that the illegal operations of the Bewitched Battalion remained cloaked in secrecy. Publicly, they appeared as a legitimate, if unconventional, paramilitary force. Privately, they served as the instruments of Verin’s sadistic whims, sent on missions designed to break their spirits and force them into moral and emotional torment. For Verin, the Battalion wasn’t just a mercenary group—it was a grand experiment in control. By fusing Lunarian magitech with the despair of those who served him, he created a theater of dominance where every mission, every humiliation, and every betrayal played out as a testament to his power and the suffering he delighted in creating.
objects.title: Maecenas

objects.text: Real Name: Elias Gender: Male Appearance: Beautiful Age: 34 Powers Consciousness Commander + Dungeon Core + Fortifications and Artillery + Fuse + Tower Defence [Final Dungeon + Impenetrable Tower + Swipe and Fuse] Elias has the extraordinary ability to merge his mind with a simulated military operations room, allowing him to access unparalleled strategic oversight. Whenever he sleeps, his consciousness is transported to this mental space, where he can monitor a five-block radius around him with dream-like clarity. Within the room, he can track every living being’s location, actions, and inventory, allowing him to maintain real-time control over all those within his range. He can also tag individuals with his influence, granting him the ability to communicate with them, coordinate their actions, and issue commands as if he were physically present. Even if someone is under the effect of one of his powers, they are automatically tagged, making it easier for him to manage multiple forces simultaneously. While Elias is connected to his ops room, he can use his immense energy pool to manipulate and control his environment, as well as direct the activities of his creations. His mind can extend into a physical realm, where he has full dominion over a Dungeon Core. When he activates his Dungeon Mastermind ability, he can transform into a Dungeon Core that governs a vast underground lair. The Dungeon begins as a simple room with a core at its heart, but through Elias’s mental focus and control, he can expand it into a fully operational fortress. The more resources he gathers, the more his dungeon grows, and with it, the power to summon and manage defensive structures and units. The Dungeon Core is Elias’s focal point, and while inside, he can create turrets, barriers, and minions that function autonomously or follow his commands. These constructs draw power from his energy pool, which regenerates over time, but he must manage them wisely to avoid depleting it too quickly. The stronger the creations, the more energy they consume. However, Elias can designate areas around his core to become "owned," granting him greater control and enhancing the strength of his defenses. This ownership allows him to manipulate the dungeon environment, making his constructs more durable and capable. Through his mastery over the Dungeon, Elias can enhance his structures and units. He can upgrade turrets, barricades, and minions, improving their performance in combat, granting them specialized abilities, or reinforcing their durability. This comes at a cost—stronger constructs demand more energy—but Elias can upgrade them efficiently by focusing on stationary defenses like turrets, while mobile units like minions consume more energy for similar enhancements. Elias also possesses the remarkable ability to fuse his creations. With a surge of energy, he can combine turrets, minions, or barriers into more powerful and versatile units. The fusion process blends their strengths, creating hybrid entities with unique properties, such as longer range, increased firepower, or enhanced mobility. The fusion results in units that are more efficient in terms of energy consumption than the sum of their parts, but they can become unwieldy if too many constructs are merged. Elias has the option to leave his Dungeon Core and return to human form, but doing so will make him vulnerable and his ability to change and command his constructs will weaken. The Dungeon will remain until he creates a new one or he returns to the core for full conrol again. As long as he remains inside the core, he can manage and control the dungeon’s expansion, using his resources to grow it into an impenetrable fortress. If the Dungeon Core is destroyed while Elias is inside, his life is forfeit. But if he is not, Elias can rebuild from zero. Ultimately, Elias is a mastermind, able to coordinate, control, and evolve his dungeon and its defenses with precision, while maintaining a mental grip on every tactical decision from within his consciousness. Personality Elias is a caring yet closed-off and stoic individual. To the point that, outside of his work with patients, few have ever seen him smile—those who have often assume that his smiles are forced or fake. However, they are mistaken. Elias can only truly smile while helping others. He takes great care to notice even the smallest details about people, always trying to avoid inadvertently causing them pain. This attentiveness allows him to understand how to comfort others and help them open up to him. His ability to read people extends to knowing when to push, when to pull back, and when to withhold or share personal information to build trust and make others feel comfortable. This deep empathy for others is balanced by an innate self-restraint. Beneath his stoic exterior lies a profound, explosive anger—a part of himself that he works hard to keep under control. This anger was the very reason Elias was sent out to psychiatrists as a young man, a pivotal moment in his life that set him on the path toward becoming the compassionate professional he is today. The anger no longer manifests in the same destructive ways it once did, but it remains a part of him, lurking beneath the surface. Years of self-training, meditation, and strict self-care practices have allowed Elias to suppress this rage. These tools have helped him heal from past trauma, though his anger remains a raw and sensitive topic— he has learned to harness his emotions, understanding their origins and finding peace within himself. Through his extensive journey of self-training, Elias has found a sense of balance that enables him to respond to others with compassion, even in moments that once might have triggered him. His anger no longer surfaces in explosive ways; instead, he has transformed it into a quiet strength, using it as a reminder of his growth and resilience. In his free time, Elias finds an outlet for his need for control and his hidden aggression. Through the use of his powers, he can conduct small-scale war games with his constructs, simulating violence, destruction, and explosions. Though he doesn’t need to create a core for this, the controlled chaos he manipulates provides a much-needed release. The violence, while simulated and contained, serves as a balm for his soul, giving him a space to unleash the emotions he otherwise keeps tightly locked away. These war games are not only a way to vent his frustrations but also a means to test and hone his abilities, allowing him to maintain both a sense of peace and an awareness of the power he holds. Background Elias is currently a warden and employed psychiatrist at the East Asylum located in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. He has been working there for just over a year, and during this time, he has quietly yet profoundly transformed the facility. With his abilities as a Parahuman, Elias has reinforced and altered much of the asylum's structure, creating an environment that is both safer and more supportive for the patients. Many of the more volatile areas, where patients with dangerous or uncontrollable powers are housed, have been fortified, and much of the infrastructure has been redesigned to accommodate the unique needs of Parahuman patients. Thanks to Elias's influence, the asylum has become a place where patients are not only protected but are given a chance to grow and heal in a safe, controlled setting. Elias’s abilities go far beyond simple physical reinforcement. He has used his powers to craft zones within the asylum where patients can train their powers in a controlled and supportive environment. Some areas are designed specifically for training, where patients can safely practice their abilities, with Elias creating constructs and units to act as targets or obstacles for practice. These units, which he summons with ease, are semi-autonomous and can be tailored to test different aspects of a Parahuman’s abilities. Whether it’s controlling energy blasts, learning to navigate a more chaotic power set, or honing their physical skills, Elias ensures that patients have the space and the tools they need to master their abilities in a way that does not endanger themselves or others. For those whose powers are particularly dangerous to others by accident—whether they’re uncontrollable or difficult to regulate—Elias uses his constructs to interact with them, ensuring that no one is harmed while the patient learns to control their abilities. These constructs are specifically designed to be resilient and adaptable, able to withstand the destructive or unpredictable nature of certain Parahuman powers. Through these interactions, Elias has been able to provide a therapeutic outlet for his patients, allowing them to confront the fears and uncertainties surrounding their abilities while knowing they are not alone in the process. Elias’s interventions with these constructs are never forceful but always guiding. His role as both a psychiatrist and a warden allows him to not only address the emotional and psychological aspects of his patients’ struggles but to also assist them in overcoming the physical and tactical challenges that come with their powers. By creating these simulations and training environments, he allows patients to engage with their abilities in a safe, controlled way, reducing the likelihood of dangerous outbursts and helping them build confidence in their control. It is this dual approach—emotional and physical—that makes Elias such a unique and invaluable asset to the East Asylum. Though Elias remains a stoic figure to many, the impact of his presence at the asylum is undeniable. His power, combined with his unwavering commitment to his patients, has turned East Asylum into a place of healing, stability, and personal growth. The environment he’s helped craft is a far cry from the cold, clinical nature that some might expect from a facility housing Parahumans. Instead, it is a place where patients can find both the resources and the emotional support they need to understand and control their powers, all while being given the space to heal from the trauma that often comes with being a Cape. Elias’s own past, filled with both anger and healing, informs his work every day. The changes he’s made to the asylum are a reflection of the changes he has made within himself—transforming both the environment and himself into something stronger, more resilient, and more compassionate.
objects.title: Bastille

objects.text:

Cape Name:

If you've bought the OoP Chaos Emeralds, she'll even have a superform like Sonic, that almost quadruples her abilities.
