Talent agencies are booming in the underworld, there's even a popular talent scouting show called Dead Talent Society which seeks to find the next rising star amongst the many dead, with the winner being granted a working pass that allow them to linger longer with the living.

With this choice, not only does dying suck, but hauntings are now more common due to this need to stay. It is inconvenient and even downright dangerous for those alive, and that's not even mentioning how much it sucks to have to deal with showbiz and exorcists as a ghost. All in all, it is unfortunately hard to avoid toxicity, even when you're dead.
objects.title: Afterlife Spotlight (Dead Talent Society)

objects.text:
Somehow, during a meteor shower, a few hundred house-sized asteroids entered the earths atmosphere and ended up crashing somewhere on earth in remote locations during the meteor shower. These asteroids, it turns out, were no ordinary asteroids, but were in fact inhabited by Glyphids, a vicious insectoid race of creatures known for their relentless aggression and hive-bound behavior. The asteroids were filled with the most common and smallest type of Glyphids, Glyphid Grunts, small but deadly melee attackers that swarm in massive packs and relentlessly seek out anything living.

Upon impact, the asteroids ended up shattering and releasing their Glyphid cargo. Surviving Glyphid grunts immediately begin burrowing into the earth and establishing makeshift hives deep beneath the surface. These initial hives are crude but functional, but the Glyphids are rapidly expanding their hives and tunnels, and they are breeding rapidly. Over time, more and more variants of Glyphids will begin to appear from larger burrowers, and newer, unknown specialized strains will begin to appear, adapted to many of Earth’s biomes, each bolstering the spreading infestation.

If nothing is done, these hives will keep expanding. Glyphid tunnels spread outward, undermining infrastructures and converting entire regions into hostile biomass zones. Surface eradication is not enough; every hive, tunnel network, and brood cluster must be located and destroyed. If even one hive remains active, it will regenerate and send out new swarms, intensifying the infestation across the planet.

NOTE 1. With each purchase of this, it will increase the number of asteroids that crashed, as well as expand the area of the planet the asteroids landed in, with the 10th purchase making it so that the asteroids are landing in well-known cities across the world.
objects.title: The Glyphid Infestation (Deep Rock Galactic)

objects.text:
There is an infection in your world.

Hostile ghosts are spreading, affecting the land of the dead or whatever afterlife your setting has. But that doesn't mean things are any easier for the living. For a "Protagonist" has emerged amongst the masses, and they are spreading the infection to bring forth their true Master.

This infection is called "The Gift", a virus that spreads in areas with large concentration of ghosts called a Haunting Point. Upon exposure to the haunting point, potential hosts go unconscious, and should they fulfill very specific conditions (such as specific gene structures, bad mental states, and harsh family lives) they are infected. The victim would then wake up with glowing eyes. And thus, the point of near no return.

Once infected, the virus begins its work. It causes hallucinations to the victim, showing them "ghosts" of their deceased family members, who act way more pleasant than they normally would've done in life. These ghosts are merely means to get the host to let their guard down, thus letting the virus burrow deeper into their brains. Once that point is reached, the hallucinations shall drop any pretense of kindness and begin acting more harshly, more commanding. They then hurt the host so much that they lose the will to fight against its control, finally making them a puppet to this "Gift".

Once fully under the influence, the hosts shall proceed to try to rack up a body count, both in attempts at making more hostile ghosts which wrecks havoc, as well as exposing other potential hosts to the nearest haunting point. These are all done in service of some sort of eldritch being, a creature of red hands and a crescent moon.

Selecting this shall bring the Gift into your world. Who the first host is and who shall the Gift spread to is random, though the glow of their eyes and the growing amount of corpses are vital clues as to who. The Gift is a blight that is making both the afterlife and the living world into a hostile, far more dangerous place. Currently, it isn't even known if hosts could potentially be cured. No, at best, you have to find who's taken by this blight, and destroy them before they spread further. The lives of the living and the unlives of the dead are counting on you.

That is unless, you get infected yourself?
objects.title: The Gift of 1966 (Deltarune Ribbit Mod)

objects.text: There are six dice in your world, gifts from a game that made itself. Whenever five people find these dice, they are spirited away into a pocket world where they’ll have to quest their way back to reality through its twisted model of fiction and history. While inside DIE, each Player takes the form of a Paragon, each with their unique skills, all trying to return: The Dictator, hated and feared for very good reasons as they twist emotions and bend minds. The Fool, which bound into action without care for the chaos in their wake, skimming through situations by the skin of their teeth as consequences follow behind. The Emotion Knight, bonded to signature weapons leeching off their psyche to fuel their creative violence. The Neo, a chromed-up cybernetic addict in deep debt to the Fair for their gifts. The Godbinder, a divine daemonologist exchanging favours and tokens with gods of all kinds. The Master, who rules, cheats, and breaks reality in order to 'facilitate' their journey, though rarely in a non-adversarial way. When a Player dies inside of DIE, they arise as a Fallen, still themselves but with none of their gifts, only able to return by consuming another living paragon. Similarly, no dead or Fallen player can leave DIE. At the quest’s end, each player receives their vote from the Grandmaster of DIE, where they can return to the real world, or betray the real and live forever in DIE. The majority applies to everyone. Once it's done, they return to their world, though time continues to pass there, and they retain any scars and injuries they gained on their journey.
objects.title: DIE (DIE)

objects.text:
The fallen do not rest. 

Whenever someone with powers dies, they don’t stay down for long. After only a few moments they rise again, alive but without the powers that were once theirs. While to some this may be considered a lucky break, the issues arise with the other aspects of the fallen. 

Firstly, the Fallen are visibly disfigured and obviously Fallen. Similarly, their voices are gritty and distinctive, utterly removing most options for concealing them. This means they have to rely on stealth and ambush tactics to complete their other objective.

Secondly, a Fallen can return to life, all they have to do is kill and eat the flesh of someone else with powers, after which they’ll come back completely healed, albeit with a mouth full of human meat. 

Finally, if a Fallen is killed, they’ll arise again, but completely removed from their minds and little more than savage animals searching for a way to restore their minds (and lives). While in this form they’re capable of smelling and tracking power usage in order to facilitate their revivals. 

If you’re in a world that places a high value on powers, prepare for a poor time to follow, for instance, in Worm, it’s highly likely Cauldron would increase the rate of Kill Orders so that useful Fallen could come back completely well (except for the trauma of course).
objects.title: Fallen (DIE)

objects.text:
The universe has gained a new threat in the form of humanoid aliens known as Saiyans. This empire is led by a line of men all named Vegeta, with Saiyans ranging from all sorts of strength levels. Universal aspects of this race include an ability to get far stronger from near death, a Tail that lets them turn 10 times stronger as a giant monkey during a full moon or an artificial moon, immense power and combat capability.

Average Low-Class warriors typically have a similar haircut and appearance overall, and have capabilities ranging from destroying moons to maybe razing a planets surface.

Mid Class warriors don't have a set appearance, and can accomplish the peak of what a low-class Saiyan could, and likely destroy chunks of planets.

Elite-Class warriors are the cream of the crop, able to destroy whole planets smaller than Earth. And Royalty... well, they can do that and then some, especially with training.

This version of the army comes with all the ships and technology they were ever given by the Frieza Force before their demise, meaning space travel is fairly easy for them. And their scientists are quite capable of advancement. Earth's mercy is that their home world, Planet Vegeta, with its 10x gravity of Earth, is far outside our own solar system.
objects.title: The Saiyan Army (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Not only do the Saiyan homeworld and Saiyan species exist... Now, the hell known as the Frieza Force exists in the universe as well, bringing horrors on a universal scale. And the scarier part is that the leader of this army, Lord Frieza... has solved his loyalty problem with the Saiyans. Frieza has now revealed the true depths of his power to those on Planet Vegeta, allowing him to be absolutely fearless of the Saiyans, even if by some miracle they actually reach anywhere near his strength. This means that now, this comes with everyone ever worked with or under the Frieza Force. Before, solo or groups of Earth-destroying-level Saiyans were among the biggest things the planet had to fear. Now, in terms of pure destructive power, the Endbringers even have a new threat with all of Frieza's men and technology under his control. Hundreds of thousands men under his control, none weaker than a moonbuster, and hundreds of planets throughout the universe under his control. From Appule to Cheelai, from Guldo to Dodoria, the universe is certainly in for a threat. Note: King Cold is included, but Cooler and his forces are not.
objects.title: The Frieza Force (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: The Apocalypse will be Televised! Congratulations! Your planet has the honor to be chosen for this season of Dungeon Crawler World, the hit galactic reality show about survival! Hooray! Unfortunately, your Homeworld has now been seized by the current host company chosen by the Syndicate Council. This means your world would undergo a transformation. The company overseeing the planet would be taking all of its resources and use them into constructing the Dungeon that shall serve as the basis for this season of Dungeon Crawler World. And thus, business shall begin. As according to Syndicate laws, locals of the planet are to be given the chance to take back control of their planet by becoming a Crawler and trying to beat the current season's challenge. These could range from a Battle Royale, to Land Wars, or most popular of all... 18 Floor Dungeons. Your planet has been prepped by your host for this very moment. A System AI shall be handling the layout, loot, rules, mobs and named NPCs of the dungeon. Should you choose to be a Crawler, you shall be given a Crawler Interface that lists down your given Stats, Skills, Class, Species, Levels, Inventory, Party, etc. This shall be important in surviving whatever the theme of your Dungeon Crawler World season, so you better listen to the first Tutorial NPC you meet on the specifics of your system, especially since they vary between seasons. But note, survival isn't the only important thing inside the dungeon. You also have to be entertaining. Give the viewers a great show, and maybe earn some Sponsors or Lootboxes. Remember, this is an entertainment show first and foremost. This may help a ton in either attempting to beat the game or survive long enough to be offered an Exit Deal, which turns you into an NPC for the next season handled by your corporation as per contract. Finally, take note that the dungeons, whatever it may be, shall have a huge effect on your biology. This ranges from healing you of injuries or certain mental illnesses (but won't heal disabilities), to full on turning you into a new species should you choose that, not to mention how your stats already affect you and you might come out of this a changed person. Overall, think of yourselves in a cruel corporate game stream where you're the characters and the galactic masses get to watch your suffering. Fun! Do you have what it takes to survive your new life in showbiz? Then crawl.
objects.title: Dungeon Crawler World (Dungeon Crawler Carl)

objects.text:
The world you're going to will have an energy that flows throughout it like countless streams in a river, one that can carry the echo of emotions and memories of all life, filling the world with life and magic to strengthen the people of the world by giving them access to the magic system of Final Fantasy.

The greatest and most iconic symbol of this power being crystals that are formed from the energy of the world and its inhabitants, these naturally forming crystals come in sets of four representing Air, Earth, Fire, and Water, helping regulate the energy of the world and promote life while being sources of great power in and of themselves. These crystals come in two types; Continental Crystals, each continent having their own set of four crystals, and Mother Crystals that oversee the whole world.

Each Crystal is located in naturally forming temple-like structures, with each being protected by a Guardian to fend off those with ill intent, while the temples of the Continental Crystals draw people to migrate near them, adding records of their civilizations to the temple and constructing settlements near them, earning their place in history. Meanwhile, the Temples of the Mother Crystals are more well protected, with far more powerful guardians and additional defences like only being accessible during certain conditions or teleporting around the world, becoming more akin to myths.

Yet, despite all their power, these Crystals can still be affected by the emotions of the people and the condition of the world, causing them to become clouded – or worse, Corrupted – causing them to stop working or bring disaster upon the world, with the Continental Crystals being affected before the Mother Crystals. When such a thing happens, the Crystals empower champions to prevent, overturn, and save the world from this crisis, with these champions becoming known as Warriors of Light. As Warriors of Light, they see their growth rate greatly increase and find all their skills and abilities increased to match the crisis so long as it is within the power of the Crystals.

As the people advance, they will learn more of this magic, leading to the creation of Magitech and the creation of man-made Crystals allowing people to use and learn spells/skills (Materia), and with time creating Crystals with such depth as to help someone learn a lifetime of skills in only a fraction of the time (general reference to job classes and such, but less restrictive) and able to be passed onto another.

Remember always that the forces of the world must be used as they were intended – that the power of Light must never be used for Dark – and that the Fifth Crystal resides ever in your heart.​
objects.title: The Crystal's Light (Final Fantasy)

objects.text: Fly high on your miraculous wings of a phoenix There was a book known as The Universe of the Four Gods containing a fairy tale that was transcribed from an ancient Chinese scroll which calls to virgin women, pulling them into the story in which they become the main character. The priestess who shall call forth one of the Four Gods (and maybe even a Fifth one) through her Seven Celestial Warriors, with her God fulfilling three of her wishes. And it seems that one of these priestesses' wishes had led to immense consequences in this world. The book's tale and your universe had become one. The influence of the four gods have spread in your world, to the point that people begun to worship them. These gods were Suzaku the Phoenix, Seiryuu the Dragon, Genbu the Tortoise, and Byakku the Tiger. Every few decades or so, a lady will be chosen by one or more of these gods as their priestess, their followers shall exalt them as bringers of great fortune. Thus begins their quest, trying to find seven people marked with the name of their gods' stars on their body, giving these warriors powers all to protect their priestess. Upon entering, your setting shall have at least one priestess and their warriors. The priestess can be any female identifying character, while their seven can be anybody random. You can even potentially be either of them. Keep that in mind as the priestess and her warriors shall be sought after for their wishes, bringing fortune and danger in their wake. Said wishes shall be granted once she summons her god via gathering all seven of her warriors. She can wish for anything. However, if she has a weak will, there is risk of being taken over by her god, transforming her and ending up in her being absorbed by their very deity. This world is a story. Shall you take part in this mysterious play?
objects.title: The Mysterious Play (Fushigi Yuugi)

objects.text:
A few months after you arrive in your chosen world, a mysterious gate will appear in the city of your choice. This gate leads through a wormhole-like connection to a fantasy world, where the local superpower, the Empire, plans to use the opening of the gate to expand its territory.

The first opening of the gate will be accompanied by the standing army of the Empire invading through the gate in an attempt to establish a bridgehead for further conquest. While magic is known and actively practised in the world of empire, it is not so readily available as to supplement the army itself. And the technological level of the world beyond the gate is roughly on par with that of the Roman Empire, with the most dangerous military units being wyvern riders and various races of demi-humans.
objects.title: Invasion From Another World (Gate — Thus the JSDF Fought There!)

objects.text: A “planet” suddenly appears in the Solar System. Settling in between Neptune and Pluto, it behaves strangely, unlike an astronomical object and much like a lifeform. Suddenly, it fires a beam of light towards Neptune. Nothing’s ever the same. Through the telescope, Neptune slowly mutates, becoming something else. It’s almost unrecognizable in the span of years, with an atmosphere (?) that resembles an ocular organ, a lens. And all of a sudden, it repeats the cycle; a ray of “light” coming from the ice giant approaches the Earth. Earth will experience a slow and gruelling invasion, beginning beneath the waters and bowels of the Earth; a moss-like, fleshy biomass starts germinating, spreading far and wide, giving rise to many horrors: an arachnid creature capable of silently attacking and possessing/infecting living organisms, multi-legged gardeners tending crops, deep-root diseases that either assimilate or possess people taking their form, a nature’s mockery, a giant mass made of humans and living animals for a “deal gone wrong”, among many things you’ll wish you hadn’t known. Oh, and mannequins that rest in your dreams, fun. All of this is fully under Iris' control and dominion, communicating through the roots as an extension of its will, leaving all the assimilated lifeforms mentally intact… in the loosest sense of the word. Unable to sit idle, humanity will respond accordingly, creating organizations and/or companies dealing with Iris’ influence, ones conspiring alongside it, others antagonistic toward the threat the Iris poses to humanity. Make sure you’re inoculated from tumorous infections and mental influence; you’ll need it.
objects.title: The Hungry Eye (Gemini Home Entertainment)

objects.text: Across your world seven Archons will appear. Archons are gods, powerful beings aligned with specific domains such as freedom, eternity, or love, who govern aspects of the Human Realm, essentially the facet of existence that hosts human (and other mortal) civilization(s). More importantly, they each hold near absolute authority over one of the seven elements, those being Anemo (Wind), Geo (Earth), Electro (Lightning), Dendro (Life), Hydro (Water), Pyro (Fire), and Cryo (Ice). The power of an Archon cannot be underestimated. Each Archon is capable of feats that can affect entire nations, such as launching attacks that literally carve countries into two pieces, terraform entire mountain ranges, create endless storms which blanket entire lands, alter the dreams of entire peoples, and more. It is not an exaggeration to say that an Archon could potentially end an entire world if not for the intervention of another being of equal or greater power, such as another Archon or a stronger god. This is especially true as each Archon will arrive with their respective Gnosis, an artifact that further enhances their power. Upon arriving, the Archons will 'claim' a territory for their own, becoming the god of that land and its people. What they do with that territory depends on the Archon in question, one might choose to become its absolute ruler, another its guardian angel while leaving the administration entirely to normal humans, and yet another simply an adviser and teacher of their people. In addition to this, the presence of the Archons have brought with them fragments of the Heavenly Principles. Without the existence of Celestia and beings like the Sustainer of Heavenly Principles, these can't completely overwrite any preexisting systems that govern the world, however they do still bring a number of aspects of Teyvat with them. The most important aspect is the existence of elemental energy and the Visions which manipulate it. Visions are essentially magical jeweled amulets bestowed upon people with particularly strong desires, typically aligned with the Archon of that element. For example, if the Anemo Archon was the god of freedom, Anemo Vision holders would generally be those who seek freedom for themselves or others from something. A normal person can only ever have one Vision, and if they lose it or turn back on the desires that granted it they will be reduced to a normal person again. On the other hand, it is also possible for a Vision holder to ascend to godhood under specific circumstances. The presence of elemental energy also leads to the creation of elemental lifeforms, such as slimes, and mythical beasts, such as whopperflowers. These beings either composed of or heavily infused with an element could be considered dangerous, invasive species, easily capable of killing the average person. However, materials harvested from them have a number of uses for crafting and other purposes. Other aspects include the introduction and influence of other realms, such as the Human Realm’s Ley Lines, the Light Realm’s elemental currents, the dreamworld and everything that comes from entering and manipulating it, people’s Fates being written in the stars, and more. Any aspects which have preexisting equivalents will be superseded by those equivalents, however they will still influence and alter them to a limited degree, such as Type-Moon’s Ley Lines beginning to store memories in addition to mana. Be warned, this modifier brings a number of problems with it. The Archons may not necessarily be peaceful and could in fact start world shaping wars between each other, other preexisting gods, the people of their lands if they reject them, and more. Visions being bestowed to random people could lead to chaos as holders may abuse their powers for various reasons and purposes. New gods being born may lead to a world war between them all for power or to try claiming an Archon's throne, and the death of a god generally leads to disaster as their power lingers, cursing the land unless specific steps are taken to mitigate it. Worst of all, someone might find the Void Realm and accidentally, or worse deliberately, summon the Abyss into the world. All of this and more is possible, and the only thing the world can do is adapt to the new normal. Good luck. Note: You may decide precisely who the Archons are. Perhaps the seven Archons from Genshin Impact, or maybe their predecessors, or even simple Vision holders who find themselves suddenly elevated to Archon status such as Fischl as the Electro Archon. Maybe the Archon is a version of a character from another setting adapted as an Archon, such as Elsa from a version of Arendelle that was always in Teyvat as the Cryo Archon, or even an entirely original character of your own creation. Who they are, how long they’ve been an Archon, what they’re the god of besides their element, it’s all up to you.
objects.title: Archon Descent (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Something that should be impossible has occurred: the birth of a new element. What this element is can be anything you choose, such as light, shadow, space, death, star, slime, literally anything is possible (it having a greek name ending in ‘o’ is optional). The exact abilities of this element depend on what it is, the symbolism associated with it, as well as a few other factors. For example, a star element would allow for plasma or gravity manipulation due to how real stars work, but it could also allow for limited fate manipulation due to how fates are quite literally written in the stars in Teyvat. Whatever this element is, it immediately becomes a part of the world with all that it entails, such as new Visions being bestowed, elemental lifeforms manifesting, etc.

Most importantly though is that somewhere a new Archon will appear. This Archon can be anyone, whether a preexisting god or a previously completely mundane mortal forcibly ascended to godhood, who now bears authority over this element. Who they are and whether or not they had anything to do with the new element existing or just got lucky is up to you, or you could leave it to chance. Either way, the sudden presence of a newborn Archon will change the face of the world, whether only politically or quite literally depends on whether or not they are capable of getting along with or at least agreeing to leave the other Archons be and what their overall goals are.

How exactly this new element exists is up to you. Maybe someone researched, planned, and executed a ritual which created it while simultaneously ascending into Archon status. Perhaps a new Descender appeared bringing an element from their homeworld with them. It could be that the element was always meant to exist and its appearance is a sign of the world fixing itself. Or maybe it was just a bafflingly improbable random occurrence. No matter the how or why, whatever the original fate of the world was is now irrelevant, as it is rewritten thanks to new possibilities emerging.

Each purchase adds one new element and its respective Archon to the world, up to seven new elements to match the seven original elements, with every additional one further altering the world and causing increasing levels of chaos as it is forced to adapt.
objects.title: Additional Elements (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
All hail your soon to be new overlords! From beyond the veil, in the realm of immortality and creation come these higher dimensional beings to take your world under their control.

These ancient aliens plan to rule with superior technology, immense knowledge and mastery over the fundamentals of creation. To Further help there rule is: The Star God of Creation and Immortality blessings which mean they possess immense magical power, portions of its own divinity, limitless mana, everlasting immortality from lacking a concept of death and destruction, and lastly, the divine power to create matter and energy from where none existed before. Ergo creating things ex nihilo and being negentropic.

This also affects their creations such as: Their magic-tech ships which can traverse space, time, and dimensions, sustaining themselves indefinitely until destroyed. For example the legendary Grancypher, which is a mighty, living, magic-tech galleon was the flagship of the astral invasion. Its engine will operate indefinitely, and is a perpetual motion machine. It's also extremely durable, surviving blows from fragments of the sky god and can be blessed by primals to be stronger.

Then there is the magnum opus the primal beasts which are ambiguous deities of idea and metaphor bound to physical form. Creating primal beasts personifies and shackles the very building blocks of reality to be servants to the astrals.
 
The earliest primal beasts created by the astral Lucilius were the archangels who’s cores were in their wings unlike other primals. Chief among the Archangels were the Primarchs, immensely powerful personifications of the elements that composed the Sky Realm. And at the head of the Primarchs sat the Supreme Primarch, Lucifer: one of the most powerful Primal Beasts to ever be conceived, who sustained the balance of Light and Darkness and oversaw the evolution of life in the skies.

However this wasn't enough for them. They even managed to subjugate fragments of the Sky God, converting these divine beings into Primal Beasts under their influence. Moreover, they also reached the Seat of God itself, Estalucia. Though the divine realm proved beyond their capacity to conquer wholly, they asserted control over its access through their Sky Maps, and rewrote history to repaint it as the Island of the Astrals.

Primal beast cores are also indestructible and immortal like their creators. They can only truly die if released by an astral.
objects.title: Astral Invasion (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text:
Emotionless and amoral beings of logical order have come to the conclusion that your world is better if it belongs to them. These descendants of the ancients are monstrous, boasting extended lifespans and advanced technology. 

All technology is based around Machine Cells which are highly versatile nanomachines which are the basis for many Central Axis technologies, most notably Automagods. They can resist most forms of damage due to their inherent durability and ability to quickly multiply and repair themselves. The Automagod Diaspora utilizes a more advanced model of Machine Cell which is capable of operating highly autonomously, allowing it to freely shift its form and function even in the form of gaseous clouds or pseudo liquids.

Omega-3 agents possessing Central Axis’ best combat augmentations and strongest warriors of the moon:
Juana Stone- She possesses a high metabolism and the ability to consume and digest nearly any material, being able to absorb properties from the materials she devoured in order to strengthen her body. 
Ellis Stamp- He possesses a unique sense of perception along a higher dimensional “t-axis” that enabled him to look into the past and calculate the future- further, he was capable of manipulating people’s minds and Automagods’ machine brains via access from this higher “t-axis”.
Dex Krak- He possesses abnormally high adrenaline levels that enabled him to fight for years on end without rest, and gave him enough gargantuan strength and durability to easily fight off multiple Weapon Contractors(seal weapon/automagod users) at once. 

Past them are Automagods; Ancient war machines of the Moon dwellers which are formed by fully awakened Seal Weapons, designed to combat the Primal Beasts of the Astrals.
They are highly advanced constructs of great power, equipped with advanced energy weaponry and composed of Machine Cells which render them nigh indestructible save to certain weapons capable of overcoming their durability and rapid regeneration. There are a total of Thirteen:

 Arianensa is a scouting model that possesses potent sensory capabilities beyond being equipped with monofilament wires to slice through most materials at incredible speeds.

 Grynoth possesses purple pyrotech abilities and tendrils to control people, sending them into mindless rages.

 Flamek possesses the ability to fire unyielding torrents of electricity, which can affect large spaces and massed quantities of targets.

 Nybeth possesses the ability to restrict the powers of other entities, both magical and technological.

 Arvess possesses the ability to generate flames of incredible heat, increase its own speed and responds against its opponents conviction.

 Embrasque possesses a more conscious Artificial intelligence and increases in offensive power in response to injuries or being pushed to the edge.

 Pyet-A Although surpassed in might by Automagod Diaspora, its combat capabilities exceed those of the other 11 Automagods, which had their specifications pared down for the sake of practicality and efficiency. Has abilities of Grynoth and Arianensa.

  Merlenaut as an Automagod still has the free floating spread of machine cells that possesses the ability to change into a poison that can debilitate virtually any target. Its efficacy is nearly absolute, and it is capable of overcoming any amount of physical or magical resistance in theory- even that of a God. However, it can only be used against a target once.

 Yatima is a massive Automagod with a highly condensed Machine cell that is equivalent to the size of a regular floating island in Sky-realm but her main body/source is the size of a young girl with dark red hair.

Yatima's abilities are close to replication and duplication capable of copying primal beast shape and power by simply analyzing them, capable of copying even Proto-Bahamut and his abilities. How she is able to completely copy a primal beast abilities is unknown but she employs the use of Automagods abilities to completely absorb a primal beast (Ambiguous deities of idea and metaphor), and machine cell to completely copy and replicate the shape and abilities of a primal beast allowing her to use their abilities by simply witnessing them or analyzing an entity and their capabilities.

Although she is capable of copying primal beast abilities she has never shown to copy other Automagod abilities, she is also capable of making Composite forms of primal beast merging primal beast abilities into one and having their body function separately from her but still as part of her.

Lastly, Diaspora is the culmination of the Moon’s technological development, it was the Thirteenth Automagod, and the basis of the Disassembler frequently used by Central Axis. Like all Automagods Diaspora was composed of Machine Cells, but the Machine Cells used in its construction were more advanced models capable of greater autonomy. This allowed it to effortlessly reconfigure into different forms, as well as separate into any number of fully functional independent entities.

Diaspora used these Machine Cells in order to break materials down into their basic molecular components, and as such was used by Central Axis in order to recycle waste into usable resources. The development of Automagod Diaspora caused further construction of Automagods to cease, as they were deemed unnecessary and outdated- instead Diaspora was continuously upgraded and improved, and by the events of Stay Moon, it comprised 15-20% of the Moon’s total mass.

Good Luck, You’ll need it.
objects.title: Lunar Assault (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text:
Somehow, whether because of a Resonance Cascade or just sheer bad luck, a Portal Storm has begun to ravage your world. A Portal Storm is what happens when multiple dimensions violently intersect one another, causing catastrophic damage to result. In this case, it is your dimension and the borderworld of Xen that are intersecting.

The Portal Storm manifests as a series of shockwaves that appear around the world, especially where the dimensional border is damaged such as the epicenter of a dimensional portal device explosion. These shockwaves cause temporary gravity fluctuations that damage the environment, which can compound over time until entire cities crumble. In addition, they can cause temporary portals to form, forcibly shifting lifeforms and small pieces of geography between dimensions.

As a result of this, various Xenien lifeforms will begin to infest your world. These range from parasitic Headcrabs that turn their victims into zombie-like monsters, to the terrifying Gargantua, to the sentient psychic Vortigaunts enslaved by Xen’s ‘ruler’, to many more bizarre and dangerous beings. These species will be nearly universally hostile, acting as invasive lifeforms that threaten the ecosystem and civilization alike.

Over time, the Portal Storms will get worse, starting out as only a threat to your starting location before spreading across the entire continent in only a matter of days. In weeks, it shall spread across the whole planet, and potentially beyond given enough time. The only way to stop the Storms would be to find a way into Xen itself and fight its ruler, the Nihilanth.

Xen is a dimension where physics and the topography are warped in bizarre ways, filled with floating islands connected by natural portals. If you search far enough, you may find the path leading to the Nihilanth, a massive psychic lifeform that seeks to escape into your world. Should you kill it, the Portal Storms growth will slow dramatically, before eventually reversing until no more occur after around a year.

While definitely a disaster of epic proportions, there are still some benefits to find in this event. For one, killing the Nihilanth will result in the Vortigaunts being freed, and they will immediately declare mankind its allies, sharing their knowledge of strange technologies and sciences, particularly knowledge of psychic phenomena. In addition, Xen has many unique resources, such as pools of healing liquid, but especially Xenium, an absurdly efficient powersource.

Still though, what made the Nihilanth so desperate to reach this world? It was almost as if it were running from something. Fortunately, whatever it was they were running from, there is no sign of them having successfully followed it here, so you are safe from that at least.
objects.title: Xenien Invasion (Half-Life)

objects.text: Carbon stars with ancient satellites colonized by sentient fungi. Gas giants inhabited by vast meteorological intelligences. Worlds stretched thin across the membranes where dimensions intersect... Impossible to describe with our limited vocabulary! - Dr. Breen It seems as though luck was not on your side, and the threat the Nihilanth was running from has caught up with it, and by extension your world. Less than a month after the Portal Storms have started a series of large scale portals will open around the world. From these portals will emerge a fleet of warships carrying an immense army with one goal: to conquer the world in the name of the Universal Union, otherwise known as the Combine. The Combine is a massive expansionistic empire that has conquered anywhere from a few thousand planets spanning multiple universes to potentially the entirety of said universes and all the worlds within, their true size being rather unclear (assume that however big your setting is, the Combine Empire is a couple thousand times larger). They are very advanced, possessing a number of dyson spheres and a mastery of biotechnological augmentation. Their might is such that an early 21st century Earth can be conquered in just seven hours. Upon conquering the planet, a process that will likely kill billions, their fleet moves on to other conquests, either in setting if your world is spacefaring, or to some other universe if not. Meanwhile, they will begin harvesting the world’s resources. Oceans will drop several feet, thousands if not millions of species will go extinct from overhunting, and humanity will be confined to a handful of cities. Life under Combine occupation can be described as a totalitarian fascist hellhole. People are shifted from city to city, not allowed to form familial bonds, and if new ones are formed they are quickly broken up with another forced relocation. Drugs are placed in rations to disrupt memory and make citizens more compliant. People are encouraged to join the local garrison’s armed forces for better accommodations, starting as the City Police known as Overwatch, but advancement requires progressively greater levels of cybernetic enhancement and brainwashing until they can’t even remember their own names let alone their families. The worst part of Combine rule is the fact that they drive all their ‘client races’ extinct. Each City possesses a Citadel, a miles high tower that connects the planet to the Combine portal network, but it also releases a massive reproductive suppression field. By preventing the formation of certain protein chains necessary for embryonic development, they ensure that no new children are born. Eventually, all races are reduced to become cybernetically modified slaves with their homeworlds completely consumed. Even in the face of all this, there is hope. The Combine are essentially creatively sterile, advancing by stealing the technology and knowledge of other civilizations. If you can innovate enough, you might stand a chance. More than that, if their portal network is damaged, such as by destroying a Citadel midway through the formation of a portal, you can cripple their ability to enter your universe, which initially required taking advantage of the Portal Storms acting as an opening. Doing so would also break the suppression field, allowing for children to be born once again. The chances of victory and eventual freedom are slim, but they do exist, if only the people work together to achieve it.
objects.title: Combine Invasion (Half-Life)

objects.text:
The world of magic is no longer centered around wizardkind. Though the familiar wizarding society remains much the same — steeped in tradition, clinging to bloodline hierarchies, and enforcing outdated laws — they are no longer the apex of magical civilization. Instead, they are now one among many magical cultures, and arguably the most stagnant. While the Ministry of Magic still holds sway in its limited jurisdiction, its reach is increasingly irrelevant in a global landscape filled with older, deeper, and more dynamic magical societies. The wizards, isolated and proud, believe themselves to be more “civilized” than the rest, but this belief is seen as laughably arrogant by many outside their cloistered walls.

Across the world, all manner of magical beings have not only flourished but evolved into complex societies with their own philosophies, power structures, and traditions. The merfolk, long thought primitive by wizards, are revealed to have sprawling undersea civilizations — most notably the Atlanteans, who trace their roots back to pre-human myth and command deep-tide magics unknown on land. Nature-bound druids, humans who were descendants of animals, operate in symbiotic harmony with their environments. Even new magical identities have emerged as well. Warlocks — muggles who have entered into magical contracts with patrons — whose magic differs greatly from one another and often feared, yet deeply respected in many magical cultures. Squibs also have form communities of their own, with many variants appearing, the most common being individuals who cannot cast spells, but possess beast-like strength, resilience, or heightened perception, often surpassing magical beasts in raw physical capability.

Culturally, the magical world is more fractured, but also more honest. Speciesism and prejudice still exist, but so do efforts toward diplomacy, cultural exchange, and even conflict resolution. Not all societies get along — some resent others, some wage subtle wars of influence, and some remain hidden by choice.
objects.title: The Ivory Tower (Harry Potter)

objects.text: "Who will pray for me, when I'm gone?" Birthed from a massive entity of chaos, the five Lords in Black were born, ruling over the other realm called The Black and White where they continue to plot, scheme, and generally have a lot of fun ruining the lives of the puny mortals beneath them. They have already ruined the town of Hatchetfield many times over at this point, and now, they have set their sights on your universe. Backed up by several cults in their name, may Lord have mercy on us all. Each Lord of Black is a threat on their own. The following are all five of them alongside their domain and their particular ways of screwing with people: Wiggy is THE Lord of Black and the current ruler of the Black and White. He is represented by the color green and is supposedly the most clever of his siblings. He also once created a doll of himself that caused immense chaos with people wanting to buy it by any means necessary. Blinky is The Watcher With A Thousand Eyes and is represented by the color purple. The most sadistic of the Lords, he once started an amusement park with him as the mascot, manipulating its visitors into fighting one another for his sick pleasure. Tinky the Bastard of Time and Space, represented by yellow, is the owner of the Bastard Box, a time traveling device that when opened, could drive people insane. He tempts people with its power, before claiming their souls to be trapped forever inside the artifact. Nibbly is The One Who Hungers in the Dark, represented by pink, and is the hungriest of the siblings, capable of inhabiting any vessel on Earth once a year where he may devour people to fill his insatiable hunger. And finally, Pokey the Singular Voice, represented by blue, and is the most controlling of the siblings. He manifests in a meteor which spreads a hivemind virus that forces people to communicate through singing and dancing. And in one reality, he managed to completely take over Earth in less than a week. These eldritch beings are able to be summoned through The Black Book, a grimoire of spells capable of utilizing their powers, but at a cost. Particularly, they would grant you your wish so long as you sacrifice the most important thing in your life.
objects.title: The Lords of Black (Hatchetfield Series)

objects.text:
Somehow, an Automaton fleet has appeared in orbit and has begun to land troops across the planet.

Know Vast drop-sites have appeared across the planet where the Automatons have landed, and the Automatons have already begun to set up production facilities across the planet, which have now begun to build and deploy endless ranks of heavily armed robotic soldiers. These machines operate under a centralized war protocol driven by cold, alien logic: total conquest through extermination.

The Automatons have already rapidly established fortified factories, using captured resources and infrastructure to mass-produce war units, artillery platforms, aerial drones, and armored walkers. Every city they seize becomes a new manufacturing hub for their war machine.

If nothing is done, the Automatons will expand relentlessly, overwhelming human defenses with superior firepower, numbers, and mechanical precision.

Destroying only frontline units is not enough. All production facilities and command nodes must be eliminated. If even one factory remains operational, the Automatons will rebuild their forces and resume their planetary campaign.

There is a possibility that a primary Command Core exists somewhere on the planet, directing all Automaton activity. Destroying it would cause widespread disorganization, but not total shutdown unless every remaining factory is also destroyed. 

Note: Should the World & Reality Modifier Galactic be taken, then the Automaton Invasion will begin on a different planet if you want it to.
objects.title: The Automaton Invasion (Helldivers 2)

objects.text:
Somehow, a fleet belonging to the advanced alien civilization known as the Illuminate has emerged in orbit around the planet

Through unknown dimensional or warp-based technology. The  Illuminate have begun to land forces and have established multiple landing zones across the planet.

The Illuminati view humanity and parahumans as inferior life forms. They do not negotiate, retreat, or compromise. Their goal is total domination through extermination or forced assimilation.

If left unchecked, the Illuminate will expand their foothold, converting captured populations into Voteless soldiers and establishing permanent alien strongholds across Earth Bet.

Destroying only frontline forces is not enough.
All Illuminate units and structures must be eliminated. If any survive, they will reopen warp entry points and resume their invasion elsewhere, spreading their influence across the planet.

Note: Should the World & Reality Modifier Galactic be taken, then the Illuminate Invasion will begin on a different planet if you want it to.
objects.title: The Illuminate Invasion (Helldivers 2)

objects.text:
Somehow, a Terminid hive has appeared on the planet.

The Terminids are in the middle of constructing massive underground spore pods and breeding nests. Whether through dimensional rupture, meteor impact, or something else, the Terminids now infest a large territory and are expanding rapidly.

The Terminids reproduce through both spores and biological breeding pits, creating endless waves of insectoid warriors, artillery organisms, and specialized strains. Their numbers are growing faster than conventional forces can exterminate them. Entire towns and wilderness zones have already been consumed or rendered uninhabitable.

If nothing is done, the swarm will continue to spread outward, overrunning population centers and collapsing regional governments under sheer biological pressure.

Destroying only surface swarms is not enough. All breeding nests and spore sources must be eradicated. If even a single hive cluster remains intact, the Terminids will regenerate their forces within weeks and resume expansion.

Note: Should the World & Reality Modifier Galactic be taken, then the Terminids will appear on a different planet. Also, these are the Terminids from Helldivers 2. It should also be noted that these Terminids produce Element-710, which can be used to fuel an Alcubierre Drive, which can do a form of FTL travel. So it would be a good idea to take the Technology and Artifice Power “Bug Hunt" with this.
objects.title: The Terminid Invasion (Helldivers 2)
The Lament Configuration (Hellraiser)
objects.text:
Somewhere in the globe, a portal to Hell resides in the form of a puzzle box. Made by a toymaker at the behest of an aristocrat obsessed with dark magics, the toymaker fashioned this intricate box, working as an audience with a species of entities, which they called themselves Cenobites.

Cenobites are extradimensional beings by their Master, characterized by their horrid mutilations and fetishistic attire. They usually come to our dimension through a schism in space-time made by strange artifacts, which the puzzle box matches with flying colors.

The Cenobites follow their Master’s tenet in sensation, a form of unearthly hedonism where you must explore sensation’s rim by stretching your limits in pain and pleasure.

The box will be known in certain circles for its power, able to grant anyone's wish once they solve it. With an audience of Cenobites, who ask payment in blood. Like moths to a flame.

Note: You can change how Cenobites are to Clive Baker’s original book depiction, the 1987 movie series, or the 2022 remake.

Your new world has now gained access to the Sacred Gear System. The Sacred Gear System exists to be a balancing agent for Humanity to match and surpass the supernatural as only humans and those that possess at least half human genetics will be able to have a Sacred Gear this will not stop them from changing species but non humans are incapable of being born with a Sacred Gear; not all Sacred Gears are equal as there exists a hierarchy to Sacred Gears. 

Sacred Gears are numerous each with a unique power such as the ability to summon fire or a variety of other abilities, these would be classified as normal Sacred Gears as the Sacred Gears are bound to the to the wielders via the soul the Sacred Gear can be effected by its wielder gaining unique Sub-Species based on evolving to match the thoughts and feelings of the wielder becoming more powerful with enough time constantly used through generations even a weak Sacred Gear can develop to the class of a Longinus Class through mutations.

There exist various Holy Longinus Class Sacred Gears, with only a singular copy in existence; weaker Sacred Gears appear multiple times, with numerous people possessing copies of them. They are unique, being outliers with the Sacred Gear System considered a glitch in the system known as Tools that Destroy the Divine. Powerful enough to shake the very world and shape nations. 

Depending on the universe, new, unique Sacred Gears can be retroactively made; for example, Sacred Gears made from Phantasmal Beasts, Heroic Spirits, or Divine Spirits can be introduced into the Sacred Gear System. Depending on the universe, this can significantly boost the number of Longinus Class Sacred Gears available.
objects.title: Sacred Gear System (High School DxD)
The Evil One (High School DxD)
objects.text:
Alongside Yahweh exists the Evil One, a primordial agent of chaos that responds to His acts of creation. When Yahweh created Earth, it created Hell; when He created animals and humanity, it produced demons and curses. 

Lucifer later organized many demons into Devil society but neither served nor ruled the Evil One. Its presence prevents Trihexa from forming, as the Beast would catastrophically unbalance creation. 

Consequently, Yahweh survives the Great War, leaving the Biblical factions stronger and more stable while the world remains subject to the Evil One’s unpredictable interventions.

Note: The Evil One is basically the potential entity that could exist from the All the Worlds Evil upgrade if it existed in High School DXD since creation. This does not introduce cursed energy to humanity.

objects.title: We are Men of God (High School DXD)
objects.text:
In this timeline, during the earliest years of the Great War, long before civilization had fully taken shape, a group of Yahweh's first followers sought to overcome the limitations of those who lacked a natural affinity for Holy Light. 

Through relentless discipline, they discovered how to awaken and cultivate their own spiritual energy—a form of power known elsewhere as Touki in the land of Nippon. 

Combined with the Holy Light granted to them by God, this gave rise to a new tradition of warrior-saints capable of dramatically strengthening their bodies, enhancing their miracles, and developing advanced spiritual arts, including Holy abilities akin to Senjutsu and other forms of life-force manipulation.

The tradition spread throughout the growing temples of Yahweh's followers and, in time, became a cornerstone of the Church's military doctrine. 

Although God's death and the decline of the Three Factions still occur, humanity's defenders are far stronger than in the original timeline. Exorcists, paladins, and Holy Sword wielders routinely reach levels once reserved for legendary figures such as Vasco Strada, while elite members can contend with even high-class Devils and Fallen Angels through skill rather than bloodline alone. 

The Church itself remains more disciplined and far less corrupt, producing a greater number of genuinely virtuous and powerful warriors, reducing humanity's dependence on rare Sacred Gears while ensuring supernatural threats are met by a far more formidable and organized force.

In this Timeline, whether through chance or intention, Merlin of Arthurian Legend would meet and fight alongside the Archangel Uriel with this encounter leading to Uriel campaigning for Merlin's newly created magic system to be incorporated into the Church and to have them not only accept it but understand its potential. After weeks of debate, Merlin's Formulaic Magic was accepted into the Church, Merlin himself being named a saint some time after for his efforts, seen by many as taking the profane of the Devil and making it holy through the powers of God.

The aftermath of which cannot be understated as the effects are far reaching and large; the first of which was that the Church took education far more seriously as it was key to making the most of Formulaic Magic, causing the research and study of the sciences to advance at a much greater rate leading to an early Renaissance and the founding of the first modern university decades ahead of time while crippling the influence the Devils and Fallen Angels could hold over Magicians.

With the resources and influence of the Church, Merlin's Formulaic Magic was able to develop at an accelerated rate, being centuries more advanced, with it producing new tools and counters to the supernatural that can be greatly amplified by one's faith and Holy Light, amongst the first major breakthroughs being the creation of Light Containers formed from prayers capable of granting a human Holy Light. Creating new tools and vastly expanding the arsenal of Exorcists, allowing them to adapt and overcome greater and greater threats.

Scientific research never came to be seen as a threat to faith but rather a celebration of God's creation; leading to scientific integrity being a cornerstone of the Church, with attempts to present bad faith research and perverted sciences being seen as both an affront to God and Humanity, those who pressure such things being rebuked, with even a former Pope almost being beheaded on the spot for fabricating false results for their own benefit.

The Church has become both the oldest university and largest Magician Organization in the world, from which their research and studies from the university go on to advance the research of their Cleric Scholars in the Magician Organization, whose own research goes back to benefit the mundane side, creating a cycle that aids both mundane and supernatural sides. So much so, the Church would have a successful space program by 1880–1920 with satellites and the ability to land a person on the moon.

All their efforts, breakthroughs, and innovations being all their own, with Heaven having little influence—outside of stopping accidents like when a monk almost caused a nuclear detonation at the Vatican—standing as a testament to Human Ingenuity and Divine Wisdom.
objects.title: Saint Merlin the Redeemed (High School DxD)

objects.text:
In this fused world, modified moreover by alterations to church history; the culture of wizards and witches, as well as their place in the world order, has changed. 

Their self-centered, xenophobic, mundane-hating perspectives have been transformed into a long-since retired isolationism born of being valuable assets coveted by many if not most factions. Even this isolationism was turned into a proactive culture of protecting and advancing the cause of innately magical humans' rights.

After the end of the Great War, the 3 factions are coerced (in the wake of their biggest hitters' deaths) by the rest of the world into a pact (known as the Pantheon Pact) codifying the rules of war and engagement with the mundane world. This replaces the Statute of Secrecy, but among other things serves a similar function.

Led by Merlin, a great deal of powerful wizards take part in the Pact's formation and volunteer wizard kind as the Pact's international enforcers, creating a diplomatic niche for their people and creating a new faction that enforces the secrecy and regulates relations between the different factions of the supernatural world. This has served to loosely unite wizardkind under the Pantheon Pact Enforcement Organization.

Wizards and Witches are significantly less blind to the benefits of learning from other cultures and beings, and despite not accepting non-magical humans into their schools and organizations, they do allow them to engage with their economy and teach Formulaic Magic at their schools, even participating in advancing the art form. They are also well versed in mundane technology and other more esoteric forms of magic (such as Touki or Senjutsu).

Thanks to Merlin, they are closest to the Church out of any other faction, but have also significantly increased relations between the Church and pagan faiths outside the 3 factions, making the imminent treaty of the 3 factions an imminent peace treaty between ALL the supernatural factions (with rare exceptions), likely to be turned into an extension of the Pantheon Pact.
objects.title: Pantheon Pact Enforcement Organization (High School DxD/Harry Potter)

objects.text: A soul is a precious, intangible, and often undefinable. Securely kept within the body of the one it belongs to. Or is it? In every world you go, the souls of its inhabitants take the form of Daimons—spirits that accompany their human counterparts throughout their lives. Should a Daimon or their human die, the other will swiftly follow. A Daimon is born alongside its human, sharing their dreams and communicating both verbally and non-verbally. Their minds and personalities reflect and complement each other. When humans fight, their Daimons will often do so as well. Touching another person's Daimon usually evokes a sense of repulsion in their human, though a loved one's touch can sometimes bypass this instinct. Daimons typically take the form of animals, often changing shape during their human's youth. In adulthood, they usually settle into a single form that represents their human’s personality in some way. While they can adopt animal forms, Daimons are not truly animals—they are spiritual beings. Often remaining intangible and hidden from sight, they can materialize to assist their human when needed. Separating from a Daimon at a great distance is painful and unpleasant. However, with practice and time, it is possible to part across vast distances if necessary—though neither the Daimon nor the human will be enthusiastic about it. You have the option to possess a Daimon, allowing you to choose their personality, their final form (if they have one), and who can touch them. Alternatively, you can choose to be unusual and not possess a Daimon, though this choice will likely attract unwanted attention. Note: While the term "human" is used here, any species with at least the same approximate intelligence or that can be said to possess a soul will have a Daimon.
objects.title: Daimon Partners (His Dark Materials)

objects.text: When the infection ravaged Hallownest, the Pale King came up with a plan to stop the Radiance's schemes. He would seal their infection with a single, pure vessel born of God and Void. To do this, he and his wife the White Lady created thousands of children, and then threw their eggs into the Abyss so that one Vessel would eventually rise up and become the Pure Vessel he sought. In canon, this is what happened, as the Hollow Knight would eventually seal away the Infection with the help of the Dreamers. However, the Pale King made a mistake, and accidentally taught the Hollow Knight love, corrupting him and resulting in the infection leaking out. The Pale King was "erased completely", Hallowness fell, and it was only by the actions of the Second Vessel that the Radiance was finally defeated and the infection stopped. That is not what happened here. Instead, the plan went off the rails, as instead of only one Vessel successfully emerging from the Abyss as the Pale King intended, several thousand emerged. With such an immense number of beings infused with the Void, far too many for the Pale King to simply get rid of the excess, they spread all throughout Hallownest outside of his control. Somehow, one eventually stumbled their way into meeting the requirements for becoming the Void given Focus and entering Godhome with or without the Godseeker's help, and defeated the Radiance long before the Vessel who would become the Hollow Knight was even selected, let alone sealed away. Due to all of this, Hallownest is now once more a bustling civilization full of towns and travellers. Many thousands of citizens call it home as they celebrate their silent champions, many of whom have taken up numerous positions from guards to cartographers, from fighters in the Colosseum of Fools to magical researchers, from explorers to simple gardeners, and many more. All of this is ruled by Queen Hornet and her Champion, the strongest remaining Vessel who would be crowned the Hollow Knight, as the Pale King eventually stepped down as King out of guilt of what he tried to do and left on a journey of self discovery.
objects.title: Hallownest Eternal (Hollow Knight)

addons.text: Sburb is ultimately a game based on the Hero's Journey. It is a Story, and you are all the Actors playing a role in this Creation Myth of a brand new universe. You are, overall, within a Narrative. So what happens when that narrative loses a purpose? With this combination of modifiers, the Author of the fanfiction you found yourself inhabiting becomes aware of being a Narrator. They now have a strong control over the story itself and you happen to be one of the few people aware of this. This does NOT mean the Author is inherently evil, or even malicious, but, having this much power, this voice upon the entire world, that could get to people. That being said, not all hope may be loss, for with this addon, the Author is also pulled into the narrative themselves. You can also potentially find them, interact with them, or if you're feeling particularly violent, kill them and take the narrative for yourself. This game has a "game master", but you can potentially take on that role. Essentially becoming a God before even winning. That is, if you're seeking to do just that. The Author is powerful, and they have some control on folks around you, but they cannot fully control you. Who knows, maybe you can lessen their control by simply making people more self aware? This is a masterpiece, would you play your role well, or would you rather pull the narrator from their throne and do their job better?
addons.title: What Is the Plot Point?

addons.text:
The Starstream and Sburb surprisingly goes hand in hand. With this, the Scenarios become a part of Sburb's game design. As you don't even need to boot up a game anymore, everyone gets given a chance to survive and work towards their own ending. Towards a perfect new worldline where the cycle shall begin annew.

The apocalypse happens gradually instead of so suddenly through a shower of meteors, letting folks get ready for the inevitable transference to the Medium. Each Constellation becomes tied to a Denizen, and thus, an Aspect, with your fulfilment of their quests giving you further access to your Classpect abilities. Finally, reaching the very end of the Scenarios gives you the chance to create the brand new universe alongside everyone who managed to survive. You may help weave the story now, with those who's stories are strong enough to reach this very point, or you may step down and choose not to.

Stories, stories, stories. This is the lifeblood of this world. Will you let this story keep going, or will you put it to rest?
addons.title: The Show Must Go On

addons.text:
Meteors? The end of the world? A universe having cancer? Double Death??

What are those?

Thankfully, with this, Sburb turns out to be just an actual game. Hella popular due to how much you can do in the sandbox, but also receiving mixed reviews due to how buggy it is. Nonetheless, some folks seemed to find that as part of its charm.

This makes your world safe at least. You can enjoy playing Gods in whatever gaming set up you see as good. It's like Minecraft made by Bethesda, what's not to love? Or hate?
addons.title: Thanks for Playing!

objects.text: You have a feeling it's going to be a long day. The world is coming to an end. Massive meteors are going to start raining against the planet, utterly eradicating it. Thankfully, there’s a small hope, a game called Sburb, designed to create a new universe from the old. Sburb is a sandbox-esque game that overlays the real world, connecting 4-12 people. The computers the actual disk of ‘Sburb’ is installed on are only really necessary for communicating with the other players and miscellaneous software. The standard ‘Sburb’ session features a few constants. The players ‘awake’ when they sleep on one of two moons ‘Derse’ and ‘Prospit’, ruled by the black and white queens, both orbiting ‘Skaia’, a battlefield that changes whenever a player enters. When a player enters, they create a planet, from which their sole purpose is to pass through, grow stronger and progress, until they can finally reach Skaia, dethrone the Black King, and create a new universe. While this is technically the truth, Sburb ultimately is a fixture of reality, assigning an Aspect of it to each player, and a Class which they wield it through. Though only some players actually achieve their ‘Classpect’ progressing far enough to start moving through ‘the god tiers’. Unfortunately, a Classpect also binds you to a position in a story. For instance, Gamzee Makara is a Bard of Rage, and thus allows [Rage] to be destroyed or invites destruction through [Rage]. But ‘Rage’ is also associated with [Narrative Contrivance]. As long thus as it was narratively convenient, he could not die, and allowed destruction through profound contrivance. Note: World Drawbacks, World Modifiers, and many Continuity Modifiers will affect Skaia, your personal ‘progression’ planet, or the new universe created from the game. Given that fouling progression up even slightly can give universes cancer in a normal session, well…
objects.title: Sburb (Homestuck)

objects.text:
Anomalous forces have spontaneously been given form and consciousness. Throughout the world in random places, thousands of mysterious beings manifest known as Majiks. Each one represents a particular magical ability, and is given a title denoting such. Some are ambivalent to humanity. Others are even friendly. Quite a large amount of them, unfortunately, are Human Haters, and will use their powers to torment and kill them. The system of magic they belong to is separate from any other that may already be present in your setting.

However, the danger these monsters pose is not without some opportunity. Each Majik possesses a Trial, a task that must be completed by a given person. Generally speaking, the difficulty of a trial scales with that Majik's natural dislike for humanity, and can prove fatal. However, no Majik's Trial is objectively impossible, no matter how difficult it might be. Completing the Trial will cause the Majik to submit to the person who bested them, no matter what, transforming them into a magic stone. Inside the stone is engraved the Majik's true name, which only their master can read, and which can be used as an incantation to unleash their power. Incantations may be taught to other people capable of magic, though at a much lesser potency.

99% of the time, only women may take a Majik's Trial and obtain their power. That being said, you will find that you can obtain them no matter your gender. Do with that what you will, and try not to get killed by the World-Hating Majik.
objects.title: Wild Magics (Ichi the Witch)

addons.text:
There is no other conduit walking around and activating new conduits and parahumans. You are humanity’s greatest and darkest hope, for you must walk across the world activating as many as you can and in the process destroying millions if not billions. 

Can your conscience handle this task? Developing a cure is a near impossibility, and if it does get developed it’ll almost certainly be too late for humanity. You and any other conduit are not capable of being harmed by a Ray Field Inhibitor, instead RF energy simply activates and enhances powers over time. You can eventually absorb all RF energy on the planet if you wish to reintroduce regular humans afterwards. 

You can force the RF energy you generate into regular humans to make them into conduits to save a few from the fate of dying in a blast or to the plague, but you’ll find this a very time consuming and inefficient method, meaning many more will die than what you can save if you try to use this your primary method. You do however possess the ability to determine who are conduits/parahumans and who are not for the purposes of your power allowing you to choose who to save, albeit still at only the same rate as before. This does not exclude you from speeding up the process through your other powers or finding a way to create parahumans using other methods for the same effect. Conduits and parahumans you come across and/or activate will join your cause freely, knowing your goal is necessary if grim.

On a positive note, at the end those you save and those that are left over will restart civilization as a new and perfect Utopia without any of the issues it had before and while they can and will self govern if you wish they will consider you their king and emperor, with complete and unbreakable loyalty and fealty, that will carry over to future generations as well, both to you and any offspring you have and so on. This will happen regardless of what method you use to give people powers. If you are a reincarnation you can choose to have already started your March, granting you a considerable head start on your journey, or to otherwise weave this modifier into this world’s and/or your history in any way you wish.
addons.title: The Beast

objects.text: A small and private group called The First Sons has spent years trying to either create or figure out how parahumans came into being, to find how to turn others into them. If Cauldron exists they are aware of this group but let it continue to exist to see if there was anything that they could develop that may be useful to them. The First Sons would make numerous breakthroughs, discovering both the Conduit Gene and Ray Field Energy, after which they would develop the Ray Sphere to use RF energy to activate conduits. Over the decades RF energy scattered and spread, eventually causing a mutation in someone that would develop into a highly contagious and lethal plague to humanity. Humanity now faces mass extinction, a cure near impossible by your world’s technology, and a monumental task for even powerful tinkers. Conduits and Parahumans are immune, and there is a powerful Conduit with The Beast (Infamous) power who is aware of this. They are traveling as fast as they can, destroying entire cities and major populations and activating as many Parahumans and Conduits as they can in a desperate bid to save as many as possible. Parahumans can be activated with the same method as Conduits. Children born of Conduits and/or Parahumans will always be born as whatever their parents were, or as a conduit and can trigger as a Parahuman later if they are children to both. There is 1 Conduit potential for every 15 regular humans, the ratio of Parahuman awakening will not change. These rates are affected by Second Wave and Mass Awakening, allowing you to activate more at a time.
objects.title: The March (Infamous)

objects.text:
Somehow, somewhere in the galaxy, a Viltrumite imperial fleet has appeared. Unlike a typical empire, this force is small in number but overwhelmingly powerful. It is led by Thragg, the Grand Regent of the Viltrumite Empire, along with the hardened Viltrumite warriors who served directly under his command.

The fleet itself consists of colony ships, warships, orbital construction platforms, and support vessels carrying thousands of settlers, soldiers, and engineers that are of various races that serve the Viltrumite Empire, but the true strength of the force lies in the Viltrumites themselves. Each warrior possesses immense strength, near invulnerability, extreme speed, and the ability to travel through space under their own power. Even a single Viltrumite is capable of conquering entire worlds if left unchecked.

Their goal is simple: rebuild and expand the Viltrumite Empire. When they locate a suitable planet, they may conquer it directly or infiltrate its population to establish long-term control. Worlds that resist are often subjugated through overwhelming force, while valuable populations may be kept alive to serve as subjects or potential breeding stock to restore Viltrumite numbers.

If these Viltrumites encounter humanity, they may initially observe or infiltrate human societies to determine their usefulness. However, if humanity proves resistant or strategically valuable, the Viltrumites will not hesitate to conquer Earth and bring it under imperial rule.

NOTE: The Viltrumites are the same from either the Invincible tv series or comic, it's up to you, so that means Thragg, Kregg, Conquest, Nolan, Anissa ect will be in this, also the part that mentions colony ships is due to the fact that they have brought other races that serve the Viltrumite Empire with them, just to clarify.
objects.title: The Viltrumite Empire (Invincible)

objects.text:
Somehow, a portal tears open and a Flaxan invasion force emerges somewhere on the planet. Their arrival is immediate and violent. The Flaxans launch intense, overwhelming assaults to establish a secure beachhead, striking with precision and brutality to eliminate resistance and secure territory for expansion.

The Flaxans cannot naturally sustain themselves in this world for long periods. To overcome this, every soldier is equipped with personal temporal stabilization devices, worn as belts, bracelets, or embedded gear, allowing them to operate for extended durations without degradation. In addition, they will begin to construct massive temporal stabilization structures once they have established a beachhead to continue the invasion. These temporal stabilization structures will project a temporal stabilization field over wide areas, anchoring their presence and enabling large-scale, long-term operations and occupation.

Once established, the Flaxans will begin constructing fortified strongholds around these stabilization zones. Civilians are captured for unknown purposes, while most resistance is met with lethal force. Their expansion is methodical, turning each secured zone into a hardened foothold from which further assaults are launched.

Each additional purchase of this modifier causes another Flaxan invasion to occur in a different location on the planet, creating multiple simultaneous warzones. If left unchecked, these incursions will begin to link together, forming a network of stabilized territories that allow the Flaxans to maintain a permanent and escalating invasion of Earth.

Destroying frontline forces is not enough. All temporal stabilization devices and strongholds must be eliminated. If even one remains active, the Flaxans will reinforce their position, rebuild their forces, and resume their expansion.

The invasion cannot be truly ended through defense alone. To stop the Flaxans completely, a counter-invasion must be launched into their home dimension, and the Flaxans must be forced onto the defensive. Until they have been conquered or... all killed, as they will not stop.
objects.title: The Flaxan Invasion (Invincible)

objects.text:
Parahumans- or simply powerful individuals in other settings- now experience Gravity, similar to that of Stand users from JoJo. This causes Parahumans to gravitate towards other Parahumans over time, sparking conflicts and interactions.
