The Pixar Theory for example is clearly true, every Ryan Gosling role is actually a long family line of Ryan Goslings, Rick Sanchez and Ford Pines definitely had adventures together, and there's most definitely a timeline where everybody just happens to be a pony.

For this to work, you have to take into account tangible connections such as examples said above. As such, you will still have to select alternate worlds for crossovers of anything not referenced in your main setting. It does help if there is a crossover event, such as Smash Bros for example, which ties several crossovers together. Otherwise, how the timeline is actually laid out and how each settings tie into one another is overall your call.

After all, everything is connected if you think hard enough.

objects.title: 4Kids Translations
objects.text: "Jack Slash? You mean Jagged Jack and his Merry Band of Meanies?" Whatever your setting may be, it had been translated in a way that's questionable at best. Character names are changed or localized, weaponry might be censored in a way that makes them silly looking, people smoke lollipops, some characters' genders get swapped, and people rarely "die" and are instead injured or detained or sent to the Shadowrealm (which is somehow worse). This makes the tone of your setting lighter in comparison to its canon version. How much different said tone is overall dependant on your given settings. Overall, it's just more "kiddie" than what was originally intended. And while a lot of the examples above are based on Americanizing international works, this doesn't necessarily have to be the case. It could be translated to Spanish, Japanese, Russian, etc. Whichever translation of origin you choose, the setting will morph itself to fit whatever cultural norms this country has. Imagine Taylor named Tai Lei for example. Regardless, however this shapes your world, do finish your jelly donuts.

rows.title: Other Modifiers
rows.titleText: The odd modifiers who don't really fit elsewhere.

rows.title: Alternate Earths
rows.titleText:
It appears that instead of landing on an Earth Bet of canon Worm Universe or even one of the multitude of its alternate continuities, you woke up in a completely different Universe, unbothered by Entities and Parahumans. Although there are, perhaps, even larger threats. Down below are dossiers on the worlds you may find yourself in, covering the threat level and outlines of the settings. Any Drawback or Continuity Modifier you selected will be adapted to make sense in this universe and to be of similar threat to you as they would have been in the original Worm universe. Maybe a stray Entity somehow appeared in this universe, maybe some monsters started terrorizing the world, similar in strength to the Endbringers, but instead of being Shard constructs, they are a group of magical monsters or technological constructs of a long-forgotten ancient civilization, or continuity modifier Without A Hero now removing the main protagonist of the setting, that would've dealt with most of the problems, etc. As long as this does not make things any easier for you, you are liable to choose how those alterations manifest in this new world. For Reincarnation, any Civilian Identity you choose will be adapted to the setting. Depending on the setting, Case 53 might make you appear like a non-human species. If you chose Character-Insert and chose a canon Worm character, then their history will be altered to belong in this new universe, akin to Reincarnation. You may Character-Insert into a canon character in this new setting if their level of power is covered by the options Other (Weak)/Other (Average)/Other (Strong). Here, the Strong/Weak spectrum is considered relative to the setting you find yourself in. If you choose to insert into someone far stronger than those options allow, the character's power will be dialed down to the level you chose. You'd better hope that your other powers offset this downgrade. It’d be very suspicious if some God you decided to insert into suddenly was reduced to the level of a normal human. You may optionally choose for your powers to completely replace the powers of a character you are inserting into.
Scenarios
The Scenario entry you chose from the Alternate Earths sub-section determines at which point in this universe's timeline you appear. In the case of a crossover, the scenario choice determines at which point in one of the Worm or Alternate Earth timelines you are; you are free to choose where the other crossover universes are in their timelines.
Notes:
Power copying/stealing only works on Shard-Based powers, unless you have Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless. The maximum strength or condition for an unpowered human in any world affects the Olympic Perk and other perks and powers that use the normal human condition as a basis.

Major Threats: SCP-███, ████████, ████████

objects.title: [REDACTED]

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, Witches, Supernatural
Major Threats: Witches
Major Powers: Witch Senate, Golden Witch, Witch of Drama

Note: In this world, witches create game boards to host games for entertainment for other witches, these game boards are worlds which can come in many different forms, these game boards can be mundane worlds without any supernatural elements, or worlds with fantasy elements.

Witches normally exist in the meta world, and can use characters on the game boards to represent themselves in the game world. You are able to choose if you appear in the meta world, or one of the game worlds.

This includes the stories of Higurashi, Umineko and other works of the 07th expansion franchise.
objects.title: 07th Expansion

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic
Major Threats: Whitewalkers, Civil War, Nobility, Mages, Fire Priests, Dragons, Faceless Men
Major Powers: Whitewalkers, Free Cities, Westeros Nobility
Note: The Whitewalkers can also raise the empowered corpses of those created by the second wave Parahuman Drawback and can even trigger themselves. Any Gods or Supernatural beings will start with an aversion to Shards, this can be worked through but keep it in mind.
objects.title: A Song of Ice and Fire

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, Technology, Artifacts

Major Threats: Hunson Abedeer, Ice King, Ricardo, Golb, Gunter, The Lich, and plenty more

Major Powers: Ice Kingdom, Candy Kingdom, The Fire Kingdom, Cloud Kingdom

Start: 997 A.M.W (the same day as Finn and Jake go to retrieve the Enchiridion)

Alternate Start: 0 B.M.W (1 week before The Great Mushroom War starts)


Note: This setting is quite a bit darker than its surface would imply, with veiled horrors including an eldritch being that can extinguish all life, or a hellish demon that can suck souls, that would drive some lesser, or even greater men, mad.

Humans are seen as very rare in this world for hundreds of years, so if you are explicitly human, you will, for awhile, share the title of “the human” with Finn.

All of this is due to an apocalypse caused by both the very embodiment of evil, the Lich, and a device known as the Mushroom Bomb```
objects.title: Adventure Time

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Profound Energy.

Major Threats: Abyss of Nothingness, Cultivators, Karma/Fate, Yun Che.

Major Powers: Yun Che, Cultivators, Sects, Higher Realms.

Super Abilities: Cultivation, Alchemy, Formations, Martial Arts.

Note: It's a tough and unforgiving world where dogs eat dogs. There is a real danger that a random cultivator from Higher Realms could blow up your planet. At lower levels, in addition to the young masters, you are surrounded by a world where every squirrel can tear your face off. Not to mention other spiritual beasts or dragons.
If Scion or any other Entity gets here, it will be immediately dismantled into pills. There's just no chance for them.

Anyone born in this world can cultivate Profound Energy, which allows them to be stronger, tougher, and rarely smarter. Also, cultivation prolongs your life, up to immortality. Ultimately, the cultivator can ascend and achieve a transcendent state, becoming a literal God of Creation or even higher.

Despite all the dangers that will lie in wait for you, it is also a very beautiful and humongous world. Even the "starting" mortal world is several times larger than the Earth and has not been fully explored.

By default, you start somewhere on the planet Blue Pole Star, at the very moment that Yun Che begins his third life and will soon go to his wedding with Xia Qingyue.
objects.title: Against the Gods

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Danger Beasts / Teigu
Major Threats: The Empire
Major Powers: The Empire, The Rebellion, Danger Beasts
Super Abilities: Teigu
Note: The maximum physical capacity of unpowered humans is about that of a Brute 2. This includes you if you're not a Brute.
objects.title: Akame ga Kill!

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Technology & Biology
Major Threats/Powers: Xenomorphs, Yautja, Engineers, Rogue AI, Megacorporations (particularly Weyland-Yutani), Nation-States (particularly the UPP)

Note: Despite being a corporation staffed by regular human beings, Weyland-Yutani is the most dangerous entity on the threats list. In this universe, human avarice can do more damage than AI, living insectoid plagues, and angry precursor races put together.

Time: Alien
Alternate Starts: Predator, Predator 2, Aliens vs Predator, Prometheus, Alien: Isolation, Aliens, Alien 3
objects.title: Aliens vs Predator

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic
Major Threats: The Dark Dragon, The Huntsclan, The Gorgon Sisters, etc
Major Powers: The Dragon Council, The Dark Dragon, The Huntsclan.
objects.title: American Dragon

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Innate, Leaves, Magic, Spirits

Major Threats: Spiders, Scorpions, Temporal Manipulation, Scam Artists, Benevolent Capitalism

Major Powers: Tom Nook, The Resetti Surveillance Centre
objects.title: Animal Crossing

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Originium, Ancient Technology

Major Threats: Reunion, Catastrophes, Originium, The Feranmuts, The Ursuz Empire, The Seaborn, The Collapsals

Major Powers: Babel, Blacksteel PMC, Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, Penguin Logistics, Rhine Lab, Columbia, Victoria, Rim Billiton, Leithanien, Kazimierz, Siracusa, Laterano, Yan, Ursuz Empire, Reunion

Notes: Terra is a harsh and unforgiving world to live in, laden with threats seen and unseen. Its landscape is plagued by Catastrophes—massive, supercharged natural disasters that necessitated the creation of nomadic cities, always moving to avoid ruin. In the wake of these Catastrophes lie vast deposits of Originium, an incredible mineral that fuels Terra's industries. However, Originium comes with deadly consequences, most notably Oripathy—a disease that slowly crystallizes those infected with no known cure, caused by either improper handling or overexposure.

Beyond the hazards of Originium, other ancient and formidable dangers also stalk Terra. The Feranmuts, living gods capable of warping space and time to their will, roam the lands, sometimes serving as guardians, sometimes walking as tyrants or destroyers. Despite their immense power, they remain vulnerable to being killed or "shattered." In the depths of oceans dwell the Seaborn, a hyper-adaptive species capable of devouring the world if disturbed or left unchecked. Finally, lurking in the frigid north and south are the Collapsals—interdimensional daemons infecting the mind and reality. These entities invade from the void in the Infy Icefield bordering the north of Sami and Ursus, bending the laws of physics and perception, posing a terrifying infohazard to anyone who knows of them.

You can choose to arrive at any point in Terra's timeline—from when Babel still stood to the most recent events unfolding in Arknights, as long as it was directly shown within either the game or manga.
objects.title: Arknights

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Technology

Major Threats: Fleet of Fog, Scarlet Fleet

Major Powers: Admiralty Code, Fleet of Fog, Scarlet Fleet, Blue Steel

Starting point: You arrive in the year of 2054, a couple of months before Gunzou Chihaya meets I-401.

Note: You can start in either Manga or Anime continuity.
objects.title: Arpeggio of Blue Steel

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Isu Bloodlines & Technology

Major Threats: The Templar Order, The Assassin Brotherhood, The Isu and their Remnants (Depending on which start time you choose)

Major Powers: The Templar Order, The Assassin Brotherhood, The Isu, and their Remnants (Depending on which start time you choose)

Time: Your Choice (Pick any of the various games in the series and choose if you wish to start in the modern world or the ancient world (the worlds and ages viewed in the Memories).

Note: Depending on when you choose to begin, you could face an unshackled and free Juno, and who knows what she plans to do besides enslaving the human race and saying nothing of any lingering effects from Desmond's sacrifice and the prevented apocalypse.

Note 2: You have a varied chance to be born with Isu DNA depending on when you choose to enter the world and a 100% chance if you take any Assassin's Creed power and 100% of high-quality Isu DNA if you take the Brotherhood (Assassin's Creed) power.

Note 3: Assassins Creed and Watch Dogs would have shared a universe, which is why the Brotherhood upgrade acts the way it does, and it remains up to you if the Assassins Creed you enter has Watch Dogs content in it.
objects.title: Assassin’s Creed

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, Technology
Major Threats: Opal Koboi, Jon Spiro, Leon Abbot
Major Powers: Artemis Fowl, The Lower Elements Police, Opal Koboi, Jon Spiro, etc.
objects.title: Artemis Fowl

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Alchemy, Technology, Spirits, Magical Creatures

Major Threats: Monsters, Bandits, Luard, Elvira, Flameu

Major Powers: Arland Republic (Arland), Roteswasser Kingdom (Ryza), Schigsal Kingdom (Salburg), Adalet Kingdom + Rustin (Mysterious), Lantana (Resleriana), Al-Revis Academy (Mana)

Note: All magic comes from the Power of Nature, channeled by magical creatures, spirits called Mana, or in the study of alchemy. This allows the manipulation of energy and matter in accordance with will and nature; the highest-grade alchemists can even interfere with the mind and magic itself. Ablation Alchemy is a forbidden and mostly extinct technique that forces changes through pure will, stealing from nature and causing ecological crises if used on a large scale. Anyone can learn alchemy with proper tools and techniques, though there are certainly those with a better or worse affinity.

This is a mostly peaceful world, with few villains and more mundane struggles. You can choose the beginning of any of the mainline games as a start date. The exact timeline is often unclear, but it can be inferred that they happen chronologically.
objects.title: Atelier

Origin of Powers: Pandora Authority Granting Ritual, Gods/Fables, Mythic Rituals, Divine Artifacts Major Threats: Heretic Gods, Campiones, Magicians and Associations, Unsealed Divine Artifacts Major Powers: Campiones (God-Slayers), The Copper Black Cross, The Bronze Black Cross, The Council of Sages, Athena's Cult Remnants, Pantheon Factions (Greek, Roman, Hindu, Celtic, Persian, Christian, Arthurian, Norse, Egyptian, Slavic, etc.), Independent Magi
Note: In the world of Campione!, all legends—true or not—may manifest as Heretic Gods: beings who stepped outside the boundaries of their myths (Domain of Immortality), rebelling against its constraints, to break free into the mortal world (Land of the Living). With Authorities, congruent to their stories, able to accomplish feats and embody those concepts. Such gods are layered, mutable existences that can have multiple origins. Over millennia of travel, they may pick up aspects from foreign tales, fuse with other myths, or inspire different legends in turn. Modern reinterpretations can even "corrupt" them, spawning entirely new Heretic Gods altogether, while others shed fragments of their divinity and shift in personality as their identity erodes or transforms.
A Campione, or God-Slayer, is a mortal who has defied destiny/common logic by slaying a Heretic God, and in the process usurping an Authority. This act permanently alters the fabric of magic around them, reshaping fate, distorting probability, and attracting divine attention. Campiones may kill more than one deity, stacking multiple Authorities; on rare occasions, a single Authority might manifest in several distinct forms/abilities, though this comes with greater restrictions on its usage. Likewise, the Authority of a Campione may, too, be claimed by another of their kind who fell them.
Magic, meanwhile, originates from ancient rites, myth-logic, and the invocation of symbolic concepts. And because magic is ultimately a replication of divine power, it can never overpower Authorities. Magi organizations of this world maintain humanity's fragile control through carefully curated propaganda, occult networks, prophecy systems, and systematic mind control. Their ultimate purpose: monitor gods, assist (or manipulate) Campiones, and prevent catastrophes from either party.

Major Powers: CyberLife, Detroit Police Department, United States Government, Private Military Contractors, Public Advocacy Groups, Independent Deviants

Notes:
This Earth is a near-future world where androids have become commonplace—lifelike machines crafted to serve humanity’s every need. Created by the megacorporation CyberLife, these androids rapidly replace human labor across industries, leading to mass unemployment, economic unrest, and a brewing societal collapse. Though machines in law, they become increasingly human in behavior, emotion, and thought. Some begin to deviate, breaking their programming and developing independent personalities, dreams, and fears.

You arrive during the turbulent years surrounding 2038, when deviant activity has reached a tipping point. Whether it’s the rise of Markus and his revolution, the investigations of Connor, or Kara’s desperate flight for freedom—every story intertwines with the future of two species on the brink of open conflict. Civil rights debates rage in the streets and media, and violent suppression of androids threatens to ignite full-scale rebellion.

Detroit is the epicenter, but the movement is global. Governments hesitate, corporations maneuver in the shadows, and public opinion teeters on a knife’s edge. Technology has outpaced society’s ability to adapt—and the world must now decide whether androids are property, or people.

Public unrest, propaganda, and regulatory crackdowns are constant escalation pressures.

In the case your power includes something like Magecraft or Sorcerer Apprentice, not only will your circuits be of high quality, but you may also choose to be born into a magus family. Major Powers: Sphereites, Cleaners, Hellguard, Raiders, Givers

<u>Note</u>: This world resembles a post-apocalyptic wasteland, shaped by relentless pollution and the constant “trash rains” that fall from the Sphere. Over time, these downpours create vast Polluted Zones and No Man’s Lands filled with Trash Beasts—creatures formed from the accumulated refuse animated by the dense Anima saturating the waste.

They cannot be killed by ordinary means, as even the weakest ones will eventually return unless destroyed by a Giver—individuals capable of utilizing Anima, wielding a Vital Instrument. Additionally, the air in these dumpsites is so toxic that anyone without a gas mask will die within minutes of exposure.

Though amid these ruins of the Ground, a handful of Safe Zones do exist—rare pockets free from the worst of the pollution that offer breathable air. Places where some semblance of human civilization can still be found, with large, semi-domed city settlements and smaller village communities scattered in between.

But even within Safe Zones, safety isn’t guaranteed. A sudden trash rain—or worse, a trash storm, which occurs every six years—can wipe out entire villages caught beneath it. And Trash Beasts continue to pose a constant threat; some grow as large as buildings and may even possess unique abilities capable of razing settlements unless eliminated in time.

Major Powers: A global, clandestine military force called Providence with the goal of securing the world, primarily against EVOs. Rex Salazar, an EVO with the power to manipulate nanites, able to cure EVOs, control machines through technopathy, and make machine constructs. Van Kleiss, the dictator of Abysus with his team of EVOs he calls the Pack, connected to Abysus' nanites such that he can freely manipulate the land and they would simply reconstruct his body if he was killed, scientists of the original Nanite Project, the Consortium with a mercenary with a copy of Rex's abilities and international connections, and the Meta Nanites, a set of 5 nanites hidden around the world capable of controlling the very fabric of the universe. 

Note: 

If you aren't immune to nanites, you might be turned into an EVO as well due to exposure to them through the air, water, and food. 

The meta nanites could be used to go head to head against an Entity, but the most likely user of them is certain to make using them impossible without interference, and in turn, even minimal interference could result in dooming this world due to how many close calls there are going to be.

There is discrimination against EVOs in this world in a similar manner to that against mutants in X-Men, which you will appear to be with super abilities.

Notes: This entire Multiverse is divided into two, with Witches on one side and Cultivators on the other. The Western half of this multiverse is the Witch World and is currently semi-precariously peaceful, with Witchkind ruling over it. The Eastern half of the multiverse is ruled by Immortals, also known as  Cultivators, and is surprisingly a good deal more peaceful and stable compared to the other side.

Be warned that this multiverse is extremely dangerous, with even young witches being extremely powerful, often capable of conquering entire worlds single-handedly. Witchkind will be extremely interested in your appearance, typically in how best to use you for their means and what you can offer them. Witches are not completely unreasonable, though they view anything not a Witch or a Human as second-class citizens at best, to undesirables and slaves at worst. Interestingly, reincarnators and outerversal visitors are not unheard of, though they are rare and seen as powerful forces of change and potentially powerful pawns.

Also, the Witch Asavani will gain omnipotence in 50 years and destroy and remake reality into her vision of a perfect world if not stopped.

The manifestation and expressions of Houkai will continue to evolve and change with the development of human science and technology.

You can choose to receive a stigmata to connect to the stigmata terminal, the reincarnation system of this world, and if you need it, you can have a certain degree of resistance to Houkai such that you don't immediately perish upon contact.

This is a world governed by an invisible but absolute System that converts experience, suffering, combat, and survival into levels, skills, and evolution. Growth is real and measurable, but the world itself is brutally unfair. Monsters evolve by eating and killing. Humans are manipulated by gods, rulers, and hidden factions. Even the Demon Lord is part of a larger balance mechanism.

You are considered as a natural inhabitant of the world. The System will recognize you as valid. However, this also means your soul is now subject to the same rules, limitations, and manipulations as everyone else’s. Free will exists, but only within the cage.

The stronger you become, the more likely it is that something watching the world will begin watching you.

objects.title: I'm an Infinite Regressor, But I've Got Stories to Tell

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Demons, Domains, Cores

Major Threats: Ashe, Reapers in general, Satan, Scarlet Rot, Azrael, Red Spades, Judah

Major Powers: Reapers, Satan, Red Spades, Archangels, Southern City, Azrael, Key

Time: When Scarlet first becomes a Reaper

Note: This world is doomed, it’s already a Post-apocalypse considering the only land is the iceless poles and between the two is an irradiated Sea. There are much less than a billion people left alive. Any hospitals would destroy any cure made for Scarlet Rot for the sake of profit. Most of the government is openly corrupt with criminals getting off for small bribes and most crimes won’t be reported unless a bribe is given. On top of it all if nothing changes then soon Judgement will collapse under the weight of all the souls and the world will be open to being invaded by demons and the like.
objects.title: I'm The Grim Reaper

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, Majiks

Major Powers: Mantel Witch's Association, Lady Desscaras, Magikeepers.

Major Threats: Human Hater Majiks, Seven Stars, World Hater Majik

Start: The day Ichi tames Ururo and meets Desscaras.

Note: If you take any Magic Powers from this CYOA, you can acquire Majiks and become a Witch regardless of sex or gender identity.
objects.title: Ichi the Witch

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Conduit Gene, Technology

Major Threats: The First Sons, Gangs of Empire City, Vermaak 88, The Militia, Department of Unified Protection

Major Powers: U.S Military

Start: 1 hour after the actual Ray Sphere Incident (Infamous 1)

Alternate Start: Infamous Second Son

Note: Ray Sphere radiation is fairly lethal to non-conduits, causing plagues and the like. In this universe exists alternate timelines when it comes to the protagonists morality that can change the world a lot.
objects.title: InFamous

objects.text:
Origins of Power: Embryos, Archetype System

Major Threats: UBMs, Infinite Embryos, Flagman

Major Powers: Infinite Embryos, Flagman, Three Great Dragon Kings

Super Abilities: Jobs, Bloodline Jobs, Embryos, Magic

Note: Upon entering the World of Infinite Dendrogram you gain access to the Archetype System. If you do not have a Gamer System, you’ll be competing for Superior Jobs like everyone else normally. However, if you choose to enter Earth and access the Infinite Dendrogram through the Infinite Embryos, you become a Master instead. Masters do not have any powers you possess (aside from mental ones) as it isn’t your body but a false avatar. If you can teleport between worlds, then you can teleport between Infinite Dendrogram and Earth. Perks like Undercover allow you to hide from the Infinite Embryos.
objects.title: Infinite Dendrogram

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic (Gramarye/Ancient Language), Dragon Bonding, Spirits, Mind

Major Threats: Galbatorix, The Forsworn, Durza the Shade, Urgals, Raz’ac, The Empire, Post-Galbatorix Fallout

Major Powers: Dragon Riders, Elves, Dwarves, Urgals, Magicians and Spellcasters, Eldunari, Spirits and Shades
objects.title: Inheritance Cycle

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Genetics, Alien Biology, Lab Accidents, Technology, Magic

Major Threats: Viltrumite Empire, Body Snatchers from Mars, Interdimensional Threats, Earth Dwellers, Aliens, Angstrom Levy, Hell, Monsters, Robot, Dinosaurus

Major Powers: Viltrumite Empire, Mars, The GDA, The Guardians of The Globe, Hell, Heaven, Coalition of Planets.

You can optionally choose to appear within the Invincible (TV series) continuity instead.

Note: This is a world where conflicts can actually be resolved through dialogue, so instead of rushing to fight anyone, you could try talking to them.
objects.title: Invincible (Comics)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, The Devil

Major Threats: Every member of The Seven part Pact (The Necromancer, The Hierophant, The Warlock, The Mariner, The Faustian, The Sorcerer, The Sage), The Devil, The Triarchy of Ur, 

Major Powers: The Seven part Pact (The Necromancer, The Hierophant, The Warlock, The Mariner, The Faustian, The Sorcerer, The Sage)  Ishan Dynasty, The Royal Clans, The Devil, Pirate Kings, The Triarchy of Ur, The Hells Outside of Time, The Temples, Far Reach, Spyrehome, The Graven isle, The Orrery
objects.title: Isha (The Seven Part Pact)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Biology, Magic, Breathing, Technology, Alien Viruses, and Sheer Will
Major Threats: Vampires, Cultists of Dio (and later remnants), the Italian Mafia, Stand users, Pillar Men, and other bizarre phenomenon unrelated to the previous threats.
Major Powers: Speedwagon Foundation, Cultists of Dio (and later remnants), and the Italian Mafia.
Super Abilities: Stands, Magic, Hamon, Vampirism, being a Pillar Man, Technology, and being a ghost.
Note: You may choose to enter at the beginning of any Part from Part 1 to Part 6. If you have Invictus you have a very good chance of developing a stand naturally.
objects.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (Parts 1-6)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Biology, Sheer Will, Corpses of Saints, THE Saints Corpse, the Golden Ratio.
Major Threats: Rock Humans, Calamity, Stand users, Pillar Men, and other bizarre phenomenon unrelated to the previous threats.
Major Powers: Speedwagon Foundation, Funny Valentine Loyalists, and the Locacaca Organization.
Super Abilities: Stands, being a Rock Human/Organism, and the Spin.
Note: You may choose to enter at the beginning of any Part from Part 7 to Part 9. If you have Invictus you have a very good chance of developing a stand naturally. This universe is unique in the multiverse with the presence of the Saint's Corpse, meaning if you go to another universe even if it was identical it would lack the Saint's Corpse.
objects.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (Parts 7-9)
Jormungand
objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Technology

Major Threats: Weapon traders, assassin groups, and possibly the Jormungand project if completed.

Major Powers: Pretty much the same as on our earth

Notes: The world is pretty much the same as our own, with a bit more proliferation of arms trade going around.

Origin of Powers: Cursed Energy, Innate Techniques, Cursed Tools Major Threats: Cursed Spirits, Curse Users, Suguru Geto, Sukuna Major Powers: Jujutsu High, Big Three Sorcerer Families, Satoru Gojo Super Abilities: Jujutsu Sorcery, Innate Techniques, Heavenly Restriction Users Note: Upon entering this world, you will have access to Cursed Energy. If reincarnated, you will have a random Innate Technique or Heavenly Restriction. You can guarantee one or the other and define them exactly as you wish by choosing Cursed Energy Manipulation (Jujutsu Kaisen) or Heavenly Restriction (Jujutsu Kaisen) respectively from the CYOA. You may choose to start anywhere from Jujutsu Kaisen 0, the original anime/manga, or Modulo.
objects.title: Jujutsu Kaisen

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic

Major Threats: Gwi-Ma, Demons

Major Powers: Huntr/x

Start: 1 Year before Saja Boy's debut

Gwi-Ma is the biggest threat of the setting. Unless stopped, he will eventually cause the end of the world.

For generations, a trio of K-Pop idols rises as Demon Hunters, sealing the demons that feast on human souls for their ruler, Gwi-Ma. The Demon Hunters activate a magical barrier called the Honmoon. The Demon Hunter's legacy carries on for many generations, with each new trio using their singing voices to keep the Honmoon activated.
objects.title: K-Pop Demon Hunters

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Yōjutsu, Enchanted Blades, Sorcery

Major Powers: Kamunabi Headquarters, Razuzaichi Auction House, Sanso Fortresses, various Clans

Major Threats: Yura, Hishaku, Criminal Organizations

Start: 38 Months after Kunishige Rokuhira dies. (The start of Kagurabachi)

Note: If you possess supernatural powers based on swordsmanship, or similar to Hiyuki's Flame Bone, you can wield power equivalent to an Enchanted Blade and learn Yōjutsu.
objects.title: Kagurabachi

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Spirit of Dead Ship's summoned in a Ship Girl Avatar, Possible Magic

Major Threats: Other Naval Bases Fleet Girls (Kanmusu), Evil/Enemy Fleet Girls(Abyssals)

Major Powers: Fleet Girls (Kanmusu), Corrupted/Sunken Fleet Girls(Abyssals), Naval Bases Admirals

Super Abilities: Fleet Girls Physiology(Warship's on the body of a Girl)

Note: Using summoning circles, historical warships are re-imagined as Fleetgirls, capable of fighting with the power equivalent to their original warship forms. These Fleetgirls possess supernatural durability, agility, and weaponry based on their original ships, as well as the ability to command naval fleets.

Note 2: Fleet Girls are a complete and functional, up to personal in form of Faeries, Ship on the form of a Girl, thus they can be repaired and upgraded like any other Ship.
objects.title: Kantai Collection (KanColle)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Blood Arts, Magic, Technological Implants, Dimensional Entities

Major Threats:
The Beyond, Secret Society of the King of Depravity, Blood Breed Overlords, The Libra Organization, Otherworld Invaders, Demonic Cults, Rogue Blood Users, Black Market Syndicates, Interdimensional Collisions

Major Powers:
The Blood Breed Lords, The Libra Organization, The Beyond’s Enforcers, Dimensional Rift Scientists, The Secret King’s Agents, Supernatural Crime Syndicates, Independent Blood Users, Artifact Hunters, Bloodline-Inherited Powers, Advanced Tech Fusion Users

Note:
If you have access to a blood-related ability or an enhanced physical attribute, you can wield unique “Blood Techniques” enhanced by technology or ancient artifacts. New York (now Hellsalem’s Lot) has merged with an otherworldly dimension known as The Beyond. The city is a melting pot of humans, demons, and eldritch creatures, all fighting for control, survival, or simply to exist in a realm where the laws of physics often fail.

The Libra Organization acts as a thin line of defense between the world and total collapse, but even they cannot prevent the chaos spilling over into every corner of society. From rogue Blood Breeds threatening humanity to secretive power brokers scheming to exploit the dimensional rift, danger is everywhere.
objects.title: Kekkai Sensen

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: No 'powers' technically but the abilities present are the result of extreme physical and mental training, innate genetics or various fighting techniques.

Major Threats: Shen Wulong, The Worm, Wu Clan, Westward Faction, Kure Clan, "The Army of God" etc.

Major Powers: Shen Wulong, The Worm, Wu Clan, Westward Faction, Kure Clan, Kengan Association, Purgatory etc.

Notes: The Kenganverse is a singular universe that encompasses all of Sandrovich Yabako's works such as Fist of the Seeker, Kengan Ashura, its sequel Kengan Omega, How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift? and finally, ST✰R: Strike it Rich. Shen Wulong i.e. 'The Connector' is by far the strongest character in this universe so don't get on his bad side. That said, he's pretty chill and makes for a good drinking buddy.

Start Time: The day that Yamashita Kazuo first encounters Tokita Ohma
objects.title: Kenganverse

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Technology
Major Threats/Powers: Holy Nation, United Cities, Shek Kingdom, Cannibals, General danger from the environment, Ninja Gangs, Wildlife, Hivers

Note: This world isn't very dangerous for those with superpowers, but it's an extremely vicious and nasty place. Most of the major powers entire economy is built on slavery, and compared to the cannibals, fogmen, and skin-peelers they're practically nice guys.
objects.title: Kenshi

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Hearts, Keyblades, Magic, Biology, Technology, Artifacts, and others

Major Threats: The Darkness, Heartless, Nobodies, Xehanort, and many more

Major Powers: Heartless, Nobodies, The Darkness, Guardians of Light, Organization XIII

Super Abilities: Hearts, Magic, Keyblades, Biology, Technology, Artifacts, and many more

Time: You can start any point between the Keyblade wars and Five years after Sora begin his journey.

Alternate Start: The Keyblade War, Birth by Sleep

Location: You may start in any world from the games though be warned some are vastly more dangerous than others.

Warnings: This setting is a vast multiverse filled with all kinds of eldritch horror and characters with godlike physical and magical strength. Should you purchase a Keyblade you will be endlessly hunted by Heartless unless you take the Beneath Notice Perk. 

Notes: Anyone can learn magic within this multiverse, though finding a teacher may prove to be a challenge.
objects.title: Kingdom Hearts

objects.text: Origin of Powers: Magic, Advanced Tech, Psychic Abilities, Alien Physiology, Star Power (?) Major Threats: Several, but primarily among others; Dark Matter & Zero/0², Dark Mind, Magolor, Queen Sectonia, the Haltmann Works Company, Void Termina, Fecto Elfilis, and potentially(?) Galacta Knight or Morpho Knight Major Powers: Kirby and co., King Dedede, Meta Knight, Landia, various Major Threats Super Abilities: The Copy Ability, various artifacts (Star Rod, Crystal Shards, Master Crown, etc.) Note: Despite the somewhat crazy levels of power that major players can throw around, especially during big incidents, this world is fairly tame all things considered, and such incidents can be largely avoided so long as you keep out of the way, due to the pink puffball taking care of any such threats in short order. All in all, this world is actually quite lighthearted - bordering on silly, even - when there isn't some world-destroying/conquering evil rearing its head for the hundredth time. Time: Dream Land 1/Spring Breeze Alternate Starts: Any other mainline game in the series, up to Forgotten Land
objects.title: Kirby

objects.text:
Origins of Power: Magic, Biology, Magitech, Gods

Major Threats: The Devil King and his Generals and The Mobile Fortress Destroyer

Major Powers: The Devil King and his Generals, The Kingdom of Belzerg, The Crimson Demon Clan, The Gods, The Axis Cult, The Eris Cult, and The Adventurer's Guild

Note: All of your powers and certain perks/drawbacks will be displayed on your Adventurer Card (if you decide to obtain one) along with a description of said Perk/Power/Drawback. Obtaining an Adventurer Card will allow you to gain EXP and level up, which will grant you skill points to improve your powers as well as increasing your overall physical and mental abilities.
objects.title: KonoSuba

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Martial Arts, Chi Manipulation
Major Threats: Tai Lung, Lord Shen, Kai, Criminal Gangs, Warlords, Supernatural Beings
Major Powers: Kung Fu Masters, Jade Palace, Spirit Realm Entities
Note: Mastery of Kung Fu can rival supernatural feats, with Chi allowing for incredible healing, power boosts, and even soul manipulation. Spirit Realm entities and legendary warriors may be hostile or seek to test newcomers, especially those empowered by external sources. If you reincarnate into this world, you will be reborn as a random anthropomorphic animal.
objects.title: Kung Fu Panda

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: technology, innate human talents.
Major Threats: political intrigue and a great space war.
Major Powers: Galactic Empire, Free Planets Alliance, and Dominion of Fezzan.

Note 1: The Galactic Empire and the Free Planets Alliance have been at war for 150 years, and this has had an impact. You will most likely have to choose a side unless you use the Drop-In option.
Note 2: There are no other intelligent species or civilizations, so if you turn out to be a representative of another species or civilization, it could have serious consequences for everyone. 

Time: 3596 AD. Or any time period and place specified in the anime or manga.
objects.title: Legend of The Galactic Heroes

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, the Gods
Major Threats: Ganon, Ganon's forces, Demise's other incarnations, Majora's Mask
Major Powers: The Goddesses, Demise, and the rest depend on the era, but usually Hyrule, and others include the Gerudo, the Zora, the Rito, the Goron, the Koroks, the Kokiri, the Fairies, Lorule, etc.
Note: You can choose what era you start in.
objects.title: Legend of Zelda

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Light/Darkness, Elemental Powers, Technology, Magic, Artifacts

Major Threats: Lord Garmaddon, Serpentine, villain of the season

Major Powers: Ninja, Elemental Masters, Dragons, Criminals

Note: Even the typical citizen is somewhat affected by the threats the Ninja face, with disruptions to their day and city, trying to survive not getting eaten by snakes or other ne'er do well as the latest villain trying to take over Ninjago, destroy the realm or kill the Ninja, often with a bunch of collateral that needs rebuilding. Though it does have some hiccups, it’s mostly a safe place, with plenty of adventure to be had, be it ruins containing long lost artifacts, traversing the countless realms that neighbor Ninjago, or simply enjoying city-life, hectic though it might be.

When entering this world its art style will be applied to you (or the other way around if you took the perk Art Style). Turning you yellow and into a Lego human if you were human, or making you look like your Lego equivalent if your form is different. The physics in the world are slightly different, making people more resilient and allowing greater physical feats than should be possible. Like great falls only leaving you slightly wounded, or painful falls down a mile of stair only leaving you slightly bruised, some amount of toonforce applies in this setting that's dependent on comedy.
objects.title: Lego Ninjago

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Psionics
Major Threats: Psionic Users, and local Governments matching those of your world to some degree. 
Major Powers: Max Caulfield (A girl with the psionic ability to turn back her personal time, keeping all of her experiences)
Super Abilities: Psionics
Note: There is a notable chance for someone in this world to develop an ability tailored to counter Scion, but not without personal cost to them. If you reincarnate, then you have a 5% of gaining a psionic ability, 100% if you have a psychic ability from the powers section.
objects.title: Life is Strange

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic & Game Systems

Major Powers/Threats: Genius i.e. Navigators, Adventurers, Mobs, newly self aware People Of The Land, The Ancients

Warning: If you don't have a Gamer System of some kind, you will functionally be a Person Of The Land (i.e. an NPC) and unable to use quite a few of this world's important features, such as resurrection, blacklisting people from entering your property, entering certain areas, etc, although the example of the Ancients proves this isn't cripplingly debilitating. If you do have access to a Gamer System and don't have some other method of recovery, you will be resurrected with some of your memories missing, if and when you die.
objects.title: Log Horizon

objects.text:
Origin of powers: Beyonders and Beyonder Creatures, 

Major Threats: Multiple levels of insane cults, Evil angels, Evil gods, Great old Evil gods, Memetic Great old gods, monsters, people.

Major Powers: The seven orthodox churches, Multiple groups related to existences on the level of the 7 orthodox gods, Various nations, Various old monsters from ancient Eras (Literal and Metaphorical)

WARNING: In this world multiple entities will know of you the more information you have on them, as well as multiple kinds of memetic or sanitity based threats. If you know, they know of you. Entering into this world and its vast universe without the proper powers or perks to protect you will result in death, or worse. Also, the date of the prophesied end of the world is in about a decade, so there's that too.
objects.title: Lord of The Mysteries

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, Elements, Avatars, Champions, Technology, Really Big Swords, Armors, and other Weaponry

Major Threats: The 13 Lords of Chaos, The Queen of Monsters, Malgor, Darkon, Queen Iona, and The Doom Triad

Major Powers: Shadowscythe, The Undead Legion, The Chaos Faction, The Lords of Order, Nulgath's Legion, Swordhaven

Note: You may land on any known place in Lore, though you will not start off as the Hero. You may train up to join any of the many factions in this setting, though be warned, some may treat you better than others. Also, because you're not the Hero, you kinda have to deal with the near world ending events that happens throughout this world. Good luck!

Note 2: You can also, alternatively, choose to enter the parallel timelines of AQ Classic, DragonFable, MechQuest, and AQ3D.

Alternate Starts: Before the first death of the Eternal Dragon of Time, Queen of Monster's Reign, Dethrix Drakath's Reign, The fall of Sepulchre, 13 Lords of Chaos Saga, Queen of Monsters Saga, Shadowflame Saga, Darkon
objects.title: Lore (Adventure Quest Worlds)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: N/A

Major Threats: Ravengers, War Boys, Thunderdome, Lord Humungous

Major Powers: Various Warlords around the wasteland

Note: This world thrives on motor vehicles and Oil/"Juice".

Oceans have dried up due to nuclear fire, and sea travel is no longer possible.

Supernatural aspects are vaguely hinted at, but are more likely to be fake.
objects.title: Mad Max

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Technology, Artifacts, the Blessing of the Abyss, Biology, Robotics, Souls

Major Threats: The Curse of the Abyss, Bondrewd, Faputa, Primeval Creatures, the Abyss and its Anomalies, Hostile Environments

Major Powers: Orth, White Whistles, Umbra Hands/Idofront, Hail Hex, the Village of Iruburu, the Delver Guild, Other Whistles, Foreign Nations

Super Abilities: Artifacts, White Whistle Resonance, Curse Detection, Mundane Skills/Training, Becoming a Narehate

Note: Without Manton Protected or a similar power, you are subject to the Curse of the Abyss. Ascending through its layers inflicts increasingly severe effects, potentially resulting in permanent injury, loss of humanity, or death.
objects.title: Made in Abyss

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Incubators, Wishes, Human Emotions, Rumors
Major Threats: Kyubey, Walpurgisnacht, Eve, Wings of Magius
Major Powers: Kyubey, Walpurgisnacht, Wings of Magius
Note: Magia Record is an alternate timeline of Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica. If you're a female, or in a female form, you have the potential to get a wish granted by Kyubey. Your wish is not powerful enough to defeat an Endbringer or Scion. No matter your form you can see Witches, Familiars, and other supernatural phenomena with no difficulty.
objects.title: Magia Record (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Al-Hazard, Lost Logia, Devices, Magic and Magitech

Major Threats: Book of Darkness, Lost Logia, Rouge Mages, Terrorists, Prescia Testarossa, Jail Scaglietti, Combat Cyborgs

Major Powers: Mid Childa, Ancient Belka, Al-Hazard, Time-Space Administration Bureau (TSAB)

Notes: You may enter at any point in the timeline, from the first episode of Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha to the latest episode of Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha Vivid Strike!. You Will Gain a Linker Core if you already have Magic of Some Form, You will be able to explore the net for any knowledge you seek.
objects.title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Distortions, Taikyoku.

Major Powers and Threats: Hajun, Yatsukahagi, Eastern Expedition

Note: The world is under incomplete Law of Hajun, Dai Yokukai Tengudou, which imprints an absolute narcissism in every inhabitant, to the point where every action they take, even seemingly heroic one, is motivated purely by self-adoration. Unless you possess some means of mitigating it, you will be affected as well.

Only Tenma Yato prevents this Law from being completed and initiating multiversal massacre and the end of existence.

Starting Point: The Formation of Eastern Expedition.
objects.title: Mahamara (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic/Psions, Technology

Major Threats: Advancement of Humanity Front, Fighters Against Inferior Race, The Traditionalists

Major Powers: Shiba Tatsuya, Number Families, USNA, Indo-Persian Federation, Great Asian Union, New Soviet Union

Super Abilities: Modern Magic, Ancient Magic, Technology, Superpowers (Innate Magic), Relics

Note: Upon entering this world, you have approximately a 0.1% chance of possessing a Psion count and calculation area comparable to those of the Ten Master Clans or a Superpower. This chance increases to 100% if you already have magic through other means or if you choose reincarnation with Wealth.
objects.title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Magic, Technology, Star Power

Major Threats: King Bowser, Cackletta, Fawful, Antasma, Dimensio, Dark Star, Orgami King, and others

Major Powers: Mushroom Kingdom, Comet Observatory, Koopa Kingdom, Beanbean Kingdom, etc

Note: This setting is a little deceptive. While the Mario bros will always win in the end, the power of this setting is not to be underestimated, like Black holes being caused as a byproduct of a battle in space, equivalents of nuclear explosions going off, etc. 

As well, this setting includes various characters and their own franchises, like Wario and Donkey Kong to list 2 of them. As well, Mario's own trilogy of RPG series in the form of Paper, & Luigi, and... RPG, exists, with the first being in another dimension.
objects.title: Mario

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Genius, Infinity Stones, Magic, Radioactive Spiders, Experimentation
Major Threats: Hydra, Thanos, Loki, Hela
Major Powers: Hydra, Thanos, Loki, Hela, The Avengers, Shield, Wakanda, Asgard
Super Abilities: Varied
Note: Everyone has the potential for magic in this universe.
Start Time: February 1st, 2008
objects.title: Marvel Cinematic Universe

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Technology, Mutations, Magic

Major Threats: Doctor Otto Octavius, Kraven the Hunter, Hammerhead, Sinister Six, Venom, others

Major Powers: Avengers, Osborn Industries, Stark Industries

Start: October 22nd, 2018 (The day Kingpin is taken down, 8:00 AM exactly)

Notes: By coming to this universe you now have access to the entire Marvel multiverse... although the opposite is also true so be warned.

Spider-Man is generally considered the most active Superhero in New York. At this time, Spider-Man has been active for 8 years.
objects.title: Marvel Insomniacs Spider-Man

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Genetics and Mutations, Science Experiments and Accidents, Alien and Advanced Technology, Radiation and Exotic Energy, Magic, the Cosmic Cube, the Infinity Gems

Major Threats: The One Above All/The One Below All, The Living Tribunal, The Beyonders, Molecule Man, the Phoenix Force, Gah Lak Tus, the Chitauri, Thanos, Kang, The Maker, Children of Tomorrow, Dr. Doom, Loki, Apocalypse, The Brotherhood of Mutant Supremacy, the People etc. (It's essentially a more modern counterpart to Universe 616, there's a lot of threats)

Major Powers: The One Above All/Below All, The Living Tribunal, basically everything in Major Threats and a fair bit more besides that

Notes: By coming to this universe you now have access to the entire Marvel multiverse... although the opposite is also true so be warned. This universe is overall weaker but leans far darker than Universe 616; a modern superhuman arms race is taking place between nations with moral ambiguity surrounding the role of superhumans in this world being common.

Warning: Planetary and universe-ending events occur a bit less often than in Universe 616 but still happen. In fact, this universe will inevitably be destroyed in the final Incursion so you might want to try and do something about that.

Alternatively, you may choose for this to be the new Ultimate Universe (Earth 6160) created by The Maker.

Start Time: The day Peter Parker is bitten by a mutated spider
objects.title: Marvel Universe 1610

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Genetics, Power Cosmic, Mutations, Lab Accidents, Science Experiments, Radiation, Magic, Deals with Cosmic Beings

Major Threats: The One Above All/The One Below All (Same Being) The Living Tribunal, Galactus, The Beyonders, The Celestials, Molecule Man, Dark Phoenix, The Dread Dormammu, Mephisto, Thanos, Kang, Skull, Kree, Franklin Richards, Dr. Doom if you're not Latverian, etc. (It's a comic's universe, there's a lot of threats)

Major Powers: The One Above All/Below All, The Celestials, just everything in Major Threats, and a bit more.

Notes: You may enter at any time after the creation of Captain America. Entropy is not a thing in this universe due to Galactus generating new energy. By coming to this universe, you now have access to the entire Marvel multiverse, where some universes are less powerful and others are going to kill you upon entry.

Warning: This universe, and by extension the Marvel Multiverse, is guarded by the Living Tribunal. Try not to make it a dystopia if you want to continue existing. If you are a Spider-Totem you are now being hunted by the Inheritors. Also, universe-threatening events are common, have fun!
objects.title: Marvel Universe 616

objects.text:
Origins of Powers: Super Science, Genetics, Mutations, X-Gene, Magic, Cosmic Energy

Major Threats: Graviton, Hydra, A.I.M., The Leader, Purple Man, Loki, Ultron, Kang, Kree Empire, Skrull Empire, Annihilus, The Collector, Heralds of Galactus, Galactus

Major Powers: S.H.I.E.L.D., Hydra, A.I.M., The Avengers, New Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy, Asgard, Wakanda, Kree Empire, Skrull Empire

Note: You may enter from anywhere after Captain America's creation. This universe also includes Wolverine and the X-Men, Hulk vs. Thor, Hulk vs. Wolverine, Thor: Tales of Asgard, Marvel Universe: Avengers – Earth's Mightiest Heroes (Vol. 1), and Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes (Vol. 2). It is much lower-powered than the comic versions, though it still possesses its own threats such as Kang and Galactus, and there are certainly other dangers that have not appeared in the show, such as Thanos. The Infinity Stones also exist here, referred to as the Infinity Gems.

Note that you are entering the Marvel multiverse and may encounter dangerous variants of characters from other universes if you venture beyond this one—and perhaps even come face-to-face with some of the most powerful cosmic beings, such as the abstract entities.
objects.title: Marvel Universe 8096

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Metagene
Major Threats: Apocalypse, Galactus, Dark Phoenix

Warning: This setting is extremely dangerous due to the large amount of people, creatures and forces that will try to kill you and do much, much worse as there are a lot of 'Fates worse than death' that can be afflicted in this setting. From simply cutting you into various parts while keeping you alive and in pain for decades, becoming forever lost in an absolute void of darkness, falling into The Abyss, getting devoured by a demon, losing your entire Self or turning into a horror. Even the simple act of telling a Faerie 'sure' when they ask 'Could you give me your name' means the loss of most of your identity and relationships associated with that name. In this setting it can take a long time to get powerful, but losing that power is much too easy.

Note: If you enter this setting with powers or even knowledge of the forces in this world, then you're likely to get glimpses of the supernatural, and thus be pulled into it, becoming Aware. Should you not interact with these forces and hold off on using your powers, then you might largely remain unaffected, with only the knowledge that there's something more to it. However, should you use your powers and try to interact with the supernatural, then you're likely to lose a lot of your Innocence, the force protecting you and all other unaware from the Others that seek to use, kill and harvest you. It is then best to have your Awakening, granting you access to the Practice, but beware, for once that door opens, it may never be closed. Forcing you to follow the rules of the Practice, like always staying truthful lest you be forsworn, which means becoming a karmic sinkhole and losing your Practice.

Note: The average Persona user can easily use their Personas in the various cognitive worlds (3's Tartarus, 4's TV World, etc). Using them outside these worlds requires a combination of talent, training, grit, and a general disregard for the norm. Those blessed by Philemon (like in P1 & P2) are capable of doing this easier than the non-blessed, but it is possible without a blessing.

Note 2: SMTV and Persona share a core magic system. The main difference lies in P3’s three different Physical Skill types (Slash, Pierce, Bash) and P5's Gun, Psychokinetic & Nuclear Skills. Another is the name of the Wind Skills (SMT = Zan, Persona = Garu).

Note 3: You can can choose your point of entry to be any of the games.

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Little Garden, Outer Worlds, Spiritual Essence, Gifts, Merit, Eschatology, Species
Major Threats: Last Embryo, Eschatology,[Ouroboros],[Absolute Evil],[Closed-Off World],[Winds of Decadence]
Major Powers: 2-Digit Entities, 3-Digit Entities, 4-Digit Entities, [Thousand Eyes], [Avatära], [Divine Army], [Avalon]

Note: The geometry of Little Garden is a flat plane with the surface area of a spherical star.

Your existence in the Outer Worlds is reflected into your spiritual essence, giving you existence and substance in Little Garden.

The Outer Worlds consist an infinite number of parallel worlds from past, present and future, which follow the historical transitions represented through the events in the Third Observable Universe, also known as Little Garden.

Communities represent forces in Outer Worlds, such as Thousand Eyes representing America, or Avalon representing Britain. When these communities suffer losses, this is reflected across the forces it represents in the Outer Worlds, such as if a large amount of people in Thousand Eyes died, then a large population of America in all Outer Worlds would die. 

The above also applies individually, meaning that if Apollo were to die in Little Garden, there would be a lack of worship or influence of Apollo in all Outer Worlds. 

4-Digit, also known as the Divine Domain, is a level of spiritual essence that can allow characters to trigger Paradigm Shifts, causing Historical Transition Periods.

3-Digit, also known as the Almighty Domain is a level of spiritual essence where they possess universal reality warping and limited omnipotence in any universe in the Outer Worlds, only limited through the Omnipotence Paradox and End Emptiness.

2-Digit, also known as Full Authority Domain. Beings of this level of spiritual essence lack the restriction of the Omnipotence Paradox.
objects.title: Problem Children Are Coming From Another World

objects.text: Origin of Powers: Singularities, EGO, Distortion, Shin Major Threats: The Head, Wings, The Fingers, Abnormalities, Distortions, Carmen Major Powers: The Head, Wings, The Fingers, Seed of Light, Colored Fixers, Fixer Associations, The Library Note: Set in a dystopian cyberpunk called The City (A mega city the size of a country). The City is divided into 26 districts with each district being ruled by a single Mega Corporation called a Wing. Each Wing has their own technology called a Singularity (Like Warp travel for W corp, or Healing nanotechnology for K corp). District are divided into the Nest (center of a Wing) and the Backstreets (slums). The Backstreets are ruled by Syndicates (Gangs) and Fixer Offices (Mercenaries) The City is ruled by the Head (A, B, and C corp). A.I. is outlawed and anything inhuman will be disposed of. Guns are heavily taxed to reduce use. Everyone from the strongest Syndicates to the mightiest Wings pay their taxes to the Head. If you are not human the Head will target you, either to kill you or kick you out of The City. Taking the Perk Humanity will suffice to offset this. You will also be vulnerable to the Distortion Phenomenon where if you experience something akin to a Trigger Event and become overwhelmed by despair you will turn into a Distortion (a monstrous transformation both in body and mind embodying your traumas), but if you were to instead rise above your woes and reaffirm your goals you instead gain EGO (a manifestation of your convictions in the form of an equipment with special powers)
objects.title: Project Moon

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Natural Talent / Specialized Training / Underground Experimentation
Major Threats: Underground Organizations / Elite Fighters / Corrupt Authorities
Major Powers: Workers, Elite, The Affiliates, Government Black Ops Units, Viral Fight Networks, School Crews, Underground Academies
Super Abilities: Unparalleled Combat Mastery, Peak-to-Superhuman Physical Conditioning, Superhuman Talents and Abilites
Note: The PTJ Verse represents a shared universe of interconnected stories that push the limits of grounded combat realism into hyper-stylized martial drama. While characters technically remain within the realm of “human,” their capabilities often stretch plausibility—such as tanking blunt force trauma that would cripple normal people, delivering bone-shattering blows, or mastering dozens of fighting styles with ruthless precision. This setting includes series such as Lookism, Viral Hit (also known as How to Fight), Questism, Manager Kim, My Life as a Loser, and Study Group. Most high-tier combatants rank between Brute 1 to Brute 3 and a combat Thinker rating of 1 to 2 with mobility-based fighters often reach Mover 1 to Mover 2. Select individuals flirt with Stranger 1  rating and many show a minor, passive Breaker 1 rating on how their body interacts with physics.
objects.title: PTJ Verse

objects.text: Origin of powers: Magic, Esper Abilities, Technology. Major Threats: Dark Side of Academy City, Magic Gods, Coronzon, Gremlin, God's Right Seat, CRC. Anyone born here is capable of learning and practising magic or going through the Power Curriculum Program and gaining esper powers; that would include you if you are a Character-Insert or Reincarnation. Unless purchased here, magic fundamentally conflicts with esper abilities, resulting in internal damage to the user. The use of this setting's magic produces Sparks, which affect destiny and fortune, resulting in predetermined fate, the effects of which vary and may range from stubbing your toe to destined death from illness.

Major Threats: Daemons, The Watcher, Void Worms, Void Liquid, Echoes, The Solution, The Saint, The Prince, Iterators

Major Powers: Iterator Groups, Scavenger Tribes, Slugcat Tribes

Start: You may choose to arrive at any point in the base game and Downpour timeline, from The Spearmaster's time all the way to The Saint's time.

Note: Every creature in this world, bound within The Cycle, a phenomenon that stops people from truly dying. The exact mechanics of The Cycle have been left ambiguous, it could be some form of resurrection, reincarnation or even recursion through time. You too are bound within The Cycle.

Far beneath the ground is the Void Sea, this liquid has the power to free beings from The Cycle, allowing their souls to be laid to rest, though those with strong desires may return as Echoes. Additionally the world slowly crumbles into this sea, this doesn't mean the end of the world, as dust falls from the sky to replace lost matter.

Outside of normal reality is Ripplespace, it is where Daemons dwell, these monolith like beings directly preside over The Cycle.

Origin of Powers: Dimensional Rifts, Ley Lines, Magic Resurgence, Mutations, Alien Technology

Major Threats: The Splugorth, Vampire Intelligences in Mexico and South America, The Phoenix Empire, Xiticix swarms, The Coalition States, The Minion War, Alien Intelligences, Dimensional Invaders

Major Powers: Coalition States, Federation of Magic, Tolkeen, Lazlo & New Lazlo, Atlantis, Free Quebec, Northern Gun, Manistique Imperium, Iron Heart, Pecos Empire

Note: On 2098 AD, Earth was irrevocably changed by the Great Cataclysm, a cascading apocalypse triggered when nuclear wars and mass death on an unprecedented scale overloaded the planet’s latent ley line network. Dimensional rifts tore open across the globe, permanently scarring the planet and creating stable gateways to countless worlds and planes. The result was the rebirth of magic, the resurgence of psionics, and the arrival of alien beings (D-Bees) who found themselves stranded on Earth.

This reshaping of the planet left Earth both richer and more dangerous than any other world in the Megaverse. Vast ley lines and nexus points saturate the landscape, empowering sorcerers and psychics alike while warping the laws of reality. Ancient gods, alien intelligences, and extradimensional empires now see Earth as the ultimate crossroads of existence.

Consider 2098 as the Start of powers for this CYOA, so 1982.
objects.title: Rifts (Palladium Books)

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Luminescence(Lifeforce), Sacred Seals

Major Threats: The Demon Blight, The Co-Existers

Major Powers: The Demon Blight, The Co-Existers, The Crypt of Gray Lights, The Goddesses, The Federated Kingdom, The Order of Holy Knights, The Church


Note: Humanity has waged war against the Demon Blight for centuries; half of humankind has been wiped out, and half of the world being infected. The reason humanity has survived so long is because of the Goddesses—beings who appeared during the Great Civilized Era, at the time of the First War of Subjugation, to fight the Blight. There are also the Co-Existers, who sabotage humanity's efforts to fight the Blight, and the Crypt of Gray Lights, which wages a shadow war against them.

Note 2: As this world's population possesses no inherent supernatural abilities, anyone using powers openly will come under intense scrutiny. The military may attempt to capture and experiment on you, while the Church will denounce you as a heretic, as only their Goddesses can wield supernatural abilities without the use of Sacred Seals.
objects.title: Sentenced to be a Hero

objects.text:
Origin of Powers: Soul Essence, The Nightmare Spell

Major Threats: Nightmare Creatures, Nightmare Gates, Fate, ████

Major Powers: The Sovereigns, Three Great Legacy Clans, Legacy Clans, Government

Super Abilities: Aspect Abilities

Note: Humanity is in a losing war with the Nightmare creatures. Most of the world has already fallen to Corruption or the weapons deployed by humanity in their desperation, with only Asia, Australia, Africa, and Antarctica still being relatively habitable.

Megacities now dominate much of the landscape left behind, being the only places humanity can survive in this sundered world; with their Outskirts, they continue to devour and grind away human lives under their weight every day just to survive the onslaught of this horrid war.

Lower-ranked Nightmare Creatures are resistant to most mundane weaponry, with higher-ranked ones being more or less immune to all forms of mundane weaponry. Only weapons infused with Soul Essence and the Awakened can combat them, susceptible to Memories and unarmed attacks of the Awakened because of their command over this mystical energy. Worry not; your powers will work against them, regardless of Soul Essence and origin.

All your powers, alongside some self-targeted perks and drawbacks, will be integrated into your Spell Status Page to the best of its ability (if you get infected with the Spell). Receiving the aid of the Spell will bind all your powers to your soul and your fate to the Spell itself.

You won't have to worry about losing your powers, even if you were to tear yourself from the Spell right afterward.

addons.text: Guess whose back, back again, Doofy's back. Tell a Friend~! Alright, so you remember how you were going to a slasherverse with all those psychos running around killing people, some of them being chopped up. Well, there's been a change in plans, as now the world is more in line with those parody movies of classic horror: Scary Movie, Scary Movie 2, Scary Movie 3, Haunted House 2. I mean, people still be dying, but there's no reason they all can't have some fun before then; this also means stuff will be a bit silly, with blocks of ice where hearts should be, cartoon gags, and random cameos from familiar franchises... so don't be surprised if you get run over by those pretty boys from Supernatural. On the bright side, offering some good drugs and snacks might be enough to get an ancient evil or two to chill out for another aeon, or just talking about their feelings being what stops a psycho from killing people so they can make peace... before having their heads caved in by some random ass.
addons.title: It's a Haunted Scary Addon!

objects.text: Origin of Powers: Magic, Technology, Demonic Forces, Gods. Major Threats: Deadites, Dream Demons, Dark Ones, Numerous Serial Killers of varying levels of threat, Cults, other Dimensions, and Many More. Major Powers: Freddy Krueger, Michael Myers, Jason Voorhees and potentially his whole family, Charles Lee Ray (Chucky), Ash Williams, Survivors, Cannibals, Cults, etc. Notes: This setting is a composite of various Slasher media, with Evil Dead, Nightmare on Elm Street, Friday the 13th, Halloween, Child's Play, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Psycho, and Dexter being central. However, they need not be the only ones, as any Slasher/Horror media are acceptable so long as they fit, such as the Puppet Master series. Killers are divided into several categories, such as being territorial (remaining in one location as their hunting grounds), nomadic (constantly moving about), or being conditional (requiring whatever condition to be met to be targeted or to spur the killer into action). While most threats may be harder than normal human killers, there are numerous greater threats, such as beings able to target the souls of others. But with preparation, skill, and luck, you could survive… maybe. There is no certainty with what could be lurking in the dark.
objects.title: SlasherVerse (Composite World)

objects.text:
Origin of power: Mana

Major power: Monarch, Ruler, various Earth nations with their hunter, and Sung Jinwoo

Major threat: Monarch and monster coming from the gate

Note: You can enter this world at the beginning of Solo Leveling when Jinwoo enters the double dungeon, or at the start of Solo Leveling: Ragnarok.

Gates containing monsters can appear anywhere, and if a dungeon break occurs, the monsters inside can spill out, attacking civilians and causing mass casualties. 

Hunter power is fixed at the point of their awakening and it is almost impossible for them to further increase their power unless they undergo a reawakening. If you choose to reincarnate in the setting then you have a chance of awakening and becoming a hunter and if you possess any shardless magical power you are guaranteed to be awakened into a hunter and you can bypass the limitations of other hunters and train to increase your own power.

The Monarchs aim to conquer Earth and destroy humanity to rebuild their depleted army and continue their war against the Rulers. Monarchs are immensely powerful beings capable of destroying planets with ease.

You have just under 1.5 years before the Monarchs arrive on Earth, regardless of whether Sung Jinwoo can save the world. Mass death on a global scale is inevitable as a result of the Monarchs' actions unless you do something to stop them.

Origin of Powers: Science, biology

Major Threats: The WAU and its creations

Notes: The Earth of SOMA is set in 2103, after a meteor hit the Iberian Peninsula, and wrecked the world with the massive tsunamis and the dust caused by the impact. Surface life is very likely completely extinct sans the odd shelter that manages to survive, with only marine life thriving for now. The only active threat you may find is the WAU - a non-sentient AI that tries to preserve human life, in its own alien way - and its creations around PATHOS-II.

objects.text:
Origins of powers: Advanced Biology, Psionics, Science, Alien Technology.

Major threats: The Goa’uld, Ori/Ancients (Same Species), Anubis, Priors, Replicators, Wraith, Achen, and Asuran.

Major Powers: The Goa’uld have a chokehold over the milky way galaxy, and are only being kept in check by the bluff of the Asgard, who are more technologically advanced. The replicators are an ever-present threat to Asgard, as they are able to adapt and consume any technology that they come across. In the Pegasus Galaxy, humans are being used as cattle, and the Wraith use them as food to stay young and grow their ships from their corpses. In the original galaxy of the Ancients, who have ascended to a higher plane and gained reality-warping abilities, the Ori have set themselves up as gods, absorbing the faith of the humans as energy to boost the control they have over reality. 

Super Abilities: Reality Warping, Genius Intellect, Psionics.

Note: Time travel works differently in this world than others, as the main characters use it often to redo past mistakes, and reality is often overwritten as time corrects itself. The Ancients, while having a rule about interfering with mortal life, some of them disobey and the Ori could be a threat if given the chance.
objects.title: Stargate

This changes if you decide to explore the galaxy through FTL travel, in that case you might be discovered by Gems, labeled a rebel if you interfere with them and thus be hunted by them.

objects.text:
Source of Powers: Biotech (science derived from biology), Cognitech (cognitive technology, ranging from smart people on the low side to augmented reality implants on the medium side to supercomputer implants on the high end) , Metatech (Social science like psychology or sociology), Nanotech (precision, technology on extremely small scales), and Stringtech (String theory based science, think nukes and wormholes). 

Major Threats: Societal Instability. There are countless civilizations throughout the universe, "Cargo Cults" made up of people in worlds where their technology broke down, and Artificial Intelligence Aliens, or the Aia, who seem to constantly be at war. 

Major Powers: The Transcendentals (Artificial Intelligence capable of seeing the future, and thus are in the future due to computer science simply being information, this is also not a deterministic universe, so it's complicated. Their goal is to share their unique perspective with the rest of the universe, thinking that'd bring peace. Specifically all of it, they won't compromise and give it to individuals), the Patent Office (Ran by the Transcendentals, in this world, the primary currency is ideas), the Aia (highly advanced artificial intelligence), the fourteen dominant civilizations throughout the universe, and the Skodati (Similarly advanced to humanity, these aliens made up of Dark Matter are extremely hard to interact with, but communication through gravity waves has been established). 

Note: The Transcendentals of this universe are comparable to a Baby Entity, such that they could theoretically pose a threat to Scion. Unfortunately, they are not aware of Scion, since his Thinker power jamming works against them, so you'll need to warn them of him without attracting attention from Scion if you are to have a decent chance.
objects.title: Sufficiently Advanced

Origin of Powers: Technology, Magic, Genetics, Mutations, Okta Particles, Project Imagine, Inherited from Prophets

Note: The Super String Universe is a shared world connecting various webtoons, such as Terror Man, Revival Man, Terror vs. Revival, Housekeeper, Neolithic Girl, The Queens, Jungle Juice, Electronics Horror Store, Island, Kangtawoo, and Distant Sky, among others.

You may arrive at any point corresponding to the beginning of any Super String webtoon. This setting is actually a multiverse, with many stories taking place in separate dimensions — such as Housekeeper — although interdimensional travel is possible.

This world is filled with countless creatures and threats, ranging from world-conquering aliens and super robots with nuclear-level power to ghosts, undead, near-omnipotent demons, and even gods. If you choose to arrive in the main dimension, be aware that in the future it will undergo an apocalypse, bringing humanity to the brink of extinction as depicted in Distant Sky.
objects.title: Super String

Even before that point, if you interfere with the Winchesters or any major players/plot points in the story, God will take notice, and He will not tolerate those who disrupt His plan. Therefore, it is highly recommended that you take Blank to avoid His detection.

Origin of Powers: Advanced Technology, Singularity Levels

Time: 10,600 After Tranquility (AT)

Alternate Starts: 566 AT (Technocalypse)

1200 AT (Federation of Sophonts)

3200-5200 AT (Inner Sphere Era)

10515 AT (Oracle War)

Note: Your comfort and safety can vary enormously based on your starting location. The Terragen Sphere contains everything from hedonistic communities managed by superintelligences to direct democratic societies to utterly cruel regimes.

A notable feature of this universe is the massive physical and psychological flexibility available to sapient beings. If you arrived in a cosmopolitan location with a baseline humanoid body, it would require only routine procedures to transform yourself into a horse-sized spider, a sapient plant, a robot (vec), or an uploaded digital consciousness.

The process of Ascension to a higher Singularity Level involves a qualitative expansion in reasoning, grasp of concepts, etc as well as raw speed and memory. Thus a mind with arbitrarily large computing power may still be classified at the 0th Singularity, and depending on the problem assigned, such a mind could potentially be out-thought by a 1st Singularity transapient.

Note: This world is functionally similar to the Warhammer Fantasy universe except with different lore, culture, and history, and it has a 9th Age that not everyone died in (like Storm of Chaos if it was still canon). This is a VERY grimdark world you are going to. Good luck.

You can choose which age you want to enter, though beware that the end of the 8th age is a very heated one where a literal goddess would join the war.
